articles.title: South Korean 'robot dog' became first to run a marathon on a single battery charge — now we know how
articles.author: Alan Bradley

paras.en: A four-legged robot completed a full marathon on a single battery charge, covering 26.2 miles (42.2 kilometers) on a hilly public-road course in South Korea two years ago. Now we know a lot more about how it achieved this record-breaking feat.
paras.zh: 两年前，一台四足机器人在韩国的一条丘陵公路上完成了单次电池充电的全程马拉松，全程26.2英里（ 42.2公里）。现在，我们对它如何实现这一创纪录的壮举有了更多的了解。

paras.en: The dog-like robot, called RAIBO2, finished the 22nd annual Sangju Dried-Persimmon Marathon in just over 4 hours, 19 minutes. The bot's developers say it's the first quadruped robot to have completed an official marathon-distance event without stopping to recharge. They're commonly referred to as "robot dogs" because the movement of their joints in both front and hind legs resembles that of canines.
paras.zh: 这个名为RAIBO2的狗形机器人在短短4小时19分钟内完成了第22届年度尚州干柿马拉松比赛。该机器人的开发人员表示，这是第一个在不停下来充电的情况下完成官方马拉松距离赛事的四足机器人。它们通常被称为“机器狗” ，因为它们的前腿和后腿的关节运动类似于犬科动物。

paras.en: The scientists outlined their findings about the robot's feat, which it achieved Nov. 17, 2024, in a study published Sept. 23 in the journal Nature.
paras.zh: 科学家们在9月23日发表在《自然》杂志上的一项研究中概述了他们对机器人壮举的发现，该壮举于2024年11月17日实现。

paras.en: This achievement represented a new milestone in overcoming a critical limitation for quadruped robots: endurance. Although four-legged robots can cross difficult terrain that wheeled machines struggle to traverse (like stairs and rugged trails), their endurance has been limited because powering multiple joints while repeatedly lifting and stabilizing the machine's body consumes huge amounts of energy.
paras.zh: 这一成就代表着克服四足机器人关键限制的新里程碑：耐力。尽管四足机器人可以穿越轮式机器难以穿越的困难地形（例如楼梯和崎岖的小路），但它们的耐力受到限制，因为在反复提升和稳定机器身体的同时为多个关节提供动力会消耗大量能量。

paras.en: "Unlike wheeled robots, quadrupeds continuously expend energy at their joints to support body weight and incur kinetic energy losses during intermittent foot-ground contact," the researchers wrote in the study.
paras.zh: 研究人员在研究中写道：“与轮式机器人不同，四足动物在关节处不断消耗能量来支撑体重，并在间歇性脚与地面接触期间产生动能损失。”

paras.en: RAIBO2's race was a demanding real-world trial. It took place during the Sangju Dried-Persimmon Marathon, with the bot racing alongside human participants. The route covered two 50-meter [164 feet] elevation climbs, with slopes of up to 10 degrees. Those kinds of gradients put increased strain on the robot's energy resources, stress-testing the bot's battery management capabilities, the scientists said.
paras.zh: RAIBO2的比赛是一场苛刻的现实世界试验。它发生在Sangju Dried-Persimmon马拉松比赛期间，机器人与人类参与者一起比赛。这条路线覆盖了两个50米（ 164英尺）的高度攀登，斜坡高达10度。科学家们说，这些梯度对机器人的能源造成了更大的压力，对机器人的电池管理能力进行了压力测试。

paras.en: RAIBO2 had previously run a 26.7-mile (43 km), GPS-guided route across a flat athletic field, which it knocked out in 4 hours, 40 minutes on one charge. However, an earlier marathon attempt across uneven terrain against other competitors had to be aborted around the 23-mile (37 km) mark after the robot's battery ran out. The robot's developers attributed that shortfall in part to frequent pace changes as the machine attempted to adjust to the pace of nearby runners.
paras.zh: RAIBO2 此前曾在 GPS 引导下在平坦的运动场上跑过 26.7 英里（43 公里）的路线，一次充电只用了 4 小时 40 分钟就跑完了。然而，早些时候，在机器人电池耗尽后，在不平坦的地形上与其他参赛者进行的马拉松尝试在 23 英里（37 公里）大关附近不得不中止。该机器人的开发人员将这种不足部分归因于频繁的配速变化，因为机器试图适应附近跑步者的配速。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: To compensate, the team boosted the robot's battery capacity by 33% and tinkered with the control system, including implementing joint-stiffness control at the actuator. This allowed the bot to soften its leg when it had to absorb an impact or it needed a stable, forceful push-off. After the adjustments, RAIBO2 expanded to a maximum range of 41.6 miles (67 km) on a single charge, albeit on straight paths, according to the researchers.
paras.zh: 作为补偿，该团队将机器人的电池容量提高了33% ，并对控制系统进行了修补，包括在执行器上实施关节刚度控制。这使得机器人在必须吸收冲击或需要稳定、有力的推力时能够软化其腿部。根据研究人员的说法，在调整后， RAIBO2一次充电的最大范围扩展到41.6英里（ 67公里） ，尽管是在直线路径上。

paras.en: Another key metric was RAIBO2's total cost of transport — a measure of the energy required to move a body over a given distance, with lower values indicating less energy expended. Researchers reported that RAIBO2 achieved a total cost of transport of 0.25, compared with a human benchmark of 0.37. The researchers said their machine was the first quadruped robot to surpass that figure.
paras.zh: 另一个关键指标是RAIBO2的总运输成本—衡量在给定距离内移动身体所需的能量，较低的值表示消耗的能量较少。研究人员报告说， RAIBO2的总运输成本为0.25 ，而人体基准为0.37。研究人员表示，他们的机器是第一个超过这一数字的四足机器人。

paras.en: The team attributed that efficiency to several optimizations across RAIBO2's software and hardware. Especially vital were its lightweight mechanical components, which were capable of transmitting kinetic energy from its joints with very little interference. They also credited a low-loss motor-driving circuit and, on the software side, a locomotion policy specifically streamlined to limit energy use. The system was also trained using the team's simulation environment, called RaiSim, which includes models of slopes, stairs and icy roads.

paras.en: Like many electric vehicles, RAIBO2 can regenerate some battery by capturing kinetic energy, particularly while traveling downhill. That capability allows it to offset some of the energy it expends while climbing, though it doesn't eliminate the extra cost of hilly terrain.
paras.zh: 像许多电动汽车一样， RAIBO2可以通过捕获动能来再生一些电池，特别是在下坡行驶时。这种能力可以抵消攀登时消耗的一些能量，尽管它不能消除丘陵地形的额外成本。

paras.en: The researchers said RAIBO2 has more than three times the travel range per charge of existing quadruped robots, with a total battery capacity of 2,016 watt-hours. It's in part because of that capacity increase that the team now estimates that the robot could travel up to 15.5 miles (25 km) farther than its marathon stint, up to a total of 41.6 miles (67 km).
paras.zh: 研究人员表示， RAIBO2每次充电的行驶里程是现有四足机器人的三倍以上，总电池容量为2,016瓦时。部分原因是容量增加，该团队现在估计机器人可以比马拉松跑步长15.5英里（ 25公里） ，总长达41.6英里（ 67公里）。

paras.en: That kind of endurance could broaden the roles for quadruped robots in places where wheeled models are impractical, the developers added in the study. For example, they could be useful in disaster zones and mountainous areas, where a sufficiently mobile, high-endurance robot could carry cameras, sensors or communications gear across uneven terrain.
paras.zh: 开发人员在研究中补充说，这种耐力可以扩大四足机器人在轮式模型不切实际的地方的作用。例如，它们可能在灾区和山区有用，在那里，一个足够机动的高耐力机器人可以在不平坦的地形上携带摄像头、传感器或通信设备。

paras.en: Lee, C., Youm, D., Park, J., Lee, J., Choi, S., Ji, G., Mun, J., Jung, M., Choi, H. C., Kim, H., Oh, H., Nam, K., Lee, M., Hur, J., Choi, D., Kim, D., An, Y., & Hwangbo, J. (2026). A quadruped robot designed to complete a marathon on a single battery charge. Nature. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-11102-5
paras.zh: Lee, C., Youm, D., Park, J., Lee, J., Choi, S., Ji, G., Mun, J., Jung, M., Choi, H. C., Kim, H., Oh, H., Nam, K., Lee, M., Hur, J., Choi, D., Kim, D., An, Y., & Hwangbo, J. (2026).四足机器人，专为单次充电完成马拉松而设计。性质。https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-11102-5

articles.title: Bronze ring with Lighthouse of Alexandria engraving discovered at palace on submerged island in Egypt
articles.author: Owen Jarus

paras.en: A bronze signet ring depicting the Lighthouse of Alexandria, a wonder of the ancient world, has been discovered underwater in the Mediterranean off Alexandria, Egypt.
paras.zh: 在埃及亚历山大附近的地中海水下发现了一枚描绘古代世界奇迹亚历山大灯塔的青铜图章戒指。

paras.en: A joint team from the European Institute for Underwater Archaeology (IEASM) and the Egyptian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities found the artifact in the remains of a palace on the now-submerged island of Antirhodos, marking the first time a signet ring featuring the image of the lighthouse has been found, the IEASM team said in a statement.
paras.zh: 欧洲水下考古研究所（IEASM）和埃及旅游和文物部的联合小组在一份声明中表示，在现已被淹没的安蒂罗多斯岛一座宫殿的废墟中发现了这件文物，这是首次发现带有灯塔图像的图章戒指。

paras.en: The image on the ring is similar to depictions of the lighthouse that have been previously found on coins dating to the second century, representatives of IEASM said.
paras.zh: IEASM 的代表表示，戒指上的图像与之前在二世纪硬币上发现的灯塔图案相似。

paras.en: "The discovery of the ring-signet is even more important as it has been excavated in the legendary palace of the Island of Antirhodos, that once was a centre of power," Franck Goddio, president of IEASM, said in the emailed statement.
paras.zh: IEASM 主席弗兰克·戈迪奥 (Franck Goddio) 在电子邮件声明中表示：“戒指印章的发现更为重要，因为它是在曾经是权力中心的安蒂罗多斯岛传奇宫殿中出土的。”

paras.en: The palace was used by Egyptian pharaohs who reigned during the Ptolemaic period (304 to 30 B.C.), a dynasty of rulers descended from one of Alexander the Great's generals. The lighthouse was built on the island of Pharos around 280 B.C. and stood more than 328 feet (100 meters) tall. Some ancient writers, such as Pliny the Elder, considered it among the wonders of the world, and it continued to be used into the Middle Ages, until earthquakes and erosion resulted in its destruction and disappearance beneath the sea.
paras.zh: 这座宫殿曾被托勒密王朝（公元前 304 年至公元前 30 年）统治时期的埃及法老使用过，该王朝的统治者是亚历山大大帝的一位将军的后裔。灯塔建于公元前 280 年左右，建于法罗斯岛上。身高超过 328 英尺（100 米）。一些古代作家，如老普林尼，将其视为世界奇迹之一，并一直被使用到中世纪，直到地震和侵蚀导致其被破坏并消失在海底。

paras.en: While the lighthouse was modified over time, it would have had a statue, possibly of Zeus, at the top holding an oil lamp that helped guide mariners.
paras.zh: 虽然灯塔随着时间的推移进行了改造，但它的顶部有一座雕像，可能是宙斯，手持一盏油灯，帮助引导水手。

paras.en: Whoever was wearing a signet ring could have used it to make an impression on soft materials, such as clay and wax, to create a seal. The discovery of the ring in the remains of the palace at Antirhodos suggests that the palace was used for administrative functions related to the lighthouse, representatives of IEASM said in the statement.
paras.zh: 无论谁戴着印章戒指，都可以用它在粘土和蜡等柔软材料上留下印记，以形成印章。IEASM的代表在声明中表示，在安提罗多斯宫殿遗址中发现的戒指表明，这座宫殿用于与灯塔相关的行政职能。

paras.en: Even though the ring's engraving is somewhat worn, it likely depicts the lighthouse, said Doris Behrens-Abouseif, a professor emeritus of history of art and archaeology at the University of London who has written about the lighthouse but was not part of the research team.
paras.zh: 伦敦大学艺术史和考古学名誉教授多丽丝·贝伦斯-阿布塞夫 (Doris Behrens-Abouseif) 表示，尽管戒指的雕刻有些磨损，但它很可能描绘的是灯塔。多丽丝·贝伦斯-阿布塞夫曾撰写过有关灯塔的文章，但不是研究团队的成员。

paras.en: There are "thousands of coins from Alexandria showing a similar depiction of the lighthouse," she told Live Science in an email. Those coins date to the Ptolemaic or Roman (29 B.C. to A.D. 395) periods, she noted.
paras.zh: 她在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》，“来自亚历山大的数千枚硬币上都有类似的灯塔描绘”。她指出，这些硬币的历史可以追溯到托勒密或罗马时期（公元前 29 年至公元 395 年）。

paras.en: Behrens-Abouseif added that she wasn't familiar enough with rings from Alexandria to comment on whether this is the only ring that contains this image.
paras.zh: 贝伦斯-阿布塞夫补充说，她对来自亚历山大的戒指不够熟悉，无法评论这是否是唯一包含此图像的戒指。

paras.en: Other scholars told Live Science that they, too, believe that this ring depicts the lighthouse, with two scholars noting that it may feature smoke coming from a lamp at top.
paras.zh: 其他学者告诉Live Science ，他们也认为这枚戒指描绘了灯塔，两位学者指出它可能有来自顶部灯泡的烟雾。

paras.en: The "most interesting thing about the new signet ring engraved gem is an asymmetrical feature at its peak," which "may depict a plume of smoke from the oil lamp in the hand of the crowning statue," Andrew Chugg, an independent researcher who wrote the book "The Pharos Lighthouse in Alexandria: Second Sun and Seventh Wonder of Antiquity" (Routledge, 2024), said in an email.
paras.zh: “新的图章戒指雕刻宝石最有趣的地方是其顶部的不对称特征”，“可能描绘了加冕雕像手中的油灯冒出的缕缕烟雾”，《亚历山大法罗斯灯塔：第二太阳和古代第七奇迹》（Routledge，2024）一书的独立研究员安德鲁·查格（Andrew Chugg）在一封电子邮件中说。

paras.en: Margaret Miles, a professor emeritus of art history and classics at the University of California, Irvine, also noticed the possible plume of smoke. Miles noted in an email that this "ring could have been used as a signet ring by a merchant from Alexandria who used the profile of the [lighthouse] to signal his location in Alexandria. The lighthouse was famous, so it became a symbol of the city."
paras.zh: 加州大学欧文分校艺术史和古典学名誉教授玛格丽特·迈尔斯也注意到了可能存在的烟雾。迈尔斯在一封电子邮件中指出，这枚戒指“可能被一位来自亚历山大的商人用作图章戒指，他利用灯塔的轮廓来表明他在亚历山大的位置。这座灯塔很有名，所以它成为了这座城市的象征。”

paras.en: Research off the coast of Alexandria over the past few years, including the discovery of 22 massive blocks, has revealed more information about the lighthouse, including how exactly it looked, which is helping researchers who are trying to digitally reconstruct it.
paras.zh: 过去几年，亚历山大海岸附近的研究，包括发现了 22 个巨大的灯塔，揭示了有关灯塔的更多信息，包括它的外观，这正在帮助试图以数字方式重建灯塔的研究人员。

paras.en: Are you a fan of mummies and hieroglyphs? Find out with our ancient Egypt quiz!
paras.zh: 您是木乃伊和象形文字的粉丝吗？通过我们的古埃及测验找出答案！

paras.en: Owen Jarus is a regular contributor to Live Science who writes about archaeology and humans' past. He has also written for The Independent (UK), The Canadian Press (CP) and The Associated Press (AP), among others. Owen has a bachelor of arts degree from the University of Toronto and a journalism degree from Ryerson University.
paras.zh: 欧文·贾鲁斯 (Owen Jarus) 是《Live Science》的定期撰稿人，撰写有关考古学和人类过去的文章。他还为《独立报》（英国）、加拿大通讯社 (CP) 和美联社 (AP) 等撰稿。欧文拥有多伦多大学文学学士学位和瑞尔森大学新闻学学位。

articles.title: 'October is the ideal time to get vaccinated': Flu season is kicking off early, experts say
articles.author: Olivia Maule

paras.en: Flu season is off to an early start in some parts of the U.S., data shows.
paras.zh: 数据显示，美国部分地区的流感季节提前开始。

paras.en: In a typical year, U.S. flu activity starts building in late fall — typically in October or November — and peaks between December and February. This year, flu activity is currently low but rising nationwide: During the week ending Sept. 26, 3.4% of respiratory samples tested by clinical labs were positive for flu, according to Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) data.
paras.zh: 在典型的年份中，美国流感活动在秋末开始增加——通常是在十月或十一月——并在十二月至二月之间达到高峰。今年，流感活动目前较低，但全国范围内有所上升：根据美国疾病控制与预防中心 (CDC) 的数据，在截至 9 月 26 日的一周内，临床实验室检测的呼吸道样本中有 3.4% 呈流感阳性。

paras.en: That's about seven times the rate that was seen at the same point last year. About 0.5% of samples tested positive during the week ending Sept. 27, 2025.
paras.zh: 这大约是去年同期的七倍。截至 2025 年 9 月 27 日的一周内，约 0.5% 的样本检测呈阳性。

paras.en: "This particular year, it appears to be starting early — like right now," Dr. William Schaffner, a professor of preventive medicine and infectious diseases at Vanderbilt Health in Tennessee, told Live Science. Patients at clinics in his area are already testing positive for flu, he said.
paras.zh: 田纳西州范德比尔特健康中心预防医学和传染病教授威廉·沙夫纳博士告诉《生活科学》杂志：“今年，它似乎开始得很早——就像现在一样。”他说，他所在地区诊所的患者流感检测结果已经呈阳性。

paras.en: The early uptick in flu is mostly unfolding in Western states, including Washington, California and Arizona. In Washington, for example, the share of emergency department visits diagnosed as flu climbed from 0.25% in the week ending Aug. 29 to 1.34% in the week ending Oct. 3, according to CDC emergency department data. That's a more than fivefold increase over six weeks.
paras.zh: 流感的早期上升主要发生在西部各州，包括华盛顿州、加利福尼亚州和亚利桑那州。例如，根据 CDC 急诊科数据，在华盛顿，诊断为流感的急诊科就诊比例从截至 8 月 29 日当周的 0.25% 攀升至截至 10 月 3 日当周的 1.34%。六周内增加了五倍多。

paras.en: Where the flu took off first isn't a warning sign in itself, Schaffner noted.
paras.zh: 沙夫纳指出，流感首先爆发的地方本身并不是一个警告信号。

paras.en: "There's nothing unusual about flu starting in the West Coast and moving east," he said. Recent seasons have more often begun in the Southeast or Midwest, he noted, but "it can start almost anywhere."
paras.zh: 他说：“流感从西海岸开始并向东传播并没有什么不寻常的。”他指出，最近的季节通常在东南部或中西部开始，但“它几乎可以在任何地方开始”。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Nowadays, seasonal flu is caused by three subtypes of flu viruses: two subtypes of influenza A, called H1N1 and H3N2, and the Victoria lineage of influenza B. (A second subtype of influenza B used to circulate but is now thought to be extinct.)
paras.zh: 如今，季节性流感是由三种流感病毒亚型引起：甲型流感的两种亚型，即 H1N1 和 H3N2，以及乙型流感的维多利亚系。（乙型流感的第二种亚型曾经流行，但现在被认为已经灭绝。）

paras.en: Last season, a fast-spreading version of H3N2 known as subclade K dominated. The CDC classified the 2025-2026 season as highly severe for children, as at least 195 children died of flu-related causes.
paras.zh: 上个季节，被称为 K 分支的 H3N2 快速传播版本占据主导地位。疾病预防控制中心将 2025-2026 年流感季节列为对儿童来说非常严重的季节，因为至少有 195 名儿童死于流感相关原因。

paras.en: Schaffner likens influenza A and B to siblings. "They're very related, but they each have their own individual characteristics," he said. Influenza A strains usually cause the biggest outbreaks early in the season, while influenza B strains "kind of smolder along" and account for most cases toward the end, he noted.
paras.zh: 沙夫纳将甲型流感和乙型流感比作兄弟姐妹。 “他们非常相关，但他们都有自己的个性特征，”他说。他指出，甲型流感病毒株通常会在季节初期引起最大的疫情爆发，而乙型流感病毒株“会一直闷烧”，并在临近季节末时造成大多数病例。

paras.en: This year, H1N1 has taken the initial lead. Of the influenza A samples that public health labs subtyped during the week ending Sept. 26, 96% were identified as H1N1, according to CDC data. That doesn't mean H1N1 will continue to dominate throughout the season; it just gives a snapshot of what's happening now.
paras.zh: 今年，H1N1流感已初步领先。根据 CDC 数据，在截至 9 月 26 日的一周内，公共卫生实验室对甲型流感样本进行了亚型分类，其中 96% 被鉴定为 H1N1。这并不意味着 H1N1 流感将继续在整个季节占据主导地位；它只是提供了现在正在发生的事情的快照。

paras.en: The dominant strain matters because flu is "a moving target," said Dr. Paul Offit, director of the Vaccine Education Center at Children's Hospital of Philadelphia. The virus constantly mutates — especially hemagglutinin, the protein on the virus's surface that it uses to latch onto human cells. Hemagglutinin is the main target of flu vaccines.
paras.zh: 费城儿童医院疫苗教育中心主任保罗·奥菲特博士说，主要毒株很重要，因为流感是“一个不断变化的目标”。该病毒不断变异，尤其是血凝素，它是病毒表面的蛋白质，可用来附着在人类细胞上。血凝素是流感疫苗的主要目标。

paras.en: An early start to the season doesn't guarantee it'll be a severe one, either. In its 2026-2027 season outlook, the CDC projected that this season will likely be moderate, although it has only low-to-moderate confidence in that forecast.
paras.zh: 赛季的早期开始也不能保证会是一个艰难的赛季。疾病预防控制中心在其2026-2027年季节展望中预测，本季度可能会温和，尽管它对该预测只有低到中等的信心。

paras.en: Everyone 6 months and older is recommended to get an annual flu vaccine.
paras.zh: 建议 6 个月及以上的每个人每年接种一次流感疫苗。

paras.en: Influenza is especially dangerous for children under 5, adults 65 and older, people with chronic health conditions and pregnant people, as these groups are more prone to severe infections. Serious cases of flu can lead to complications such as pneumonia, sepsis, and brain or heart inflammation, and in some cases, they can be deadly. Tens of thousands of people die of flu each season in the U.S.
paras.zh: 流感对于 5 岁以下儿童、65 岁及以上成人、患有慢性疾病的人和孕妇尤其危险，因为这些群体更容易受到严重感染。严重的流感病例会导致肺炎、败血症、脑部或心脏炎症等并发症，在某些情况下，可能会致命。在美国，每个季节都有数万人死于流感。

paras.en: For flu vaccination, timing matters. The CDC generally doesn't recommend vaccination in July or August for most adults, because the shot's protection can wane over the course of a season. But with flu arriving early, "October is the ideal time to get vaccinated, and even more so right now," Schaffner said.
paras.zh: 对于流感疫苗接种来说，时机很重要。疾病预防控制中心通常不建议大多数成年人在七月或八月接种疫苗，因为疫苗的保护作用可能会随着季节的推移而减弱。但随着流感提前到来，“十月是接种疫苗的理想时间，现在更是如此，”沙夫纳说。

paras.en: When circulating strains' features differ from those captured in the vaccine, "that usually predicts a more difficult season," Offit said. That said, it's too early to know if this year's flu shots are a good match for the circulating flu viruses.
paras.zh: 奥菲特说，当流行毒株的特征与疫苗中捕获的特征不同时，“通常预示着一个更困难的季节”。也就是说，现在判断今年的流感疫苗是否适合流行的流感病毒还为时过早。

paras.en: Protection begins building right after you get the shot, but it takes up to about two weeks to reach full strength.
paras.zh: 注射后，保护作用就开始建立，但需要大约两周的时间才能达到完全强度。

paras.en: How much protection a flu vaccine offers varies by season, depending partly on how well its formulation matches the strains that circulate. Offit said that protection against symptomatic illness varies by age group and that the vaccines are "a little more effective" at preventing more severe illness. In terms of flu cases that prompt people to seek medical care, the shot has been 29% to 56% effective over the past decade, the CDC estimates.
paras.zh: 流感疫苗提供的保护程度因季节而异，部分取决于其配方与流行毒株的匹配程度。奥菲特说，针对症状性疾病的保护作用因年龄组而异，并且疫苗在预防更严重的疾病方面“更有效”。 CDC 估计，在促使人们就医的流感病例方面，过去 10 年注射疫苗的有效率为 29% 至 56%。

paras.en: While the vaccines are less reliable at preventing mild cases of flu, Schaffner said, they work best at "keeping you out of the hospital, keeping you out of the intensive care unit, and keeping you out of the cemetery."
paras.zh: 沙夫纳说，虽然疫苗在预防轻度流感方面不太可靠，但它们在“让你远离医院、让你远离重症监护室、让你远离墓地”方面效果最好。

paras.en: The CDC's 2026-2027 guidance keeps its recommendation of an annual flu vaccine for everyone 6 months and older, with high-dose and adjuvanted shots preferred for adults 65 and older. (Adjuvanted shots contain an extra ingredient to help rev up the immune system.)
paras.zh: CDC 的 2026-2027 年指南保留了对 6 个月及以上的所有人每年接种流感疫苗的建议，65 岁及以上的成年人首选高剂量和佐剂疫苗。 （佐剂注射液含有一种额外的成分，可以帮助增强免疫系统。）

paras.en: There's also a new option: In August, the Food and Drug Administration approved mFlusiva, the first mRNA flu vaccine, for adults 50 and older. (You can find out where mFlusiva shots are available near you using Moderna's vaccine finder.) With the mRNA shot, "you're less likely to get symptomatic disease," Offit told Live Science.
paras.zh: 还有一个新的选择：8 月，美国食品和药物管理局批准了 mFlusiva，这是第一种 mRNA 流感疫苗，适用于 50 岁及以上的成年人。 （您可以使用 Moderna 的疫苗查找器找到您附近哪里可以注射 mFlusiva 疫苗。）通过 mRNA 注射，“您患上症状性疾病的可能性较小，”Offit 告诉 Live Science。

paras.en: Traditional flu shots contain purified pieces of the virus itself, Schaffner explained. With mRNA, the vaccine contains a "blueprint" of those proteins — essentially a set of genetic instructions that the body's cells then use. In mFlusiva's case, those instructions code for hemagglutinin (the protein on the virus's surface that it uses to latch onto human cells) from each of three flu subtypes, Offit said. The mRNA then breaks down in the body, Offit noted. It "cannot influence human genetic material," Schaffner emphasized.

paras.en: Whether this early start gives way to a heavy flu season should become clearer in the coming weeks, as the CDC's weekly surveillance reports will show whether cases keep climbing beyond the West.
paras.zh: 疾病预防控制中心的每周监测报告将显示西方国家以外的病例是否继续攀升，因此，这种早期开始是否会导致严重的流感季节，在未来几周内应该会变得更加清楚。

paras.en: This article is for informational purposes only and is not meant to offer medical advice.
paras.zh: 本文仅供参考，并不旨在提供医疗建议。

paras.en: Olivia Maule is a science journalist whose beats include space, biotechnology and the environment. She holds a B.A. in biology and a B.S. in anthropology from the University of Florida and completed a master's degree in science communication at U.C. Santa Cruz. A 2025 AAAS Mass Media Fellow, she wrote stories and produced videos during a summer at El Nuevo Día, Puerto Rico's largest newspaper, and has written for Eos, Mongabay, Science magazine and Stanford Report. Olivia is a native Spanish and English speaker.
paras.zh: 奥利维亚·莫尔 (Olivia Maule) 是一位科学记者，关注领域包括太空、生物技术和环境。她拥有学士学位。生物学学士学位和学士学位获得佛罗里达大学人类学博士学位，并在加州大学获得科学传播硕士学位。圣克鲁斯。作为 2025 年美国科学促进会大众媒体研究员，她在一个夏天为波多黎各最大的报纸 El Nuevo Día 撰写故事并制作视频，并为《Eos》、《Mongabay》、《科学》杂志和《斯坦福报告》撰稿。奥利维亚的母语是西班牙语和英语。

articles.title: Raised in Apartheid South Africa, 2026 Nobel Peace Prize Winner Navi Pillay Is One of the World’s Leading Human Rights Jurists

paras.en: Navanethem Pillay has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize “for her efforts to promote peace and international law.”
paras.zh: 纳瓦尼特姆·皮莱 (Navanethem Pillay) 因“为促进和平与国际法所做的努力”而被授予 2026 年诺贝尔和平奖。

paras.en: The Nobel committee lauded the 85-year-old South African jurist and former United Nations human rights chief for her “commitment to universal legal principles” and her “firm moral compass” throughout her long career.
paras.zh: 诺贝尔委员会赞扬这位 85 岁的南非法学家、前联合国人权事务负责人在其漫长的职业生涯中“致力于普遍法律原则”和“坚定的道德指南针”。

paras.en: Through decades of work in South African and international courts, Pillay, who is known as Navi, has helped shape legal efforts to hold governments and individuals accountable for human rights abuses and mass atrocities.
paras.zh: 皮莱（又名“纳维”）在南非和国际法庭工作了数十年，帮助制定法律努力，让政府和个人对侵犯人权和大规模暴行负责。

paras.en: Pillay was born in Durban, South Africa, in 1941. She grew up in a poor family of Indian Tamil descent. The daughter of a bus driver, she pursued a career in law at a time when discrimination limited opportunities for non-white South Africans. She established her own law firm in 1967 and in 1988 became the first South African at Harvard Law School to become a Doctor of Juridical Science, the school’s most advanced degree.
paras.zh: 皮莱1941年出生于南非德班。她在一个贫穷的印度泰米尔血统家庭长大。作为一名公交车司机的女儿，她在歧视限制非白人南非人的机会的时代从事法律职业。她于 1967 年成立了自己的律师事务所，并于 1988 年成为哈佛法学院第一位获得法学博士学位的南非人，这是该校最高级的学位。

paras.en: Under apartheid, Pillay and other non-white South Africans were “treated like dirt,” she told the Agence France-Presse (AFP) in 2023. But rather than letting the mistreatment keep her down, she opted to “fight every step of the way.”
paras.zh: 2023 年，她对法新社 (AFP) 表示，在种族隔离制度下，皮莱和其他非白人南非人“被当作泥土一样对待”。但她并没有让这种虐待让她沮丧，而是选择“一步一步地抗争”。

paras.en: “I always had a sense of confidence about who I am and how you confront any kind of discrimination,” she told AFP. “Open your mouth and speak up, condemning it.”
paras.zh: 她告诉法新社：“我对自己是谁以及如何面对任何形式的歧视始终充满信心。” “张开嘴，大声谴责。”

paras.en: Pillay’s early career centered on defending anti-apartheid activists, including Nelson Mandela, whom she joins as a Nobel Peace Prize laureate. In 1995, she broke another barrier when she became the first non-white woman appointed to South Africa’s High Court.
paras.zh: 皮莱的早期职业生涯主要致力于捍卫反种族隔离活动人士，其中包括纳尔逊·曼德拉（Nelson Mandela），她与曼德拉一起成为诺贝尔和平奖获得者。 1995 年，她打破了另一个障碍，成为第一位被任命为南非高等法院法官的非白人女性。

paras.en: Her work subsequently took her onto the international stage. In 1999, Pillay became a judge and president of the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda, which investigated crimes committed during the 1994 genocide. During her tenure, she helped establish important legal precedents recognizing sexual violence as potential acts of genocide and crimes against humanity, bringing international attention to the estimated 100,000 to 250,000 Rwandan women who were raped during the three-month massacre.
paras.zh: 她的作品随后将她带上了国际舞台。 1999年，皮莱成为卢旺达问题国际刑事法庭的法官和庭长，该法庭调查1994年种族灭绝期间犯下的罪行。在她任职期间，她帮助建立了重要的法律先例，承认性暴力是潜在的种族灭绝行为和危害人类罪，使国际社会关注在三个月的大屠杀中估计有 100,000 至 250,000 名卢旺达妇女被强奸。

paras.en: “Rape had always been regarded as one of the spoils of war,” she said at the time. “Now it is a war crime, no longer a trophy of war.”
paras.zh: “强奸一直被视为战利品之一，”她当时说道。 “现在它是一种战争罪，不再是战争的战利品。”

paras.en: From 2008 to 2014, Pillay served as the U.N. high commissioner for human rights. From 2021 to 2025, she chaired the U.N. Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, leading an investigation that concluded Israel committed genocide against Palestinians in the Gaza Strip. (Israel strongly rejected the report.)
paras.zh: 2008年至2014年，皮莱担任联合国人权事务高级专员。 2021年至2025年，她担任联合国巴勒斯坦被占领土独立国际调查委员会主席，领导一项调查，得出以色列对加沙地带巴勒斯坦人实施种族灭绝的结论。 （以色列强烈拒绝该报告。）

paras.en: Pillay also served as a judge on the International Criminal Court and currently serves as an ad hoc judge on the International Court of Justice, the U.N.’s primary judicial body, in an ongoing case assessing whether Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority.
paras.zh: 皮莱还曾担任国际刑事法院法官，目前在联合国主要司法机构国际法院担任专案法官，负责评估缅甸是否对其罗辛亚少数民族实施种族灭绝的案件。

paras.en: By honoring Pillay, the Nobel committee sought to remind the world that international law is the “foundation for a more peaceful world,” Jørgen Watne Frydnes, chair of the Nobel committee, said during the award announcement.
paras.zh: 诺贝尔委员会主席约尔根·沃特纳·弗里德内斯在颁奖典礼上表示，通过表彰皮莱，诺贝尔委员会试图提醒世界，国际法是“更加和平的世界的基础”。

paras.en: “International law has never been perfect,” Frydnes added. But it “sets the standards. Legal measures do prevent acts of war and violence. That is a fact.”
paras.zh: “国际法从来都不是完美的，”弗里德尼斯补充道。但它“设定了标准。法律措施确实可以防止战争和暴力行为。这是事实。”

paras.en: Pillay learned that she had won the prize while attending an international law conference in Courtroom 600 of the Nuremberg Palace of Justice, where top Nazi leaders were indicted and tried for their crimes during World War II.
paras.zh: 皮莱是在纽伦堡司法宫 600 号法庭参加国际法会议时得知自己获奖的，纳粹高层领导人在这里因二战期间的罪行被起诉和审判。

paras.en: “At this venue, your applause means a great deal,” she said after hearing the news. “But being a lawyer and a judge, I still want to verify this information.”
paras.zh: “在这个会场，你们的掌声意义重大，”她听到这个消息后说道。 “但作为一名律师和法官，我还是想核实一下这个信息。”

paras.en: Pillay is the first South African woman to win the Nobel Peace Prize. Four South African men—Albert Lutuli, Desmond Tutu, Nelson Mandela and F.W. de Klerk—have received the award.
paras.zh: 皮莱是第一位获得诺贝尔和平奖的南非女性。四名南非男子——阿尔伯特·卢图利、德斯蒙德·图图、纳尔逊·曼德拉和 F.W.德克勒克——获得了该奖项。

paras.en: Swedish inventor Alfred Nobel established the Nobel Peace Prize, as well as prizes for physiology or medicine, chemistry, literature and physics, with a bequest in his will, which he drafted in 1895. The prizes were first awarded in 1901. The economics prize was established in Nobel’s memory in 1968.
paras.zh: 瑞典发明家阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔在 1895 年起草的遗嘱中设立了诺贝尔和平奖，并设立了生理学或医学奖、化学奖、文学奖和物理学奖。这些奖项于 1901 年首次颁发。为了纪念诺贝尔，经济学奖于 1968 年设立。

paras.en: This year, the Nobel Peace Prize celebrates its 125th anniversary, with 287 individuals and organizations nominated for the award. The committee noted that the 2026 prize “springs directly” from Nobel’s will, which stated that the award should be given to those who have “conferred the greatest benefit to humankind.”
paras.zh: 今年，诺贝尔和平奖庆祝其设立 125 周年，共有 287 名个人和组织获得提名。该委员会指出，2026 年的奖项“直接源于”诺贝尔的遗嘱，其中规定该奖项应颁发给那些“为人类带来最大利益”的人。

paras.en: Pillay is “one of the great defenders of international legal principles in our time,” according to the committee. “[Her] commitment to justice and human dignity is a source of hope and inspiration to all who seek to bring about a more peaceful world.”
paras.zh: 该委员会称，皮莱是“我们这个时代国际法律原则的伟大捍卫者之一”。 “[她]对正义和人类尊严的承诺是所有寻求建立一个更加和平世界的人的希望和灵感的源泉。”

articles.title: A Digital Swamp Coming to New York City’s MoMA Is 'Made to Envelop You' in Nature With the Help of Cutting-Edge Technology

paras.en: A new-age swamp is bubbling up inside the lobby of New York City’s Museum of Modern Art (MoMA). Beginning next week, visitors will find themselves stepping through a colorful, pulsing digital ecosystem that may seem a world away from the city’s urbanity and frenetic pace.
paras.zh: 纽约市现代艺术博物馆 (MoMA) 的大厅内正在冒出新时代的沼泽。从下周开始，游客将发现自己正在步入一个色彩缤纷、生机勃勃的数字生态系统，这似乎与城市的都市化和疯狂的节奏截然不同。

paras.en: “Wetland,” an immersive exhibition by the Danish artist Jakob Kudsk Steensen, thrives in this sensory disconnect. Opening on October 12, MoMA’s newest show is a futuristic, digital vision of nature. It also opens a portal back to the mucky landscapes that major cities—including New York—were founded upon.
paras.zh: 丹麦艺术家 Jakob Kudsk Steensen 的沉浸式展览“湿地”在这种感官脱节中蓬勃发展。 MoMA 的最新展览将于 10 月 12 日开幕，展示未来主义的数字自然景观。它还打开了一扇回到包括纽约在内的主要城市所建立的肮脏景观的门户。

paras.en: The installation harnesses macro photogrammetry and game-engine software (the architecture behind video games) to simulate the movements, sounds and sights of a large-scale swamp.
paras.zh: 该装置利用宏观摄影测量和游戏引擎软件（视频游戏背后的架构）来模拟大型沼泽的运动、声音和景象。

paras.en: Wall-spanning screens display photographs and 3D scans of real-life wetlands. Digitally altered field recordings of amphibians and susurrating riverine rhythms have been mixed with human vocals, including those from the Venezuelan musician Arca.
paras.zh: 跨墙屏幕显示现实湿地的照片和 3D 扫描结果。经过数字修改的两栖动物现场录音和令人惊叹的河流节奏与人类的声音混合在一起，其中包括委内瑞拉音乐家阿尔卡的声音。

paras.en: “At MoMA, it’s made to envelop you—but with a sense of … dance,” Kudsk Steensen tells the New York Times’ Frank Rose. “Things appear. They vanish. They’re dark. They’re bright. They’re vocal.”
paras.zh: “在现代艺术博物馆，它的设计初衷是让你沉浸其中，但又带着一种……舞蹈的感觉，”库斯克·斯廷森告诉《纽约时报》的弗兰克·罗斯。 “事物出现。它们消失。它们是黑暗的。它们是明亮的。它们是有声音的。”

paras.en: “Wetland” features just a single work of art: the simulated swamp installation known as Berl-Berl, which Kudsk Steensen has allowed to evolve since its creation in 2021.
paras.zh: “湿地”只展示了一件艺术品：名为 Berl-Berl 的模拟沼泽装置，自 2021 年创作以来，Kudsk Steensen 允许其不断发展。

paras.en: Both Berl-Berl’s form and name were inspired by the swamps surrounding Berlin, many of which have fallen victim to urban development. The artist collaborated with Berlin’s natural history museum to devote months to studying the landscape. A combination of photography, sound recording, kayaking, swamp-slogging and archival research left Kudsk Steensen with a trove of material documenting humanity’s relationship with wetland habitats. The result was Berl-Berl, first installed in Berghain, a nightclub located in a sprawling decommissioned East German power plant.
paras.zh: Berl-Berl 的形式和名称均受到柏林周围沼泽的启发，其中许多沼泽已成为城市发展的受害者。这位艺术家与柏林自然历史博物馆合作，花了几个月的时间研究这片景观。摄影、录音、皮划艇、沼泽跋涉和档案研究相结合，库斯克·斯滕森获得了大量记录人类与湿地栖息地关系的材料。 Berl-Berl 诞生了，它首先安装在 Berghain，这是一家位于东德庞大的退役发电厂内的夜总会。

paras.en: “In the beginning, I thought I was just making an immersive show, with some nature sounds, some screens and some things that are moving around,” Kudsk Steensen told Dazed’s Juule Kay in 2021, ahead of Berl-Berl’s debut. “But when I walked around in the space, I started to whistle and clap and noticed the echo.”
paras.zh: “一开始，我以为我只是在制作一场身临其境的表演，有一些自然声音、一些屏幕和一些移动的东西，”2021 年 Berl-Berl 首次亮相之前，Kudsk Steensen 告诉 Dazed 的 Juule Kay。 “但是当我在空间中走动时，我开始吹口哨和拍手，并注意到回声。”

paras.en: Each iteration of the installation—in Denmark, South Korea, Switzerland and elsewhere in Berlin—remains in a state of flux. At times, folklore plays a central role. Triglav, a three-headed god from Slavic folklore, makes an appearance at MoMA in the form of a giant tree. Although absent from the MoMA iteration, the shape-shifting water spirit Nøkken, who is said to appear to travelers as a handsome, music-playing young man, often appears in the digital swamp, too.
paras.zh: 该装置的每一次迭代——在丹麦、韩国、瑞士和柏林其他地方——都处于不断变化的状态。有时，民间传说起着核心作用。斯拉夫民间传说中的三头神特里格拉夫以一棵巨树的形式出现在现代艺术博物馆。尽管没有出现在 MoMA 的迭代中，但据说在旅行者看来，他是一位英俊、会演奏音乐的年轻人，变形的水神 Nøkken 也经常出现在数字沼泽中。

paras.en: “We used to sing to the world in order to navigate it,” Kudsk Steensen said in 2024. “And in Europe, in the past, there were many practices to create songs as ways of mapping terrains, especially rivers and swamps, because these are ever-changing landscapes.”
paras.zh: Kudsk Steensen 在 2024 年表示：“我们过去常常通过唱歌来引导世界。而在欧洲，过去有很多通过创作歌曲来绘制地形图的做法，尤其是河流和沼泽，因为这些都是不断变化的景观。”

paras.en: - In July, the United Nations added the Okefenokee National Wildlife Refuge, which protects a swamp sprawled between Florida and Georgia, to its list of UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
paras.zh: - 7月，联合国将奥克弗诺基国家野生动物保护区列入联合国教科文组织世界遗产名录，该保护区保护佛罗里达州和乔治亚州之间的沼泽地。

paras.en: - UNESCO described it as a “diverse mosaic of wetlands, savannas and forests” with stunning biodiversity.
paras.zh: - 联合国教科文组织将其描述为“湿地、稀树草原和森林的多样化马赛克”，具有令人惊叹的生物多样性。

paras.en: In “Wetland,” Kudsk Steensen uses macro photogrammetry—the practice of turning microscopic details into larger images—to illuminate and archive the overlooked textures of wetland soils, plants and currents. Cutting-edge tools help bring the artist closer to nature instead of dividing him from it. “Technology for me, in the sense of being a medium, is a connector,” the artist has said.
paras.zh: 在《湿地》中，库茨克·斯滕森使用宏观摄影测量——将微观细节转化为更大图像的做法——来照亮和存档湿地土壤、植物和水流中被忽视的纹理。尖端的工具有助于让艺术家更接近自然，而不是将他与自然分开。 “对我来说，技术作为一种媒介，是一种连接器，”这位艺术家说道。

paras.en: “It’s fascinating,” Paola Antonelli, MoMA’s senior curator of architecture and design, tells the Times. “This most technological part of the museum is the one that really digs into nature, into consciousness.”
paras.zh: “这太令人着迷了，”现代艺术博物馆建筑与设计高级策展人保拉·安东内利 (Paola Antonelli) 告诉《泰晤士报》。 “博物馆中科技含量最高的部分是真正深入自然、深入意识的部分。”

paras.en: “Wetland” will be on view at the Museum of Modern Art in New York City from October 12, 2026, to March 7, 2027.
paras.zh: “湿地”将于2026年10月12日至2027年3月7日在纽约现代艺术博物馆展出。

articles.title: Watch Five Adorable Newborn Cheetah Cubs Grow on a Livestream From the Smithsonian's Conservation Biology Institute

paras.en: Safe in their den, a new litter of cheetah cubs curls up for nap time. One extends an arm and leg in a big stretch, and another stumbles over its siblings to nurse. Five tiny bodies are piled together, one black-spotted coat blending into another.
paras.zh: 一窝新的猎豹幼崽安全地待在巢穴里，蜷缩起来打盹。其中一只伸出了手臂和腿，另一只则绊倒了自己的兄弟姐妹去吃奶。五具微小的尸体堆在一起，一件黑色斑点的皮毛与另一件融合在一起。

paras.en: In a milestone for cheetah conservation, the five cubs were born on October 5 at the Smithsonian’s Conservation Biology Institute in Front Royal, Virginia. When they’re not snoozing, the healthy, young cats are active—they started climbing on their mother on day one.
paras.zh: 10 月 5 日，这五只猎豹幼崽在弗吉尼亚州弗兰特罗亚尔的史密森尼保护生物学研究所出生，这对猎豹保护来说是一个里程碑。当它们不打瞌睡时，这些健康的小猫就会很活跃——它们从第一天就开始爬到妈妈身上。

paras.en: “Because there’s five of them, somebody’s usually nursing,” Adrienne Crosier, a cheetah biologist and curator of carnivores at the Conservation Biology Institute, tells Smithsonian magazine. “Somebody’s always hungry. Somebody always needs to be groomed. Somebody always needs a bath.”
paras.zh: “因为有五只，所以通常有人在护理，”猎豹生物学家、保护生物学研究所食肉动物馆长阿德里安·克罗西尔 (Adrienne Crosier) 告诉《史密森尼》杂志。 “总有人饥饿。总有人需要梳洗。总有人需要洗澡。”

paras.en: Zura, who at 5 years old is a first-time mother, has taken it all in stride. She’s an incredibly calm and attentive parent, and she’s dedicating almost every moment of her time to the cubs. Today, she ventured out of the den to get a bite to eat for the first time since their birth.
paras.zh: 祖拉五岁时第一次当妈妈，她泰然自若地接受了这一切。她是一位非常冷静和细心的父母，她几乎把每一刻的时间都奉献给了幼崽。今天，自从他们出生以来，她第一次冒险走出巢穴去吃点东西。

paras.en: “That’s very, very normal,” Crosier explains. “But we obviously were happy that she came out, got some food, got some water, and then she went right back to the den with the cubs.”
paras.zh: “这非常非常正常，”克罗泽解释道。 “但我们显然很高兴她出来了，得到了一些食物，得到了一些水，然后她就带着幼崽回到了巢穴。”

paras.en: Born with their eyes closed and ears shut, cheetah cubs are completely dependent on their mothers for survival. It typically takes about four to seven days before they open their eyes, and their ears—initially “flat against their little heads,” Crosier says—will stand up days later.
paras.zh: 猎豹幼崽出生时眼睛紧闭，耳朵紧闭，完全依赖母亲生存。它们通常需要大约四到七天的时间才能睁开眼睛，而它们的耳朵（最初“平贴在它们的小头上”，克罗泽说）会在几天后竖起来。

paras.en: For now, the care staff is hands-off with the cubs, letting the feline family bond without interference. But they’re keeping a close eye on the cheetah cub cam, which shows scenes from within the den. The online live stream also gives viewers around the world a special window into the animals’ lives, especially since the Front Royal facility is closed to the public.
paras.zh: 目前，护理人员对幼崽不干涉，让猫科动物家庭在不受干扰的情况下建立联系。但他们正在密切关注猎豹幼崽的摄像头，它显示了猎豹巢穴内的场景。在线直播还为世界各地的观众提供了了解动物生活的特殊窗口，特别是在 Front Royal 设施不对公众开放的情况下。

paras.en: The cubs will grow rapidly as they nurse. They’ll put on about 50 grams of weight daily—something between a golf ball and an egg. After about three or four weeks, they’ll start to grow curious when Zura leaves the den to eat or drink, gathering at the door when she exits. “They’re going to want to start following her outside,” Crosier says.
paras.zh: 幼崽在吃奶的过程中会迅速成长。他们每天会增加大约 50 克的体重——大约是一个高尔夫球和一个鸡蛋之间的重量。大约三四个星期后，当祖拉离开巢穴吃喝时，它们会开始变得好奇，并在她离开时聚集在门口。 “他们会想开始在外面跟踪她，”克罗泽说。

paras.en: Eventually, animal care staff will come into the den and look at the cheetahs to make sure they seem healthy. They’ll pick up a cub, bring it outside to a scale to get its weight, then deposit it back with the family a few minutes later. Staff will mark each baby with a small shave mark in the fur so that they can tell them all apart. At six weeks, they’ll have their first vet exam and vaccinations, and they’ll get transponders implanted for more reliable identification.
paras.zh: 最终，动物护理人员将进入猎豹巢穴并观察猎豹，以确保它们看起来很健康。他们会抱起一只幼崽，把它带到外面的秤上称量它的重量，然后几分钟后把它放回家人那里。工作人员会在每个婴儿的皮毛上标记一个小剃毛标记，以便他们能够区分它们。六周后，他们将进行第一次兽医检查和疫苗接种，并且他们将植入应答器以进行更可靠的识别。

paras.en: Zura herself was born at the institute in 2021, and her mother and grandmother are also at the facility. With the newest litter, that makes four generations of the family in the biologists’ care. The cubs’ 9-year-old father, Flash, also at the institute, has sired seven cubs from previous litters. Cheetah fathers are not involved with raising the youngsters.
paras.zh: 祖拉本人于 2021 年出生在该研究所，她的母亲和祖母也在该机构。有了最新的一窝幼仔，这个家族的四代人就由生物学家照顾。这些幼崽的 9 岁父亲弗莱什（Flash）也在该研究所，他从前几窝幼崽中生下了七只幼崽。猎豹父亲不参与抚养幼崽。

paras.en: Cheetahs are listed as vulnerable by the International Union for Conservation of Nature, and their global population has plunged by more than 90 percent since 1900. Human activity has fragmented their wild populations, but the cats had been struggling with low genetic diversity since around the end of the last ice age, when an extinction event drove several cheetah species to disappear.
paras.zh: 猎豹被国际自然保护联盟列为易危物种，自 1900 年以来，猎豹的全球数量锐减了 90% 以上。人类活动导致猎豹的野生种群支离破碎，但自上个冰河时代末期以来，猎豹一直在与低遗传多样性作斗争，当时一场灭绝事件导致一些猎豹物种消失。

paras.en: The Conservation Biology Institute breeds cheetahs in accordance with the Cheetah Species Survival Plan, established by the Association of Zoos and Aquariums. Through this initiative, ten facilities across the country select which cheetahs should breed together based on their DNA, temperament, health and other factors. Careful “matchmaking,” which sometimes involves cheetahs traveling hundreds of miles between facilities to meet their possible mate, aims to promote genetic diversity in the population and “produce offspring with the best possible chance of living a healthy life,” per the Smithsonian.
paras.zh: 保护生物学研究所根据动物园和水族馆协会制定的猎豹物种生存计划饲养猎豹。通过这一举措，全国十个机构根据 DNA、性情、健康和其他因素选择哪些猎豹应该一起繁殖。根据史密森学会的说法，精心的“配对”有时需要猎豹在不同的设施之间行驶数百英里来遇见它们可能的配偶，其目的是促进猎豹种群的遗传多样性，并“让后代拥有健康生活的最佳机会”。

paras.en: The newborn cubs’ father is considered genetically valuable in this program, so the little cheetahs will likely have a big role to play in the future of their species.
paras.zh: 新生幼崽的父亲在该计划中被认为具有遗传价值，因此小猎豹可能会在其物种的未来中发挥重要作用。

paras.en: With these cubs, the Conservation Biology Institute has now reached 90 cheetah births at the facility, representing 21 litters.
paras.zh: 凭借这些幼崽，保护生物学研究所现已在该设施内产下 90 只猎豹，共 21 窝幼崽。

paras.en: “Every litter is so important,” Crosier says. “Every cheetah that’s born is an ambassador for its species and … can contribute in the future, potentially, to help with the conservation of the animals in the wild.”
paras.zh: “每一窝幼崽都非常重要，”克罗泽说。 “每只诞生的猎豹都是其物种的大使……可以在未来为保护野生动物做出潜在的贡献。”

paras.en: Save Up to $1,000 Off With Canon Refurbished Discounts

paras.zh: 这句话是正确的——减少、再利用、回收——即使对于相机也是如此。本周，您可以使用经过认证的翻新型号的优惠券获得相机的额外折扣——从 100 美元到 900 美元不等。例如，翻新的 EOS R5 Mark II Body 折扣为 271 美元。还有翻新的 EOS R3 Body，现折扣 900 美元； EOS R6 Mark II Body，优惠超过 400 美元；翻新版 EOS R7 Body 售价 1,119 美元，立减 80 美元。所有这些打折的佳能产品均经过佳能认证，并提供一年有限保修，让您更加安心。

articles.title: LG Promo Codes and Coupons for October 2026
articles.author: Harry Rabinowitz

paras.en: LG makes many of the best TVs you can buy. Its C-series TVs are our top pick for the best OLED TV and have been for quite some time. Pair it with one of the brand’s great soundbars, and you have a top-tier home theater setup that will last for years. While WIRED loves LG mostly for its TVs, the brand is an electronics giant that makes excellent computer monitors and very competitive home appliances like smart refrigerators. These are all big-ticket items, though, so here’s where to find LG promo codes and other ways to save on LG discounts for these often big-ticket items.
paras.zh: LG 生产许多您能买到的最好的电视。它的 C 系列电视一直是我们评选的最佳 OLED 电视的首选。将其与该品牌最出色的条形音箱之一搭配使用，您就拥有了可以使用多年的顶级家庭影院设置。虽然《连线》杂志喜欢 LG 主要是因为它的电视，但该品牌是一家电子巨头，生产出色的电脑显示器和智能冰箱等极具竞争力的家用电器。不过，这些都是高价商品，因此您可以在此处找到 LG 促销代码以及其他方式，以节省这些高价商品的 LG 折扣。

Otherwise, there are plenty of other products currently on sale that you can stack with My LG Rewards for 5% back and points on every purchase.
paras.zh: 如果您准备好购买上述电视中的一款，LG 的 C4 和超亮升级型号 G4 目前都符合 77 英寸尺寸的要求。此外，目前还有许多其他产品在售，您可以与 My LG Rewards 叠加使用，每次购买均可获得 5% 的返利和积分。

Just in time for the season, you can get a $200 NFL Shop e-gift card and free installation when you purchase select LG OLED and QNED Mini LED TVs, including an LG OLED evo 4K TV and an LG Micro RGB evo AI 4K Smart TV. To claim your NFL Shop reward, buy a qualifying LG TV between September 14 and October 4, submit your claim within 30 days of purchase, and once your claim is approved, you’ll receive your reward within 45 days.
paras.zh: 冬天即将来临，这意味着要呆在室内避寒，蜷缩起来看足球比赛。恰逢赛季，当您购买精选 LG OLED 和 QNED Mini LED 电视（包括 LG OLED evo 4K 电视和 LG Micro RGB evo AI 4K 智能电视）时，即可获得价值 200 美元的 NFL Shop 电子礼品卡并免费安装。要领取 NFL 商店奖励，请在 9 月 14 日至 10 月 4 日之间购买符合条件的 LG 电视，并在购买后 30 天内提交申请，申请获得批准后，您将在 45 天内收到奖励。

The Counter-Depth French Door Refrigerator is a sleek, three-door stainless-steel machine with a built-in ice maker and a luxe mirror finish. The Side-By-Side InstaView Refrigerator is the fridge of the future, with a translucent door that lets you see what’s inside without opening it. paras.en: Looking for more discounts? If you’re a teacher, student, or first responder, you could receive an additional LG Promo Code for extra savings. To check your eligibility, click the LG Appreciation Program link and follow the instructions to register your account. Exclusive discounts include free installation for refrigerators, cooking ranges, and washer/dryers, as well as select LG Studio and LG Signature appliances. Once your status is verified, you’ll register your LG account to start shopping for exclusive discounts and the latest offers. Plus, registered LG members will get additional benefits like free shipping, flexible payment options, exclusive discounts, free installation, and best price guarantees.
paras.zh: 如果您是现役军人或退伍军人，还可以享受 LG 军事折扣 10% 的折扣。您所需要做的就是在 ID.me 上验证您的状态。一旦您的状态得到验证，您将注册您的 LG 帐户以开始购买独家折扣和最新优惠。此外，注册 LG 会员还将获得额外优惠，如免费送货、灵活的付款方式、独家折扣、免费安装和最优惠价格保证。
