paras.zh: 通过 MyLG 奖励获得高达 20% 的返利或推荐代码 5% 的折扣

paras.en: With MyLG Rewards, you can get up to 20% back in rewards, plus exclusive deals, extended warranties, and free installation. Eligible rewards members can get an additional 5% off LG products by referring a friend or loved one through the LG Referral program when they make an eligible purchase of $200 or more. They’ll get 5% off, and you’ll earn 5,000 MyLG Rewards points, so it’s a win-win. This coupon is stackable with other promotions, so you can still take advantage of the many other featured discounts.
paras.zh: 通过 MyLG Rewards，您可以获得高达 20% 的奖励返还，以及独家优惠、延长保修和免费安装。符合资格的奖励会员在合格购买 200 美元或以上时，可以通过 LG 推荐计划推荐朋友或亲人，获得额外 5% 的 LG 产品折扣。他们将获得 5% 的折扣，而您将获得 5,000 MyLG Rewards 积分，因此这是双赢。该优惠券可与其他促销活动叠加，因此您仍然可以享受许多其他特色折扣。

paras.en: LG wants to reward gamers. Right now, you’ll get a $200 gaming or Mastercard credit when you pre-order the 52-inch UltraGear evo monitor. This LG gaming monitor is the world’s largest 52-inch 5K2K screen, delivering epic ultra-wide scale and UHD detail, with a curve that wraps the action in UHD clarity across your natural view for an immersive gaming experience like never before. Plus, the built-in speakers deliver clear, well-balanced stereo sound, and the ability to adjust height, tilt, and swivel helps refine your gaming experience without adding desk clutter.
paras.zh: LG 希望奖励游戏玩家。现在，预订 52 英寸 UltraGear evo 显示器时，您将获得 200 美元的游戏或万事达信用卡积分。这款 LG 游戏显示器是世界上最大的 52 英寸 5K2K 屏幕，可提供史诗般的超宽尺寸和超高清细节，其曲线将超高清清晰度的动作包裹在您的自然视野中，带来前所未有的身临其境的游戏体验。此外，内置扬声器可提供清晰、平衡的立体声，并且调节高度、倾斜和旋转的能力有助于改善您的游戏体验，而不会增加桌面杂乱。

articles.title: Trump says he has deal for Russian diesel as Treasury eases sanctions

paras.en: Oct. 9 (UPI) -- President Donald Trump on Friday said he secured a deal with Russia to supply millions of tons of diesel fuel to the global market.
paras.zh: 10 月 9 日（UPI）——美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周五表示，他与俄罗斯达成了一项向全球市场供应数百万吨柴油的协议。

paras.en: Trump said Russian President Vladimir Putin agreed to immediately supply more than 300,000 tons of diesel, followed by another 500,000 tons in November and 1 million tons shortly afterward.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，俄罗斯总统普京同意立即供应超过30万吨柴油，随后于11月再供应50万吨，不久后又供应100万吨。

paras.en: The announcement came as the Treasury Department said it was issuing a temporary license allowing Russian diesel to be sold on the global market despite existing U.S. sanctions. The license will remain in effect until April 7.
paras.zh: 这一消息发布之际，美国财政部表示，尽管美国实施了制裁，但仍将发放临时许可证，允许俄罗斯柴油在全球市场上销售。该许可证有效期至4月7日。

paras.en: "Between our TOTAL CONTROL of the Strait of Hormuz, and this great announcement on Russian Energy, Diesel Prices for Americans and, indeed, the World, will be COMING DOWN, IN RECORD NUMBERS, AND FAST!" Trump wrote on Truth Social. "Lower prices for Americans, especially our Great Farmers, Ranchers, and Truckers, is my Greatest Priority."
paras.zh: “在我们完全控制霍尔木兹海峡，以及关于俄罗斯能源的这一伟大声明之间，美国乃至全世界的柴油价格将以创纪录的速度下降！”特朗普在《真相社会》上撰文。 “为美国人，特别是我们伟大的农民、牧场主和卡车司机降低价格，是我的首要任务。”

paras.en: The move marks a reversal of U.S. efforts to restrict Russian energy exports over Moscow's war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 此举标志着美国因莫斯科乌克兰战争而限制俄罗斯能源出口的努力发生逆转。

paras.en: The United States banned imports of Russian oil and other energy products in 2022 following Russia's invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后，美国于 2022 年禁止进口俄罗斯石油和其他能源产品。

paras.en: "Gifts to Putin will not bring peace or any benefit to the civilized world," Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said in a statement following the diesel announcement. "Russia will 'repay' the diesel with further terror and perfidy.
paras.zh: “给普京的礼物不会给文明世界带来和平或任何利益，”乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基在柴油宣布后的一份声明中表示。 “俄罗斯将以进一步的恐怖和背信弃义‘偿还’柴油。

paras.en: "Allowing Russia to sell petroleum products is an investment in a war that must be ended, not prolonged. What is needed is real de-escalation with Russia on a reciprocal basis."
paras.zh: “允许俄罗斯出售石油产品是对一场战争的投资，这场战争必须结束，而不是延长。我们需要的是在互惠的基础上与俄罗斯真正缓和紧张局势。”

paras.en: Trump signed new sanctions legislation targeting Russia's energy sector last month, including measures against Russian banks, officials and oil tankers used to circumvent international restrictions.
paras.zh: 特朗普上个月签署了针对俄罗斯能源部门的新制裁法案，包括针对俄罗斯银行、官员和用于规避国际限制的油轮的措施。

paras.en: The new agreement comes as diesel prices have surged amid the ongoing war in Iran, which has disrupted global oil supplies and shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.
paras.zh: 新协议出台之际，伊朗持续战争导致柴油价格飙升，这场战争扰乱了全球石油供应和霍尔木兹海峡的运输。

paras.en: The price of diesel has climbed nearly 70% since the start of the Iran war in February. The national average price for diesel was about $6.27 per gallon Friday, according to AAA.
paras.zh: 自2月份伊朗战争爆发以来，柴油价格已上涨近70%。据 AAA 称，周五全国柴油平均价格约为每加仑 6.27 美元。

articles.title: Former U.S. Postal Service worker pleads guilty in $34M fraud scheme

paras.en: Oct. 9 (UPI) -- A former U.S. Postal Service employee pleaded guilty to stealing millions of dollars in checks from the mail in a fraud scheme that affected nearly 6,500 people, federal prosecutors said Friday.
paras.zh: 10 月 9 日（UPI）——联邦检察官周五表示，一名前美国邮政服务员工承认在一项欺诈计划中从邮件中窃取了数百万美元的支票，该计划影响了近 6,500 人。

paras.en: Destinee Ruffin, 29 of Indianapolis, pleaded guilty to conspiracy to commit bank fraud and theft of mail in a scheme involving $34 million in stolen checks.
paras.zh: 29 岁的德斯蒂妮·鲁芬 (Destinee Ruffin) 来自印第安纳波利斯，承认共谋银行欺诈和盗窃邮件，涉及 3400 万美元被盗支票。

paras.en: Between November 2020 and May 2022, Ruffin worked as a letter carrier at the Bacon Station Post Office in Indianapolis, where he stole checks from incoming and outgoing mail.
paras.zh: 2020 年 11 月至 2022 年 5 月期间，鲁芬在印第安纳波利斯的培根站邮局担任邮递员，他在那里窃取了传入和传出邮件中的支票。

paras.en: Prosecutors said Ruffin sold the checks to accomplices who altered them and deposited them into bank accounts belonging to other people.
paras.zh: 检察官称，鲁芬将支票卖给同伙，同伙对其进行了修改，并将其存入其他人的银行账户。

paras.en: In one instance, Ruffin received more than $10,000 through 38 Cash App transactions from an accomplice who purchased stolen checks.
paras.zh: 在一个案例中，Ruffin 通过 38 笔 Cash App 交易从一名购买被盗支票的同谋那里收到了超过 10,000 美元。

paras.en: That accomplice, Tony McMullen, 36 of Illinois, deposited 36 stolen checks worth approximately $235,000.
paras.zh: 该同谋名叫托尼·麦克穆伦 (Tony McMullen)，36 岁，来自伊利诺伊州，存有 36 张偷来的支票，价值约 235,000 美元。

paras.en: Ruffin also supplied more than $12 million in stolen checks to another accomplice, John Young, 24, who recruited others to deposit the checks or sell them through the messaging application Telegram.
paras.zh: 鲁芬还向另一位同伙、24 岁的约翰·杨 (John Young) 提供了超过 1200 万美元的被盗支票，后者招募其他人存入支票或通过消息应用程序 Telegram 出售支票。

paras.en: Investigators uncovered the scheme by mailing Treasury checks with recorded serial numbers and tracing them back to Ruffin's delivery route.
paras.zh: 调查人员通过邮寄带有记录序列号的财政部支票并追踪到鲁芬的投递路线，发现了该计划。

paras.en: In April 2024, investigators searched Ruffin's home, vehicle and electronic devices and discovered thousands of stolen checks worth more than $20 million that had not yet been sold.
paras.zh: 2024 年 4 月，调查人员搜查了鲁芬的住宅、车辆和电子设备，发现了数千张被盗支票，价值超过 2000 万美元，但尚未出售。

paras.en: Three accomplices have already been sentenced for their involvement in the scheme.
paras.zh: 三名同谋已因参与该计划而被判刑。

paras.en: McMullen received two years and nine months in prison. Eric Hollis, 23 of Indianapolis, received one year and one day. Kendall Thompson, 24, also of Indianapolis, was sentenced to four months in prison. Young is awaiting sentencing.
paras.zh: 麦克马伦被判入狱两年零九个月。埃里克·霍利斯 (Eric Hollis)，23​​ 岁，印第安纳波利斯人，获刑一年零一天。 24 岁的肯德尔·汤普森（Kendall Thompson）也来自印第安纳波利斯，被判处四个月监禁。杨正在等待判决。

paras.en: Federal prosecutors estimate that approximately 6,500 people were affected by the scheme.
paras.zh: 联邦检察官估计大约 6,500 人受到该计划的影响。

paras.en: Ruffin is scheduled to be sentenced Oct. 27.
paras.zh: 鲁芬定于 10 月 27 日被判刑。

articles.title: Oklahoma chiropractor sentenced to 14 years in $30M healthcare fraud

paras.en: Oct. 9 (UPI) -- An Oklahoma chiropractor was sentenced to 14 years in federal prison for his role in a $30 million healthcare fraud scheme targeting Medicare and programs serving military personnel and veterans, the Justice Department said Friday.
paras.zh: 10 月 9 日（UPI）——司法部周五表示，俄克拉荷马州一名脊椎按摩师因参与针对医疗保险以及为军事人员和退伍军人服务的项目的 3000 万美元医疗欺诈计划而被判处 14 年监禁。

paras.en: Mark Loftis, 39 of Cushing, and his accomplices submitted more than $30 million in fraudulent claims for medical equipment that patients did not need or want.
paras.zh: 39 岁的库欣市马克·洛夫蒂斯 (Mark Loftis) 及其同伙针对患者不需要或不想要的医疗设备提出了超过 3000 万美元的欺诈索赔。

paras.en: The scheme collected more than $8 million from Medicare, TRICARE and the Civilian Health and Medical Program of the Department of Veterans Affairs, known as CHAMPVA.
paras.zh: 该计划从 Medicare、TRICARE 和退伍军人事务部的平民健康和医疗计划（称为 CHAMPVA）筹集了超过 800 万美元。

paras.en: Prosecutors said Loftis paid more than $1 million in illegal kickbacks to marketers, telemedicine companies and a call center that persuaded elderly and disabled Americans to provide their personal information and receive unnecessary medical equipment.
paras.zh: 检察官称，洛夫蒂斯向营销人员、远程医疗公司和一家呼叫中心支付了超过 100 万美元的非法回扣，这些公司说服美国老年人和残疾人提供个人信息并获得不必要的医疗设备。

paras.en: The payments were made in part through a shell marketing company.
paras.zh: 部分付款是通过一家空壳营销公司支付的。

paras.en: The group also fulfilled fraudulent medical orders for orthopedic braces, continuous glucose monitors and other equipment from doctors and nurse practitioners who never examined the patients.
paras.zh: 该团伙还履行了来自从未检查过患者的医生和护士的虚假医疗订单，包括矫形支架、连续血糖监测仪和其他设备。

paras.en: Prosecutors said the group frequently submitted claims for multiple medical braces for individual patients, including one instance in which eight braces were billed for a single person.
paras.zh: 检察官表示，该组织经常为个别患者提交多个医疗支架的索赔，其中一次为一个人支付了八个支架的费用。

paras.en: Loftis was convicted of conspiracy to commit healthcare fraud and wire fraud following a 12-day jury trial in July.
paras.zh: 经过 7 月份为期 12 天的陪审团审判后，洛夫蒂斯被判犯有共谋医疗欺诈和电汇欺诈罪。

paras.en: In addition to his prison sentence, he was ordered to pay more than $8 million in restitution and forfeit more than $560,000.
paras.zh: 除了监禁之外，他还被勒令支付超过 800 万美元的赔偿金并没收超过 56 万美元。

articles.title: ‘JAŸ-Z in 8’ Finale: 5 Things We Learned From Episodes 7 & 8
articles.author: Kyle-Brandon Denis

paras.en: The final two installments of Hov’s HBO Max docuseries landed Friday evening (Oct. 9), with Rick Rubin helping the hip-hop legend unpack the stories behind key moments and releases from the latter years of his career.
paras.zh: Hov 的 HBO Max 纪录片系列的最后两期于周五晚（10 月 9 日）播出，Rick Rubin 帮助这位嘻哈传奇人物揭开了他职业生涯后期关键时刻和发布作品背后的故事。

paras.en: Episode seven explores hits like “Hard Knock Life (Ghetto Anthem)” and “Empire State of Mind” (with Alicia Keys), as well as essential projects like The Blueprint 3 and Streets Is Watching. As Jay reflected on his hit-packed 2009 LP, he affirmed Rubin’s observation that the release marked a shift in his approach to album artwork. “I started getting into collecting art around that time,” the Brooklyn MC concurred.
paras.zh: 第七集探讨了《Hard Knock Life (Ghetto Anthem)》和《Empire State of Mind》（与 Alicia Keys 合作）等热门歌曲，以及《蓝图 3》和《Streets Is Watching》等重要项目。当杰伊回顾他的 2009 年热门专辑时，他肯定了鲁宾的观察，即这张专辑的发行标志着他对专辑艺术风格的转变。 “我大约在那个时候开始收藏艺术品，”这位布鲁克林主持人表示同意。

paras.en: Episode eight digs into some of Jay’s more heady, political work. He breaks down his exploration of intracommunity fighting amongst Black folk on “The Story of O.J.,” explains his challenging of existing power structures on the classic “No Church in the Wild” and draws a throughline of generational healing between “Family Feud” and “Legacy.”
paras.zh: 第八集深入探讨了杰伊的一些更令人兴奋的政治作品。他在《O.J.的故事》中详细剖析了他对黑人内部斗争的探索，在经典《野外没有教会》中解释了他对现有权力结构的挑战，并在《家庭世仇》和《遗产》之间勾勒出了代际治愈的主线。

paras.en: Both episodes are a fitting close to the eight-part series, which used relatively broad strokes to paint the arc of Jay’s life and career. The episodes also bolster the docuseries’ overarching argument that rap is a quintessential American art form deserving of the same respect as any of the country’s foundational sounds and cultural spaces.
paras.zh: 这两集都非常接近该八集系列，该系列使用相对广泛的笔触描绘了杰伊的生活和职业生涯。这些剧集还支持了纪录片系列的总体论点，即说唱是一种典型的美国艺术形式，值得与美国任何基础声音和文化空间一样受到尊重。

paras.en: Directed by Rubin, JAŸ-Z in 8 is a Tetragrammaton production. Executive producers include Academy Award winner Daniel Kaluuya, Jay-Z and Rubin. Leila Mattimore and David Rohde also serve as producers.
paras.zh: 《JAŸ-Z in 8》由鲁宾执导，是一部 Tetragrammaton 作品。执行制片人包括奥斯卡金像奖得主丹尼尔·卡卢亚、Jay-Z 和鲁宾。莱拉·马蒂摩尔和大卫·罗德也担任制片人。

paras.en: The series arrives amid a celebratory year for the hip-hop mogul. He returned to the stage in an Afro during his buzzy headlining set at May’s Roots Picnic, which set the scene for his string of stadium-packing JAŸ-Z 30 concerts across Los Angeles, London, Paris, and, of course, New York City. Hov actually kicked off the trek in his hometown with three sold-out Yankee Stadium shows featuring a barrage of who’s who in the music industry, including Beyoncé, Rihanna, Eminem, Blue Ivy, Usher, Teyana Taylor, Slick Rick, Jaz-O, The-Dream, Clipse, Pharrell Williams and more.
paras.zh: 该剧在这位嘻哈大亨的庆祝年中推出。在五月的 Roots Picnic 上，他以爆炸头造型重返舞台，成为热门话题，这为他在洛杉矶、伦敦、巴黎，当然还有纽约市举办的一系列挤满体育场的 JAŸ-Z 30 音乐会奠定了基础。实际上，霍夫在家乡的旅程始于三场售罄的洋基体育场演出，其中包括碧昂丝、蕾哈娜、埃米纳姆、Blue Ivy、亚瑟小子、Teyana Taylor、Slick Rick、Jaz-O、The-Dream、Clipse、Pharrell Williams 等音乐界名人。

paras.en: Last week (Sept. 24), a woman who accused Jay-Z of raping her as a 13-year-old girl fully recanted her allegations, telling a federal judge that her claims were “false,” that she had mental health issues and that her ex-attorneys filed the case without the proper due diligence.
paras.zh: 上周（9 月 24 日），一名指控 Jay-Z 强奸她 13 岁女孩的妇女完全撤回了自己的指控，她告诉联邦法官，她的指控是“错误的”，她有精神健康问题，而且她的前律师在没有经过适当的尽职调查的情况下提起了此案。

paras.en: Here are five things we learned from episodes seven and eight below. The final two episodes of JAŸ-Z in 8 are now available to stream on HBO Max.
paras.zh: 以下是我们从下面第七集和第八集学到的五件事。 《JAŸ-Z in 8》的最后两集现已在 HBO Max 上播出。

paras.en: - How the Nas Rivalry Started — And Ended Before Kendrick and Drake imploded hip-hop with their 2024 battle, Jay-Z and Nas arguably had the most famous hip-hop beef of all time. Now that the two gentlemen are “really good friends,” as Jay puts it, they can reflect on the origins and endings of their row. “Nas was supposed to be on my first album; he just never showed up to the studio,” Jay revealed. “And I’m not really a guy like that… so that was that for me. I’m never asking him for anything again. [There’s] not a problem. But that was the end of it.” By the time Nas dropped his second album, It Was Written, in 1996, “he was taking what I perceived to be shots,” said Jay. “Everyone knew I had the Lexus with the TVs.” On “The Message,” Nas spits, “Lex with TV sets—the minimum, ill sex adrenaline,” which “began a cold war of sorts” that escalated into a rap battle, but the competition made both artists better. “He really rose to the occasion, I’ll say that,” Jay said in closing. “It fizzled out at the end; during the whole thing we had so much respect for each other. It got personal… but it was more about competition.”
paras.zh: - Nas 的竞争是如何开始和结束的 在 Kendrick 和 Drake 于 2024 年展开嘻哈之战之前，Jay-Z 和 Nas 可以说是有史以来最著名的嘻哈争执。现在，正如杰伊所说，两位先生是“真正的好朋友”，他们可以反思争吵的起源和结局。 “纳斯本来应该出现在我的第一张专辑中；他只是从未出现在录音室，”杰伊透露道。 “我并不是那样的人……所以这对我来说就是这样。我再也不会向他要任何东西了。[没有]问题。但事情就这样结束了。” 1996 年，当纳斯推出他的第二张专辑《It Was Written》时，“他正在拍摄我认为的镜头，”杰伊说。 “每个人都知道我有一辆带电视的雷克萨斯。”在《The Message》中，纳斯吐槽道，“莱克斯带着电视机——最低限度的、病态的性肾上腺素”，这“开始了一场冷战”，并升级为一场说唱大战，但这场竞争让两位艺术家都变得更好。 “我想说，他真的挺身而出，”杰伊最后说道。 “最终以失败告终；在整个过程中，我们非常尊重彼此。这很个人化……但更多的是关于竞争。”

paras.en: - Jay-Z vs. Beyoncé in the Studio In something of a preview to the breakdown of “Family Feud” in episode eight, Rubin asked Jay to compare and contrast his recording process with his wife’s. Of course, Hov & Bey have teamed up for Billboard Hot 100 chart-toppers like “Crazy in Love,” Grammy-winning full-lengths such as Everything is Love and a pair of stadium-conquering world tours. Jay has also been a key songwriting partner for Beyoncé over the years, contributing to her rap verses on tracks like “Savage (Remix),” “Alien Superstar” and “Spaghettii” Jay described Beyoncé’s recording process as “wild” and “layered,” in contrast to his improvisational approach. “She’ll record her vocal and stack it up a thousand times,” he said. “Her creativty, a lot of it is in the melodies and the harmonies… and she’ll try anything. I’m too self-conscious to try anything and be screaming… [My process is] pretty much my voice, straightforward. I play with music and melody more than the character.”
paras.zh: - Jay-Z 与 Beyoncé 在录音室的较量 在第八集《Family Feud》的预览中，Rubin 要求 Jay 将他的录音过程与他妻子的录音过程进行比较和对比。当然，Hov 和 Bey 还曾合作制作过《Crazy in Love》等 Billboard Hot 100 排行榜冠军歌曲、《Everything is Love》等格莱美获奖单曲以及两次征服体育场的世界巡演。多年来，杰伊也是碧昂斯的重要歌曲创作合作伙伴，为她在《Savage (Remix)》、《Alien Superstar》和《Spaghettii》等歌曲中的说唱诗句做出了贡献。杰伊将碧昂丝的录音过程描述为“狂野”和“分层”，这与他的即兴创作方式形成鲜明对比。 “她会录制她的声音并将其叠加一千次，”他说。 “她的创造力，很多都体现在旋律和和声中……她会尝试任何事情。我太不自然了，无法尝试任何事情并尖叫……[我的过程]几乎是我的声音，简单。我比角色更多地玩音乐和旋律。”

paras.en: - The First Hip-Hop Line He Remembers Hitting Him On a Deeper Level At the beginning of episode seven, Rubin asks Jay about the first hip-hop line he remembers making him realize that something deeper was going on in the lyrics. In response, Hov flawlessly spit Big Daddy’s verse of Marley Marl’s “The Symphony,” which he remembers hearing the Brooklyn MC lay down during the making of joint mixtape with Jaz-O at producer Fresh Gordon’s house. “So put a quarter in your ass ’cause ya played yourself/ Like a game in the arcade, you need a far aid,” raps Kane. “‘You played yourself’ wasn’t a popular phrase yet, and I was like Wow. Whoa,” Jay told Rubin. “I was in there thinking, ‘I got a ways to go,’ I’m not there yet.”
paras.zh: - 他记得的第一句嘻哈台词让他更深层次地受到打击 在第七集开始时，鲁宾向杰伊询问他记得的第一句嘻哈台词，这让他意识到歌词中正在发生一些更深层次的东西。作为回应，Hov 完美地吐出了 Big Daddy 对 Marley Marl 的《The Symphony》的诗句，他记得在制作人 Fresh Gordon 的家中与 Jaz-O 制作联合混音带时听到布鲁克林的 MC 放下了这首诗。 “所以把四分之一放在你的屁股上，因为你自己玩/就像街机游戏一样，你需要远程援助，”凯恩说唱。 “‘你扮演你自己’还不是一个流行的短语，我当时就觉得哇。哇，”杰伊告诉鲁宾。 “我在那里想，‘我还有很长的路要走，’但我还没到那里。”

paras.en: - The First Time Jay Heard Hip-Hop From Outside of NYC Jay says Ice-T or NWA were his first encounters with hip-hop music from outside of New York City. “It felt like Richard Pryor albums,” he remembered. “It felt dangerous.”
paras.zh: - Jay 第一次听到纽约市以外的嘻哈音乐 Jay 说 Ice-T 或 NWA 是他第一次接触纽约市以外的嘻哈音乐。 “感觉就像理查德·普赖尔的专辑，”他回忆道。 “感觉很危险。”

paras.en: - Rick Rubin Visited N.W.A in the Studio During the Making of ‘Straight Outta Compton’ As Jay reflected on his first time hearing hip-hop music from outside of New York City, Rubin revealed that he actually visited the studio while N.W.A was recording its landmark Straight Outta Compton album. He noted that it was the first time he was around a lot of guns in hip-hop, saying, “Before that, it wasn’t really like that… a lot of people with a lot of guns. It was different.”
paras.zh: - Rick Rubin 在制作《Straight Outta Compton》期间参观了 N.W.A 的录音室 当 Jay 回忆起他第一次听到来自纽约市以外的嘻哈音乐时，Rubin 透露，他实际上是在 N.W.A 录制其标志性的《Straight Outta Compton》专辑时参观了工作室。他指出，这是他第一次在嘻哈音乐中遇到很多枪，他说，“在那之前，情况并不是这样的……很多人拿着很多枪。这是不同的。”

articles.title: ADÉLA Makes Her Case For Pop Stardom at Sold-Out Los Angeles Show: ‘I’m an Immigrant’
articles.author: Alicia Urrea

paras.en: ADÉLA had a few things to get off of her chest in Los Angeles — and she did so with a little ballet, fiery hair choreography, some spicy dancing and a song that might have put her in some hot water with the local crowd.
paras.zh: 阿黛拉在洛杉矶有一些事情要倾诉——她用一点芭蕾舞、火热的头发编排、一些辛辣的舞蹈和一首可能让她与当地人群陷入困境的歌曲来做到这一点。

paras.en: The Slovak pop singer brought her Red Bottoms Tour to the Fonda Theatre on Thursday night (Oct. 8) for the first of two Los Angeles dates, delivering a 16-song set that highlighted why she’s quickly becoming one of pop music’s most compelling emerging names. The demand for ADÉLA in Los Angeles continues tonight (Oct. 9), when she returns to the Fonda Theatre for a second sold-out show.
paras.zh: 这位斯洛伐克流行歌手周四晚上（10 月 8 日）在方达剧院举办了她的 Red Bottoms 巡演，这是洛杉矶两场演出中的第一场，演唱了 16 首歌曲，突显了她为何迅速成为流行音乐界最引人注目的新兴名字之一。今晚（10 月 9 日）洛杉矶对 ADÉLA 的需求仍在继续，届时她将返回方达剧院进行第二场演出，门票全部售完。

paras.en: With her signature bright pink hair, a hot pink ballet rail and pink and red lighting setting the tone, ADÉLA leaned into the vigorous performance style that has helped distinguish her since her days on The Debut: Dream Academy, the competition series that introduced her to a wider audience.
paras.zh: ADÉLA 标志性的亮粉色头发、亮粉色芭蕾舞裙以及粉色和红色灯光奠定了基调，她倾向于充满活力的表演风格，这种风格自她参加《首次亮相：梦想学院》系列比赛以来就帮助她脱颖而出，该系列竞赛将她介绍给了更广泛的观众。

paras.en: The sold-out show comes just weeks after the release of her debut album, PRIMA, which debuted at No. 4 on the Billboard 200. Two of its singles have also made their way onto the Billboard Hot 100: “Ain’t in LA,” which peaked at No. 27, and “Nicole Kidman,” which recently climbed to No. 11. At the Fonda, she brought those chart successes to life alongside other songs in the setlist that moved between the brash confidence of “KGB,” “Boys” and “NastyDirtyGross” and the more provocative pop of “Starving Artist,” “SexOnTheBeat” and “Superscar.”
paras.zh: 这场演出门票全部售罄，就在她的首张专辑《PRIMA》发行几周后，该专辑在 Billboard 200 排行榜上排名第 4 位。其中的两首单曲也进入了 Billboard Hot 100：“Ain’t in LA”（最高排名第 27 位）和“Nicole Kidman”（最近攀升至第 11 位）。在 Fonda，她将这些排行榜上的成功与曲目列表中的其他歌曲一起演绎得栩栩如生。其风格介于“KGB”、“Boys”和“NastyDirtyGross”的傲慢自信与“Starving Artist”、“SexOnTheBeat”和“Superscar”等更具挑衅性的流行音乐之间。

paras.en: A trained ballerina, ADÉLA has the flawless movement and performance instincts to make choreography feel very central to her artistry instead of just an accessory to it. Her fashion choices are just as much a part of the package, with a wardrobe of sparkling, barely-there separates and statement boots complementing her signature bright pink hair. The look also fits the visual identity of her collaboration with 5 Gum, which brought its Stimulating Style Collection to select stops on the Red Bottoms Tour.
paras.zh: 作为一名训练有素的芭蕾舞演员，ADÉLA 拥有完美的动作和表演本能，让编舞成为她艺术的核心，而不仅仅是其附属品。她的时尚选择同样是整体的一部分，衣柜里有闪闪发光的几乎没有的单品和个性的靴子，与她标志性的亮粉色头发相得益彰。这一造型也符合她与 5 Gum 合作的视觉形象，5 Gum 将其刺激风格系列带到了 Red Bottoms 巡演的精选站点。

paras.en: A hot pink rail served as a focal point for her ballet segment and other choreographed moments, recalling the setup from her opening dates for Demi Lovato. The production itself was relatively stripped back, relying largely on the rail and a palette of pink and red lighting rather than some elaborate staging or visuals. That simplicity kept the spotlight on ADÉLA herself without any other distractions: her dancing, vocals and ability to carry a show surrounding her creativity, music and artistry.
paras.zh: 一条亮粉色的栏杆成为她的芭蕾舞片段和其他精心设计的时刻的焦点，让人想起她为黛米·洛瓦托 (Demi Lovato) 开场演出时的场景。制作本身相对精简，主要依赖于轨道和粉色和红色灯光，而不是一些精心设计的舞台或视觉效果。这种简单性让 ADÉLA 本人成为众人瞩目的焦点，没有任何其他干扰：她的舞蹈、声乐以及围绕她的创造力、音乐和艺术进行表演的能力。

paras.en: And while the PRIMA material gave the night its backbone, ADÉLA also made room for a surprise. She typically performs an unreleased track called “Kiss Here” on tour, but for her Los Angeles audience, she opted for “Homewrecked” instead — a song she said she hadn’t been performing on the trek — as an apology for a certain lyric in her catalog.
paras.zh: 虽然 PRIMA 材料为夜晚提供了支柱，但 ADÉLA 也为惊喜创造了空间。她通常在巡演中表演一首未发行的歌曲“Kiss Here”，但对于洛杉矶的观众，她选择了“Homewrecked”——她说她在旅途中没有表演过这首歌——作为对她目录中某句歌词的道歉。

paras.en: The reason was clear when she introduced “Ain’t in LA” earlier in the set, the song whose title and main sentiment could’ve made for a pretty awkward moment in a city she now calls home.
paras.zh: 当她在片场早些时候介绍“Ain't in LA”时，原因就很清楚了，这首歌的标题和主要情感可能会在她现在称之为家的城市中造成一个相当尴尬的时刻。

paras.en: “I have to say … the next song that I’m gonna sing is a little bit awkward,” she told the crowd, asking them to “please don’t boo” as she explained the inspiration behind a song that declares the “baddest bitches ain’t in LA.”
paras.zh: “我不得不说……我要唱的下一首歌曲有点尴尬，”她告诉人群，并要求他们“请不要嘘”，同时她解释了一首声称“最坏的母狗不在洛杉矶”的歌曲背后的灵感。

paras.en: ADÉLA went on to share that she moved to Los Angeles from Slovakia a couple of years ago to participate in Dream Academy. Even though her journey on the show didn’t unfold the way she had hoped, she pointed toward the balcony, where her former castmates Megan Skiendiel and Lara Raj of KATSEYE and Emily Kelavos of Saint Satine were watching.
paras.zh: 阿黛拉接着透露，几年前她从斯洛伐克搬到洛杉矶参加梦想学院。尽管她在节目中的旅程没有按照她希望的方式展开，但她指着阳台，她的前剧组 KATSEYE 的 Megan Skiendiel 和 Lara Raj 以及 Saint Satine 的 Emily Kelavos 正在观看。

paras.en: As ADÉLA pursued her dream of becoming a pop star, ADÉLA said she had grown fatigued by the way the industry seemed to celebrate the same people over and over again. That feeling, as she explained, inspired “Ain’t in LA” — a song that she framed not as a rejection of the city, but as an acknowledgment of the people whose contributions can go unrecognized.
paras.zh: 当阿黛拉追求成为流行歌星的梦想时，阿黛拉说，她已经厌倦了这个行业似乎一遍又一遍地庆祝同一个人的方式。正如她解释的那样，这种感觉启发了《Ain’t in LA》——她将这首歌定义为不是对这座城市的拒绝，而是对那些贡献可能被忽视的人们的认可。

paras.en: “I’m an immigrant,” she said. “And you know what? LA wouldn’t be LA without who? The immigrants.”
paras.zh: “我是移民，”她说。 “你知道吗？如果没有移民，洛杉矶就不会成为洛杉矶。”

paras.en: Funny enough, ADÉLA recently spoke to Billboard about how she never doubted her success would happen. At the Fonda, that conviction feels less like an abstract promise than a very tangible reality.
paras.zh: 有趣的是，ADÉLA 最近在接受 Billboard 采访时表示，她从未怀疑过自己会取得成功。在方达，这种信念感觉不像是一个抽象的承诺，而是一个非常切实的现实。

paras.en: Before closing the show with “Nicole Kidman,” ADÉLA took another moment to address the audience, this time sharing what she was manifesting for her future. Among her wishes was to make “Nicole Kidman” No. 1 on Spotify in the U.S. “forever,” to continue to perform for “so many years,” and — in a final nod to the evening’s earlier tension — hoping Los Angeles wouldn’t stay mad at her over “Ain’t in LA.”
paras.zh: 在与“妮可·基德曼”的演出结束之前，阿黛拉又花了一点时间向观众发表讲话，这一次分享了她对未来的表现。她的愿望之一是让“妮可·基德曼”在美国 Spotify 上“永远”排名第一，继续表演“这么多年”，并且——作为对当晚早些时候紧张局势的最后点头——希望洛杉矶不要因为“Ain't in LA”而对她生气。

paras.en: The show very much felt like a victory lap for a debut album that has already found a sizable audience. Looking out into the crowd, you’d see hot pink outfits and tutu skirts scattered throughout, with newer fans and older fans cheering ADÉLA on. Alongside the artist, everyone seemed to be celebrating her breakthrough while she articulated the ambition, insecurity, and personal experiences that got her here in the first place. Her former Dream Academy castmates watching from the balcony offered a reminder of where her story began, but the sold-out room was a testament to the career she is building now.
paras.zh: 这场演出感觉就像是一张已经吸引了大量观众的首张专辑的胜利。向人群望去，你会看到亮粉色的服装和芭蕾舞短裙散落在各处，新粉丝和老粉丝都在为 ADÉLA 加油。在这位艺术家旁边，每个人似乎都在庆祝她的突破，而她则阐述了最初让她来到这里的野心、不安全感和个人经历。她的前梦想学院演员们在阳台上观看，让我们想起了她的故事是从哪里开始的，但满座的房间证明了她现在正在建立的职业生涯。

paras.en: And this was only her second headlining show in Los Angeles since playing The Roxy last year, so it already feels like a huge milestone. If the trajectory if PRIMA is any indication, it is unlikely that this will be her last time headlining in Los Angeles.
paras.zh: 这只是她自去年出演 The Roxy 以来在洛杉矶的第二场头条秀，所以这已经感觉像是一个巨大的里程碑。如果 PRIMA 的轨迹有任何迹象的话，这不太可能是她最后一次在洛杉矶成为头条新闻。

articles.title: Phil Wickham, Josiah Queen, Brandon Lake, Tasha Cobbs Leonard Top GMA Dove Awards Winners
articles.author: Jessica Nicholson

paras.en: On Friday night (Oct. 9), the 57th annual GMA Dove Awards aired on TBN and TBN+, as those in the Christian and Gospel music community gathered to honor some of the year’s top artists, songs, albums and more. Hosted for the fourth consecutive year by singer-songwriter Tauren Wells, the event was held on Oct. 6 at Nashville’s Bridgestone Arena.
paras.zh: 周五晚上（10 月 9 日），第 57 届年度 GMA Dove 奖在 TBN 和 TBN+ 上播出，基督教和福音音乐界的人士齐聚一堂，表彰年度顶级艺术家、歌曲、专辑等。该活动由歌手兼作曲家 Tauren Wells 连续第四年主办，于 10 月 6 日在纳什维尔的普利司通体育场举行。

paras.en: Among the top winners were Phil Wickham, Josiah Queen and Brandon Lake, with three wins each, while Tasha Cobbs Leonard took home two honors.
paras.zh: 菲尔·威克姆 (Phil Wickham)、乔赛亚·奎因 (Josiah Queen) 和布兰登·莱克 (Brandon Lake) 分别获得三场胜利，而塔莎·科布斯·伦纳德 (Tasha Cobbs Leonard) 则获得两项荣誉。

paras.en: Wickham was named artist of the year, while his album Song of the Saints was named worship album of the year and he won children’s recorded song of the year for his work on “Follow The Light.”
paras.zh: 威克姆被评为年度艺术家，他的专辑《圣徒之歌》被评为年度敬拜专辑，他的作品《跟随光》赢得了年度儿童录制歌曲。

paras.en: “God has given us reason after reason to worship him,” Wickham said in accepting the worship album of the year honor, adding, “To be able to write songs with amazing people and to think that people sing them to Jesus blows my mind. That I get to write a song to Jesus and I have the honor of filling the mouths of believers with these songs…I don’t take one moment for granted. He is so worthy.”
paras.zh: “神给了我们一个又一个敬拜他的理由，”威克姆在接受年度敬拜专辑荣誉奖时说道，并补充道，“能够与出色的人一起创作歌曲，并想到人们为耶稣唱这些歌曲，这让我大吃一惊。我为耶稣写了一首歌，我很荣幸能用这些歌曲填满信徒的口……我不认为任何一刻都是理所当然的。他是如此值得。”

paras.en: Queen earned accolades in categories including song of the year and pop/contemporary recorded song of the year (both for “Dusty Bibles”) and recorded music packaging of the year (for his album Mt. Zion).
paras.zh: 皇后乐队获得的奖项包括年度歌曲和年度流行/当代录制歌曲（均凭借《尘土飞扬的圣经》）以及年度录制音乐包装（其专辑 Mt. Zion）。

paras.en: Taking the stage to accept the song of the year honor for “Dusty Bibles,” Queen thanked his co-writers on the song, John Michael Howell, Zac Lawson, and Dylan Thomas.
paras.zh: 皇后乐队上台接受《尘土飞扬的圣经》年度歌曲荣誉，感谢这首歌的共同创作者约翰·迈克尔·豪厄尔、扎克·劳森和迪伦·托马斯。

paras.en: “We wrote this song two Dove Awards ago, so it’s an honor to be here,” Queen said. “I grew up following the Dove Awards because I looked up to so many of you writers and musicians. In saying that and getting this, it’s a huge honor. The greatest honor I can have as a human is to serve Jesus.” He added that faith helped him through hard times, saying, “It was opening up my Bible and spending time with Him that he completely changed my life.”
paras.zh: “我们在两次鸽子奖前写了这首歌，所以很荣幸来到这里，”皇后乐队说。 “我是在鸽子奖的陪伴下长大的，因为我尊敬你们中的许多作家和音乐家。能说出这样的话并获得这个奖，这是一个巨大的荣誉。作为一个人，我能拥有的最大的荣誉就是侍奉耶稣。”他补充说，信仰帮助他度过了困难时期，他说：“打开我的圣经，花时间与他在一起，他彻底改变了我的生活。”

paras.en: Lake earned accolades including songwriter of the year (artist), pop/contemporary album of the year (King of Hearts), and country/roots recorded song of the year, for “The Jesus I Know Now,” with Lainey Wilson.
paras.zh: 莱克赢得了包括年度词曲作者（艺术家）、年度流行/当代专辑（King of Hearts）以及年度乡村/根源录制歌曲在内的多项荣誉，其中包括与莱尼·威尔逊（Lainey Wilson）合作的《我现在知道的耶稣》（The Jesus I Know Now）。

paras.en: Cobbs Leonard won the contemporary Gospel album of the year for her project Tasha, as well as traditional Gospel recorded song of the year for “Church” (which she also performed during the show). “God took me on a journey over the past year and a half…I’ve seen sides of Him that I’ve never seen before,” Cobbs Leonard said of working on the project, which was produced by Kenneth Leonard Jr. “The goodness of God and who He is is absolutely amazing,” Cobbs Leonard said.
paras.zh: 科布斯·伦纳德 (Cobbs Leonard) 凭借她的项目《塔莎》(Tasha) 赢得了年度当代福音专辑奖，并凭借《教堂》(Church) 赢得了年度传统福音歌曲奖（她也在节目中表演了这首歌曲）。 “在过去的一年半里，上帝带我踏上了旅程……我看到了他以前从未见过的一面，”科布斯·伦纳德谈到这个项目的工作时说道，该项目由小肯尼斯·伦纳德制作。“上帝的良善和他是谁绝对是令人惊奇的，”科布斯·伦纳德说。

paras.en: Jamie MacDonald, known for hits including “Left It In The River,” won new artist of the year.
paras.zh: 因《Left It In The River》等热门歌曲而闻名的杰米·麦克唐纳 (Jamie MacDonald) 荣获年度新人奖。

paras.en: “I spent two decades waiting tables and trying to write songs,” MacDonald said. “I was trying to heal after years of addiction and shame. I got ahold of a CeCe Winans record and it changed everything and I began singing the truth over myself….thank you for helping me to find my life’s purpose…thank you Jesus.”
paras.zh: “我花了二十年的时间当服务员并尝试写歌，”麦克唐纳说。 “在经历了多年的上瘾和羞耻之后，我试图治愈自己。我拿到了一张 CeCe Winans 的唱片，它改变了一切，我开始唱出自己的真理……谢谢你帮助我找到了人生的目标……谢谢耶稣。”

paras.en: Several artists offered powerful performances during the evening. Amy Grant and Natalie Grant joined forces to honor the late singer-songwriter Dolly Parton.
paras.zh: 当晚，多位艺术家带来了精彩的表演。艾米·格兰特和娜塔莉·格兰特联手纪念已故创作型歌手多莉·帕顿。

paras.en: “What a rare artist…she felt like she belonged to all of us,” Amy Grant said from the stage. “Her music crossed generations and genres and boundaries of all kinds, and faith was woven into who she was, how she lived, and the music she made.” A video clip showed an older performance of Parton singing “How Great Thou Art,” as Natalie Grant and Amy Grant then joined in singing the song together from the Bridgestone stage, which was awash in pink lighting. They ended by joining to sing Parton’s “I Will Always Love You” as videos of Parton’s past performances filled the screens.
paras.zh: “多么罕见的艺术家……她感觉自己属于我们所有人，”艾米·格兰特在舞台上说道。 “她的音乐跨越了世代、流派和各种界限，信仰融入了她的身份、她的生活方式以及她创作的音乐中。”一段视频剪辑显示了帕顿演唱的《你的艺术多么伟大》，娜塔莉·格兰特和艾米·格兰特随后在普利司通的舞台上一起演唱了这首歌，舞台上充满了粉红色的灯光。最后，他们一起唱了帕顿的《我将永远爱你》，帕顿过去的表演视频充斥着屏幕。

paras.en: Grant also told Billboard in a statement, “I have thought about Dolly and the impact she had on all of us so much since her passing. Being asked to speak about her and then joining Natalie for a performance was an honor in and of itself. From the beginning, Dolly’s one request of [country singer] Porter [Wagoner] was that she be allowed to include a hymn or a Gospel song in each of their shows. Her roots in faith shaped who she was and how she lived. I appreciated getting to sing with Natalie Grant. Her voice captures the colors of the stratosphere, mine of the earth. Singing together, following Dolly, on the arrangement Natalie and Bernie [Herms] put together was magical. I was so happy to be a part of it.”
paras.zh: 格兰特还在一份声明中告诉《告示牌》，“自从她去世以来，我一直在思考多莉以及她对我们所有人的影响。被邀请谈论她，然后和娜塔莉一起表演本身就是一种荣幸。从一开始，多莉对[乡村歌手]波特[瓦格纳]的一个要求就是允许她在他们的每场演出中加入一首赞美诗或一首福音歌曲。她的信仰根源塑造了她的身份和生活方式。我很高兴能够成为这样的人。”与娜塔莉·格兰特一起唱歌，她的声音捕捉到了平流层的色彩，跟随多莉一起唱歌，按照娜塔莉和伯尼[赫姆斯]的安排，我很高兴能成为其中的一部分。”

paras.en: Also during the evening, Anne Wilson performed “Who I Am,” while Gospel roots ensemble Chosen Road offered up “A God Thing.” Hope Darst performed “Mighty Name of Jesus,” while rapper Hulvey brought choreography-filled performance of “Rich Like This” and “Dave.” Wells also took the stage for “This Is What a Miracle Feels Like” with Naomi Raine. Later in the evening, Tye Tribbett further elevated the evening’s energy with “I Want It All Back.”
paras.zh: 当晚，安妮·威尔逊 (Anne Wilson) 表演了《我是谁》(Who I Am)，而福音根源合奏团 Chosen Road 则表演了《A God Thing》。霍普·达斯特 (Hope Darst) 表演了《耶稣的伟大之名》(Mighty Name of Jesus)，而说唱歌手胡维 (Hulvey) 则带来了充满编舞的《Rich Like This》和《戴夫》(Dave)。威尔斯还与娜奥米·雷恩一起登台演唱了《This Is What a Miracle Feels Like》。当晚晚些时候，泰·特里贝特 (Tye Tribbett) 凭借《I Want It All Back》进一步提升了当晚的活力。

paras.en: Sarai Rivera’s “Tu Voz” was named Spanish Language Recorded song of the year. Rivera said she wrote the song at a time when “I needed His voice to be louder than the fears, than the lies…today I’m a living testimony that His voice keeps echoing louder and louder.”
paras.zh: Sarai Rivera 的《Tu Voz》被评为年度西班牙语录制歌曲。里维拉说，她写这首歌的时候，“我需要他的声音比恐惧、谎言更响亮……今天我就是一个活生生的见证，他的声音不断回响，越来越响亮。”

paras.en: The show spilled over into the nearby Ryman Auditorium, where Elevation Worship performed “So Be It.”
paras.zh: 演出蔓延至附近的莱曼礼堂，Elevation Worship 乐队在那里表演了《So Be It》。

paras.en: Influential Gospel music songwriter, artist and musician Richard Smallwood was honored with a performance from Jonathan McReynolds, Kierra Sheard, Donald Lawrence, Maurette Brown Clark & Ted Winn, who sang songs including “The Center of My Joy, and “I Love The Lord.”
paras.zh: 有影响力的福音音乐词曲作者、艺术家和音乐家理查德·斯莫伍德 (Richard Smallwood) 荣幸地获得了乔纳森·麦克雷诺兹 (Jonathan McReynolds)、基拉·谢尔德 (Kierra Sheard)、唐纳德·劳伦斯 (Donald Lawrence)、莫雷特·布朗·克拉克 (Maurette Brown Clark) 和特德·温恩 (Ted Winn) 的表演，他们演唱的歌曲包括《The Center of My Joy》和《I Love The Lord》。

paras.en: The inaugural GMA community impact award for peace and purpose to God Behind Bars, an organization that focuses on bringing a faith-based message to those in prison.
paras.zh: 首届 GMA 和平与使命社区影响奖颁给了 God Behind Bars，该组织致力于向监狱中的人们传达基于信仰的信息。

paras.en: Having been newly crowned with the new artist of the year honor, MacDonald closed out the evening with the joyous and soulful “Left It In The River.”
paras.zh: 刚刚获得年度新艺术家荣誉的麦克唐纳以欢乐而深情的“Left It In The River”结束了当晚活动。

paras.en: See a list of winners in key categories at the 57th annual GMA Dove Awards below:
paras.zh: 请参阅以下第 57 届年度 GMA Dove 奖关键类别获奖者名单：

paras.en: Pop/contemporary recorded song of the year: “Dusty Bibles,” Josiah Queen
paras.zh: 年度流行/当代录制歌曲：“Dusty Bibles”，Josiah Queen

articles.title: Roseanne Barr’s Self-Produced TV Series Now Courting Distributors, Co-Creator Says
articles.author: Katie Kilkenny

paras.en: Roseanne Barr’s new independently produced television series is being shopped to distributors and has fielded interest from a few, according to her co-creator on the project.
paras.zh: 据罗珊娜·巴尔 (Roseanne Barr) 的联合创作者透露，罗珊娜·巴尔 (Roseanne Barr) 独立制作的新电视剧正在向发行商出售，并引起了一些人的兴趣。

paras.en: “We have a lot of nibbles right now,” writer-producer Allan Stephan told The Hollywood Reporter on Friday. Representatives for the comedy series, co-created by Stephan and Barr and called Meemaw: A Modern-Day Fable, have been sending a trailer around to interested parties and targeting streamers.
paras.zh: “我们现在有很多东西，”编剧兼制片人艾伦·斯蒂芬周五告诉《好莱坞报道》。这部由斯蒂芬和巴尔共同创作的喜剧系列剧《Meemaw：现代寓言》的代表已经向感兴趣的各方和主播发送了预告片。

paras.en: Stephan didn‘t name any specific platforms that have been sniffing around but said “I know [representatives for the show] are in talks with a few places.” (Of course, as the co-creator of the series, Stephan has a vested interest in portraying the project as in-demand.)
paras.zh: 斯蒂芬没有透露任何正在嗅探的具体平台，但表示“我知道（该节目的代表）正在与一些地方进行谈判。” （当然，作为该系列的联合创作者，史蒂芬对于将这个项目描绘成受欢迎的作品有着既得利益。）

paras.en: Page Six Hollywood broke the news on Thursday that the former sitcom star, whose Roseanne reboot on ABC was canceled in 2018 after Barr posted an offensive tweet about former advisor to President Barack Obama Valerie Jarrett, had filmed the eight-episode indie series.
paras.zh: 好莱坞第六页周四爆料称，这位前情景喜剧明星拍摄了这部八集独立剧集。巴尔在推特上发布了一条攻击巴拉克·奥巴马总统前顾问瓦莱丽·贾勒特的攻击性推文后，美国广播公司 (ABC) 的《罗珊娜》重启版于 2018 年被取消。

paras.en: Meemaw is said to follow the matriarch (played by Barr) of a Texas family of preppers who is attempting to organize a blowout bat mitvah for her granddaughter. Alongside Barr, Randy Quaid, Drea de Matteo, Omar Gooding, Doug Jones and Indy Bugg star. Comedians Jon Lovitz, Tony Hinchcliffe and Kim Congdon make cameos in the series, which shot in Austin.
paras.zh: 据说，米莫跟随德克萨斯州一个末日准备者家庭的女族长（由巴尔饰演），她试图为她的孙女组织一场井喷式的蝙蝠成人仪式。除了巴尔之外，兰迪·奎德、德瑞·德·马泰奥、奥马尔·古丁、道格·琼斯和印迪·巴格也担任主演。喜剧演员乔恩·洛维茨、托尼·欣奇克利夫和金·康登在该剧中客串，该剧在奥斯汀拍摄。

paras.en: Comedy scribe and producer Allen Covert (Murder Mystery, Eight Crazy Nights), a longtime collaborator of Adam Sandler, helped write the series.
paras.zh: 喜剧编剧兼制片人艾伦·科弗特（《谋杀之谜》、《疯狂八夜》）是亚当·桑德勒的长期合作者，他帮助创作了该剧。

paras.en: “They’re struggling farmers, where everybody is at today, especially farmers,“ Stephan said of the show’s characters. “And it’s about surviving in the world as it is today, trying to keep food in the table and the family together.“
paras.zh: “他们是苦苦挣扎的农民，今天每个人都处于这种境地，尤其是农民，”斯蒂芬谈到剧中的角色时说道。 “这是为了在当今的世界中生存，努力让餐桌上有食物和家人在一起。”

paras.en: None of this guarantees Meemaw is coming to a major streaming platform. Plenty of creators of independent shows engage in talks with companies and not all of them land a deal. But it does appear to show that, eight years after her eponymous show‘s cancellation at ABC, Barr isn’t a total pariah in Hollywood.
paras.zh: 所有这些都不能保证 Meemaw 能够进入主要的流媒体平台。许多独立节目的创作者都在与公司进行谈判，但并非所有人都能达成协议。但这似乎确实表明，在美国广播公司的同名节目被取消八年后，巴尔并不是好莱坞彻底的贱民。

paras.en: Barr raised the money independently for Meemaw’s first season with the help of her son, Jake Pentland, Stephan said. He added that he didn’t know the details of the fundraising efforts, leaving the question of which funders wanted to help bring a new Barr project to the world unanswered for now. (THR has reached out to Pentland for comment.)
paras.zh: 斯蒂芬说，巴尔在儿子杰克·彭特兰的帮助下为 Meemaw 的第一季独立筹集了资金。他补充说，他不知道筹款工作的细节，因此哪些资助者希望帮助将新的巴尔项目推向世界的问题目前还没有答案。 （《好莱坞报道》已联系彭特兰征求意见。）

paras.en: The episodes of Meemaw are 30 minutes each, but don‘t call it a sitcom. “We call it a fable because part of the storytelling involves some animals and it’s just a little different,” Stephan said.
paras.zh: 《Meemaw》每集时长 30 分钟，但不要称其为情景喜剧。 “我们称其为寓言，因为故事讲述的一部分涉及到一些动物，只是有点不同，”斯蒂芬说。

paras.en: After breaking into entertainment as a stand-up comic, Barr shot to stardom in the late ’80s with her ABC sitcom Roseanne, where she played a working-class mom in Illinois. After concluding in 1997, the show was rebooted in 2018 at ABC until Barr‘s tweet led to its cancellation. Barr apologized at the time for the tweet saying, “I apologize to Valerie Jarrett and to all Americans. I am truly sorry for making a bad joke about her politics and her looks. I should have known better. Forgive me — my joke was in bad taste.”
paras.zh: 在以单口喜剧演员身份进入娱乐圈后，巴尔在 80 年代末凭借 ABC 情景喜剧《Roseanne》一举成名，在剧中她饰演伊利诺伊州的一位工薪阶层妈妈。该节目于 1997 年结束后，于 2018 年在 ABC 重新启动，直到巴尔的推文导致该节目取消。巴尔当时为这条推文道歉，他说：“我向瓦莱丽·贾勒特和所有美国人道歉。我真的很抱歉对她的政治和外表开了一个糟糕的玩笑。我应该更清楚。请原谅我——我的笑话品味很差。”

paras.en: Stephan says Barr‘s latest project is a nonpartisan effort meant to appeal to the masses, much like Roseanne did in its heyday. “The show is very representative of all people,” he said. “There’s no Trump side, there’s no democratic side. It’s just the family struggling to get by and what they have to deal with to get by.”
paras.zh: 斯蒂芬说，巴尔的最新项目是一项无党派努力，旨在吸引大众，就像罗珊娜在其鼎盛时期所做的那样。 “这个节目非常能代表所有人，”他说。 “没有特朗普的一面，也没有民主的一面。这只是一个艰难度日的家庭，以及他们必须面对的事情。”

articles.title: ‘14th’ Review: Ava DuVernay Delivers Another Essential and Compelling Constitutional Deep Dive for Netflix
articles.author: Daniel Fienberg

paras.en: On November 3, U.S. voters will cast ballots in midterm elections that will go a long way toward shaping or reshaping our government. The results will offer a pivotal snapshot of how the country is currently viewing the solvency of our particular brand of democracy.
paras.zh: 11 月 3 日，美国选民将在中期选举中投票，这将对塑造或重塑我们的政府大有帮助。结果将提供一个关键的快照，显示该国目前如何看待我们特定民主品牌的偿付能力。

paras.en: Ava DuVernay‘s new documentary for Netflix focuses on the 14th Amendment to the Constitution, recent attempts to strip the 14th Amendment of its power, and the ways in which the 14th Amendment embodies and represents the ideals and long-term viability of the American experiment.
paras.zh: 艾娃·杜威内 (Ava DuVernay) 为 Netflix 制作的新纪录片重点关注宪法第 14 条修正案、最近剥夺第 14 条修正案权力的尝试，以及第 14 条修正案如何体现和代表美国实验的理想和长期可行性。

paras.en: Release date: November 27 (theatrical); December 4 (Netflix)
paras.zh: 上映日期：11月27日（院线）； 12 月 4 日（Netflix）

paras.en: Naturally, Netflix has set 14th for a brief theatrical run on November 27 ahead of a streaming premiere on December 4th. A sequel or companion to DuVernay’s Oscar-nominated 13th, the doc is a cogent, urgent clarion call, and Netflix is sending it straight to the scheduling equivalent of voicemail.
paras.zh: 当然，Netflix 将 14 日定于 11 月 27 日进行短暂院线放映，然后于 12 月 4 日进行流媒体首播。这部纪录片是杜威内获得奥斯卡提名的《第 13 部》的续集或姊妹篇，它是一个令人信服、紧急的号角，Netflix 将其直接发送到相当于语音信箱的日程安排中。

paras.en: I’m baffled, but I guess it isn’t my job to review programming choices or corporate politics. Like its predecessor — I briefly was outraged recalling that 13th lost the Oscar, until I was reminded that OJ: Made in America won — 14th is powered by well-earned rage; also like its predecessor, it’s more a history lesson and a model of carefully composed rhetoric than a screed.
paras.zh: 我很困惑，但我想审查编程选择或公司政治不是我的工作。就像它的前身一样——回想起《第 13 届》失去奥斯卡奖，我短暂地感到愤怒，直到我想起《橙汁：美国制造》赢了——《第 14 届》充满了应有的愤怒；和它的前身一样，它更像是一堂历史课，也是精心构思的修辞典范，而不是长篇大论。

paras.en: As anybody who studied Constitutional amendments in school — and why isn’t that everybody? — knows, there are plenty of amendments that can be summed up in a catchy phrase: “Alcohol? No!” “Actually, alcohol? Sure!” “Vote at 18!” “Vote if you’re a woman!” “Cruel and unusual punishment, like when a state is unable to correctly administer the death penalty (or, actually, the death penalty itself)? No!” Etc., etc.
paras.zh: 作为任何在学校学习过宪法修正案的人——为什么不是每个人都这样呢？ ——要知道，有很多修正案可以用一句朗朗上口的话来概括：“酒精？不！” “实际上，酒精？当然！” “18岁投票！” “如果你是女性，请投票！” “残酷和不寻常的惩罚，比如一个国家无法正确执行死刑（或者实际上是死刑本身）？不！”等等等等

paras.en: DuVernay’s last documentary focused on the supposed simplicity of the 13th Amendment, which outlawed slavery and involuntary servitude, except in cases where the prison industrial complex is involved. It’s a simple amendment, but the hypocrisy around its implementation remains complicated.
paras.zh: 杜威内的上一部纪录片重点关注了第十三修正案的简单性，该修正案禁止奴隶制和非自愿奴役，但涉及监狱工业综合体的情况除外。这是一项简单的修正案，但其实施过程中的虚伪仍然很复杂。

paras.en: The 14th Amendment is not one of the simple ones.
paras.zh: 第十四修正案并不是一项简单的修正案。

paras.en: As Stacey Abrams, part of a wide-ranging group of talking heads here, puts it, the 14th Amendment is the “everything bagel” of constitutional amendments.
paras.zh: 正如史黛西·艾布拉姆斯 (Stacey Abrams) 所说，第十四修正案是宪法修正案中的“万能百吉饼”。

paras.en: As Dr. Eric Foner puts it, the 14th Amendment is the most important since the Bill of Rights.
paras.zh: 正如埃里克·福纳博士所说，第十四修正案是自《权利法案》以来最重要的修正案。

paras.en: As Dr. Sherrilyn Ifill explains in some depth, the 13th, 14th and 15th amendments reflect a grand reimagining of the American experiment in the aftermath of the Civil War — almost a second Constitution.
paras.zh: 正如 Sherrilyn Ifill 博士深入解释的那样，第 13 条、第 14 条和第 15 条修正案反映了美国内战后实验的重大重新构想——几乎是第二部宪法。

paras.en: The amendment offers a new definition for citizenship, one built on equality, particularly in issues of due process and equal protection under the law. It’s the foundation for Supreme Court decisions allowing for interracial and gay marriage, the origin of birthright citizenship, and the reason why paying off the January 6th insurrectionists is blatantly unconstitutional.
paras.zh: 该修正案为公民身份提供了新的定义，该定义建立在平等的基础上，特别是在正当程序和法律下的平等保护问题上。它是最高法院允许异族通婚和同性婚姻的判决的基础，是与生俱来的公民权的起源，也是为什么贿赂 1 月 6 日叛乱分子是公然违宪的原因。

paras.en: It is, in modern TV and movie terms, a constitutional reboot, and like so many reboots, it has sparked debate about what is and isn’t canonical to the intention of its framers — both the original constitutional framers and the framers of these bridge amendments, including John Bingham, Thaddeus Stevens and Charles Sumner. Note that the documentary promises to remove the obscurity around this second group of framers and, unfortunately, it doesn’t come close.
paras.zh: 用现代电视和电影的术语来说，这是一次宪法重启，就像许多重启一样，它引发了关于什么是、什么不符合其制定者意图的争论——无论是最初的宪法制定者还是这些桥梁修正案的制定者，包括约翰·宾厄姆、撒迪厄斯·史蒂文斯和查尔斯·萨姆纳。请注意，这部纪录片承诺消除第二组制定者周围的默默无闻，但不幸的是，它并没有接近。

paras.en: DuVernay and her various talking heads establish quickly why the 14th Amendment is so essential, and then go into depth on the attempts to erase the amendment’s protections over the years, with a particular focus on the decades of efforts to erase the immediate gains of Reconstruction. Some of that will be familiar to regular viewers of documentary and comedy/news programs, especially when it comes to the evisceration of the Daughters of the Confederacy, the perpetuation of the Lost Cause myth, and the erection of countless monuments to the various slaveholders and insurrectionists who fought for the South. I attended a Jefferson Davis Elementary School in my youth — since renamed for Barack Obama — so much of this hit hard and close to home.
paras.zh: 杜威内和她的各个谈话人物很快就确定了为什么第十四修正案如此重要，然后深入探讨了多年来消除该修正案的保护的尝试，特别关注数十年来消除重建的直接成果的努力。其中一些内容对于纪录片和喜剧/新闻节目的普通观众来说是熟悉的，特别是当涉及到联邦女儿们的内脏，“失败事业”神话的永久存在，以及为南方而战的各种奴隶主和叛乱分子竖立无数纪念碑时。我年轻时就读于杰斐逊·戴维斯小学（后来更名为巴拉克·奥巴马小学），这对我来说是沉重的打击，而且离我的家很近。

paras.en: In addition to the usual historians, constitutional scholars, populist commentators and politicians — including Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Jasmine Crockett, Alex Padilla and dedicated regurgitator of MAGA talking points Anna Paulina Luna — DuVernay weaves in ground-level vignettes. We spend time with the likes of Devon Henry, the contractor tasked with removing Richmond’s Confederate monuments, and Dr. Carla Hayden, fired as the Librarian of Congress for poorly articulated reasons related to the current administration’s war on DEI.
paras.zh: 除了常见的历史学家、宪法学者、民粹主义评论员和政治家——包括亚历山大·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯（Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez）、茉莉花·克罗克特（Jasmine Crockett）、亚历克斯·帕迪拉（Alex Padilla）和专门重复 MAGA 话题的安娜·宝琳娜·卢纳（Anna Paulina Luna）——杜威内还编织了一些地面小插曲。我们花时间与德文·亨利（Devon Henry）等人交谈，他是负责拆除里士满联邦纪念碑的承包商，还有卡拉·海登博士（Carla Hayden），他因与现任政府对 DEI 的战争有关的不清楚的原因而被解雇，担任国会图书馆馆长。

paras.en: The documentary is fairly straightforward, but never visually dull. DuVernay stages her interviews in a diverse assortment of settings, moving the camera in a way that’s kinetic but never nauseating. There’s a frequently utilized effect that brings to life vintage black-and-white photos, which comes across as an extension of Ken Burns’ beloved technique with a computer-effects twist that I don’t fully understand, but it keeps things lively. The argument DuVernay builds is deftly constructed within the 108 minutes of the documentary, escalating from past to present to future and from dryly historical to emotional and visceral.
paras.zh: 这部纪录片相当简单，但视觉上绝不乏味。杜威内在各种不同的场景中进行采访，以一种充满活力但绝不令人作呕的方式移动镜头。有一种经常使用的效果可以使老式黑白照片栩栩如生，它是肯·伯恩斯 (Ken Burns) 喜爱的技术的延伸，带有我不完全理解的计算机效果扭曲，但它让事情变得生动活泼。杜威奈在这部 108 分钟的纪录片中巧妙地构建了自己的论点，从过去到现在再到未来，从枯燥的历史升级到情感丰富和发自内心。

paras.en: Spencer Averick’s editing and the score by Jason Moran retain a high intensity throughout, evoking a heist movie in which the main antagonists are out to steal your rights. Which is apt, I guess.
paras.zh: 斯宾塞·艾弗里克 (Spencer Averick) 的剪辑和杰森·莫兰 (Jason Moran) 的配乐自始至终都保持着高强度，让人想起一部抢劫电影，其中主要对手试图窃取你的权利。我想这很恰当。

paras.en: The documentary generates anger, sadness and even, by showcasing clips from the likes of George Carlin and Hasan Minhaj, humor. More than that, though, 14th made me wish for two things: First, that DuVernay continue her amendment-by-amendment documentary series until we eventually get her exposé on the timetable of Congressional salary increases. Second, that given the effort DuVernay puts into these films, it would be nice if they were released at the time when they could most successfully stir people to action.
paras.zh: 这部纪录片引发了愤怒、悲伤，甚至通过展示乔治·卡林和哈桑·明哈吉等人的片段，引发了幽默。更重要的是，《14》让我希望有两件事：首先，杜威内继续她的逐项修正案纪录片系列，直到我们最终让她揭露国会加薪的时间表。其次，考虑到杜威内在这些电影中付出的努力，如果它们在最能成功地激发人们采取行动的时候上映，那就太好了。

paras.en: Production Company: Array Filmworks in association with Array Alliance
paras.zh: 制作公司：Array Filmworks 与 Array Alliance 联合制作

paras.en: Producers: Ava DuVernay, Spencer Averick, Tammy Garnes, Paul Garnes
paras.zh: 制片人：Ava DuVernay、Spencer Averick、Tammy Garnes、Paul Garnes

paras.en: Cinematographers: Michael Cambio Fernandez, Clifford Charles
paras.zh: 摄影师：迈克尔·坎比奥·费尔南德斯、克利福德·查尔斯

articles.title: BlumFest Haunts New York Comic Con 2026: All the Highlights From Blumhouse Atomic Monster
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: BlumFest revealed Craig Zobel as the director for the adaptation of James Tynion IV and Werther Dell’Edera’s Something is Killing the Children, while also debuting the trailer for The Exorcist: Martyrs, and teasing upcoming projects including Seasons, RoboCop, Molepeople, and more.
paras.zh: BlumFest 透露克雷格·佐贝尔将担任改编自詹姆斯·泰尼昂四世和维特·戴尔·埃德拉的《有什么东西杀死了孩子》的导演，同时还发布了《驱魔人：烈士》的预告片，并预告了即将推出的项目，包括《季节》、《机械战警》、《鼹鼠人》等。

paras.en: The two-hour Friday night panel featured an A-List lineup, including Mike Flanagan, James Wan, Chiwetel Ejiofor, David Harbour, LaKeith Stanfield, Curry Barker, and Kristen Bell. About halfway through the panel, the entire 2027 lineup was revealed, including River (Jan. 15), The Revenge of Llorona (Feb. 26), The Exorcist: Martyrs, Anything but Ghosts (May 7), Paranormal Activity (May 21), The Blair Witch Project (Sept. 24), and Sleepover and Seasons (Nov. 12). The list also included a currently untitled film set for August 2027.
paras.zh: 周五晚上两小时的座谈会邀请了一线明星阵容，包括迈克·弗拉纳根 (Mike Flanagan)、温子仁 (James Wan)、切瓦特·埃加福特 (Chiwetel Ejiofor)、大卫·哈伯 (David Harbour)、莱基思·斯坦菲尔德 (LaKeith Stanfield)、库里·巴克 (Curry Barker) 和克里斯汀·贝尔 (Kristen Bell)。小组讨论进行到一半时，整个2027年的阵容被揭晓，包括《大河》（1月15日）、《洛洛纳的复仇》（2月26日）、《驱魔人：烈士，除了鬼魂》（5月7日）、《超自然活动》（5月21日）、《布莱尔女巫计划》（9月24日）以及《过夜与四季》（11月12日）。该名单还包括一部目前尚未定名的 2027 年 8 月上映的电影。

paras.en: During a panel, which served as a victory lap for Blumhouse Atomic Monster’s box office hits Backrooms and Obsession, producer and Blumhouse co-founder Jason Blum teased what is ahead for the studio.
paras.zh: 在一场为 Blumhouse Atomic Monster 的票房大片《Backrooms》和《Obsession》带来胜利的座谈会上，制片人兼 Blumhouse 联合创始人 Jason Blum 透露了工作室的未来。

paras.en: “It’s been an incredible year, and what’s so cool about the movies you listed is how different they all are. Everybody has a different idea about what’s scary, and that is what I love about horror,” he said. “We want to work with filmmakers who never stop surprising you. And a year like we’ve had, with the help of movies like Obsession, gives us more opportunity to take more chances, and you’ll get a taste of those chances and risks and weird stuff tonight.”
paras.zh: “这是令人难以置信的一年，你列出的电影的最酷之处在于它们都是如此不同。每个人对可怕的事情都有不同的看法，这就是我对恐怖的热爱，”他说。 “我们希望与那些永远给你带来惊喜的电影制作人合作。在《痴迷》等电影的帮助下，我们度过了这样的一年，让我们有更多的机会去尝试更多的机会，今晚你就会体验到这些机会、风险和奇怪的东西。”

paras.en: Earlier in the day, IDW Dark and Blumhouse announced they were teaming on a Happy Death Day comic series from Blumhouse and IDW Dark, with writer Tim Seeley (Hack/Slash) attached to translate the time-loop slasher and expand its mystery ahead of a third movie.
paras.zh: 当天早些时候，IDW Dark 和 Blumhouse 宣布他们将合作制作 Blumhouse 和 IDW Dark 的忌日快乐漫画系列，编剧 Tim Seeley（《Hack/Slash》）将负责翻译这部时间循环恐怖片，并在第三部电影上映之前扩展其神秘面纱。

paras.en: Read below for more on what was unveiled during BlumFest 2026 at New York Comic Con.
paras.zh: 请阅读下文，详细了解纽约动漫展 BlumFest 2026 期间发布的内容。

paras.en: Towards the end of the panel, Barker and Cooper Tomlinson were brought out on stage, and briefly discussed how his life had changed in just a year. After reflecting on Obsession and the nature of their partnership, the duo teased Anything But Ghosts, which follows ghost hunter con artists who “get a huge job, a bigger one than they’ve ever gotten before. But it’s a real ghost, so they have to step up and be the thing that they promised.” The film will see Barker co-star with Tomlinson.
paras.zh: 小组讨论即将结束时，巴克和库珀·汤姆林森被带上台，并简要讨论了他的生活在短短一年内发生了怎样的变化。在反思了《Obsession》和他们合作的本质之后，两人调侃了《Anything But Ghosts》，该片讲述了捉鬼者骗子“得到了一份大工作，比他们以前得到的更大的工作。但这是一个真正的鬼魂，所以他们必须站出来，实现他们所承诺的事情。”巴克将与汤姆林森共同主演这部电影。

paras.en: “I need him on camera with me. We wrote this together thinking this will be the movie that we starred in together, an homage to what we’ve been doing online,” Barker said. “I didn’t write Obsession with me necessarily in mind, but we knew we had to do these two characters.”
paras.zh: “我需要他和我一起出现在镜头前。我们一起写了这篇文章，认为这将是我们一起主演的电影，向我们在网上所做的事情致敬，”巴克说。 “我写《痴迷》并不是为了我自己，但我们知道我们必须演这两个角色。”

paras.en: Barker also expressed that the film will take a similar approach to their work on Obsession, trying to subvert horror film tropes and expectations. “I think, just me as an audience member who’s been watching horror movies my entire life, you can take the blueprint of a horror movie, and know what audiences are expecting. You can actually use that to your advantage to say, if I’m an audience member and I’m watching this and I know what’s going to happen next, how can I subvert that? You can expect that same attitude as Anything But Ghosts.”
paras.zh: 巴克还表示，这部电影将采取与《痴迷》类似的方式，试图颠覆恐怖电影的比喻和期望。 “我认为，作为一名一生都在看恐怖电影的观众，你可以了解一部恐怖电影的蓝图，并知道观众在期待什么。你实际上可以利用这一点来说，如果我是一名观众，我正在看这个，我知道接下来会发生什么，我怎样才能颠覆它？你可以期待与《除了鬼以外的一切》相同的态度。”

paras.en: Among the new partnerships announced at the panel was a deal with Matthew Patrick, aka MatPat, the founder and former host of the “Theory” Channels on YouTube. Patrick will work with the studio to develop new films based on indie games and horror channels to bring those stories to the big screen. “We are giving them the spotlight they deserve,” Patrick said during the panel.
paras.zh: 在小组会议上宣布的新合作伙伴关系中，有一项是与 Matthew Patrick（又名 MatPat）达成的协议，他是 YouTube 上“理论”频道的创始人和前主持人。帕特里克将与工作室合作开发基于独立游戏和恐怖频道的新电影，将这些故事搬上大银幕。 “我们正在给予他们应有的关注，”帕特里克在小组讨论中说道。

paras.en: The first announced project is a feature film based on DreadXP’s indie video game Amanda the Adventurer. A teaser at the panel also previewed footage of the online horror phenomenon, a series of clips that combines the animated children’s show-esque story with unsettling interstitials. “We are currently in talks with writers and directors, so more is coming soon. We’re moving really fast on that one,” Patrick said.
paras.zh: 第一个宣布的项目是一部基于 DreadXP 的独立视频游戏《冒险家阿曼达》的故事片。小组中的预告片还预览了在线恐怖现象的镜头，这是一系列将动画儿童表演式故事与令人不安的插页式广告结合在一起的剪辑。 “我们目前正在与编剧和导演进行谈判，因此很快就会有更多内容。我们在这方面的进展非常快，”帕特里克说。

paras.en: Among the newer projects is RoboCop, which Wan noted is currently being developed as a series for Amazon Prime with the original writer Edward Neumeier and Dan Stevens in the titular role. The second major project out of the studio is Rob Savage’s next Blumhouse Atomic Monster film Molepeople, starring Lakeith Stanfield, his return to the studio following the game-changing Get Out. Described by Savage “as a subterranean horror movie that’s going to scare the living shit out of you,” the film will be in the vein of The Texas Chain Saw Massacre and The Hills Have Eyes, with Savage noting the movie will begin filming very soon.
paras.zh: 较新的项目之一是《机械战警》，万指出，该项目目前正在为 Amazon Prime 开发一个系列，由原作者爱德华·纽迈尔 (Edward Neumeier) 和丹·史蒂文斯 (Dan Stevens) 担任主角。工作室的第二个主要项目是 Rob Savage 的下一部 Blumhouse Atomic Monster 电影《鼹鼠人》，由 Lakeith Stanfield 主演，他在改变游戏规则的《逃出绝命镇》之后重返工作室。萨维奇将这部电影描述为“一部会吓得你魂飞魄散的地下恐怖电影”，这部电影将继承《德州电锯杀人狂》和《山有眼》的风格，萨维奇指出这部电影很快就会开始拍摄。

paras.en: Speaking to the connections between Get Out and Molepeople, Stanfield shared that the 2018 Jordan Peele film “was fantastical on the outside, but there was some heart in it on the inside, and I think that’s the kind of thing I like to replicate and continue to have in my career.” He added, “I found something that I think can be engaging, action-packed, cool, fun, and also a little bit of commentary, too.”
paras.zh: 在谈到《逃出绝命镇》和《鼹鼠人》之间的联系时，斯坦菲尔德表示，乔丹·皮尔 2018 年的电影“表面上很精彩，但里面却有一些用心之处，我认为这就是我喜欢复制并在我的职业生涯中继续拥有的东西。”他补充道，“我发现了一些我认为可以吸引人、充满动感、很酷、有趣，而且还有一点评论的东西。”

paras.en: Wan also teased a new movie with Companion director Drew Hancock, Seasons, which is based on the “No Sleep” subreddit story. “It’s a horror movie that takes place over four seasons,” the producer told the audience after a video featuring Hancock on set with Ron Perlman. Additional titles teased included The Blair Witch Project, with Dylan Clark set to helm, and a new Paranormal Activity entry from Undertones director Ian Tuason, with a video from the director hyping the entry.
paras.zh: 万还取笑了与《伴侣》导演德鲁·汉考克合作的一部新电影《四季》，该电影是根据“No Sleep”子reddit故事改编的。 “这是一部跨越四个季节的恐怖电影，”制作人在播放汉考克与朗·帕尔曼在片场的视频后告诉观众。其他被嘲笑的作品包括迪伦·克拉克 (Dylan Clark) 掌舵的《女巫布莱尔计划》(The Blair Witch Project)，以及由 Undertones 导演伊恩·图森 (Ian Tuason) 执导的新《超自然活动》作品，并附有导演宣传该作品的视频。

paras.en: “Paranormal Activity is such an emotional movie for me because it’s really how Blumhouse started, and it really gave birth to everything that we’ve done,” said Blum. “I hate the idea that you keep making movies and then drive it into the ground, so we stopped making them for a long time. What got me excited is that my partner, who, in my humble opinion, has created three of the greatest horror franchises of all time, which no one else has ever done, came to me.”
paras.zh: “《超自然活动》对我来说是一部非常感人的电影，因为这确实是布卢姆豪斯的起点，它确实催生了我们所做的一切，”布卢姆说。 “我讨厌继续拍电影然后把它推入地下的想法，所以我们很长一段时间都不再制作它们。让我兴奋的是，我的搭档来找我，以我的愚见，他创造了有史以来最伟大的三部恐怖片，这是其他人从未做过的。”

paras.en: Added the producer: “For me, it was enough to hear that, and that’s really what made it happen. People ask me how do you choose what movies go to Blumhouse or Atomic Monster? It’s a very simple answer. Whatever James doesn’t want, we do.”
paras.zh: 制片人补充道：“对我来说，听到这个就足够了，这就是它发生的真正原因。人们问我如何选择哪些电影要在 Blumhouse 或 Atomic Monster 上放映？这是一个非常简单的答案。无论詹姆斯不想要什么，我们都会做。”

paras.en: Wan also spoke about returning to the Saw universe, telling the NYCC crowd that going with director Mike P. Nelson was about “his sensibility” and how he “really prioritizes surprises in his movies. I think the Saw movies are full of surprises, right? It’s all twists and turns. It’s not just about the traps. It’s about the moral dilemma. It’s about the visual style.”
paras.zh: 万还谈到了重返《电锯惊魂》宇宙，他告诉纽约观众，与导演迈克·P·尼尔森合作是因为“他的敏感性”，以及他如何“真正优先考虑电影中的惊喜。我认为《电锯惊魂》电影充满了惊喜，对吧？一切都是曲折的。这不仅仅是关于陷阱。这是关于道德困境。这是关于视觉风格。”

paras.en: As part of the final portion of the jam-packed panel, Something Is Killing the Children creator James Dickinson, as well as the newly announced director Noel, appeared on stage to tease their upcoming title. “My first conversation with Jason about this was really incredible. We have been building the world on Instagram for about seven years now, and we’ve now reached over five million readers around the world. But we’ve always known that this is a franchise that had the potential to reach a much, much bigger audience,” Dickinson said.
paras.zh: 作为挤满了人的小组的最后部分的一部分，《某物正在杀死孩子》的创作者詹姆斯·迪金森以及新宣布的导演诺埃尔出现在舞台上，预告他们即将推出的作品。 “我与杰森关于这个问题的第一次对话真是令人难以置信。我们在 Instagram 上构建世界已经有大约七年了，现在我们已经在全球范围内吸引了超过 500 万读者。但我们一直都知道，这是一个有潜力吸引更多受众的系列，”迪金森说。

paras.en: The duo was pretty mum on when production would start or any filming locations but they did briefly tease what they’re excited about with the characters. While Dickinson confirmed fans can expect to see Octo — the story’s stuffed Octopus with a monster trapped inside it — Noel is quite excited for how fans will experience the story’s protagonist, Erica Slaughter. The director described her as “such a powerful badass” and not only strong, but able to “lift axes and dismember 15-foot monsters,” which the film will get to illustrate. “We also see how funny she can be and that Erica, in the midst of something killing the children, has this very bone-dry humor we’ve really got to nail.”
paras.zh: 两人对制作何时开始或任何拍摄地点都保持沉默，但他们确实简短地透露了他们对角色的兴奋之处。虽然迪金森证实粉丝们可以期待看到章鱼——故事中的章鱼标本，里面困着一个怪物——但诺埃尔对粉丝们将如何体验故事的主角艾丽卡·斯劳特感到非常兴奋。导演形容她是“如此强大的坏蛋”，不仅强壮，而且能够“举起斧头并肢解 15 英尺的怪物”，这部电影将对此进行说明。 “我们还看到她是多么有趣，艾丽卡在杀害孩子们的事情中，有一种非常枯燥的幽默，我们真的必须要解决。”

paras.en: Dickinson also confirmed there would be children killed onscreen. “The first time that Jason and I talked about it, about 20 to 30 minutes into the conversation, I was like, ‘You’ve, like, read the copy? This would be intense,’” he recalled. “It’s called Something Is Killing the Children, and, you know, I promise you, there are kids who die.”
paras.zh: 迪金森还证实银幕上会有儿童被杀。 “杰森和我第一次谈论这个话题时，大约进行了 20 到 30 分钟，我当时想，‘你已经读过文案了吗？这会很激烈，’”他回忆道。 “这就是《有什么东西正在杀死孩子》，你知道，我向你保证，会有孩子死去。”

paras.en: Violent Night stars David Harbour and Kristen Bell were also joined on stage by director Tommy Wirkola and producer Kelly McCormick. While discussing his return to an unusual role, Harbour shared that the sequel happened because there’s “a lot of really rabid, crazy fans out there, and they wanted to know more about Santa’s backstory specifically, and how he got those tattoos and lots of different things. I would go to cons like this, and people would bring up all these questions, and I would video them, and I would send them to Kelly and Tommy. They wrote a script, and it’s really exciting to bring you guys some more Santa.”
paras.zh: 《暴力之夜》的主演大卫·哈伯和克里斯汀·贝尔也与导演汤米·维尔科拉和制片人凯利·麦考密克一同登台。在讨论他回归一个不寻常的角色时，哈伯分享说，续集的发生是因为“有很多非常狂热、疯狂的粉丝，他们想具体了解更多关于圣诞老人的背景故事，以及他是如何得到这些纹身和许多不同的东西。我会去像这样的骗子，人们会提出所有这些问题，我会把它们录下来，然后把它们发送给凯利和汤米。他们写了一个剧本，给你们带来更多圣诞老人真的很令人兴奋。”

paras.en: Bell, who joins the sequel as Mrs. Klaus, shared she was “so confused” she got the call for the role, as she wasn’t aware of a second film. But says her character, “Mrs. Klaus is substantially older than Mr. Klaus. Take that how you will, but if you’re looking at the lore of who came first — and I know the first one, there were sort of moments where you saw his Viking mythology v you’ll get a taste of what Mrs. Klaus’ elven history is.”
paras.zh: 贝尔在续集中饰演克劳斯夫人，她表示，接到这个角色的电话时，她“很困惑”，因为她不知道还有第二部电影。但她的角色说，“克劳斯夫人比克劳斯先生年长得多。不管你怎么想，但如果你看看谁先来的传说——我知道第一个，在某些时刻你看到了他的维京神话，你会领略克劳斯夫人的精灵历史。”

paras.en: The section featured several clips, including an intense multi-minute fight sequence where Harbour’s Santa takes on some henchmen with the tools of a bakery, ending in someone getting cooked, literally. Another clip teased a few more sequences in a moment from the trailer, which sees Bell’s Mrs. Klaus arrive to save the day. Speaking to how she prepared for the role, Bell shared that she had a stunt double, but also trained for five weeks ahead of filming.
paras.zh: 该部分包含了几个片段，其中包括一段长达数分钟的激烈战斗序列，港口的圣诞老人用面包店的工具与一些追随者较量，最终有人被煮熟了。另一个片段在预告片中展示了更多的片段，其中贝尔饰演的克劳斯夫人赶来拯救了世界。在谈到她如何为这个角色做准备时，贝尔分享说，她有一个替身演员，而且还在拍摄前进行了五周的训练。

paras.en: “It was some of the most fun I had ever had at 87North working with stunt people who know exactly what they’re doing and are teaching me about my body and how I can move. I had always known that the physicality of the character is really important, just as important as the words you’re saying,” she said. “Do you take up space in a room, or do you sit back? Are you imposing? What you’re doing with your body can really tell a story. I feel like a billion bucks having learned this choreo.”
paras.zh: “这是我在 87North 与特技人员一起工作最有趣的事情，他们清楚地知道自己在做什么，并教我有关我的身体以及如何移动。我一直都知道角色的身体素质非常重要，就像你所说的话一样重要，”她说。 “你会占据房间的空间，还是会坐下来？你很威风吗？你用身体所做的事情真的可以讲述一个故事。我觉得学会这个舞蹈就像赚了十亿美元。”

paras.en: “It’s basically Miracle on 34th Street with an enormous bloody hammer,” teased Harbour, later revealing, alongside the film’s director, that the original film and its sequel are influenced by Home Alone and Die Hard, which will get its own vent nod in Violent Night 2.
paras.zh: “这基本上就是《34街的奇迹》，带着一把该死的大锤子，”哈伯调侃道，后来与电影导演一起透露，原片及其续集受到了《小鬼当家》和《虎胆龙威》的影响，这两部影片将在《暴力之夜 2》中得到自己的认可。

paras.en: As part of a brief panel that revealed the first trailer for the film, out March 12, Flanagan and Ejiofor teased a movie that is “so god damn scary.”
paras.zh: 3 月 12 日，在揭晓该片首部预告片的简短座谈会上，弗拉纳根和埃加福特嘲笑了一部“太可怕了”的电影。

paras.en: “I can feel it on set. It was freaking me out in my chair,” Flanagan said. “This movie is unlike any other Exorcist movie that’s ever been made, which was something that we were really determined, all of us, to do from the very beginning. It was to take this franchise in a completely different direction. One of the things that we all agreed on going in was that it had to be scary.”
paras.zh: “我在片场就能感觉到。坐在椅子上的我都被吓坏了，”弗拉纳根说。 “这部电影与以往制作的任何其他《驱魔人》电影不同，这是我们所有人从一开始就下定决心要做的事情。要把这个系列带向一个完全不同的方向。我们都同意的一件事是它必须是可怕的。”

paras.en: Speaking to expanding the larger Exorcist universe, Flannigan shared that, “I’ve been lucky enough or crazy enough in my career now several times to step into a franchise underneath a monolithic titan of the genre and have to carry that torch a little further.”
paras.zh: 在谈到扩大《驱魔人》宇宙时，弗兰尼根分享道，“在我的职业生涯中，我有好几次足够幸运或足够疯狂，能够进入该类型巨头的特许经营权，并且必须将火炬传递得更远一些。”

paras.en: He continued: “It is really intimidating because The Exorcist is The Exorcist, and it’s not just [William] Friedkin’s masterpiece that we’re stepping into the shadow of. It’s an entire franchise that has struck out in different directions every time they come to bat. It’s like, they’re going this way, they’re going that way. You’re seeing all sorts of different expressions of this central idea — and it wasn’t just The Exorcist. We talked an awful lot about The Exorcist III, for example. I think [it’s] one of the most underrated, underappreciated films in the franchise. The hallway scene, iconic.”
paras.zh: 他继续说道：“这真的很吓人，因为《驱魔人》就是《驱魔人》，我们步入阴影的不仅仅是[威廉]·弗里德金的杰作。这是一个整个系列，每次他们击球时都会向不同的方向发起冲击。就好像，他们朝这边走，他们朝那个方向走。你会看到这个中心思想的各种不同表达方式——而且不仅仅是《驱魔人》。我们讨论了例如，我认为《驱魔人 3》是该系列电影中最被低估、最不受重视的电影之一，具有标志性。”

paras.en: For Ejiofor, the terror is partly in the feeling. “I think with these, with the way that it talks about that feeling, how do you describe it? That feeling that’s sort of there that you feel can sometimes be a force, a malevolent force that’s just around. Sometimes you can put a name to it. Sometimes you can’t, but you can just sort of feel it around you. And with this, it really felt like it was entering.”
paras.zh: 对于埃加福特来说，恐惧部分在于这种感觉。 “我认为，通过这些，通过它谈论那种感觉的方式，你如何描述它？那种你感觉到的感觉有时可能是一种力量，一种就在身边的恶意力量。有时你可以给它起一个名字。有时你不能，但你可以感觉到它在你周围。有了这个，真的感觉它正在进入。”

paras.en: Following a video message from writer-director Joshua Giuliano, who introduced the film’s trailer but wasn’t present because he is currently prepping his next Blumhouse film Occupant in Vancouver, star of the film Jessica Rothe came to tease the river thriller. Also starring Jane Levy, Max Mattern, and Dane DiLiegro, the film is “wild,” but also a family drama, with “heartfelt moments, terror, a psychotic six-foot-eight ripped, super hot but very scary man,” according to the actress.
paras.zh: 编剧兼导演约书亚·朱利亚诺 (Joshua Giuliano) 发布了视频信息，介绍了电影的预告片，但由于他目前正在温哥华准备下一部布卢姆豪斯电影《占领者》而没有出席，在视频信息之后，电影明星杰西卡·罗德 (Jessica Rothe) 前来取笑这部河流惊悚片。该片由简·莱维、马克斯·马特恩和戴恩·迪利格罗主演，这部电影“狂野”，但也是一部家庭剧，其中有“真挚的时刻、恐怖、一个身高六英尺八、撕裂、超级性感但非常可怕的男人”，这位女演员说。

paras.en: Speaking to the demands of filming a movie so heavily based in water, she told the NYCC crowd that 14 of the 22 shoot days were on the water. “It’s such a gift as an actor to be able to be in the physical element that you’re actually supposed to be in. Because the fear you see on my face when Dane, our incredible masked man, is swimming after me, that’s real fear because I was like, that man is going to catch me. He is definitely faster than I am, and it just adds another element of reality and terror and fun.”
paras.zh: 在谈到拍摄一部如此以水为背景的电影的要求时，她告诉 NYCC 观众，22 个拍摄日中有 14 个是在水上进行的。 “作为一名演员，能够处于你真正应该处于的身体元素中，这真是一种天赋。因为当戴恩，我们令人难以置信的蒙面人在我后面游泳时，你在我脸上看到的恐惧，那是真正的恐惧，因为我想，那个人会抓住我。他肯定比我快，这只是增加了现实、恐怖和乐趣的另一个元素。”

paras.en: Blumhouse Atomic Monster also announced a new short film development deal with multimedia horror storyteller and content creator Heidi Wong. Known as “The Horror Queen,” Wong will create a new horror short film for Blumhouse Atomic Monster through her new development deal. Speaking to tapping creators, Blum noted that what “Kane [Pareons] did and what Curry did, original voices and a fresh point of view and a new take on something we haven’t seen before, is more effective in the world than it’s ever been, which is exciting. It’s exciting for me. It’s much more fun to do what I do. It’s more fun to watch what we all watch, as a result of that. As we continue going forward, we’re always trying to find new, different, original ways to scare all of you and all of us.”
paras.zh: Blumhouse Atomic Monster 还宣布与多媒体恐怖故事讲述者和内容创作者 Heidi Wong 达成新的短片开发协议。被称为“恐怖女王”的王将通过她的新开发协议为 Blumhouse Atomic Monster 制作一部新的恐怖短片。布鲁姆在接受点击创作者采访时指出，“凯恩（帕里昂斯）所做的和库里所做的，原创的声音和新鲜的观点以及对我们以前从未见过的事物的新看法，在世界上比以往任何时候都更有效，这令人兴奋。这对我来说很令人兴奋。做我所做的事情更有趣。因此，观看我们所有人观看的内容更有趣。随着我们继续前进，我们总是在努力寻找新的、以不同的、原创的方式来吓唬你们所有人和我们所有人。”

paras.en: While speaking about the deal on stage with Wong, Blum noted that they are looking to “develop, and hopefully make [the short] into a future film.” While Wong was pretty mum about the plot, she noted her butterfly dress and social media easter eggs hinted at the short’s focus. “It’s inspired by Eastern mythology and folklore,” she told the crowd. “I grew up in Asia, so it’s very close to me, and to have Blumhouse’s support really means so much.”
paras.zh: 在台上谈到与黄的交易时，布鲁姆指出，他们正在寻求“发展，并希望将[短片]制作成未来的电影。”虽然黄对这个情节保持沉默，但她指出她的蝴蝶连衣裙和社交媒体复活节彩蛋暗示了短片的焦点。 “它的灵感来自东方神话和民间传说，”她告诉人群。 “我在亚洲长大，所以它离我很近，得到 Blumhouse 的支持真的意义重大。”

articles.title: Trump's diesel agreement with Putin accused of contradicting Russia sanctions law

paras.en: President Donald Trump's Friday announcement that Russia will supply diesel fuel to the global market marked an apparent pivot from recent efforts to pressure Moscow to end the Ukraine war by targeting Russian energy exports.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周五宣布俄罗斯将向全球市场供应柴油，这标志着最近通过针对俄罗斯能源出口向莫斯科施压以结束乌克兰战争的努力的明显转变。

paras.en: Trump claimed the move, unveiled with less than a month left in an affordability-focused midterm election, would swiftly bring down record-high diesel prices.
paras.zh: 特朗普声称，在以负担能力为重点的中期选举还剩不到一个月的时候公布的这一举措将迅速降低创纪录的高柴油价格。

paras.en: But commentators and critics were quick to highlight contradictions between the new policy and prior efforts by the U.S. to clamp down on Russian oil sales.
paras.zh: 但评论员和批评者很快就强调了新政策与美国此前打压俄罗斯石油销售的努力之间的矛盾。

paras.en: Those efforts most recently included the enactment of the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026, empowering Trump to impose tariffs up to 100% on the top purchasers of Russian crude oil or gas, among other restrictions. Trump signed the bill into law just three weeks ago.
paras.zh: 最近的这些努力包括颁布《2026 年林赛·格雷厄姆制裁俄罗斯和伊朗法案》，授权特朗普对俄罗斯原油或天然气的最大买家征收高达 100% 的关税，以及其他限制。特朗普三周前签署该法案成为法律。

paras.en: "Congress just passed a law giving Trump the power to impose new tariffs on major buyers of Russian oil & gas," Scott Lincicome, vice president of the libertarian Cato Institute, said on X after Trump's Friday announcement.
paras.zh: “国会刚刚通过了一项法律，赋予特朗普对俄罗斯石油和天然气的主要买家征收新关税的权力，”自由主义卡托研究所副所长斯科特·林西科姆在特朗普周五宣布这一消息后对 X 表示。

paras.en: "Can America tariff America?" he quipped.
paras.zh: “美国可以对美国征收关税吗？”他打趣道。

paras.en: Sen. Richard Blumenthal, D-Conn., a member of the Senate Ukraine Caucus, accused Trump's latest move of being "directly contrary to Congress's intent in our bipartisan sanctions bill."
paras.zh: 参议院乌克兰核心小组成员、康涅狄格州民主党参议员理查德·布卢门撒尔指责特朗普的最新举动“直接违背了国会在我们的两党制裁法案中的意图”。

paras.en: Peter Harrell, visiting scholar at Georgetown University Law Center's Institute of International Economic Law, in an X post said that the relaxation of Russian diesel restrictions "pretty much proves the point that the Graham Russia Bill was not going to force the Trump Administration to increase economic pressure on Moscow."
paras.zh: 乔治城大学法律中心国际经济法研究所访问学者彼得·哈勒尔在一篇 X 帖子中表示，俄罗斯柴油限制的放松“很大程度上证明了格雷厄姆俄罗斯法案不会迫使特朗普政府加大对莫斯科的经济压力”。

paras.en: Some of the criticism crossed party lines.
paras.zh: 有些批评跨越了党派界限。

paras.en: "Through the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act, we gave the president significant authorities and leverage against China and Russia to bring Putin's war to an end with a negotiated settlement," Rep. Michael McCaul, R-Texas, said in an X post. "Unfortunately, while I understand the desire to bring down diesel prices, I am concerned the lifting of sanctions on Russian oil will only fund the Kremlin's war machine—emboldening more violence and destruction, as we have seen in recent days," McCaul said.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯州共和党众议员迈克尔·麦考尔在 X 帖子中表示：“通过《林赛·格雷厄姆制裁俄罗斯和伊朗法案》，我们赋予总统针对中国和俄罗斯的重要权力和影响力，以通过谈判达成解决方案来结束普京的战争。”麦考尔表示：“不幸的是，虽然我理解降低柴油价格的愿望，但我担心解除对俄罗斯石油的制裁只会为克里姆林宫的战争机器提供资金，从而助长更多的暴力和破坏，正如我们最近几天所看到的那样。”

paras.en: The White House did not immediately respond to CNBC's questions about the diesel agreement with Russia.
paras.zh: 白宫没有立即回应 CNBC 关于与俄罗斯达成柴油协议的问题。

paras.en: Less than a year earlier, the Trump administration slapped sanctions on multiple Russian oil companies in response to what it called "Russia's lack of serious commitment to a peace process to end the war in Ukraine."
paras.zh: 不到一年前，特朗普政府对多家俄罗斯石油公司实施制裁，以回应所谓的“俄罗斯缺乏对结束乌克兰战争的和平进程的认真承诺”。

paras.en: Trump also had previously slammed NATO allies for continuing to buy Russian oil. In a September 2025 Truth Social post, he wrote, "the purchase of Russian Oil, by some, has been shocking! It greatly weakens your negotiating position, and bargaining power, over Russia."
paras.zh: 特朗普此前还批评北约盟国继续购买俄罗斯石油。他在 2025 年 9 月的《真相社会》帖子中写道，“一些人购买俄罗斯石油令人震惊！这极大地削弱了你们对俄罗斯的谈判地位和议价能力。”

paras.en: Later that month, Trump again harangued world leaders for doing business with Russia.
paras.zh: 当月晚些时候，特朗普再次批评世界领导人与俄罗斯做生意。

paras.en: "They're funding the war against themselves. Who the hell ever heard of that one?" he said in a speech at the United Nations General Assembly. "They can't be doing what they're doing. They're buying oil and gas from Russia while they're fighting Russia."
paras.zh: “他们正在资助针对自己的战争。到底谁听说过这个？”他在联合国大会上发表讲话时说道。 “他们不能做他们正在做的事情。他们一边与俄罗斯作战，一边从俄罗斯购买石油和天然气。”

paras.en: Trump announced the diesel deal in a Truth Social post Friday afternoon after what he described as a "highly successful discussion" with Russian President Vladimir Putin.
paras.zh: 特朗普周五下午在《真相社会》帖子中宣布了这项柴油交易，此前他称与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京进行了“非常成功的讨论”。

paras.en: Under the agreement, Russia will immediately supply more than 300,000 tons of diesel, then another 500,000 tons in November, followed by 1 million tons "immediately thereafter" and 3 million more depending on refinery conditions, Trump wrote.
paras.zh: 特朗普写道，根据协议，俄罗斯将立即供应超过30万吨柴油，然后在11月再供应50万吨，“此后立即”供应100万吨，根据炼油厂条件再供应300万吨。

paras.en: The Treasury Department soon after said that Trump directed the Office of Foreign Assets Control to immediately issue a "temporary general license to allow the supply of Russian diesel to the global market." OFAC specified that the sanctioned transactions will be authorized for about six months, until April 7.
paras.zh: 美国财政部不久后表示，特朗普指示外国资产控制办公室立即颁发“临时一般许可证，允许向全球市场供应俄罗斯柴油”。 OFAC 指定，受制裁交易的授权期限约为六个月，直至 4 月 7 日。

paras.en: Russia seemed to celebrate the move. "Russia-US cooperation on diesel and energy will benefit the world," an X account associated with Putin's economic envoy Kirill Dmitriev said in response to the announcement.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯似乎庆祝这一举动。普京经济特使基里尔·德米特里耶夫（Kirill Dmitriev）的 X 账号在回应这一消息时表示：“俄美在柴油和能源领域的合作将使世界受益。”

paras.en: But Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, whose military has started targeting Russian oil refineries, said in a searing statement that the U.S. easing sanctions on Moscow "plays into Russia's hands."
paras.zh: 但乌克兰总统泽伦斯基（其军队已开始针对俄罗斯炼油厂）在一份严厉的声明中表示，美国放松对莫斯科的制裁“正中俄罗斯的下怀”。

paras.en: "Any easing of sanctions against Russia without a clear and lasting de-escalation agreement with Russia is an obvious weakness," Zelenskyy said. "Allowing Russia to sell petroleum products is an investment in a war that must be ended, not prolonged."
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示：“如果没有与俄罗斯达成明确且持久的降级协议，放松对俄罗斯的制裁就是一个明显的弱点。” “允许俄罗斯出售石油产品是对一场战争的投资，这场战争必须结束，而不是延长。”

paras.en: "We count on America's fair support for our defense of life, for our defense of people in Ukraine – and on the United States having a correspondingly strong conversation with Russia," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们指望美国对我们保卫生命、保卫乌克兰人民的公正支持，并指望美国与俄罗斯进行相应的强有力的对话。”

paras.en: "A strong one, not a weak one," he added.
paras.zh: “是强者，而不是弱者，”他补充道。

paras.en: Trump thanked Putin later Friday afternoon for enabling "massive amounts of oil" to come to the U.S.
paras.zh: 周五下午晚些时候，特朗普感谢普京让“大量石油”运抵美国。

paras.en: "We need oil for the world, and this is diesel, which is what we need, so we're very happy to get it," Trump told reporters before heading to Syracuse, New York.
paras.zh: 特朗普在前往纽约州锡拉丘兹之前对记者表示：“我们世界需要石油，而这就是柴油，这正是我们所需要的，所以我们很高兴得到它。”

paras.en: The Trump administration has previously eased some Russian energy sanctions temporarily, though more narrowly than Friday's announcement.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府此前曾暂时放松了对俄罗斯的一些能源制裁，但幅度比周五的声明要小。

paras.en: Earlier this year, in an attempt to stabilize markets after the start of the Iran war, the Trump administration issued limited, 30-day waivers allowing countries to buy sanctioned Russian oil that was already in transit.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，为了在伊朗战争爆发后稳定市场，特朗普政府发布了为期 30 天的有限豁免，允许各国购买已在运输途中的受制裁俄罗斯石油。

paras.en: But some interpreted the latest move as a more significant step.
paras.zh: 但一些人将最新举措视为更重要的一步。

paras.en: "It looks like Trump cut a deal with the devil," Jeremy Siegel, professor emeritus of finance at the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania, told CNBC's "Closing Bell" Friday afternoon.
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚大学沃顿商学院金融学名誉教授杰里米·西格尔周五下午在 CNBC 的“收盘钟”节目中表示：“特朗普似乎与魔鬼达成了协议。”

paras.en: "It's not a permanent solution at all. It's sort of a short-term Band Aid," Siegel said. "And cutting back on or eliminating sanctions on Russia for the invasion in Ukraine, I think, is a very unfortunate consequence."
paras.zh: “这根本不是一个永久的解决方案。这有点像短期的创可贴，”西格尔说。 “我认为，减少或取消对俄罗斯入侵乌克兰的制裁是一个非常不幸的后果。”

articles.title: AI is changing how lawyers work — and putting the billable hour under pressure

paras.en: Artificial intelligence is now used by almost 90% of legal professionals in the U.K. and Ireland, and it's putting one of the profession's oldest conventions — the billable hour — under the microscope.
paras.zh: 目前，英国和爱尔兰近 90% 的法律专业人士都在使用人工智能，并且该行业最古老的惯例之一——计费时间——也被置于显微镜下。

paras.en: That's according to legal software company Clio's U.K. & Ireland Legal Insights Report 2026.
