articles.title: Opetaia could fight Wilder on Fury-AJ undercard: 'He’s ready to go!'

paras.en: Fury vs Joshua undercard: Jai Opetaia could fight Deontay Wilder on Principality Stadium bill
paras.zh: 富里 vs 约书亚底牌：杰伊·奥佩塔亚可以在公国体育场法案上与德昂泰·维尔德对抗

paras.en: Former heavyweight champion Deontay Wilder and cruiserweight star Jai Opetaia look set to collide on the undercard of the Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua all-British mega-fight on December 11 at the Principality Stadium in Cardiff; Opetaia's long-term target remains David Benavidez
paras.zh: 前重量级冠军德昂泰·维尔德和轻量级明星贾伊·奥佩塔亚看起来将在 12 月 11 日于卡迪夫公国体育场举行的泰森·富里 vs 安东尼·约书亚全英超级大战的底牌上发生碰撞； Opetaia的长期目标仍然是David Benavidez

paras.en: Deontay Wilder could fight Jai Opetaia on the undercard of the Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua blockbuster clash on December 11.
paras.zh: 德昂泰·维尔德可能会在 12 月 11 日泰森·富里对阵安东尼·约书亚的重磅对决中与杰·奥佩塔亚对决。

paras.en: Fury and Joshua meet in a long-awaited, much-anticipated all-British heavyweight fight at the Principality Stadium.
paras.zh: 富里和约书亚在公国体育场举行了一场期待已久的全英重量级拳击比赛。

paras.en: Wilder, the hard-punching former world heavyweight champion, is eyeing a place on the bill against elite cruiserweight Jai Opetaia.
paras.zh: 前世界重量级拳王怀尔德正着眼于与精英轻量级杰伊·奥佩塔亚（Jai Opetaia）的比赛中争夺一席之地。

paras.en: - White: Fury-AJ will be most lucrative gate in British boxing history
paras.zh: -怀特：Fury-AJ将成为英国拳击史上最赚钱的门

paras.en: - Fury vs AJ: 'Not yet determined' who gets A-side second ringwalk
paras.zh: - 富里 vs AJ：“尚未确定”谁将获得 A 方第二环

paras.en: - Follow boxing for news and highlights in the free Sky Sports
paras.zh: - 在免费的天空体育中关注拳击新闻和亮点

paras.en: Dana White, who promotes Opetaia, told Sky Sports: "Jai Opetaia is more than likely going to be on the undercard. [Wilder] is one that we've been talking about and working on."
paras.zh: 奥佩塔亚的推广人达纳·怀特（Dana White）告诉天空体育：“杰·奥佩塔亚很可能会出现在底牌上。[怀尔德]是我们一直在谈论和努力的人之一。”

paras.en: It would be a first high-level heavyweight fight for Opetaia, the unbeaten Australian who has been a force at cruiserweight.
paras.zh: 对于奥佩塔亚来说，这将是他的第一次高水平重量级比赛，这位保持不败的澳大利亚人一直是轻量级的力量。

paras.en: Wilder is now 40 years old but the former WBC titlist is still known for his fearsome punch-power.
paras.zh: 维尔德现在已经 40 岁了，但这位前 WBC 拳王仍然以其可怕的拳击力量而闻名。

paras.en: "The guy's willing to fight anybody," White said of Opetaia. "It's a very dangerous fight for him considering where he sits in his division right now.
paras.zh: “这家伙愿意与任何人战斗，”怀特谈到奥佩塔亚时说道。 “考虑到他现在在分区中的位置，这对他来说是一场非常危险的战斗。

paras.en: "But he's a fighter; he'll fight anybody, even at heavyweight with a guy who hits as hard as Wilder does."
paras.zh: “但他是一名斗士；他会与任何人战斗，即使是在重量级比赛中，与像怀尔德一样重拳出击的人战斗。”

paras.en: Opetaia would likely return to cruiserweight afterwards. He and David Benavidez are considered the two best fighters in the 200lb weight class and Benavidez remains Opetaia's ultimate target.
paras.zh: 之后奥佩塔亚很可能会重返轻量级。他和大卫·贝纳维德斯被认为是 200 磅级别中最好的两名拳手，而贝纳维德斯仍然是奥佩塔亚的最终目标。

paras.en: "That's the fight he really wants. He wants that fight so we've got to figure that one out," White said, adding: "He wants to stay active, he wants to fight and he doesn't care if it's at heavyweight or wherever, he's ready to go."
paras.zh: “这就是他真正想要的战斗。他想要那场战斗，所以我们必须弄清楚这一点，”怀特说，并补充道：“他想要保持活跃，他想要战斗，他不在乎是否是重量级比赛或任何地方，他已经准备好了。”

paras.en: Wilder had an epic trilogy with Tyson Fury and came close to setting a fight with Anthony Joshua, only to lose to Joseph Parker.
paras.zh: 维尔德与泰森·富里打出了史诗般的三部曲，并差点与安东尼·约书亚展开对决，但最终输给了约瑟夫·帕克。

paras.en: In his last fight Wilder battled to a points win over British contender Derek Chisora at The O2 in London in April.
paras.zh: 4 月，怀尔德在伦敦 O2 体育馆举行的最后一场比赛中，以一分击败英国选手德里克·奇索拉 (Derek Chisora)。

articles.title: Masked Man and Wellington Arch tackle Chepstow's Silver Trophy

paras.en: Today on Sky Sports Racing: Chepstow, Hexham and Southwell feature live on Saturday
paras.zh: 今天天空体育赛车：切普斯托、赫克瑟姆和绍斯韦尔周六直播

paras.en: With the new jumps season up and running, the Silver Trophy takes centre stage at Chepstow with Wellington Arch and Masked Man set to feature; we also have competitive action from Hexham and Southwell, live on Sky Sports Racing from 1.35pm
paras.zh: 随着新的跳跃赛季的开始和运行，银奖杯将在切普斯托成为焦点，惠灵顿拱门和蒙面人将成为亮点；我们还有来自 Hexham 和 Southwell 的竞技比赛，从下午 1.35 开始在 Sky Sports Racing 直播

paras.en: We have a busy day's racing on Saturday with action from Chepstow, Hexham and Southwell, live on Sky Sports Racing...
paras.zh: 周六我们将进行忙碌的一天比赛，切普斯托、赫克瑟姆和绍斯韦尔的比赛将在天空体育赛车直播......

paras.en: 4.02 Chepstow - Wellington Arch and Masked Man spearhead classy field
paras.zh: 4.02 切普斯托 - 惠灵顿拱门和蒙面人先锋经典球场

paras.en: The feature Wasdell Group Silver Trophy Handicap Hurdle at Chepstow looks a belter with Masked Man and Wellington Arch among a host of contenders.
paras.zh: 切普斯托的瓦斯德尔集团银杯障碍跨栏看起来与蒙面人和惠灵顿拱门等众多竞争者齐名。

paras.en: Masked Man has been at the head of the market all week and this lightly raced five-year-old must be feared on handicap debut. He scored on two of his four hurdles starts last season while running with credit in Graded company and ought to be involved.
paras.zh: “蒙面人”整周都在市场上处于领先地位，这匹表现平淡的五岁马在让分赛首秀中一定会令人感到恐惧。上赛季他在 Graded 公司的四场跨栏比赛中，有两场都取得了进球，并且他应该参与其中。

paras.en: Wellington Arch has a very different profile having landed a pair of handicaps on his last two outings. Ultra-impressive when landing a strong Aintree contest, he will need more again to defy a further seven-pound rise.
paras.zh: 惠灵顿拱门的情况截然不同，在过去的两次比赛中遭遇了一些障碍。当他在安特里的比赛中表现出色时，他将需要更多的力量来对抗进一步增加的七磅体重。

paras.en: Melon claimed an Aintree handicap on his last hurdling run and arrives fit from a spin on the Flat.
paras.zh: 甜瓜在最后一次跨栏比赛中声称受到安特里让分，并在平地上旋转后恢复健康。

paras.en: Glynn Brae and The Mighty Celt are others will obvious each-way chances as well as last year's victor Rambo T.
paras.zh: 格林·布雷 (Glynn Brae) 和强大的凯尔特队 (The Mighty Celt) 以及去年的冠军兰博·T (Rambo T) 都是其他明显的单向机会。

paras.en: 3.45 Hexham - Prolific Passing Diamond faces Tiddesley Wood
paras.zh: 3.45 赫克瑟姆 - 多产传球钻石面对蒂德斯利伍德

paras.en: Prolific Passing Diamond takes on three rivals in a trappy Cast Novices' Limited Handicap Chase at Hexham.
paras.zh: 多产传球戴蒙德 (Prolific Passing Diamond) 在赫克瑟姆 (Hexham) 举行的一场充满陷阱的演员新手有限让分追逐赛中与三名对手对决。

paras.en: The Ben Haslam-trained six-year-old has relished the switch to fencing winning both starts at Cartmel and deserves a crack at this better race. A natural jumper, he ought to take some catching.
paras.zh: 这位经过本·哈斯拉姆 (Ben Haslam) 训练的六岁赛马很高兴转战击剑，并在卡特梅尔 (Cartmel) 的两场比赛中都获得了胜利，值得在这场更好的比赛中一试身手。作为一个天生的跳投手，他应该接受一些接球。

paras.en: Tiddesley Wood is the chief danger as he makes his debut for trainer Adrian Keatley. He doubled his tally over hurdles when landing a Kempton novice on his final start for Fergal O'Brien and remains of interest over fences.
paras.zh: 蒂德斯利·伍德 (Tiddesley Wood) 是教练阿德里安·基特利 (Adrian Keatley) 首次亮相时的主要危险。在为费格尔·奥布莱恩 (Fergal O'Brien) 做最后一场比赛时，他在坎普顿新手上场时将跨栏得分翻了一番，并且在跨栏方面仍然令人感兴趣。

paras.en: Ballykinlar and Passengerontheship complete the quartet.
paras.zh: Ballykinlar 和 Passengerontheship 构成了四重奏。

paras.en: 7.30 Southwell - Recent scorer Tanjen contests strong heat
paras.zh: 7.30 Southwell - 最近的得分手 Tanjen 对抗强大的热度

paras.en: Recent winner Tanjen features among a field of nine for the competitive Pilsner To The Post Handicap at Southwell.
paras.zh: 最近的获胜者 Tanjen 跻身于绍斯韦尔 (Southwell) 的 Pilsner To The Post Handicap 比赛的九名参赛者之列。

paras.en: Tim Easterby's four-year-old has won over this course and distance and arrives on the back of a comfortable success at Hamilton. Up seven pounds, he switches back to the all-weather and will be fancied to follow up.
paras.zh: 蒂姆·伊斯特比 (Tim Easterby) 的四岁赛马在这条赛道和距离上取得了胜利，并在汉密尔顿取得了轻松的成功。体重增加了七磅后，他又回到了全天候状态，预计会继续跟进。

paras.en: Star Noir bounced back to life with an eight-and-a-half length victory at Catterick and reverts to handicaps with strong claims.
paras.zh: “黑星”在卡特里克赛中以八个半马位的胜利重新焕发活力，并以强劲的赔率恢复让分。

paras.en: David O'Meara's top-weight Goyard was only just denied over this course and distance last month and a similar effort would put him in the frame despite a one-pound rise.
paras.zh: 大卫·奥米拉 (David O'Meara) 的顶级重量级 Goyard 上个月刚刚在这条路线和距离上被拒绝，尽管体重增加了一磅，但类似的努力仍将使他进入框架。

articles.title: A 7.7-magnitude earthquake rocks Panama
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: A 7.7-magnitude earthquake shook the central coast of Panama on Friday, prompting tsunami warnings for several neighboring countries.
paras.zh: 周五，巴拿马中部海岸发生7.7级地震，多个邻国收到海啸警报。

paras.en: The earthquake hit around 1:56 p.m. ET, according to the U.S. Geological Survey. Around three hours later, a second powerful earthquake measuring at 6.6 magnitude, struck Panama after a series of aftershocks, which registered magnitudes between 4.8 and 5.8, rippled across the southern tip of the country.
paras.zh: 地震发生在下午 1 点 56 分左右。 ET，根据美国地质调查局。大约三小时后，巴拿马南端发生了一系列余震，震级在 4.8 至 5.8 级之间，随后又发生了第二次 6.6 级强烈地震。

paras.en: Seismologists at the University of Panama recorded more than 45 aftershocks, though many were too weak to be felt.
paras.zh: 巴拿马大学地震学家记录了超过 45 次余震，但其中许多余震太弱，无法被感觉到。

paras.en: The U.S. Tsunami Center flagged tsunami warnings for Ecuador, Colombia, Nicaragua, Guatemala, Mexico, El Salvador, Costa Rica and Peru, as well as Panama, shortly after the quake.
paras.zh: 地震发生后不久，美国海啸中心向厄瓜多尔、哥伦比亚、尼加拉瓜、危地马拉、墨西哥、萨尔瓦多、哥斯达黎加、秘鲁以及巴拿马发出海啸警报。

paras.en: The initial earthquake was centered about 6 miles southwest of the remote community of Pitaloza Arriba, near Panama’s southern tip, the USGS said. It struck at a depth of 6 miles.
paras.zh: 美国地质调查局表示，最初的地震震中位于巴拿马南端附近的偏远社区皮塔洛萨阿里巴西南约 6 英里处。撞击深度为 6 英里。

paras.en: Tremors were also felt in the capital, Panama City, where buildings shook and people evacuated into the streets. The city is known for its tall skyscrapers.
paras.zh: 首都巴拿马城也有震感，建筑物摇晃，人们疏散到街道上。这座城市以其高耸的摩天大楼而闻名。

paras.en: Visibly shaken residents gathered outside as they waited for news of the quake’s impact.
paras.zh: 明显受到惊吓的居民聚集在外面，等待地震影响的消息。

paras.en: “We felt it very strongly. It knocked things over in the kitchen, but we’re OK, though we’re very scared,” Rosendo Domínguez, 60, who is from Herrera province, told The Associated Press by phone. “Everyone is outside, scared.”
paras.zh: 来自埃雷拉省的 60 岁罗森多·多明格斯 (Rosendo Domínguez) 通过电话告诉美联社：“我们的感觉非常强烈。它把厨房里的东西打翻了，但我们没事，尽管我们很害怕。” “每个人都在外面，很害怕。”

paras.en: Omar Smith of the National Civil Protection Service said the damage was concentrated in the central provinces of Veraguas, Herrera and Los Santos.
paras.zh: 国家民防局的奥马尔·史密斯表示，损失主要集中在中部省份贝拉瓜斯、埃雷拉和洛桑托斯。

paras.en: Smith said several injuries have been reported, including one person struck by debris from a partially collapsed structure in the city of Penonomé. He confirmed a partial collapse and cracks at the cathedral in the district’s main square and the Dos Continentes hotel.
paras.zh: 史密斯说，据报道有多人受伤，其中一人被佩诺诺梅市部分倒塌建筑的碎片击中。他证实该地区主广场的大教堂和多斯大陆酒店出现部分倒塌和裂缝。

paras.en: No fatalities were immediately reported, but Malitzie Rivera, deputy director of Panama Civil Protection said injured people “have been transferred to educational centers, health centers, and hospital centers.”
paras.zh: 目前尚未有人员死亡的报道，但巴拿马民防局副局长马利茨·里维拉表示，受伤人员“已被转移到教育中心、卫生中心和医院中心”。

paras.en: The province of Coclé said the governor’s palace there suffered significant structural damage, but that staff members were safely evacuated. The local government also urged community members to remain calm in the quake’s aftermath.
paras.zh: 科克莱省表示，省长官邸遭受严重结构性损坏，但工作人员已安全疏散。当地政府还敦促社区成员在地震发生后保持冷静。

paras.en: Video aired by local news outlets showed a Catholic cathedral collapsing and part of a hotel’s facade falling onto a car in the city of Penonomé, in the central province of Coclé.
paras.zh: 当地新闻媒体播放的视频显示，在中部科克莱省的佩诺诺梅市，一座天主教大教堂倒塌，一家酒店外墙的一部分掉到了一辆汽车上。

paras.en: Social media videos show collapsed buildings near the site of the original quake and the aftershocks, including a hotel reduced to rubble in the tourist-friendly Playa Venao.
paras.zh: 社交媒体视频显示，原地震和余震现场附近的建筑物倒塌，其中包括游客友好的维纳奥海滩 (Playa Venao) 的一家酒店被夷为废墟。

paras.en: Panama’s National System for Civil Protection said it is monitoring for further reports of damage throughout the country.
paras.zh: 巴拿马国家民事保护系统表示，正在监测全国各地有关损失的进一步报告。

paras.en: Panama lies along the “Ring of Fire,” the line of seismic faults encircling the Pacific Ocean where most of the world’s earthquakes occur.
paras.zh: 巴拿马位于“火环”沿线，即环绕太平洋的地震断层线，世界上大多数地震都发生在这里。

paras.en: Nearby countries sent messages of support Friday afternoon. Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella, whose country was recently hit by earthquakes, expressed his solidarity with the Panamanian people and their government during what he called “difficult times.”
paras.zh: 周五下午，附近国家发出了支持信息。哥伦比亚总统阿韦拉多·德拉埃斯普里埃拉的国家最近遭受了地震袭击，他在他所说的“困难时期”表达了对巴拿马人民及其政府的声援。

paras.en: “Panama is not alone! You can count on Colombia’s support and our full willingness to provide whatever assistance is needed,” he wrote on X.
paras.zh: “巴拿马并不孤单！您可以信赖哥伦比亚的支持，我们完全愿意提供所需的任何援助，”他在 X 上写道。

paras.en: The U.S. Embassy in Panama said it was “closely monitoring” the aftermath of the quake and accounting for the welfare of its citizens in Panama, a well-known retirement destination for Americans.
paras.zh: 美国驻巴拿马大使馆表示，正在“密切监视”地震的后果，并考虑巴拿马公民的福利，巴拿马是美国人著名的退休目的地。

articles.title: State Department IG probing Kimberly Guilfoyle amid alleged $100,000 demand
articles.author: Garrett Haake

paras.en: U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle and the embassy she leads are under investigation by the State Department’s Office of the Inspector General, two people familiar with the decision confirmed to NBC News.
paras.zh: 两名知情人士向 NBC 新闻证实，美国驻希腊大使金伯利·吉尔福伊尔 (Kimberly Guilfoyle) 和她领导的大使馆正在接受国务院监察长办公室的调查。

paras.en: The government watchdog’s probe comes as legal consultant and longtime Donald Trump supporter and donor Eric Deters has accused Guilfoyle of asking him to pay her outstanding $100,000 American Express bill in the days before her 2025 confirmation hearing in exchange for access to senior administration officials.
paras.zh: 政府监管机构展开调查之际，法律顾问、唐纳德·特朗普的长期支持者和捐助者埃里克·德特斯 (Eric Deters) 指控吉尔福伊尔要求他在 2025 年提名确认听证会前几天支付她未付的 10 万美元美国运通账单，以换取接触高级政府官员的机会。

paras.en: “She was so desperate for that $100,000. It was a quid pro quo,” Deters told NBC News in an interview Thursday.
paras.zh: “她非常渴望那 10 万美元。这是一个交换条件，”德特斯在周四接受 NBC 新闻采访时表示。

paras.en: “She said I could ask her for anything and everything in Trump world. There was no request too big,” he said of Guilfoyle, a former Fox News personality, Trump campaign surrogate and ex-fiancee of Donald Trump Jr.
paras.zh: “她说我可以向她提出特朗普世界里的任何事情。没有什么要求太大，”他谈到前福克斯新闻名人、特朗普竞选代理人、小唐纳德·特朗普的前未婚妻吉尔福伊尔时说道。

paras.en: Deters provided NBC News with a PDF document of texts and Signal messages with Guilfoyle, which were first reported Wednesday by The Wall Street Journal. The Daily Mail first reported the watchdog investigation.
paras.zh: 德特斯向 NBC 新闻提供了一份 PDF 文档，其中包含与 Guilfoyle 的文本和 Signal 消息，《华尔街日报》于周三首次报道了该消息。 《每日邮报》首先报道了监管机构的调查。

paras.en: One of the messages provided by Deters appears to show Guilfoyle instructing him to wire the money directly to American Express because “it won’t show up anywhere” that way. He said he did not pay her the money.
paras.zh: 德特斯提供的一条消息似乎显示吉尔福伊尔指示他将钱直接汇给美国运通卡，因为这样“钱就不会出现在任何地方”。他说他没有付给她钱。

paras.en: An attorney for Guilfoyle did not respond to a request for comment, but told the Journal she disputed the authenticity of the messages while not providing specifics.
paras.zh: 吉尔福伊尔的律师没有回应置评请求，但告诉《华尔街日报》，她对消息的真实性提出质疑，但没有提供具体细节。

paras.en: Vice President JD Vance said Friday that “these are accusations” and “we don’t try people in the court of public opinion.”
paras.zh: 副总统万斯周五表示，“这些都是指控”，“我们不会在舆论法庭上审判人。”

paras.en: Deters’ claims, he said, are “one person’s story.”
paras.zh: 他说，德特斯的说法是“一个人的故事”。

paras.en: “Let’s actually see what the facts are. Let’s see what the truth is, and obviously if there was something bad that happened, then people have to suffer consequences for it,” he said.
paras.zh: “让我们看看事实是什么。让我们看看真相是什么，显然，如果发生了不好的事情，那么人们就必须承受后果，”他说。

paras.en: Rep. Gregory Meeks, the top Democrat on the House Foreign Affairs Committee, wrote to Secretary of State Marco Rubio last week asking for more information about additional allegations that appeared in The Wall Street Journal.
paras.zh: 众议院外交事务委员会民主党领袖、众议员格雷戈里·米克斯上周写信给国务卿马可·卢比奥，要求提供有关《华尔街日报》上出现的其他指控的更多信息。

paras.en: On Thursday, Rubio chided a reporter for asking him about the accusations against Guilfoyle while he was with her in Athens.
paras.zh: 周四，卢比奥指责一名记者在雅典与吉尔福伊尔在一起时询问他对吉尔福伊尔的指控。

paras.en: “We don’t conduct these things in a press conference on a tarmac in a foreign country because you wrote a story or somebody else wrote a story because some source gave it to you,” he said, adding: “I don’t even know if what you’re reporting is true.”
paras.zh: “我们不会在外国停机坪上的新闻发布会上进行这些事情，因为你写了一个故事，或者其他人写了一个故事，因为一些消息来源给了你，”他说，并补充说：“我什至不知道你所报道的是否属实。”

paras.en: A senior diplomatic official, meanwhile, said the news of probe set off alarm bells throughout the State Department. The official described the investigation as rare and said that watchdog is known primarily for performing routine embassy inspections rather than investigations.
paras.zh: 与此同时，一名高级外交官员表示，调查的消息给整个国务院敲响了警钟。该官员称此次调查非常罕见，并表示该监管机构主要以对大使馆进行例行检查而不是调查而闻名。

paras.en: A spokesperson for the State Department inspector general’s office said the watchdog does not confirm, deny or comment on investigations.
paras.zh: 美国国务院监察长办公室发言人表示，该监管机构不会证实、否认或评论调查。

paras.en: The State Department declined to comment on the accusations against Guilfoyle or any investigation.
paras.zh: 美国国务院拒绝就针对吉尔福伊尔的指控或任何调查发表评论。

paras.en: Watchdog investigations into potential ethics violations by U.S. ambassadors are rare, but not unprecedented.
paras.zh: 监管机构对美国大使潜在违反道德行为的调查很少见，但并非史无前例。

paras.en: During the first Trump administration, Woody Johnson, then the U.S. ambassador to the U.K. and a longtime Republican donor, was investigated by the State Department’s inspector general, who found he made “inappropriate” comments on race, gender and religion to embassy staff.
paras.zh: 在特朗普第一届政府期间，时任美国驻英国大使、长期共和党捐助者伍迪·约翰逊接受了国务院监察长的调查，发现他向使馆工作人员发表了有关种族、性别和宗教的“不当”评论。

paras.en: The State Department rejected recommendations for Johnson, saying he had watched a government video on workplace harassment and instructed senior officials to do the same, and also encouraged staff to take a training course on “mitigating unconscious bias.”
paras.zh: 美国国务院拒绝了对约翰逊的建议，称他观看了有关工作场所骚扰的政府视频，并指示高级官员也这样做，并鼓励工作人员参加“减少无意识偏见”的培训课程。

paras.en: Under President Joe Biden in 2024, the watchdog investigated U.S. Ambassador to Singapore Jonathan Kaplan, finding the political appointee threatened his staff and failed to submit about $48,000 in travel expenses on time or with proper documentation.
paras.zh: 2024 年，乔·拜登总统任内，该监管机构对美国驻新加坡大使乔纳森·卡普兰进行了调查，发现这位政治任命者威胁其工作人员，并且未能按时或提供适当文件提交约 48,000 美元的差旅费。

paras.en: In Kaplan’s case, State said it was taking the recommendations seriously and made organizational changes.
paras.zh: 在卡普兰的案例中，国务院表示正在认真对待这些建议，并进行了组织变革。

paras.en: “The president always wants his representatives ... to manage people with dignity and respect,” former White House National Security Council spokesman John Kirby said at the time. “He’s comfortable that the State Department is taking this seriously.”
paras.zh: “总统总是希望他的代表……以尊严和尊重的方式管理人民，”前白宫国家安全委员会发言人约翰·柯比当时表示。 “他对国务院认真对待此事感到放心。”

articles.title: Breaking: Indian police detain 'cockroach' movement founder Abhijeet Dipke

paras.en: The founder of the Cockroach Janta Party has been arrested ahead of a protest against India's electoral commission on Saturday.
paras.zh: 蟑螂简塔党的创始人在周六针对印度选举委员会的抗议活动之前被捕。

paras.en: TV channels reported earlier that police officers met founder Abhijeet Dipke at the Delhi airport after he arrived from the financial capital Mumbai and asked him to call off the protest as authorities had banned it.
paras.zh: 电视频道早些时候报道称，创始人阿比吉特·迪普克(Abhijeet Dipke)从金融首都孟买抵达后，警察在德里机场会见了他，并要求他取消抗议活动，因为当局已禁止抗议活动。

paras.en: Party leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were also detained from their flight upon landing, the movement said in a statement.
paras.zh: 该运动在一份声明中表示，该党领导人萨乌拉夫·达斯(Saurav Das)和阿舒托什·兰卡(Ashutosh Ranka)也在飞机着陆后被拘留。

paras.en: Thousands of protesters are expected at Jantar Mantar, where authorities have imposed sweeping restrictions, including suspension of mobile internet.
paras.zh: 预计简塔·曼塔天文台将有数千名抗议者，当局已实施全面限制，包括暂停移动互联网。

paras.en: Police said on Friday they had denied permission for the protest because the request was submitted late.
paras.zh: 警方周五表示，由于请求提交较晚，他们拒绝了抗议活动的许可。

paras.en: The demonstration site has been cordoned off with yellow metal barricades and thousands of police have been deployed in and around the area.
paras.zh: 示威地点已用黄色金属路障封锁，该地区及周边地区部署了数千名警察。

paras.en: Restrictions on train services and metro stations were expected to disrupt travel across the capital and make it harder for protesters to reach the venue.
paras.zh: 对火车服务和地铁站的限制预计将扰乱首都的交通，并使抗议者更难到达会场。

paras.en: The preparations signal the authorities' determination to contain a fast-growing protest campaign that has drawn opposition support and intensified scrutiny of Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
paras.zh: 这些准备工作表明当局决心遏制快速增长的抗议活动，抗议活动引起了反对派的支持，并加强了对总理纳伦德拉·莫迪的审查。

paras.en: The protests also come at a politically sensitive time, months after demonstrations led by the "Cockroach" movement over exam paper leaks forced Modi's education minister to resign in July.
paras.zh: 这次抗议活动也是在政治敏感时期发生的，几个月前，“蟑螂”运动因试卷泄露引发的示威活动迫使莫迪的教育部长于 7 月辞职。

articles.title: Samoa looks for power from pain in World Cup tilt

paras.en: Fri, 11 Sept, 7:50 pm, Final score, Rabbitohs 10, Knights 20
paras.zh: 9 月 11 日星期五，晚上 7:50，最终比分，Rabbitohs 10，Knights 20

paras.en: Samoa looking to find power in grand final pain ahead of Rugby League World Cup
paras.zh: 萨摩亚希望在橄榄球联盟世界杯前的总决赛痛苦中找到力量

paras.en: The Rugby League World Cup was officially launched on Saturday with representatives from all 10 men's teams and eight women's teams.
paras.zh: 橄榄球联盟世界杯于周六正式启动，共有 10 支男子球队和 8 支女子球队的代表参加。

paras.en: Samoa captain Junior Paulo hopes those in his side who lost last week's NRL Grand Final can use their pain to propel the Toa to a repeat of 2022, when they made the final.
paras.zh: 萨摩亚队长朱尼尔·保罗希望他的球队在上周的 NRL 总决赛中失利，能够利用他们的痛苦来推动 Toa 重演 2022 年的决赛，当时他们已经进入了决赛。

paras.en: The men's tournament kicks off on Thursday night while the women's edition begins on Friday afternoon.
paras.zh: 男子比赛于周四晚上开始，女子比赛于周五下午开始。

articles.title: Outback Dolly Parton Festival bigger and glitzier than ever after star's death
articles.author: Catherine James, Lucy Thackray, and Samuel O'Brien

paras.en: An outback town has traded its 9 to 5 farm tools and workwear for a day of bedazzled country glam and platinum-blonde bouffants inspired by megastar Dolly Parton.
paras.zh: 一个内陆小镇放弃了朝九晚五的农具和工作服，换来了一整天令人眼花缭乱的乡村魅力和受巨星多莉·帕顿 (Dolly Parton) 启发的白金金发卷发。

paras.en: The 3,500-resident town of Narromine in western NSW transformed into "Dollymine" for its annual October festival which celebrates the country music icon, who died in August at the age of 80.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州西部拥有 3,500 名居民的纳罗明镇 (Narromine) 因一年一度的 10 月音乐节而摇身一变成为“Dollymine”，以纪念这位乡村音乐偶像，他于 8 月去世，享年 80 岁。

paras.en: "So this is Dollymine — not Narromine — for the weekend," attendee Juanita Peardon said.
paras.zh: “所以这是周末的 Dollymine，而不是 Narromine，”与会者胡安妮塔·皮尔登 (Juanita Peardon) 说。

paras.en: A record number of visitors were urged to leave their frown at the updated town sign for this year's event.
paras.zh: 今年活动更新后的城镇标志吸引了创纪录数量的游客。

paras.en: Along the streets of "Dollymine", a sea of pink and bejewelled coats of many colours, sweet lovin' friends and wayfaring strangers gathered to say in their own way "I Will Always Love You" to the Queen of Country.
paras.zh: 沿着“Dollymine”的街道，一片粉红色和宝石般的色彩海洋，甜蜜的挚爱朋友和远行的陌生人聚集在一起，用自己的方式向国家女王说“我将永远爱你”。

paras.en: Festival organiser Skye Rush said she has been blown away by the support this year.
paras.zh: 音乐节组织者斯凯·拉什 (Skye Rush) 表示，今年的支持令她震惊。

paras.en: "It's been great; locals have come out in force and all the visitors have come out in force as well," she said.
paras.zh: “这太棒了；当地人都来了，所有游客也都来了，”她说。

paras.en: "Our shops are being used, our accommodation is being used, [the event] fills the town with people."
paras.zh: “我们的商店正在被使用，我们的住宿正在被使用，[活动]让整个城镇挤满了人。”

paras.en: The festival began in 2022, run by a volunteer committee of die-hard Dolly fans.
paras.zh: 该节日于 2022 年开始，由顽固的多莉粉丝志愿者委员会主办。

paras.en: It faced funding challenges, and was cancelled in 2024, before being rescued by a $150,000 state government grant and a boost from the local council.
paras.zh: 它面临资金挑战，并于 2024 年被取消，随后得到了 15 万美元的州政府拨款和地方议会的支持。

paras.en: Ms Rush said the event has always been about celebrating Parton's legacy, even before she died in August.
paras.zh: 拉什女士表示，这个活动一直是为了庆祝帕顿的遗产，甚至在她八月份去世之前也是如此。

paras.en: "It's her attitude to people, attitude to small towns, attitude to not forgetting where she's from,"
paras.zh: “这是她对人的态度，对小镇的态度，对不忘记自己来自哪里的态度，”

paras.en: "We're a small town and we support our locals."
paras.zh: “我们是一个小镇，我们支持当地人。”

paras.en: Narromine Elder Aunty Ruth said Dolly Parton represents a lot to the town.
paras.zh: 纳罗迈恩老阿姨露丝说，多莉·帕顿对这个镇来说代表着很多。

paras.en: "Why wouldn't you celebrate such a beautiful person?" she said.
paras.zh: “你为什么不庆祝这么美丽的人呢？”她说。

paras.en: "To me country is country, and to be on the land; if country music's part of the land, that's where we are going to be."
paras.zh: “对我来说，乡村就是乡村，生活在这片土地上；如果乡村音乐是这片土地的一部分，那我们就要去那里。”

paras.en: The town is five and a half hours north-west of Sydney, but the remote location has not stopped people from all over the country from coming to celebrate.
paras.zh: 该小镇距离悉尼西北方向有五个半小时车程，但偏远的地理位置并没有阻止来自全国各地的人们前来庆祝。

paras.en: Best-dressed judge Dolly Delicious, travelled to the event from Canberra and has attended all five festivals.
paras.zh: 最佳着装评委 Dolly Delicious 从堪培拉赶来参加活动，并参加了所有五个节日。

paras.en: He said Dolly Parton's death in August has not put a dampener on celebrations.
paras.zh: 他说多莉·帕顿八月份的去世并没有影响庆祝活动。

paras.en: "I'm a bit sad but I'm actually really excited to celebrate her ... all her music, all her looks," he said.
paras.zh: “我有点难过，但实际上我很高兴能够庆祝她......她所有的音乐，她所有的外表，”他说。

paras.en: "It makes me really fuzzy inside — it's incredible."
paras.zh: “这让我内心非常模糊——这太不可思议了。”

paras.en: Sam and Amber Bloem got married last week and sang Parton's 1982 duet Islands in the Stream at their reception instead of a first dance.
paras.zh: Sam 和 Amber Bloem 上周结婚了，他们在招待会上唱了 Parton 1982 年的二重唱《Islands in the Stream》，而不是跳第一支舞。

paras.en: "We love Dolly so we had to stop in," Amber said.
paras.zh: “我们喜欢多莉，所以我们不得不停下来，”安布尔说。

paras.en: "[There's] lots of pink and sparkles ... fantastic music; it' s just lovely."
paras.zh: “[有]很多粉红色和闪光......美妙的音乐；真是太可爱了。”

paras.en: The Bourke locals said it was especially important to celebrate Dolly's legacy this year, including her efforts to promote literacy in children.
paras.zh: 布尔克当地人表示，今年庆祝多莉的遗产尤其重要，包括她为促进儿童识字所做的努力。

paras.en: "Our kids were part of her Imagination Library, so they've been getting books sent from her every month since they've been born," Amber said.
paras.zh: “我们的孩子是她想象力图书馆的一部分，所以自从他们出生以来，他们每个月都会收到她寄来的书籍，”安布尔说。

paras.en: "Our kids call her aunty Dolly because she sends something in the post each month,"
paras.zh: “我们的孩子们叫她多莉阿姨，因为她每个月都会邮寄一些东西，”

paras.en: For Johnny Gilmore, supporting regional towns like Narromine has also been a motivator.
paras.zh: 对于约翰尼·吉尔摩来说，支持纳罗迈恩等地区城镇也是一个动力。

paras.en: "We always like to support country towns and we love the music, so we always come out and try to support the town and have some fun," he said.
paras.zh: “我们总是喜欢支持乡村小镇，我们喜欢音乐，所以我们总是出来尝试支持小镇并享受一些乐趣，”他说。

paras.en: "I love her music; everything from the 70s and 80s is always wonderful."
paras.zh: “我喜欢她的音乐；70 年代和 80 年代的一切总是那么美妙。”

articles.title: 8 people hospitalized after turbulence forces Medellin-New York flight to divert to Miami
articles.author: Jillian Kestler-D'Amours

paras.en: 8 people hospitalized after turbulence forces Medellin-New York flight to divert to Miami
paras.zh: 麦德林-纽约航班因湍流被迫改飞迈阿密 造成 8 人住院

paras.en: Eight passengers have been hospitalized after an Avianca Airlines flight bound for New York City was forced to divert to Miami due to turbulence, local officials and the airline have said.
paras.zh: 当地官员和阿维安卡航空公司表示，一架飞往纽约市的航班因湍流被迫改道至迈阿密，导致八名乘客入院治疗。

paras.en: Greg Chin, communications director of the Miami-Dade Aviation Department, said in an email Friday morning that Avianca Flight 042 — travelling from Medellin, Colombia, to New York's John F. Kennedy International Airport — landed at Miami International Airport at 3:30 a.m.
paras.zh: 迈阿密戴德航空部通讯总监格雷格·钦 (Greg Chin) 在周五早上的一封电子邮件中表示，阿维安卡航空 042 号航班——从哥伦比亚麦德林飞往纽约约翰·肯尼迪国际机场——于凌晨 3:30 降落在迈阿密国际机场。

paras.en: "Eight passengers were transported to a nearby hospital," Chin told CBC News.
paras.zh: 钦告诉加拿大广播公司新闻：“八名乘客被送往附近的一家医院。”

paras.en: The condition of the injured passengers was not immediately clear.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚受伤乘客的情况。

paras.en: An Avianca Airlines plane prepares to take off at San Oscar Arnulfo Romero International Airport in San Luis Talpa, El Salvador, in 2022. (Jose Cabezas/Reuters)
paras.zh: 阿维安卡航空公司的一架飞机准备于 2022 年在萨尔瓦多圣路易斯塔尔帕的圣奥斯卡·阿努尔福·罗梅罗国际机场起飞。（Jose Cabezas/路透社）

paras.en: In a statement sent to CBC on Friday, Avianca said the flight "encountered unexpected turbulence during its journey."
paras.zh: 阿维安卡航空公司在周五发给加拿大广播公司的一份声明中表示，该航班“在飞行过程中遇到了意外的湍流”。

paras.en: "As a precaution and in accordance with the airline’s safety protocols, the flight was diverted to Miami International Airport (MIA), where the aircraft landed safely," it said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“作为预防措施，根据航空公司的安全协议，该航班被转移到迈阿密国际机场（MIA），并在那里安全着陆。”

paras.en: Three members of the crew and six passengers were affected, the airline added, without specifying who had been transported to hospital.
paras.zh: 该航空公司补充说，三名机组人员和六名乘客受到影响，但没有具体说明哪些人已被送往医院。

paras.en: The Miami-Dade Fire Rescue Department (MDFR) told CBC News it transported one person to the main trauma centre while seven others were taken to local hospitals by private ambulances.
paras.zh: 迈阿密戴德消防局 (MDFR) 告诉 CBC 新闻，已将一名人员送往主要创伤中心，另有七人被私人救护车送往当地医院。

paras.en: It said eight MDFR units had responded to a "medical call" at 3:10 a.m. following "reports of turbulence in an aircraft."
paras.zh: 据称，在接到“飞机出现湍流的报告”后，八个 MDFR 单位已于凌晨 3 点 10 分接到“医疗呼叫”。

paras.en: Local media outlets aired footage showing multiple fire department vehicles, with their lights flashing, on the Miami airport tarmac.
paras.zh: 当地媒体播放的视频显示，迈阿密机场停机坪上有多辆消防车闪烁着灯光。

paras.en: Maria Paula Jimenez, one of the passengers, told CBS News Miami that she saw "more than five or six ambulances" when the plane landed in Miami.
paras.zh: 其中一名乘客玛丽亚·保拉·希门尼斯告诉哥伦比亚广播公司迈阿密新闻，当飞机降落在迈阿密时，她看到“超过五六辆救护车”。

paras.en: "When we arrived, well, you know, it wasn't normal."
paras.zh: “当我们到达时，嗯，你知道，这不正常。”

paras.en: Chin at Miami International Airport said the flight was scheduled to depart for JFK International Airport at 8:15 a.m. Friday "with the remaining passengers."
paras.zh: 迈阿密国际机场的 Chin 表示，该航班定于周五上午 8 点 15 分“与其余乘客”一起飞往肯尼迪国际机场。

paras.en: The airport's flight tracker showed Avianca Flight 042 departed at that time.
paras.zh: 机场的航班追踪显示阿维安卡航空 042 号航班当时起飞。

paras.en: Avianca said it made arrangements for the remaining passengers to continue to New York while it "remains in contact with the affected passengers and crew members as it continues to respond to the situation."
paras.zh: 阿维安卡航空公司表示，已安排剩余乘客继续前往纽约，同时“在继续应对局势的同时与受影响的乘客和机组人员保持联系”。

paras.en: "The safety of our customers and employees is, and will remain, the foundation of our operations."
paras.zh: “我们客户和员工的安全现在是、将来也将是我们运营的基础。”

articles.title: FlyDubai co-pilot sought to crash plane into Tel Aviv's main airport: UAE

paras.en: FlyDubai co-pilot sought to crash plane into Tel Aviv's main airport: UAE
paras.zh: FlyDubai副驾驶试图将飞机撞向特拉维夫主要机场：阿联酋

paras.en: UAE prosecutor statement says co-pilot 'drew inspiration' from 9/11
paras.zh: 阿联酋检察官声明称副驾驶从 9/11 事件中“汲取灵感”

paras.en: The axe-wielding co-pilot who attacked the captain of a FlyDubai flight to Tel Aviv last month intended to seize control of the airplane and fly it into the passenger terminal at Israel's main international airport, authorities in the United Arab Emirates said Friday.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯联合酋长国当局周五表示，上个月，一名挥舞斧头的副驾驶袭击了飞往特拉维夫的迪拜航空航班的机长，意图控制飞机并将其带入以色列主要国际机场的航站楼。

paras.en: The suspect, an Omani national, did so "with the intention of causing the greatest possible number of human casualties," the UAE's top prosecutor said in a statement carried by the state news agency WAM. Most of the 174 passengers on the flight were from Israel.
paras.zh: 阿联酋最高检察官在国家通讯社WAM发表的一份声明中表示，嫌疑人是阿曼人，他这样做“目的是造成尽可能多的人员伤亡”。该航班上的 174 名乘客大部分来自以色列。

paras.en: The statement said the co-pilot "drew inspiration" from the Sept. 11, 2001, attacks in the United States and used two previous flights from Dubai to Tel Aviv to "familiarize himself with the flight route and the airport."
paras.zh: 声明称，副驾驶从2001年9月11日发生在美国的袭击中“汲取了灵感”，并利用之前从迪拜飞往特拉维夫的两次航班来“熟悉飞行路线和机场”。

paras.en: It said none of FlyDubai's security or professional checks had indicated that the pilot, who was identitifed by The Associated Press as 29-year-old Hamam al-Hammami, harboured extremist views or plans to carry out an attack.
paras.zh: 据称，FlyDubai 的安全或专业检查均未表明这名被美联社确认为 29 岁哈马姆·哈马米 (Hamam al-Hammami) 的飞行员怀有极端主义观点或计划实施袭击。

paras.en: Co-pilot admits acting alone: prosecutor
paras.zh: 副驾驶承认单独行动：检察官

paras.en: Hammami "admitted that he had acted alone, without the involvement of others," the statement said, adding that he "provided a detailed confession outlining his motives and the stages of planning and execution" in the presence of his lawyer. It also suggested he was radicalized at a mosque in Australia while attending the Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology in 2017.
paras.zh: 声明称，哈马米“承认他是单独行动，没有其他人参与”，并补充说，他在律师在场的情况下“提供了详细的供词，概述了他的动机以及计划和执行的阶段”。它还表明他在2017年就读皇家墨尔本理工学院时在澳大利亚的一座清真寺里变得激进。

paras.en: The update from the public prosecutor Friday was the most comprehensive since the UAE took over the investigation shortly after the incident on Sept. 30. FlyDubai is a government-owned airline.
paras.zh: 检察官周五发布的最新消息是自阿联酋 9 月 30 日事件发生后不久接管调查以来最全面的更新。FlyDubai 是一家政府拥有的航空公司。

paras.en: The crisis unfolded suddenly in the skies above Jordan and Saudi Arabia, when Hammami attacked the captain, Smit Machchhar, with a crash axe in the cockpit. Bloodied and beaten, Machchhar managed to open the cockpit door, alerting passengers and crew to the assault.
paras.zh: 危机在约旦和沙特阿拉伯上空突然爆发，哈马米在驾驶舱内用一把坠毁斧袭击了机长斯密特·马赫恰尔。马赫恰尔浑身是血，遭到殴打，他设法打开驾驶舱门，提醒乘客和机组人员注意这次袭击。

paras.en: Passengers detained Hammami and helped steady the aircraft, which had plunged roughly 14,000 to 16,000 feet in less than a minute. Two reserve pilots then guided the plane to an emergency landing at Tabuk airport in Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 乘客们扣留了哈马米并帮助稳定了飞机，飞机在不到一分钟内就坠落了大约 14,000 至 16,000 英尺。随后，两名预备飞行员引导飞机紧急降落在沙特阿拉伯塔布克机场。

articles.title: Hurricane Isaias makes landfall on U.S. Gulf Coast as Category 2 storm

paras.en: Hurricane Isaias makes landfall on U.S. Gulf Coast as Category 2 storm
paras.zh: 飓风伊萨亚斯以 2 级风暴的形式登陆美国墨西哥湾沿岸

paras.en: U.S. National Hurricane Center says Isaias made landfall near Destin, Fla., on Friday
paras.zh: 美国国家飓风中心称伊萨亚斯于周五在佛罗里达州德斯坦附近登陆

paras.en: Hurricane Isaias crashed into the U.S. Gulf Coast as a dangerous Category 2 storm on Friday, lashing communities in Alabama and the Florida Panhandle with damaging winds, heavy rain, flooding and life-threatening storm surge.
paras.zh: 周五，飓风伊萨亚斯以危险的 2 级风暴袭击了美国墨西哥湾沿岸，给阿拉巴马州和佛罗里达州狭长地带的社区带来了破坏性的大风、暴雨、洪水和危及生命的风暴潮。

paras.en: The first hurricane of the Atlantic season made landfall near Destin, Fla., the Miami-based U.S. National Hurricane Center said. It had maximum sustained winds of 169 km/h. The storm weakened to just below major hurricane status before it came ashore.
paras.zh: 总部位于迈阿密的美国国家飓风中心表示，大西洋季节的第一场飓风在佛罗里达州德斯坦附近登陆。最大持续风速为 169 公里/小时。风暴在登陆前减弱至略低于主要飓风级别。

paras.en: "The storm is here. Buckle down at this point. Don't be getting out on the roads," Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis said at a news conference, adding that flash flooding would be a hazard "throughout the region."
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州州长罗恩·德桑蒂斯在新闻发布会上表示：“风暴来了。此时请系好安全带。不要上路。”他补充说，山洪暴发将成为“整个地区”的危险。

paras.en: Hurricane-force winds lashed the Gulf shoreline in the low-lying coastal area known for powdery white sand beaches that are dotted with vacation homes, waterfront bars and seafood shacks. Forecasters warned the conditions could also stir up tornadoes.
paras.zh: 飓风袭击了低洼沿海地区的墨西哥湾海岸线，该地区以粉状白色沙滩而闻名，沙滩上点缀着度假屋、海滨酒吧和海鲜小屋。预报员警告说，这种情况也可能引发龙卷风。

paras.en: People are seen leaving a gas station in Mobile, Ala., on Friday, which had been boarded up prior to the hurricane's arrival. (Octavio Jones/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周五，人们看到人们离开阿拉巴马州莫比尔的一家加油站，该加油站在飓风到来之前已经用木板封起来。 （奥克塔维奥·琼斯/美联社）

paras.en: In Mobile, Ala., officials reported downed trees and power lines, while Emerald Coast Utilities Authority, which serves parts of Florida, issued a boil-water notice for its customers.
paras.zh: 在阿拉巴马州莫比尔，官员报告了树木和电线倒塌的情况，而为佛罗里达州部分地区提供服务的翡翠海岸公用事业管理局则向客户发布了烧水通知。

paras.en: More than 400,000 customers in Florida and Alabama were without power Friday evening, according to poweroutage.com.
paras.zh: 据 poweroutage.com 称，周五晚上，佛罗里达州和阿拉巴马州有超过 40 万用户断电。

paras.en: Residents in Panama City, Fla., braved the rain while filling sandbags Friday to protect their houses.
paras.zh: 周五，佛罗里达州巴拿马城的居民冒着大雨填沙袋以保护他们的房屋。

paras.en: "I mean, it's just the nature of the beast. It's Florida," said Corliss Stone, who works for the fire department.
paras.zh: “我的意思是，这就是野兽的本性。这是佛罗里达州，”在消防部门工作的科利斯·斯通说。

paras.en: A downed tree blocks a road in Pensacola, Fla., on Friday, as Isaias-driven wind and rain approached the area. (Joe Raedle/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 周五，随着伊萨亚斯带来的风雨逼近该地区，一棵倒下的树堵塞了佛罗里达州彭萨科拉的一条道路。 （乔·雷德尔/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: One of the biggest concerns is a storm surge that could be as high as 1.8 to 2.7 metres, according to the hurricane centre. Places most at risk include Florida's Pensacola Beach and the Gulf Islands National Seashore.
paras.zh: 据飓风中心称，最大的担忧之一是风暴潮可能高达 1.8 至 2.7 米。风险最高的地方包括佛罗里达州的彭萨科拉海滩和海湾群岛国家海岸。

paras.en: Anne Petzold, who lives with her husband in the Florida beach community of Gulf Breeze, said everyone in their neighbourhood planned to ride out the storm. The couple installed hurricane shutters and picked up anything in their yard that could turn into a projectile.
paras.zh: 安妮·佩佐德 (Anne Petzold) 和丈夫住在佛罗里达州微风湾海滩社区，她说，附近的每个人都计划安然度过这场风暴。这对夫妇安装了防风百叶窗，并捡起了院子里任何可能变成弹丸的东西。

paras.en: "Everybody does what they can do, everybody asks if they need help — they ask for help, they offer help. All good," she said. "It's just another adventure."
paras.zh: “每个人都尽其所能，每个人都询问是否需要帮助——他们寻求帮助，他们提供帮助。一切都很好，”她说。 “这只是另一次冒险。”

paras.en: Dangerous conditions are expected throughout the western panhandle, southern Alabama and southern Mississippi, the U.S. National Hurricane Center said. Several counties announced mandatory evacuations while Mobile, Ala., imposed a curfew beginning Friday evening until morning.
paras.zh: 美国国家飓风中心表示，预计整个西部狭长地带、阿拉巴马州南部和密西西比州南部都会出现危险情况。几个县宣布强制疏散，阿拉巴马州莫比尔从周五晚上到早上实施宵禁。

paras.en: In a sign of how serious the warnings are, dozens of Waffle Houses in the Florida Panhandle were closed, according to the company's website. The beloved Southern breakfast chain is known for staying open through severe weather and often is a measuring stick of a storm's severity.
paras.zh: 据该公司网站称，佛罗里达狭长地带的数十家华夫饼店已被关闭，这表明警告的严重性。这家深受喜爱的南方早餐连锁店以在恶劣天气下保持营业而闻名，并且常常是风暴严重程度的衡量标准。

paras.en: Kelsei Frazier, a Florida-native living in Pace who is no stranger to hurricanes, knows all about the Waffle House Index.
paras.zh: 凯尔塞·弗雷泽 (Kelsei Frazier) 是一位居住在佩斯的佛罗里达人，对飓风并不陌生，他对华夫饼屋指数了如指掌。

paras.en: "We joke because if Waffle House is still open, then you know it's not a bad hurricane, but all the Waffle Houses that I know of within at least a normal range from us are closed," said Frazier. "Which is a pretty big deal."
paras.zh: 弗雷泽说：“我们开玩笑是因为，如果华夫饼屋仍然开放，那么你就知道这不是一场严重的飓风，但据我所知，距离我们至少正常范围内的所有华夫饼屋都关闭了。” “这是一件大事。”

paras.en: DeSantis warned residents to expect power outages, gasoline shortages and closures of bridges and highways.
paras.zh: 德桑蒂斯警告居民，预计会出现停电、汽油短缺以及桥梁和高速公路关闭的情况。

paras.en: The state's National Guard deployed about 5,000 soldiers and airmen to help with the response, and search and rescue teams were ready to respond, while some prisons evacuated inmates.
paras.zh: 该州国民警卫队部署了约 5,000 名士兵和飞行员来协助应对，搜救队也做好了应对准备，同时一些监狱还疏散了囚犯。

paras.en: Gas pumps at a gas station in Mobile, Ala., are seen wrapped in plastic earlier Friday, ahead of the arrival of Hurricane Isaias. (Octavio Jones/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周五早些时候，在飓风伊萨亚斯到来之前，阿拉巴马州莫比尔的一个加油站的加油泵被塑料包裹着。 （奥克塔维奥·琼斯/美联社）

paras.en: Isaias is expected to weaken and be downgraded to a tropical storm by Saturday afternoon, the center said.
paras.zh: 该中心表示，预计到周六下午，伊萨亚斯将减弱并降级为热带风暴。

paras.en: Still, heavy rain is forecast as it moves inland, with 10 to 20 centimetres or even more expected through the weekend from southern Alabama to southwestern Georgia.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，预计随着大雨向内陆移动，预计周末从阿拉巴马州南部到佐治亚州西南部将会有10到20厘米甚至更多的大雨。

articles.title: Poland: Lifeline for Ukrainian refugees confronts donor fatigue and online abuse as anti-Ukrainian sentiment grows

paras.en: Hours after Vladimir Putin announced his "special military operation" in Ukraine on February 24, 2022, Russian troops began attacking Kyiv's Antonov Airport close to the home of Nastya Podorozhnya's family.
paras.zh: 2022 年 2 月 24 日，弗拉基米尔·普京 (Vladimir Putin) 宣布在乌克兰实施“特别军事行动”数小时后，俄罗斯军队开始袭击靠近娜斯佳·波多罗日尼亚 (Nastya Podorozhnya) 家人的基辅安东诺夫机场。

paras.en: Nastya was 24 at the time and living in Krakow in neighboring Poland, having recently graduated from the city's Jagiellonian University.
paras.zh: 纳斯蒂亚当时 24 岁，住在邻国波兰的克拉科夫，最近刚从该市的雅盖隆大学毕业。

paras.en: Alarmed by the reports coming out of Ukraine and fearful of what was to come, Nastya rushed back to Ukraine two days before the invasion to be with her family and help her sister and her three children cross the border to safety in Poland.
paras.zh: 纳斯蒂亚对来自乌克兰的报道感到震惊，并对即将发生的事情感到恐惧，在入侵前两天赶回乌克兰与家人团聚，帮助她的妹妹和三个孩子越过边境到达波兰的安全地带。

paras.en: Nastya realized she could use her experience of living in Poland — how to get a doctor's appointment or simply buy a tram ticket — to help the many women and children arriving in the country from Ukraine.
paras.zh: 纳斯蒂亚意识到她可以利用自己在波兰的生活经验——如何预约医生或简单地购买电车票——来帮助许多从乌克兰抵达该国的妇女和儿童。

paras.en: Poles were offering help and food at the border, but some people sought to take advantage of the vulnerable arrivals.
paras.zh: 波兰人在边境提供帮助和食物，但有些人试图利用弱势群体。

paras.en: "I spoke to activists engaged in anti-human trafficking and they said what was happening at the border in the first weeks after the invasion was like Christmas, Easter and birthdays rolled into one for traffickers because people were so easily trusting the volunteers," Nastya told DW in a two-bedroom apartment in central Krakow her organization uses to provide shelter to vulnerable women refugees escaping domestic abuse or trafficking.
paras.zh: 纳斯蒂亚在克拉科夫市中心的一套两居室公寓里告诉德国之声：“我与从事反人口贩运活动的活动人士交谈，他们说入侵后头几周在边境发生的事情就像贩运者的圣诞节、复活节和生日一样，因为人们很容易信任志愿者。”

paras.en: Named Martynka, after Nastya's youngest niece, the organization also runs a hotline. It has received more than 5,000 requests for help since March 2022 and now gets about a hundred every month.
paras.zh: 该组织以娜斯佳最小的侄女的名字命名为“马丁卡”，还开通了一条热线电话。自 2022 年 3 月以来，它已收到 5,000 多个帮助请求，现在每个月大约收到 100 个。

paras.en: Her small team provides psychological and moral support in four languages as well as legal assistance and counselling.
paras.zh: 她的小团队以四种语言提供心理和道德支持以及法律援助和咨询。

paras.en: "One of the very young women who lived with us for a long time was drugged by her boyfriend who she met as a teenager when she escaped the full-scale invasion and after years of relationship she found out that he has been drugging her and selling sex with her to other people" she said.
paras.zh: “其中一位长期与我们住在一起的非常年轻的女性被她的男友下药，她是在十几岁时逃离全面入侵时认识的，经过多年的关系，她发现他一直在给她下药，并向其他人卖淫。”她说。

paras.en: Nastya said she was motivated to help partly because of a traumatic experience of her own. While studying in Krakow, a Ukrainian man tried to rape her outside of her dormitory.
paras.zh: 纳斯蒂亚说，她之所以愿意提供帮助，部分原因是她自己的一次创伤经历。在克拉科夫学习期间，一名乌克兰男子试图在宿舍外强奸她。

paras.en: After a long and difficult legal process, during which police detained the suspect before releasing him, he was eventually found guilty of violating Nastya's bodily autonomy and given a restraining order.
paras.zh: 经过漫长而艰难的法律程序，警方拘留了嫌疑人，然后将其释放，最终他被判犯有侵犯纳斯佳身体自主权罪，并被授予限制令。

paras.en: "This terrible, traumatic experience not only gave me horrible PTSD, which later on sort of helped me be empathetic and understand survivors with PTSD, but also it put me through the system of justice and how survivors are being treated," she added.
paras.zh: “这次可怕的创伤经历不仅给我带来了可怕的创伤后应激障碍（PTSD），这在后来帮助我产生了同理心并理解了创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）幸存者，而且还让我了解了司法系统以及幸存者如何受到对待，”她补充道。

paras.en: Since 2022, around 100 women and children have found shelter in the apartment. Her team's work relies largely on donations from international organizations.
paras.zh: 自 2022 年以来，约有 100 名妇女和儿童在该公寓找到了庇护所。她的团队的工作很大程度上依赖于国际组织的捐款。

paras.en: But cuts to USAID have led to increased competition for grants, while donor fatigue has forced the team to cut its one-to-one therapy sessions.
paras.zh: 但美国国际开发署的削减导致了赠款竞争的加剧，而捐助者的疲劳也迫使该团队减少了一对一的治疗疗程。

paras.en: "Ukraine is not in the headlines anymore," says Nastya. "The international attention has moved elsewhere. For all of summer 2026 we have been running a very challenging fundraising campaign. It is so hard to convince people to donate to a Ukrainian organization right now. There is something called exhaustion, donor exhaustion, fundraising exhaustion."
paras.zh: “乌克兰不再成为头条新闻，”纳斯蒂亚说。 “国际社会的注意力已经转移到其他地方。2026 年整个夏天，我们一直在开展一场非常具有挑战性的筹款活动。现在很难说服人们向乌克兰组织捐款。有一种叫做耗尽、捐助者耗尽、筹款耗尽的现象。”

paras.en: The UNHCR's acting representative for Poland, Czechia and Slovakia, Jun Shirato, confirmed the difficult situation in the aid sector.
paras.zh: 联合国难民署驻波兰、捷克和斯洛伐克的代理代表白户淳（Jun Shirato）证实了援助部门的困难处境。

paras.en: Speaking to DW in Warsaw, she said that funding cuts last year have forced UNHCR to scale back its staff in Poland by two thirds, from 120 at its peak in the months after the invasion to 40 now. The UNHCR has now closed three of its regional offices opened in Krakow, Lublin and Rzeszow after Russia's invasion of Ukraine. Its sole remaining office in Poland is in Warsaw.
paras.zh: 她在华沙接受德国之声采访时表示，去年的资金削减迫使难民署在波兰的工作人员人数减少了三分之二，从入侵后几个月最高峰的120人减少到现在的40人。俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后，联合国难民署现已关闭在克拉科夫、卢布林和热舒夫设立的三个地区办事处。它在波兰仅存的唯一办事处位于华沙。

paras.en: Nastya's fundraising efforts increasingly meet with online abuse, too.
paras.zh: 纳斯蒂亚的筹款活动也越来越多地遭遇网络谩骂。

paras.en: Attitudes toward Ukrainians in Poland have changed. In the months after the invasion, many Poles opened their homes to refugees, including Nastya's sister and her daughters.
paras.zh: 波兰对乌克兰人的态度发生了变化。入侵后的几个月里，许多波兰人向难民开放了家园，其中包括娜斯佳的姐姐和她的女儿们。

paras.en: The situation is now very different. Earlier this year, new rules restricting access to child benefits and free healthcare for refugees who don't work were introduced.
paras.zh: 现在的情况已经大不相同了。今年早些时候，出台了限制不工作难民获得儿童福利和免费医疗的新规定。

paras.en: In the first half of this year, reports of hate crimes committed against Ukrainians in Poland rose by a third according to Polish police statistics.
paras.zh: 根据波兰警方的统计数据，今年上半年，波兰境内针对乌克兰人的仇恨犯罪报告增加了三分之一。

paras.en: At the same time, historical disputes between Poland and Ukraine, have resurfaced, fueling further hostility toward the Ukrainian community, which accounts for more than three quarters of all foreigners living in Poland.
paras.zh: 与此同时，波兰和乌克兰之间的历史争端再次浮出水面，进一步加剧了对乌克兰社区的敌意，乌克兰社区占居住在波兰的外国人总数的四分之三以上。

paras.en: In May, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's decision to name a military unit after the Ukrainian Insurgent Army (UPA), which took part in the murder of tens of thousands of Poles during the World War II, triggered outrage in Poland.
paras.zh: 今年5月，乌克兰总统泽伦斯基决定以乌克兰起义军（UPA）的名字命名一支军事部队，该部队在二战期间参与了杀害数万名波兰人的行动，引发了波兰的愤怒。

paras.en: Polish President Karol Nawrocki stripped Zelenskyy of Poland's highest state honor, the Order of the White Eagle.
paras.zh: 波兰总统卡罗尔·纳罗基剥夺了泽伦斯基的波兰最高国家荣誉——白鹰勋章。

paras.en: While Poles focus on the UPA's massacre of Polish citizens, many Ukrainians view the UPA and nationalist leaders like Stepan Bandera as heroes because they fought against the Soviet occupation after the war.
paras.zh: 虽然波兰人关注统一进步联盟对波兰公民的屠杀，但许多乌克兰人将统一进步联盟和斯捷潘·班德拉这样的民族主义领导人视为英雄，因为他们在战后反抗苏联的占领。

paras.en: "This week we are supporting a family of Ukrainians whose car was completely destroyed. No windows left in the car and with spray paint someone wrote 'Bandera people go back where you came from,'" said Nastya, adding, "I think it is so devastating and I've recorded a video about it. We have hundreds of comments there, of people wishing me death, wishing me to go back where I came from. It is very tough emotionally."
paras.zh: 纳斯蒂亚说：“本周我们正在支持一个乌克兰家庭，他们的汽车被完全摧毁。车上没有窗户，有人用喷漆写着‘班德拉人回到你来的地方’。”她补充道，“我认为这真是毁灭性的，我录制了一个关于它的视频。我们有数百条评论，人们希望我死，希望我回到我来的地方。这在情感上非常艰难。”

paras.en: Nastya said the hostility is also driven by Russia using online bots to stoke tensions between Poles and Ukrainians.
paras.zh: 纳斯蒂亚表示，俄罗斯利用在线机器人加剧波兰人和乌克兰人之间的紧张关系也是造成这种敌意的原因。

paras.en: "They do not want us to be together, or to remember who our common enemy is. They don't want Ukrainian refugees to integrate or feel welcome," she said.
paras.zh: “他们不希望我们在一起，也不希望我们记住我们共同的敌人是谁。他们不希望乌克兰难民融入社会或感到受欢迎，”她说。

paras.en: Despite the strain, Nastya remains optimistic that she and her team can continue their work.
paras.zh: 尽管压力很大，纳斯蒂亚仍然乐观地认为她和她的团队可以继续他们的工作。

paras.en: "For some reason I am — and this is the weirdest thing. I love my job so much. I want to do this beautiful thing. I would easily send my mother, my sister, my best friend to Martynka for support. I know there are few organizations that could provide such wonderful help."
paras.zh: “出于某种原因，我是——这是最奇怪的事情。我非常热爱我的工作。我想做这件美丽的事情。我会很容易地把我的母亲、我的妹妹、我最好的朋友送到马丁卡那里寻求支持。我知道很少有组织能够提供如此出色的帮助。”

paras.en: If you or someone you know have experienced any kind of gender-based violence, the website lila.help lists trustworthy helplines and NGOs that offer support in almost every country in the world.
paras.zh: 如果您或您认识的人经历过任何形式的性别暴力，lila.help 网站列出了值得信赖的帮助热线和非政府组织，它们在世界上几乎每个国家/地区提供支持。

articles.title: Is China seeking to restrict Taiwan's cultural presence?

paras.en: When Taiwaneseauthor Yang Shuang-zi's "Taiwan Travelogue" won the 2026 International Booker Prize, it marked a historic breakthrough on the global stage. But behind the triumph lay a sharp geopolitical reality.
paras.zh: 台湾作家杨双子的《台湾游记》荣获2026年国际布克奖，标志着在全球舞台上的历史性突破。但胜利的背后却隐藏着尖锐的地缘政治现实。

paras.en: On stage, Lin King, who translated the book into English, gave voice to the anxiety looming over Taiwan, where she spent a large part of her childhood.
paras.zh: 在舞台上，将这本书翻译成英文的林金表达了她在台湾度过的大部分童年时光所笼罩的焦虑情绪。

paras.en: "In 2022, when Russia invaded Ukraine, I made the explicit decision that rather than translating Sinophone works indiscriminately, I would only translate writing from Taiwan for the foreseeable future. I will continue to do so until the day comes that my homeland's sovereignty is no longer a provocation or a punchline — until no English speaker feels comfortable saying to me, 'I really should come visit you in Taiwan while it still exists.'" she said in her acceptance speech.
paras.zh: “2022年，当俄罗斯入侵乌克兰时，我做出了明确的决定，在可预见的未来，我不会不加区别地翻译华语作品，而是只翻译台湾的作品。我将继续这样做，直到我祖国的主权不再是挑衅或笑话的那一天——直到没有一个说英语的人愿意对我说，‘我真的应该在台湾还存在的时候来拜访你。’”她在获奖感言中说道。

paras.en: "Taiwan Travelogue" follows a young Japanese writer visiting Japanese-colonized Taiwan in May 1938 on an official government-sponsored lecture tour. As she and her Taiwanese interpreter explore local street food together, a subtle intimacy unfolds between them. The narrative centers Taiwan's history rather than Beijing's preferred "Greater China" framework.
paras.zh: 《台湾游记》讲述了一位年轻的日本作家于 1938 年 5 月在政府资助的官方巡回演讲中访问日本殖民地台湾的故事。当她和她的台湾翻译一起探索当地街头美食时，他们之间展开了微妙的亲密关系。叙事以台湾历史为中心，而不是北京偏爱的“大中华”框架。

paras.en: "Literature and politics are directly connected," Yang told DW. "Politics determines the allocation of resources, and the allocation of resources determines which works get pulled out, held up high and defined as 'good literature.' The idea that politics can just be kept out of it doesn't exist."
paras.zh: “文学和政治是直接相关的，”杨告诉德国之声。 “政治决定资源配置，资源配置决定哪些作品被拔出、被高举、被定义为‘好文学’。认为政治可以被排除在外的想法并不存在。”

paras.en: A few days after the 2026 International Booker Prize was announced, China's Taiwan Affairs Office reacted by saying the following: "Writers from both sides of the Taiwan Strait should firmly uphold a national standpoint, respect historical facts, and squarely face the immense suffering inflicted upon the Chinese people ... by Japan's war of aggression and fascism."
paras.zh: 2026年国际布克奖公布几天后，中国国台办回应称：“海峡两岸作家应坚定民族立场，尊重历史事实，正视日本侵略战争和法西斯战争给中国人民带来的巨大苦难。”

paras.en: "From China's perspective, they do not want to see Taiwan's voice gain prominence." Yang said.
paras.zh: “从中国的角度来看，他们不希望看到台湾的声音受到重视。”杨说。

paras.en: Her book demonstrates that Taiwanese culture is shaped by multiple historical strands — including Indigenous, Japanese colonial and local Han influences, rather than being merely a "branch of Chinese culture."
paras.zh: 她的书表明，台湾文化是由多种历史因素塑造的，包括原住民、日本殖民和当地汉族的影响，而不仅仅是“中华文化的一个分支”。

paras.en: During Yang's German book tour this October, an event at the Literaturhaus in the southern German city of Munich sparked controversy when the writer's interpreter significantly shortened certain statements concerning Taiwan, China, history and politics. The interpreter later admitted that there had been oversights and shortcomings in the translation but denied deliberately deleting content due to their political stance or the situation in Taiwan.
paras.zh: 今年十月杨洁篪的德国售书活动期间，德国南部城市慕尼黑文学馆举行的一次活动引发了争议，当时这位作家的翻译大幅缩短了有关台湾、中国、历史和政治的某些陈述。该翻译后来承认翻译存在疏忽和缺陷，但否认因政治立场或台湾局势而故意删除内容。

paras.en: Beijing claims Taiwan as a Chinese province and has long threatened to use force to bring the island under its control. Taiwan's democratically elected president has rejected Beijing's assertion that its laws apply to Taiwan.
paras.zh: 北京声称台湾是中国的一个省，并长期以来威胁要使用武力将该岛置于其控制之下。台湾民选总统拒绝了北京关于其法律适用于台湾的说法。

paras.en: Since 1949, Taiwan has functioned with de facto independence, maintaining its own government, military, and legal systems while facing ongoing military pressure from Beijing.
paras.zh: 自 1949 年以来，台湾一直以事实上的独立运作，维持自己的政府、军事和法律体系，同时面临来自北京的持续军事压力。

paras.en: China's monitoring of Taiwanese international engagement reaches far further than words over a literature prize.
paras.zh: 中国对台湾国际参与的监控远远超出了文学奖的言论。

paras.en: "The target of suppression and harassment primarily include outspoken individuals, exiled activists, diaspora community organizers, alongside their family members and close affiliates back home, " said said Dr. Yan-ho Lai, a senior fellow of Georgetown Center for Asian Law. "From the PRC's (People's Republic of China) eyes, these groups are a threat to regime security, as they are able to amplify the dissenting voices and alternative stories of China to the West."
paras.zh: 乔治敦亚洲法律中心高级研究员赖彦浩博士说：“镇压和骚扰的目标主要包括直言不讳的个人、流亡活动人士、侨民社区组织者，以及他们在国内的家人和关系密切的人。” “从中华人民共和国的角度来看，这些团体对政权安全构成威胁，因为他们能够向西方放大中国的异议声音和另类故事。”

paras.en: In April this year, Taiwanese barista Lin Shao-hsing, also known as Bala, won the 2026 World Latte Art Championship in the United States. Soon after, all mention of Taiwan as it related to Bala's win was removed from the official World Coffee Championships website.
paras.zh: 今年4月，台湾咖啡师林绍兴（又名巴拉）在美国获得2026年世界拉花艺术锦标赛冠军。不久之后，世界咖啡锦标赛官方网站上删除了所有与巴拉获胜有关的台湾内容。

paras.en: It now says that Bala was representing "the competition body of Chinese Taipei," a term often used in international contests, such as the Olympics, to refer to Taiwan, but almost never used in Taiwan itself.
paras.zh: 现在它说巴拉代表“中华台北的比赛机构”，这个词经常在奥运会等国际比赛中用来指代台湾，但在台湾本土几乎从未使用过。

paras.en: According to a 2026 poll by National Chengchi University's Election Study Center, the vast majority of people in Taiwan identify as "Taiwanese," while only 2.5% identify as Chinese.
paras.zh: 根据国立政治大学选举研究中心2026年的民意调查，绝大多数台湾人认为自己是“台湾人”，只有2.5%的人认为自己是中国人。

paras.en: In 2024, China allegedly planned to stage a "car collision" during Taiwanese Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim's visit to the Czech capiutal Prague. Czech intelligence officials told local media that the incident had been part of a much larger and escalatory plan by Chinese diplomats and intelligence officers working out of the Chinese embassy in Prague.
paras.zh: 据称，2024年，中国计划在台湾副总统萧美琴访问捷克首都布拉格期间制造“车祸”。捷克情报官员告诉当地媒体，该事件是中国驻布拉格大使馆外交官和情报官员一项规模更大、升级计划的一部分。

paras.en: In early October this year, the FBI said authorities arrested a woman in California for allegedly spying on the son of Taiwan's president. According to the US Department of Justice, the woman had traveled to Seattle in 2025 under instructions from Beijing to monitor the Taiwanese president's son and his family, capturing photos, video footage, and license plate information.
paras.zh: 今年10月初，美国联邦调查局表示，当局在加州逮捕了一名涉嫌监视台湾总统之子的女子。据美国司法部称，该女子于 2025 年按照北京的指示前往西雅图监视台湾总统的儿子及其家人，拍摄照片、视频片段和车牌信息。

paras.en: During a press conference on October 6, China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs said it "consistently opposes the hype surrounding so-called 'Chinese spies' and the smearing and vilification of China."
paras.zh: 中国外交部在10月6日的记者会上表示，“一贯反对炒作所谓‘中国间谍’，反对对中国的抹黑污蔑”。

paras.en: "It reflects the ambiguity and limitation of international law, that the PRC using soft power to restrict the visibility of Taiwan may not directly fall into international law arena, as Taiwan is not recognized by international bodies as a sovereign state party." said Dr. Lai.
paras.zh: “这反映了国际法的模糊性和局限性，中华人民共和国利用软实力限制台湾的可见性可能不会直接落入国际法舞台，因为台湾没有被国际机构承认为主权国家。”赖博士说。

articles.title: Schools crisis in France: Investment fails to inspire confidence

paras.en: Rats in the toilets, leaking roofs, broken heating systems: Cellphone videos filmed by French schoolchildren and circulating on social media bear witness to the dilapidated infrastructure in many educational institutions across France.
paras.zh: 厕所里的老鼠、屋顶漏水、供暖系统损坏：法国学童拍摄并在社交媒体上流传的手机视频见证了法国许多教育机构破旧的基础设施。

paras.en: At the Lycee Paul Eluard in the Parisian suburb of Saint-Denis, a center of the current protests, young people have reported that there are vermin in the building, and say burst pipes are a regular occurrence. In nearby Pantin, pupils complained that windows couldn't be opened, even when temperatures soared to 40 degrees Celsius (over 104 degrees Fahrenheit) in summer.
paras.zh: 在巴黎郊区圣但尼的保罗·艾吕雅中学（当前抗议活动的中心），年轻人报告说，大楼里有害虫，水管爆裂是常事。在附近的庞坦，学生抱怨说，即使夏天气温飙升至 40 摄氏度（超过 104 华氏度），窗户也打不开。

paras.en: Pupils also complain of overcrowded classrooms and frequently cancelled lessons.
paras.zh: 学生们还抱怨教室过于拥挤，课程经常被取消。

paras.en: The protests, which have erupted all over the country, show no sign of coming to an end.
paras.zh: 全国各地爆发的抗议活动没有任何结束的迹象。

paras.en: Yet, by EU standards, France invests a substantial amount in its education system — 6.7% of its GDP. The fact that this investment has not translated into a better learning environment may be partly attributable to the way responsibilities are divided.
paras.zh: 然而，按照欧盟标准，法国在教育系统上投入了大量资金——占 GDP 的 6.7%。这项投资并未转化为更好的学习环境，部分原因可能是责任划分方式。

paras.en: The central government in Paris mainly deals with paying teachers, and setting national curricula. But the responsibility for maintaining school buildings lies with France's various levels of local government. For elementary schools, the administration responsible is the municipality; for "colleges" (lower secondary schools, ages 11–15) it is the wider department, and for lycees (upper secondary schools, ages 15–18) it is the region.
paras.zh: 巴黎中央政府主要负责支付教师工资和制定国家课程。但维护校舍的责任在于法国各级地方政府。对于小学，负责的行政部门是市政府；对于“学院”（初中，11-15 岁）来说，它是更广泛的部门，对于中学（高中，15-18 岁）来说，它是地区。

paras.en: Depending on the region, the local authorities have different financial possibilities at their disposal, and must plan renovation projects themselves. Progress on making improvements is often very slow as a result. In addition, more than two-thirds of their budget is already allocated to staffing costs and pension payments, leaving relatively little room for investment.
paras.zh: 根据地区的不同，地方当局有不同的财政可能性，并且必须自行规划改造项目。因此，改进的进展往往非常缓慢。此外，其预算的三分之二以上已分配给员工成本和养老金支付，投资空间相对较小。

paras.en: Over 80% of elementary school buildings in France are more than 50 years old. An estimated 10 to 20% of all school buildings are considered to be in serious need of renovation. In many instances, politicians have been trying to address the problem. Ile-de-France, which covers Paris and the region surrounding it, approved a 10-year program of renovation and expansion for the period 2017 to 2027 at a cost of €6.6 billion ($7.4 billion).
paras.zh: 法国80%以上的小学建筑都有50年以上的历史。据估计，所有校舍中有 10% 至 20% 急需翻修。在许多情况下，政客们一直在努力解决这个问题。法兰西岛涵盖巴黎及其周边地区，批准了一项为期 10 年的改造和扩建计划，从 2017 年到 2027 年，耗资 66 亿欧元（74 亿美元）。

paras.en: According to the local authorities, two-thirds of upper secondary pupils now attend a new school, or one that has been renovated. But even after mold has been removed and roofs repaired, it is still rare for buildings to have effective protection against the summer heat. It is also a bitter irony that some buildings newly constructed at considerable expense, or renovated just a few years earlier, have been damaged in the recent protests.
paras.zh: 据地方当局称，三分之二的高中生现在在一所新学校或一所经过翻修的学校就读。但即使在霉菌被清除、屋顶被修复之后，能够有效抵御夏季炎热的建筑物仍然很少见。具有讽刺意味的是，一些耗资巨大的新建建筑或几年前刚刚翻新的建筑在最近的抗议活动中遭到破坏。

paras.en: Imbalances are also evident in ongoing education expenditure. While France invests a comparatively large amount in upper secondary education, according to OECD calculations Paris spends less per primary school pupil than the average for industrialized countries. Education researchers emphasize that it is precisely these early years that lay the foundation for subsequent academic success.
paras.zh: 持续教育支出的不平衡也很明显。尽管法国在高中教育方面的投资相对较多，但根据经合组织的计算，巴黎在每个小学生身上的支出低于工业化国家的平均水平。教育研究人员强调，正是这些早年为后来的学业成功奠定了基础。

paras.en: The governments put in place by French President Emmanuel Macron have attempted to address this imbalance. Since 2017, class sizes in the first years of primary school have been halved in socially disadvantaged areas, and around 16,000 additional teaching posts created.
paras.zh: 法国总统马克龙组建的政府试图解决这种不平衡问题。 2017年以来，贫困地区小学一年级班级规模减半，新增教师岗位约1.6万个。

paras.en: Amid the ongoing protests, the government has said it now intends to recruit more than 3,000 supply teachers at short notice. French Education Minister Edouard Geffray announced that software would be used to identify schools that are in a particularly difficult situation.
paras.zh: 在持续不断的抗议活动中，政府表示现在打算在短时间内招聘 3,000 多名代课教师。法国教育部长爱德华·格弗雷 (Edouard Geffray) 宣布，将使用软件来识别处境特别困难的学校。

paras.en: These announcements are the government's first concrete response to the demands of the students, who have been demonstrating for almost two weeks now, calling for better facilities in secondary schools, more supply teachers and greater investment in the education system generally.
paras.zh: 这些公告是政府对学生要求的首次具体回应，学生们已经示威了近两周，呼吁改善中学设施、增加代课教师以及加大对教育系统的投资。

paras.en: The latest scores for the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development’s (OECD) program for international student assessment (Pisa), which were published in September, illustrate the scale of the problems in the education system. According to the results, more than one in three 15-year-olds in France no longer achieve a basic level of competence in mathematics, for example.
paras.zh: 经济合作与发展组织 (OECD) 国际学生评估计划 (PISA) 于 9 月份发布的最新分数显示了教育系统问题的严重程度。例如，根据结果，超过三分之一的法国 15 岁青少年不再具备基本的数学能力。

paras.en: Macron's reform of the upper secondary education system has also been criticized. The abolition of academic streaming in favor of specialist subjects selected by the individual was meant to give pupils greater freedom of choice. However, the large number of possible subject combinations make it difficult to timetable lessons. Students complain that they have too many free periods and longer school days.
paras.zh: 马克龙的高中教育制度改革也受到批评。废除学术分流，转而选择个人选择的专业科目，旨在给予学生更大的选择自由。然而，大量可能的科目组合使得课程安排变得困难。学生们抱怨他们有太多的空闲时间和更长的上课时间。

paras.en: The problems also extend to universities. A lecturer at a Paris university described a seminar attended by 50 students — so many that they have to fetch chairs from other rooms or sit on the floor. So far, she said, the university administration had done nothing about it.
paras.zh: 这些问题也延伸到了大学。巴黎一所大学的讲师描述了一次有 50 名学生参加的研讨会——人数太多，以至于他们不得不从其他房间拿椅子或坐在地板上。她说，到目前为止，大学管理部门还没有采取任何行动。

paras.en: Compared with pupils in other EU countries, French schoolchildren have a high number of teaching hours per school year — on paper, at least. But the French Court of Accounts recorded that 9% of lessons at state colleges were cancelled in the 2023–24 school year. A study from the school year 2024–25 suggests that only around 12% of lessons cancelled at short notice are covered by other teachers.
paras.zh: 与其他欧盟国家的学生相比，法国学童每学年的教学时间很高——至少在纸面上是这样。但法国审计法院记录称，2023-24 学年州立大学 9% 的课程被取消。 2024-25 学年的一项研究表明，在临时通知取消的课程中，只有约 12% 是由其他教师承担的。

paras.en: The relatively low salaries of French teachers compared to those in neighboring countries are also a problem. OECD data shows that after 15 years in the profession teachers at lower secondary schools in France only earn about half as much as their German counterparts.
paras.zh: 与邻国相比，法国教师的工资相对较低也是一个问题。经合组织的数据显示，从业 15 年后，法国初中教师的收入仅为德国同行的一半左右。

paras.en: France takes pride in its republican model of education, which is supposed to provide all children with equal opportunities, irrespective of their background. In reality, academic success in France is much more dependent on parents' socioeconomic circumstances than in many other countries. This is also apparent in that children from poorer families are far more likely to be affected by the cancellation of lessons.
paras.zh: 法国对其共和教育模式感到自豪，这种模式应该为所有儿童提供平等的机会，无论其背景如何。事实上，与许多其他国家相比，法国的学业成功更多地取决于父母的社会经济环境。这也很明显，因为来自贫困家庭的孩子更有可能受到课程取消的影响。

paras.en: The government's financial room for maneuver is currently restricted by the country's precarious budgetary situation. Although the draft budget for 2027 includes an additional €1.2 billion for the Ministry of Education, there are also plans to cut teaching posts, on the grounds that pupil numbers are falling.
paras.zh: 目前，政府的财政回旋余地受到国家不稳定的预算状况的限制。尽管2027年预算草案包括为教育部追加12亿欧元，但由于学生人数下降，也计划削减教师职位。

paras.en: Protests in the run-up to the presidential election
paras.zh: 总统选举前夕的抗议活动

paras.en: It's not just videos of dilapidated school buildings that are circulating on social media. As the discontent has spread, there is also footage of demonstrations where people carry placards with political slogans that have little to do with education policy. Some videos show burning barricades and clashes with the police, which faces accusations of usingdisproportionate force.
paras.zh: 社交媒体上流传的不仅仅是破旧校舍的视频。随着不满情绪的蔓延，还有一些示威活动的镜头，人们举着写有与教育政策无关的政治口号的标语牌。一些视频显示路障被焚烧，并与警察发生冲突，警方被指控过度使用武力。

paras.en: Some members of the far-left France Unbowed (LFI) party have associated themselves with the protesting students. Lawmakers have appeared at school blockades and shared related videos. The government has accused LFI of deliberately exploiting young people's anger for political purposes, an allegation that the party rejects.
paras.zh: 极左翼法国不屈党（LFI）的一些成员与抗议学生联系在一起。立法者出现在学校封锁现场并分享相关视频。政府指责 LFI 故意利用年轻人的愤怒来达到政治目的，但该党否认了这一指控。

paras.en: With the French presidential election just six months away, the protests over the crisis in education are evolving into a power struggle.
paras.zh: 距离法国总统大选仅剩六个月，针对教育危机的抗议活动正在演变成一场权力斗争。

paras.en: This article was originally published in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初以德文发表。

articles.title: Israel’s economy prospers despite years of war, but prices worry voters

paras.en: After three years of Israel’s multi-front war in the Middle East, it would be no surprise if this month’s Knesset elections were taking place against the backdrop of an economy in dire straits.
paras.zh: 以色列在中东进行了三年多战线战争后，如果本月的议会选举是在经济陷入困境的背景下举行，也就不足为奇了。

paras.en: Instead, Israel’s economy is – by many measures – flourishing.
paras.zh: 相反，从许多方面来看，以色列的经济正在蓬勃发展。

paras.en: After slowing sharply in the initial aftermath of the Hamas-led October 7, 2023 attacks and Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza, Israel has rebounded to become one of the fastest-growing advanced economies in recent years.
paras.zh: 在哈马斯领导的 2023 年 10 月 7 日袭击和以色列对加沙的种族灭绝战争之后，以色列的经济增长最初急剧放缓，但后来已经反弹，成为近年来增长最快的发达经济体之一。

paras.en: Gross domestic product (GDP) grew 2.9 percent in 2025, picking up from a 1 percent expansion in 2024, and 3.2 percent in the first half of this year, according to government figures.
paras.zh: 根据政府数据，2025 年国内生产总值 (GDP) 增长 2.9%，高于 2024 年 1% 的增速，今年上半年增长 3.2%。

paras.en: The Bank of Israel has forecast 4 percent growth for the whole of 2026 and 5.5 percent growth in 2027 – projections that far exceed the outlooks for major economies such as the United States, United Kingdom, France, Canada, and Japan.
paras.zh: 以色列央行预计 2026 年全年经济增长 4%，2027 年增长 5.5%，这一预测远远超出美国、英国、法国、加拿大和日本等主要经济体的预期。

paras.en: Over the past three years, the shekel has strengthened against the US dollar, hitting a three-decade high in May, and Israel’s stock market has surged, with the benchmark TA-125 up more than 110 percent.
paras.zh: 过去三年来，谢克尔兑美元汇率不断走强，5月份触及三年来新高，以色列股市飙升，基准TA-125上涨超过110%。

paras.en: Meanwhile, unemployment stands at 2.8 percent, while inflation is modest at 1.5 percent.
paras.zh: 与此同时，失业率为 2.8%，而通胀率为 1.5%。

paras.en: Against this relatively rosy economic backdrop, campaigning for the October 27 election has been dominated by national security, with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, leader of the right-wing Likud party, and retired general Gadi Eisenkot, head of the centrist Yashar, each claiming to be most qualified to keep Israelis safe.
paras.zh: 在相对乐观的经济背景下，10月27日选举的竞选活动主要以国家安全为主导，右翼利库德集团领导人、总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡和中间派亚沙尔党主席、退役将军加迪·艾森科特都声称自己最有资格保护以色列人的安全。

paras.en: Driving Israel’s striking economic resilience has been a booming tech sector largely insulated from its conflicts spanning Gaza, Lebanon, Syria, Iraq, Iran and Yemen.
paras.zh: 推动以色列惊人经济恢复力的是蓬勃发展的科技行业，该行业在很大程度上不受加沙、黎巴嫩、叙利亚、伊拉克、伊朗和也门冲突的影响。

paras.en: Despite being on a war footing since October 2023, Israel has attracted record levels of investment in tech, the driver of about one-fifth of economic activity, amid the frenetic global rollout of artificial intelligence (AI).
paras.zh: 尽管自 2023 年 10 月以来一直处于战争状态，但随着人工智能 (AI) 在全球的疯狂推广，以色列吸引了创纪录水平的科技投资，科技投资约占经济活动的五分之一。

paras.en: Total direct foreign investment hit a record $26.2bn last year, up 78 percent from 2024, led by US tech giants Alphabet and Palo Alto Networks’ record-breaking acquisitions of Israeli cybersecurity firms Wiz and CyberArk, respectively.
paras.zh: 去年，外国直接投资总额达到创纪录的 262 亿美元，比 2024 年增长 78%，其中美国科技巨头 Alphabet 和 Palo Alto Networks 分别破纪录地收购了以色列网络安全公司 Wiz 和 Cyber​​Ark。

paras.en: Foreign capital has continued to flood into the country this year, with inflows reaching a quarterly record of $14.1bn in the January-March period, according to government figures.
paras.zh: 政府数据显示，今年外国资本继续涌入该国，1月至3月期间流入量达到季度纪录的141亿美元。

paras.en: Along with prospering from the global AI boom, Israel’s tech scene has benefitted from its close ties to the local defence sector, which has ramped up orders from hundreds of startups supplying everything from radar systems to communications platforms and anti-drone technology.
paras.zh: 随着全球人工智能热潮的繁荣，以色列的科技界也受益于其与当地国防部门的密切联系，该部门增加了数百家初创公司的订单，这些初创公司供应从雷达系统到通信平台和反无人机技术等各种产品。

paras.en: While Israel’s economy has bounced back in part due to robust employment and wage growth, its resilience is primarily an “export-driven story that reflects strong global technology demand, particularly in areas where Israel – and multinational firms operating from Israel – is globally competitive, such as cybersecurity and artificial intelligence,” said Keren Uziyel, a senior analyst for the Middle East and Africa at the Economist Intelligence Unit (EIU).
paras.zh: 经济学人智库（EIU）中东和非洲高级分析师克伦·乌齐耶尔（Keren Uziyel）表示，虽然以色列经济反弹的部分原因是强劲的就业和工资增长，但其韧性主要是“出口驱动的故事，反映了强劲的全球技术需求，特别是在以色列以及在以色列运营的跨国公司具有全球竞争力的领域，例如网络安全和人工智能”。

paras.en: “Interest in Israel’s technology goods and services is driving high levels of FDI and venture capital fundraising, and boosting the capital markets, which in turn is having significant wealth effects and boosting government revenue,” Uziyel told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 乌齐耶尔告诉半岛电视台：“对以色列技术产品和服务的兴趣正在推动高水平的外国直接投资和风险资本融资，并推动资本市场的发展，这反过来又产生了显着的财富效应并增加了政府收入。”

paras.en: But Israel’s military campaigns have come at an enormous cost to the public purse.
paras.zh: 但以色列的军事行动让公共财政付出了巨大的代价。

paras.en: In March, the Bank of Israel estimated that Israel’s war costs to date had reached approximately 350 billion shekels ($114.6bn) – a figure not including the then recently-launched Iran war.
paras.zh: 3月份，以色列央行估计，迄今为止以色列的战争成本已达到约3500亿谢克尔（1146亿美元）——这一数字不包括当时最近发动的伊朗战争。

paras.en: Military expenditures are on track to rise substantially in the coming years as Israeli leaders double down on “national security”.
paras.zh: 随着以色列领导人加倍重视“国家安全”，军事支出在未来几年有望大幅增加。

paras.en: Netanyahu, whose right-wing coalition has cast security as “the foundation of everything else”, has pushed to raise the annual defence budget to 183 billion shekels ($60bn), equivalent to roughly 9 percent of GDP.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡领导的右翼联盟将安全视为“一切的基础”，并推动将年度国防预算提高到 1,830 亿谢克尔（600 亿美元），相当于 GDP 的约 9%。

paras.en: If passed, the budget would raise military spending by two and a half times what it was before October 7.
paras.zh: 如果该预算获得通过，军费开支将比 10 月 7 日之前增加两倍半。

paras.en: Outgoing opposition leader Yair Lapid has backed an expanded defence budget, but has clashed with Netanyahu about how to fund it.
paras.zh: 即将离任的反对派领导人亚伊尔·拉皮德支持扩大国防预算，但与内塔尼亚胡在如何为其提供资金方面发生冲突。

paras.en: Though security has dominated the run-up to the election, opinion polling suggests that Israelis also view the economy as a key concern.
paras.zh: 尽管安全问题在选举前夕占据主导地位，但民意调查显示，以色列人也将经济视为一个关键问题。

paras.en: In an opinion poll released by the Israel Democracy Institute last month, 38 percent of Jewish Israelis and 46 percent of Palestinian citizens of Israel – who make up about 20 percent of the population – chose the economy and the cost of living as the most important or second-most important election issue.
paras.zh: 以色列民主研究所上个月发布的一项民意调查显示，38%的犹太以色列人和46%的以色列巴勒斯坦公民（约占以色列人口的20%）选择经济和生活成本作为最重要或第二重要的选举问题。

paras.en: Israel’s high cost of living, in particular, has long been a source of public discontent.
paras.zh: 尤其是以色列高昂的生活成本长期以来一直是公众不满的根源。

paras.en: Israel has for years ranked among the most expensive countries in the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD), a dynamic economists attribute to the country’s limited trade relations with its neighbours and cumbersome regulations.
paras.zh: 以色列多年来一直位居经济合作与发展组织（OECD）最昂贵的国家之列，经济学家将这一动态归因于该国与邻国的有限贸易关系和繁琐的监管。

paras.en: Though Israel’s overall rate of inflation has been modest, food prices have risen at a faster pace, increasing 8 percent between the start of 2024 and mid-2026, according to consumer advocacy group Lobby 99.
paras.zh: 根据消费者权益倡导组织 Lobby 99 的数据，尽管以色列的总体通胀率较低，但食品价格上涨速度更快，从 2024 年初到 2026 年中期上涨了 8%。

paras.en: “People are worried about the economy but not so much about the macroeconomic situation, more so on their personal perspectives, especially cost of living,” Ayal Kimhi, vice president of the Shoresh Institution for Socioeconomic Research in Tel Aviv, told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 特拉维夫肖雷什社会经济研究所副所长阿亚尔·金希（Ayal Kimhi）告诉半岛电视台：“人们担心经济，但不太担心宏观经济形势，更担心他们的个人观点，尤其是生活成本。”

paras.en: “However, the security situation dominates the public discourse for obvious reasons, so I do not think the economy will play a major role in the vote,” Kimhi said.
paras.zh: “然而，由于显而易见的原因，安全局势主导了公众讨论，因此我认为经济不会在投票中发挥重要作用，”金希说。

paras.en: “Some parties do not even bother presenting a vision or an agenda,” he added.
paras.zh: “有些政党甚至懒得提出愿景或议程，”他补充道。

paras.en: “Other parties do not differ much about economic issues.”
paras.zh: “其他政党在经济问题上没有太大分歧。”

paras.en: While Israel’s headline economic figures are impressive, they come with caveats attached.
paras.zh: 虽然以色列的总体经济数据令人印象深刻，但也有一些警告。

paras.en: Economists note that while Israel’s economy has grown much faster than its peers, GDP has been boosted in part by the country’s usually high population growth, which has averaged nearly 2 percent over the past decade.
paras.zh: 经济学家指出，虽然以色列的经济增长速度远远快于其他国家，但该国GDP的增长在一定程度上得益于该国通常较高的人口增长率，过去十年平均增长率接近2%。

paras.en: Israel’s growth trajectory has also taken a hit despite the expansion, with the Bank of Israel estimating an accumulated loss of output through the end of 2025 equivalent to 8.6 percent of annual GDP.
paras.zh: 尽管经济扩张，但以色列的增长轨迹也受到了打击，以色列央行估计，到 2025 年底，累计产出损失相当于年度 GDP 的 8.6%。

paras.en: Joseph Zeira, a professor of economics at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem, said the country’s economic performance has “not been great at all” considering that growth has consistently lagged the pre-conflict trend since late 2023.
paras.zh: 耶路撒冷希伯来大学经济学教授约瑟夫·泽拉表示，考虑到自 2023 年底以来增长一直落后于冲突前的趋势，该国的经济表现“一点也不出色”。

paras.en: “Actual living standards depend on the area,” Zeira told Al Jazeera, adding that Israelis are grappling with “higher prices, or rather lower real wages and incomes”, and deteriorating public services.
paras.zh: “实际生活水平取决于该地区，”泽拉告诉半岛电视台，并补充说以色列人正在努力应对“更高的价格，或者更确切地说更低的实际工资和收入”以及不断恶化的公共服务。

paras.en: “The only improvement is some decline in housing prices due to a vast wave of construction in recent years,” he said.
paras.zh: “唯一的改善是，由于近年来的大规模建设浪潮，房价有所下降，”他说。

paras.en: The long-term health of Israel’s public finances is another concern.
paras.zh: 以色列公共财政的长期健康状况是另一个令人担忧的问题。

paras.en: While Israel’s debt-to-GDP ratio of about 68 is far below that of peers such as the US, the UK, France, and Italy, the gap between government revenue and spending has grown rapidly over the past three years.
paras.zh: 尽管以色列的债务与GDP之比约为68，远低于美国、英国、法国和意大利等国家，但政府收入与支出之间的差距在过去三年中迅速扩大。

paras.en: In its latest annual report, the Bank of Israel said it was “essential” for the government to “restore orderly budgetary processes” and implement “credible measures” to reduce the public debt.
paras.zh: 以色列央行在最新的年度报告中表示，政府“恢复有序的预算流程”并实施“可信措施”来减少公共债务“至关重要”。

paras.en: Other long-term challenges include boosting labour participation among ultra-Orthodox Jewish men – whose refusal to do military service has become a major election issue – and Arab women (among Palestinian citizens of Israel), both of whom are employed at much lower rates than the general population.
paras.zh: 其他长期挑战包括提高极端正统犹太男性（他们拒绝服兵役已成为一个主要选举问题）和阿拉伯女性（以色列的巴勒斯坦公民）的劳动参与率，两者的就业率都远低于一般人口。

paras.en: “The cost of the military campaigns and mobilisation has severely strained public finances,” Omer Moav, a professor of economics at the University of Warwick and at Reichman University, told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 华威大学和赖希曼大学经济学教授奥马尔·莫阿夫告诉半岛电视台：“军事行动和动员的成本使公共财政严重紧张。”

paras.en: “Deficits and national debt have expanded significantly, making current spending trajectories unsustainable without fiscal consolidation,” Moav said.
paras.zh: 莫阿夫表示：“赤字和国债大幅扩大，如果不进行财政整顿，当前的支出轨迹将难以为继。”

paras.en: “The next government is facing a huge challenge.”
paras.zh: “下一届政府面临着巨大的挑战。”

paras.en: Regardless of who prevails in the election, economists say, Israel’s economic prospects will in large part hinge on whether conflict in the region escalates or subsides.
paras.zh: 经济学家表示，无论谁在选举中获胜，以色列的经济前景在很大程度上取决于该地区的冲突是升级还是平息。

paras.en: “We expect growth to reach around 4 percent in 2026 and to exceed this level in 2027,” said Uziyel, the EIU analyst.
paras.zh: EIU 分析师 Uziyel 表示：“我们预计 2026 年增长率将达到 4% 左右，并在 2027 年超过这一水平。”

paras.en: “However, significant downside risks to growth remain should conflicts in Gaza, Iran, or on the Lebanon front resume.”
paras.zh: “然而，如果加沙、伊朗或黎巴嫩前线的冲突重新爆发，经济增长面临的重大下行风险仍然存在。”

paras.en: “The outlook depends greatly on the security situation,” said Kimhi of the Shoresh Institution for Socioeconomic Research.
paras.zh: “前景在很大程度上取决于安全局势，”肖雷什社会经济研究所的金希说。
