paras.zh: 虽然钙会将硼隔离在顽固不溶的岩石中，但通过引入核糖将这种串联转变为化学三角恋提供了溶解度解决方案。

paras.en: The ribose helped pull boron from its rocky prison into water across all four minerals that the researchers used – and it was especially effective for those containing calcium.
paras.zh: 核糖帮助将硼从岩石监狱中拉入研究人员使用的所有四种矿物质中的水中，并且对于含钙的矿物质尤其有效。

paras.en: The team then repeated the experiment using a piece of "puffy evaporative crust" collected from the high-altitude Puga hydrothermal system in Ladakh, India, for a chemical early Earth analog.
paras.zh: 然后，研究小组使用从印度拉达克高海拔普加热液系统收集的一块“蓬松的蒸发地壳”重复了该实验，作为早期地球的化学模拟。

paras.en: When they dunked this substance in water, without ribose, a certain amount of boron was released. When they then added ribose, the amount of boron released into the water increased by approximately 60 percent.
paras.zh: 当他们将这种物质浸入不含核糖的水中时，会释放出一定量的硼。当他们添加核糖时，释放到水中的硼量增加了大约 60%。

paras.en: Then the researchers explored whether degraded ribose could improve boron solubility.
paras.zh: 然后研究人员探索了降解的核糖是否可以提高硼的溶解度。

paras.en: After they 'caramelized' their ribose through heat and alkalinity, or chemically, they found only a slight increase in the absolute amount of dissolved boron in the solution.
paras.zh: 在通过热量和碱度或化学方法将核糖“焦糖化”后，他们发现溶液中溶解的硼的绝对量仅略有增加。

paras.en: Although dissolved boron concentration from colemanite increased by 50 percent with the addition of caramelized ribose, that was a much smaller boost than fresh ribose gave the same mineral (about 3.5 times more boron), suggesting that fresh ribose is best.
paras.zh: 尽管添加焦糖核糖后，硬硼酸钙石中溶解的硼浓度增加了 50%，但与新鲜核糖产生的相同矿物质相比（硼含量增加约 3.5 倍），其增幅要小得多，这表明新鲜核糖是最好的。

paras.en: Finally, the researchers similarly tested sucrose and glucose, finding that they can improve boron solubility but not as much as ribose. This is likely because the molecular geometry of ribose is especially well suited to forming stable complexes with boron.
paras.zh: 最后，研究人员同样测试了蔗糖和葡萄糖，发现它们可以提高硼的溶解度，但不如核糖。这可能是因为核糖的分子几何形状特别适合与硼形成稳定的复合物。

paras.en: So, the researchers propose the following loop.
paras.zh: 因此，研究人员提出了以下循环。

paras.en: Ribose pulls and protects boron, which then protects ribose. So more ribose could lead to more dissolved boron, which could then help more ribose survive, setting the stage for the RNA World Hypothesis and, eventually, us.
paras.zh: 核糖拉动并保护硼，硼随后保护核糖。因此，更多的核糖可能会导致更多的溶解硼，从而帮助更多的核糖生存，为 RNA 世界假说以及最终的我们奠定基础。

paras.en: But wait a second. The study also presents an intriguing nuance: boron compounds are double-edged swords. They can stabilize existing ribose, but in excess they actually inhibit ribose from forming in the first place.
paras.zh: 但等一下。该研究还提出了一个有趣的细微差别：硼化合物是双刃剑。它们可以稳定现有的核糖，但过量时它们实际上会抑制核糖的形成。

paras.en: In this context, calcium suddenly becomes a villain-turned-hero: It may have kept boron levels low, so ribose could form, and then the aforementioned loop possibly took over.
paras.zh: 在这种情况下，钙突然变成了反派英雄：它可能使硼水平保持在较低水平，因此可以形成核糖，然后上述循环可能会接管。

paras.en: Finally, shifting pH levels, as may be common in hot spring systems, may have helped liberate ribose from the boron, allowing it to undergo other reactions, like, again, us.
paras.zh: 最后，pH值的变化（在温泉系统中可能很常见）可能有助于从硼中释放核糖，使其能够进行其他反应，就像我们一样。

paras.en: So this work shows the value of using natural mineral samples, rather than pure, synthetic materials, even though the latter help maintain control and reduce experimental complexity.
paras.zh: 因此，这项工作展示了使用天然矿物样品而不是纯合成材料的价值，尽管后者有助于保持控制并降低实验复杂性。

paras.en: As a result, we come full (or semi) circle to Carl Sagan's quote about us all being star-stuff – specifically, space sugar.
paras.zh: 结果，我们绕了一圈（或半圈）卡尔·萨根关于我们都是明星的名言——特别是太空糖。

paras.en: Sure, our susceptibility to sugar's soothing sweetness introduces many health effects. But maybe it also provided the physical fulcrum that helped us exist and attempt to enjoy it in moderation.
paras.zh: 当然，我们对糖的舒缓甜味的敏感性会带来许多健康影响。但也许它也提供了帮助我们生存并尝试适度享受它的物理支点。

paras.en: The research has been published in Scientific Reports.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《科学报告》上。

articles.title: Bacteria turn a virus’ own weapon against it

paras.en: Bacteria turn a virusâ own weapon against it
paras.zh: 细菌利用病毒自身的武器来对抗它

paras.en: - Researchers have uncovered a new way bacteria detect viral attacks: a virus-produced enzyme cuts a bacterial sensor protein, triggering a self-destructing immune response. The discovery could lead to more effective phage therapies against antibiotic-resistant bacteria and provide insight into ancient immune mechanisms shared with humans.
paras.zh: - 研究人员发现了细菌检测病毒攻击的新方法：病毒产生的酶切割细菌传感器蛋白，引发自毁免疫反应。这一发现可能会导致针对抗生素耐药细菌的更有效的噬菌体疗法，并提供对人类共享的古老免疫机制的深入了解。

paras.en: Scientists searching for new ways to treat bacterial infections are increasingly turning to viruses known as bacteriophages (phages). These viruses specifically target bacteria, allowing them to kill harmful microbes without damaging human cells. They can also attack bacteria that have developed resistance to antibiotics.
paras.zh: 寻找治疗细菌感染新方法的科学家越来越多地转向称为噬菌体的病毒。这些病毒专门针对细菌，使它们能够杀死有害微生物而不损害人体细胞。它们还可以攻击对抗生素产生耐药性的细菌。

paras.en: Phage therapy, however, faces a major obstacle. Bacteria are not defenseless against viruses. They have evolved their own immune systems, and understanding those defenses could help scientists develop therapeutic phages that are better able to overcome them.
paras.zh: 然而，噬菌体疗法面临着重大障碍。细菌对病毒并非毫无防御能力。它们进化出了自己的免疫系统，了解这些防御系统可以帮助科学家开发出能够更好地克服这些防御系统的治疗性噬菌体。

paras.en: New research has now identified an important way bacteria recognize a viral attack. Scientists found that a viral enzyme cuts a crucial sensor molecule inside the bacterial cell. That damage serves as an alarm, activating an immune response. The discovery could ultimately help researchers develop more effective phage therapies capable of avoiding bacterial immune defenses.
paras.zh: 新的研究现在已经确定了细菌识别病毒攻击的一种重要方式。科学家发现，病毒酶会切割细菌细胞内的关键传感器分子。这种损害就像一个警报，激活免疫反应。这一发现最终可以帮助研究人员开发出更有效的噬菌体疗法，能够避免细菌免疫防御。

paras.en: "This is one of the most common forms of bacterial immunity, so when we finally figured it out, it was a total eureka moment," says Sam Hobbs, PhD, assistant professor of biochemistry at University of Utah Health and the first author on a paper describing the research.
paras.zh: “这是最常见的细菌免疫形式之一，所以当我们最终弄清楚它时，我们彻底灵光一现，”犹他健康大学生物化学助理教授、描述这项研究的论文的第一作者萨姆·霍布斯博士说。

paras.en: The study focused on a bacterial immune system called CBASS. When activated, CBASS can trigger an extreme "last resort" response in which an infected bacterium kills itself before the invading virus has a chance to spread to nearby cells.
paras.zh: 该研究的重点是一种名为 CBASS 的细菌免疫系统。当被激活时，CBASS 可以触发极端的“最后手段”反应，即受感染的细菌在入侵的病毒有机会传播到附近的细胞之前杀死自己。

paras.en: Because activating this defense is fatal to the bacterium, the system must be able to recognize a genuine viral threat with great precision.
paras.zh: 由于激活这种防御对于细菌来说是致命的，因此系统必须能够非常精确地识别真正的病毒威胁。

paras.en: Hobbs and his colleagues found that this detection process relies on something the virus itself needs. Certain phages produce an enzyme that becomes the signal that alerts the bacterium to the attack.
paras.zh: 霍布斯和他的同事发现，这种检测过程依赖于病毒本身所需的东西。某些噬菌体会产生一种酶，这种酶会成为警告细菌受到攻击的信号。

paras.en: "Certain kinds of phages have a protein called a protease, which degrades other proteins," he explains. "We found that the protease from the phage actually acts directly on the host protein, and that is the signal that turns on the whole signaling pathway."
paras.zh: “某些噬菌体含有一种称为蛋白酶的蛋白质，它可以降解其他蛋白质，”他解释道。 “我们发现来自噬菌体的蛋白酶实际上直接作用于宿主蛋白，这就是打开整个信号通路的信号。”

paras.en: This form of virus detection is notably different from related antiviral immune systems. Some of those pathways recognize viral genetic material directly. In CBASS, the trigger instead comes from the activity of a viral protein acting on a protein belonging to the bacterial host.
paras.zh: 这种形式的病毒检测与相关的抗病毒免疫系统明显不同。其中一些途径直接识别病毒遗传物质。在 CBASS 中，触发因素来自病毒蛋白作用于细菌宿主蛋白的活性。

paras.en: "This is a totally new mechanism for how these host proteins are activated," Hobbs says. "I never would have guessed that this was the way it was going to work."
paras.zh: “这是如何激活这些宿主蛋白的全新机制，”霍布斯说。 “我从来没有想到这就是它的运作方式。”

paras.en: The finding not only sheds light on how bacteria defend themselves from phages, but could also have implications for understanding immunity in humans.
paras.zh: 这一发现不仅揭示了细菌如何防御噬菌体，而且还可能对理解人类的免疫力产生影响。

paras.en: CBASS is related to an immune pathway found in people, suggesting that aspects of this antiviral defense have survived across an enormous span of evolutionary history. The connection indicates that the pathway dates back at least to the common ancestor shared by bacteria and humans.
paras.zh: CBASS 与人类体内发现的免疫途径有关，这表明这种抗病毒防御的某些方面在漫长的进化历史中一直存在。这种联系表明该途径至少可以追溯到细菌和人类的共同祖先。

paras.en: An Ancient Immune System With Human Connections
paras.zh: 与人类有联系的古老免疫系统

paras.en: Bacteria also give researchers a useful experimental system for investigating fundamental questions about immunity. Their rapid life cycles allow scientists to study immune processes quickly, then test what they learn in biological models that are more closely related to humans.
paras.zh: 细菌还为研究人员提供了一个有用的实验系统，用于研究有关免疫的基本问题。它们快速的生命周期使科学家能够快速研究免疫过程，然后在与人类更密切相关的生物模型中测试它们学到的东西。

paras.en: "The fact that these systems are conserved between bacteria and humans suggests that they've been maintained in these different organisms for that entire evolutionary trajectory," Hobbs says. "The cells are telling us that this is a really important pathway because they've maintained it for billions of years. It's incredibly fascinating, and it's a cool window into what's important in maintaining the ability to fight viruses."
paras.zh: 霍布斯说：“这些系统在细菌和人类之间是保守的，这一事实表明它们在整个进化轨迹中一直保留在这些不同的生物体中。” “细胞告诉我们，这是一条非常重要的途径，因为它们已经维持了数十亿年。它非常令人着迷，而且它是了解维持抗病毒能力的重要因素的一个很酷的窗口。”

paras.en: This research is published in Science as "Phage proteases activate CBASS antiphage immunity."
paras.zh: 这项研究发表在《科学》杂志上，标题为“噬菌体蛋白酶激活 CBASS 抗噬菌体免疫”。

paras.en: This work was supported by the Pew Biomedical Scholars program, the Burroughs Wellcome Fund, the G. Harold and Leila Y. Mathers Foundation, the Cancer Research Institute (CRI3996), the Parker Institute for Cancer Immunotherapy, the Massachusetts Consortium on Pathogen Readiness, and the National Institute of General Medical Sciences of the National Institutes of Health (1DP2GM146250-01). Content is solely the responsibility of the authors and does not necessarily represent the official views of the National Institutes of Health.
paras.zh: 这项工作得到了皮尤生物医学学者计划、Burroughs Wellcome 基金、G. Harold 和 Leila Y. Mathers 基金会、癌症研究所 (CRI3996)、帕克癌症免疫治疗研究所、马萨诸塞州病原体准备联盟和美国国立卫生研究院国家普通医学科学研究所 (1DP2GM146250-01) 的支持。内容完全由作者负责，并不一定代表美国国立卫生研究院的官方观点。

paras.zh: 材料由犹他大学健康中心提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: Scientists find hidden materials that could improve batteries and solar fuels

paras.en: Scientists find hidden materials that could improve batteries and solar fuels
paras.zh: 科学家发现可以改善电池和太阳能燃料的隐藏材料

paras.en: - Scientists have uncovered a hidden world of âin-betweenâ materials that briefly form as chemical ingredients are heated, revealing structures that conventional methods can miss. Among the discoveries is a previously unknown form of bismuth vanadate, a material widely studied for using sunlight to help produce clean hydrogen. The new version has a different atomic structure and interacts with light in a strikingly different way, potentially opening new possibilities for solar fuels, catalysts, and electronics.
paras.zh: - 科学家们发现了一个隐藏的“中间”材料世界，这些材料在化学成分被加热时短暂形成，揭示了传统方法可能忽略的结构。这些发现之一是一种以前未知的钒酸铋，这种材料被广泛研究用于利用阳光来帮助生产清洁的氢气。新版本具有不同的原子结构，并以截然不同的方式与光相互作用，可能为太阳能燃料、催化剂和电子产品开辟新的可能性。

paras.en: Researchers have uncovered previously unknown materials by closely following what happens as molecular precursors break apart and transform during heating. Among the discoveries is a new form of a well-studied clean energy material.
paras.zh: 研究人员通过密切关注分子前体在加热过程中分解和转变时发生的情况，发现了以前未知的材料。这些发现之一是一种经过充分研究的清洁能源材料的新形式。

paras.en: The research, published in Nature Communications, focuses on intermediate phases that appear while molecules are being converted into solid materials. These temporary stages are often overlooked because scientists typically concentrate on the final product. By capturing and studying them, the researchers found a possible route to materials that are difficult or impossible to obtain through conventional synthesis.
paras.zh: 这项研究发表在《自然通讯》上，重点关注分子转化为固体材料时出现的中间相。这些临时阶段经常被忽视，因为科学家通常专注于最终产品。通过捕获和研究它们，研究人员找到了一条可能的途径来获得通过传统合成很难或不可能获得的材料。

paras.en: Dr. Sebastian Pike, Department of Chemistry, University of Warwick, said: "When materials are made by heating, scientists usually focus on the final product, the 'B' that results from 'A.' But this study shows that there are many fascinating stages in between 'A' and 'B,' and these hidden steps, could be just as important.
paras.zh: 华威大学化学系的塞巴斯蒂安·派克博士说：“当通过加热制造材料时，科学家通常关注最终产品，即由‘A’产生的‘B’。但这项研究表明，“A”和“B”之间有许多令人着迷的阶段，而这些隐藏的步骤可能同样重要。

paras.en: "We didn't know exactly what we would find going in, but we were confident there would be something interesting and unknown in the intermediate phases. We were thrilled to discover that some of these could have practical uses, even from the very first experiments."
paras.zh: “我们并不确切地知道会发现什么，但我们相信在中间阶段会出现一些有趣且未知的东西。我们很高兴发现其中一些可以具有实际用途，即使从最初的实验开始也是如此。”

paras.en: The researchers began with specially designed 'single-source precursors', molecules containing all the elements needed to create a material. They then monitored how those molecules changed as temperatures increased.
paras.zh: 研究人员从专门设计的“单一来源前体”开始，这些分子含有制造材料所需的所有元素。然后他们监测这些分子随着温度升高如何变化。

paras.en: This approach exposed several previously unknown material phases. One was a new, kinetically stabilized form of bismuth vanadate (BiVO4), which the researchers named β-BiVO4.
paras.zh: 这种方法暴露了几个以前未知的材料相。其中之一是一种新的动力学稳定形式的钒酸铋 (BiVO4)，研究人员将其命名为 β-BiVO4。

paras.en: BiVO4 has attracted attention in clean energy research because of its useful "band gap" (the energy it needs to absorb sunlight and drive chemical reactions). Its properties allow it to absorb sunlight effectively while still supplying enough energy to split water and generate clean hydrogen fuel.
paras.zh: BiVO4因其有用的“带隙”（吸收阳光和驱动化学反应所需的能量）而在清洁能源研究中引起了关注。它的特性使其能够有效吸收阳光，同时仍然提供足够的能量来分解水并产生清洁的氢燃料。

paras.en: The newly identified β-BiVO4 has an atomic arrangement that differs from known forms of the material. It also has a significantly larger band gap, which changes the way it interacts with light.
paras.zh: 新发现的 β-BiVO4 具有与已知形式的材料不同的原子排列。它还具有明显更大的带隙，这改变了它与光相互作用的方式。

paras.en: Those differences could give researchers new ways to adjust materials for use in solar fuel production, catalysis, and electronics.
paras.zh: 这些差异可能为研究人员提供新的方法来调整用于太阳能燃料生产、催化和电子产品的材料。

paras.en: The newly discovered intermediate phases may also have uses beyond solar energy. Another hidden material identified during the experiments was able to store large amounts of lithium, raising the possibility that it could contribute to next-generation battery technologies.
paras.zh: 新发现的中间相可能还有太阳能以外的用途。实验期间发现的另一种隐藏材料能够储存大量锂，这提高了它为下一代电池技术做出贡献的可能性。

paras.en: Dr. Dominik Kubicki, School of Chemistry, University of Birmingham, said: "What's exciting is that these 'in-between' materials aren't just stepping stones -- they can have useful properties in their own right. By understanding and controlling how they form, we can start to design better materials for batteries, catalysis, and solar energy."
paras.zh: 伯明翰大学化学学院的 Dominik Ku​​bicki 博士表示：“令人兴奋的是，这些‘中间’材料不仅仅是垫脚石，它们本身就具有有用的特性。通过了解和控制它们的形成方式，我们可以开始为电池、催化和太阳能设计更好的材料。”

paras.en: To observe these normally hidden states, the researchers combined several state-of-the-art techniques, including solid-state NMR spectroscopy, X-ray diffraction, and pair distribution function analysis.
paras.zh: 为了观察这些通常隐藏的状态，研究人员结合了几种最先进的技术，包括固态核磁共振波谱、X射线衍射和对分布函数分析。

paras.en: Their results also showed that the precursor selected at the beginning of the process, along with the way that precursor decomposes, can strongly influence which materials form. By controlling those factors, researchers may be able to produce structures that are difficult to obtain using standard heating methods.
paras.zh: 他们的结果还表明，在过程开始时选择的前体以及前体的分解方式可以强烈影响材料的形成。通过控制这些因素，研究人员也许能够生产出使用标准加热方法难以获得的结构。

paras.en: The findings suggest that temporary stages in material formation could represent a largely unexplored source of useful compounds. Instead of treating intermediate structures only as brief steps on the way to a final material, scientists may be able to deliberately create and stabilize them for practical applications.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，材料形成的临时阶段可能代表了很大程度上未经探索的有用化合物的来源。科学家们可能能够故意创建并稳定它们以用于实际应用，而不是仅仅将中间结构视为最终材料的简单步骤。

paras.en: Dr. Pike concluded: "We only studied a few precursors here, but this work points to a broader opportunity in materials science. By carefully controlling temperature, precursor chemistry, and reaction pathways, there may be many more "hidden" but extremely useful materials to be found."
paras.zh: 派克博士总结道：“我们在这里只研究了一些前体，但这项工作为材料科学指出了更广泛的机会。通过仔细控制温度、前体化学和反应途径，可能会发现更多‘隐藏’但极其有用的材料。”

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Warwick. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由华威大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: Only one workout helped older adults lose fat and keep muscle

paras.en: Only one workout helped older adults lose fat and keep muscle
paras.zh: 只有一项锻炼可以帮助老年人减脂并保持肌肉

paras.en: - A six-month study suggests that high-intensity interval training (HIIT) may offer older adults a powerful advantage: losing body fat while keeping their muscle. Unlike moderate-intensity workouts, which led to a small loss of lean muscle, HIIT preserved it while also improving body composition around the waist.
paras.zh: - 一项为期六个月的研究表明，高强度间歇训练 (HIIT) 可能为老年人提供强大的优势：在保持肌肉的同时减少体内脂肪。与会导致少量肌肉流失的中等强度锻炼不同，HIIT 可以在保留肌肉的同时改善腰部的身体成分。

paras.en: Losing body fat is one thing. Losing fat while keeping the muscle that helps you stay strong and active is another, especially as you get older. Research suggests that one particular type of exercise may have an advantage when it comes to achieving both goals.
paras.zh: 减少体内脂肪是一回事。减掉脂肪的同时保持有助于保持强壮和活跃的肌肉是另一回事，尤其是随着年龄的增长。研究表明，一种特定类型的锻炼可能在实现这两个目标方面具有优势。

paras.en: High-intensity interval training (HIIT), which involves alternating short bursts of demanding exercise with easier recovery periods, may be especially helpful for older adults who want to reduce fat without sacrificing lean muscle.
paras.zh: 高强度间歇训练 (HIIT) 包括交替进行短时间的高强度运动和较容易的恢复期，对于想要在不牺牲肌肉的情况下减少脂肪的老年人可能特别有帮助。

paras.en: In a study published in Maturitas, researchers from the University of the Sunshine Coast compared three different exercise intensities. Although participants across the groups experienced modest fat loss, HIIT stood out for its ability to reduce fat while maintaining lean tissue.
paras.zh: 在《成熟》杂志上发表的一项研究中，阳光海岸大学的研究人员比较了三种不同的运动强度。尽管各组的参与者都经历了适度的减脂，但 HIIT 因其在减少脂肪的同时保持瘦肉组织的能力而脱颖而出。

paras.en: "We found that high, medium and low intensity exercises all led to modest fat loss but only HIIT retained lean muscle," said lead author and exercise physiologist Dr. Grace Rose of the University of the Sunshine Coast.
paras.zh: “我们发现，高、中、低强度的锻炼都会导致适度的脂肪减少，但只有 HIIT 保留了瘦肌肉，”阳光海岸大学的主要作者、运动生理学家 Grace Rose 博士说。

paras.en: The results highlight an important distinction in healthy aging: losing weight is not necessarily the same as improving body composition.
paras.zh: 结果凸显了健康老龄化的一个重要区别：减肥并不一定等于改善身体成分。

paras.en: Six Months of Exercise Revealed a Key Difference
paras.zh: 六个月的锻炼揭示了一个关键的区别

paras.en: The Australian research team investigated how workout intensity affects body composition, meaning the proportions of fat, muscle and other tissues that make up the body.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚研究小组调查了锻炼强度如何影响身体成分，即构成身体的脂肪、肌肉和其他组织的比例。

paras.en: A total of 123 healthy older adults from the Greater Brisbane region participated in the trial. Their average age was 72, and their average body mass index was approximately 26kg/m2, which the researchers described as normal for adults over 65.
paras.zh: 来自大布里斯班地区的总共 123 名健康老年人参加了试验。他们的平均年龄为 72 岁，平均体重指数约为 26kg/m2，研究人员称这对于 65 岁以上的成年人来说是正常的。

paras.en: Participants completed three supervised gym sessions each week for six months. Each session lasted 45 minutes, and participants were assigned to high-intensity intervals, moderate-intensity exercise, or a low-intensity comparison group.
paras.zh: 参与者在六个月内每周完成三场有人监督的健身课程。每次训练持续 45 分钟，参与者被分配到高强度间歇组、中等强度运动组或低强度对照组。

paras.en: To track changes, researchers measured body composition at the beginning of the study, after three months, and again at six months. They used a specialized scanning technique that estimates fat and lean tissue throughout the body.
paras.zh: 为了追踪变化，研究人员在研究开始时、三个月后和六个月后再次测量了身体成分。他们使用一种专门的扫描技术来估计全身的脂肪和瘦肉组织。

paras.en: The findings revealed that exercise intensity made a difference.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，运动强度会产生影响。

paras.en: Both high- and moderate-intensity training significantly reduced fat mass, with larger improvements than those seen in the low-intensity group. However, the two more demanding approaches differed in their effects on lean tissue.
paras.zh: 高强度和中等强度训练均显着减少了脂肪量，并且比低强度训练组的改善幅度更大。然而，这两种要求更高的方法对瘦肉组织的影响有所不同。

paras.en: "While moderate training reduced fat mass, it also caused a small decline in lean muscle," Rose said.
paras.zh: “虽然适度的训练减少了脂肪量，但它也导致了瘦肌肉的小幅下降，”罗斯说。

paras.en: Participants performing HIIT, meanwhile, reduced fat without experiencing the same decline in lean mass.
paras.zh: 与此同时，进行 HIIT 的参与者减少了脂肪，但瘦体重却没有出现同样的下降。

paras.en: This could be particularly valuable later in life, when maintaining muscle becomes increasingly important for physical independence. Strong muscles help people climb stairs, get out of chairs, maintain balance, and carry out everyday activities.
paras.zh: 这在以后的生活中尤其有价值，因为保持肌肉对于身体独立变得越来越重要。强壮的肌肉可以帮助人们爬楼梯、离开椅子、保持平衡并进行日常活动。

paras.en: One important distinction is that the scans measured lean tissue rather than muscle strength directly. Lean mass includes muscle but also other tissues and water, so changes in these measurements do not necessarily translate into equivalent changes in strength.
paras.zh: 一个重要的区别是扫描测量的是瘦组织而不是直接测量肌肉力量。瘦体重包括肌肉，还包括其他组织和水，因此这些测量值的变化不一定会转化为力量的等效变化。

paras.en: High-Intensity Exercise Also Reduced Abdominal Fat
paras.zh: 高强度运动也能减少腹部脂肪

paras.en: The researchers found another potentially important benefit involving fat stored around the middle of the body.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现了另一个潜在的重要好处，涉及身体中部周围储存的脂肪。

paras.en: "Both high and moderate intensities improved the composition of weight carried around the middle. Further analysis is needed of the low intensity results."
paras.zh: “高强度和中等强度都改善了中部的重量构成。需要对低强度结果进行进一步分析。”

paras.en: The original study found improvements in visceral adipose tissue among both the high and moderate intensity groups.
paras.zh: 最初的研究发现高强度组和中等强度组的内脏脂肪组织都有所改善。

paras.en: Visceral fat is different from the fat that sits directly beneath the skin. It accumulates deeper in the abdomen, surrounding internal organs such as the liver and intestines.
paras.zh: 内脏脂肪与直接位于皮肤下方的脂肪不同。它积聚在腹部深处，围绕肝脏和肠道等内脏器官。

paras.en: Excessive amounts of this fat have been linked to insulin resistance, cardiovascular disease, and other metabolic problems.
paras.zh: 过量的这种脂肪与胰岛素抵抗、心血管疾病和其他代谢问题有关。

paras.en: According to Rose, these findings matter because body composition can influence the development and progression of chronic diseases as people age.
paras.zh: 罗斯认为，这些发现很重要，因为随着人们年龄的增长，身体成分会影响慢性疾病的发生和进展。

paras.en: While body weight and body mass index provide useful general information, they do not reveal how much fat or muscle a person carries, or where that fat is stored.
paras.zh: 虽然体重和体重指数提供了有用的一般信息，但它们并不能揭示一个人携带多少脂肪或肌肉，或者脂肪储存在哪里。

paras.en: Someone who loses fat while maintaining muscle may experience a more favorable change in body composition than someone who loses a similar amount of weight along with valuable lean tissue.
paras.zh: 在保持肌肉的同时减掉脂肪的人可能会比在失去同等重量的同时减少宝贵的瘦肉组织的人经历更有利的身体成分变化。

paras.en: Still, the original researchers emphasized that the improvements were relatively small. They cautioned that the differences were not clearly clinically meaningful when compared with lower intensity exercise, particularly after accounting for measurement uncertainty.
paras.zh: 不过，最初的研究人员强调，改进相对较小。他们警告说，与较低强度的运动相比，这些差异没有明显的临床意义，特别是在考虑了测量不确定性之后。

paras.en: Why HIIT May Help Aging Muscles Stay Strong
paras.zh: 为什么 HIIT 可以帮助衰老的肌肉保持强壮

paras.en: One possible explanation for HIIT's advantage lies in the way it challenges the body.
paras.zh: HIIT 优势的一种可能解释在于它挑战身体的方式。

paras.en: Rather than exercising at the same pace throughout a workout, HIIT repeatedly pushes the cardiovascular system and working muscles through periods of intense effort, followed by easier activity.
paras.zh: HIIT 并不是在整个锻炼过程中以相同的速度进行锻炼，而是反复推动心血管系统和工作肌肉经历剧烈运动阶段，然后进行轻松的活动。

paras.en: University of the Sunshine Coast Associate Professor of Physiology and study co-author Mia Schaumberg explained how the training worked.
paras.zh: 阳光海岸大学生理学副教授兼研究合著者米娅·绍姆伯格解释了训练的运作方式。

paras.en: "High-intensity training in this study involved repeated short bursts, or intervals, of very hard exercise -- where breathing is heavy and conversation is difficult -- alternated with easier recovery periods.
paras.zh: “这项研究中的高强度训练包括重复短时间爆发或间歇性的非常艰苦的运动——呼吸沉重、谈话困难——与更容易的恢复期交替。

paras.en: "HIIT likely works better because it puts more stress on the muscles, giving the body a stronger signal to keep muscle tissue rather than lose it."
paras.zh: “HIIT 可能效果更好，因为它会给肌肉带来更大的压力，给身体发出更强的信号来保留肌肉组织而不是失去它。”

paras.en: This explanation is consistent with the idea that muscles adapt to the demands placed on them. When exercise provides a sufficiently challenging stimulus, the body has more reason to maintain the tissues needed to perform that activity.
paras.zh: 这种解释与肌肉适应对它们的要求的观点是一致的。当运动提供足够具有挑战性的刺激时，身体就有更多理由维持执行该活动所需的组织。

paras.en: Muscle preservation is especially important because aging is often accompanied by a gradual decline in muscle mass and strength. In more advanced cases, this can contribute to sarcopenia, a condition characterized by reduced muscle strength and quantity that can interfere with mobility and independence.
paras.zh: 肌肉的保存尤为重要，因为衰老往往伴随着肌肉质量和力量的逐渐下降。在更严重的病例中，这可能会导致肌肉减少症，这种疾病的特征是肌肉力量和数量减少，从而影响活动能力和独立性。

paras.en: Schaumberg said the original research could help people make more informed decisions about exercise and healthy aging.
paras.zh: 绍姆伯格表示，最初的研究可以帮助人们在运动和健康老龄化方面做出更明智的决定。

paras.en: When the university publicized the findings in early 2026, she also highlighted their relevance to people setting fitness goals.
paras.zh: 当该大学于 2026 年初公布研究结果时，她还强调了这些研究结果与人们设定健身目标的相关性。

paras.en: "With the festive season now behind most of us and New Year's resolutions in full swing, this research can help inform people's plans for healthy aging in 2026," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“随着我们大多数人的节日已经过去，新年决心也如火如荼地进行，这项研究可以帮助人们制定 2026 年健康老龄化计划。”

paras.en: The research involved collaborators from UniSC's Healthy Ageing Research Cluster and The University of Queensland.
paras.zh: 这项研究涉及南卡罗来纳大学健康老龄化研究集群和昆士兰大学的合作者。

paras.en: More Recent Studies Reveal Additional Benefits of HIIT
paras.zh: 最近的研究揭示了 HIIT 的其他好处

paras.en: Research published in 2026 has provided further insight into how HIIT affects older adults, although it also suggests that intense workouts are not necessarily superior in every situation.
paras.zh: 2026 年发表的研究进一步深入了解了 HIIT 对老年人的影响，尽管它也表明高强度锻炼并不一定在任何情况下都更有效。

paras.en: One 2026 study, published in Medicine & Science in Sports & Exercise, investigated whether older adults could benefit from completing HIIT at home with remote supervision.
paras.zh: 2026 年发表在《运动与锻炼医学与科学》杂志上的一项研究调查了老年人在远程监督下在家完成 HIIT 是否可以受益。

paras.en: The study involved 20 adults aged 61 to 74 who exercised using a specialized machine that let them work their arms and legs without bearing their body weight.
paras.zh: 这项研究涉及 20 名年龄在 61 岁至 74 岁之间的成年人，他们使用专门的机器进行锻炼，让他们在不承受体重的情况下锻炼手臂和腿部。

paras.en: After eight weeks of training, participants had lost an average of approximately 1.4 kilograms, or about 3 pounds, of fat mass. Their aerobic fitness also improved substantially.
paras.zh: 经过 8 周的训练，参与者平均减少了约 1.4 公斤（约 3 磅）的脂肪量。他们的有氧运动能力也显着提高。

paras.en: Participants completed 96 percent of their scheduled workouts, and the researchers reported no exercise-related adverse events.
paras.zh: 参与者完成了 96% 的预定锻炼，研究人员报告没有与锻炼相关的不良事件。

paras.en: Although the trial was small, its findings suggest that appropriately supervised HIIT programs may offer benefits outside a conventional gym.
paras.zh: 尽管试验规模较小，但其结果表明，适当监督的 HIIT 项目可能会在传统健身房之外带来好处。

paras.en: Another 2026 randomized trial, published in The Journals of Gerontology, Series A: Biological Sciences and Medical Sciences, compared HIIT with continuous moderate-intensity exercise in older adults living with HIV.
paras.zh: 另一项 2026 年随机试验发表在《老年学杂志 A 系列：生物科学和医学科学》上，对感染艾滋病毒的老年人进行 HIIT 与持续中等强度运动的比较。

paras.en: In that study, participants completed 16 weeks of exercise, with both groups also performing resistance training.
paras.zh: 在该研究中，参与者完成了 16 周的锻炼，两组还进行了阻力训练。

paras.en: Unlike the original Australian study, both exercise groups experienced reductions in fat and increases in lean mass. The researchers found no statistically significant difference between the two groups in those body composition changes.
paras.zh: 与最初的澳大利亚研究不同，两个运动组的脂肪都减少了，瘦体重也增加了。研究人员发现，两组之间的身体成分变化没有统计学上的显着差异。

paras.en: These results suggest that workout intensity is not the only factor that matters. Resistance training, which challenges muscles through weights or other forms of resistance, may also help preserve or increase lean tissue.
paras.zh: 这些结果表明锻炼强度并不是唯一重要的因素。阻力训练通过重量或其他形式的阻力来挑战肌肉，也可能有助于保留或增加瘦肉组织。

paras.en: The populations and training programs differed, so the findings should not be treated as a direct contradiction of the Australian results.
paras.zh: 人口和培训计划不同，因此研究结果不应被视为与澳大利亚结果的直接矛盾。

paras.en: Is HIIT Really the Best Exercise for Older Adults?
paras.zh: HIIT真的是老年人最好的运动吗？

paras.en: A broader scientific review published in the Journal of Clinical Medicine in August 2026 offers additional perspective.
paras.zh: 2026 年 8 月在《临床医学杂志》上发表的更广泛的科学评论提供了更多观点。

paras.en: Researchers examined 25 reports involving approximately 2,818 participants to assess how HIIT and other forms of interval training affect older adults.
paras.zh: 研究人员审查了涉及约 2,818 名参与者的 25 份报告，以评估 HIIT 和其他形式的间歇训练对老年人的影响。

paras.en: The most consistent benefits involved cardiovascular fitness, including improvements in the body's ability to use oxygen during exercise.
paras.zh: 最一致的好处涉及心血管健康，包括提高身体在运动过程中利用氧气的能力。

paras.en: Some studies also reported improvements in physical function and metabolic health. However, the review did not establish that HIIT was consistently better than moderate-intensity exercise.
paras.zh: 一些研究还报告了身体机能和代谢健康的改善。然而，审查并未证明 HIIT 始终优于中等强度运动。

paras.en: The researchers noted that differences between exercise programs, participant characteristics, and study methods made it difficult to identify a single optimal training approach.
paras.zh: 研究人员指出，锻炼计划、参与者特征和研究方法之间的差异使得很难确定单一的最佳训练方法。

paras.en: Taken together, the findings suggest that HIIT can be a useful tool for healthy aging, but it is not the only way to improve fitness or protect muscle.
paras.zh: 总而言之，研究结果表明 HIIT 可以成为健康老龄化的有用工具，但它并不是改善健康或保护肌肉的唯一方法。

paras.en: For adults over 65, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention recommends a combination of aerobic exercise, muscle strengthening activities, and exercises that improve balance.
paras.zh: 对于 65 岁以上的成年人，疾病控制和预防中心建议将有氧运动、肌肉强化活动和改善平衡的运动结合起来。

paras.en: Higher intensity workouts may be appropriate for some older adults, but people who are inactive or have medical conditions may benefit from gradually building up their fitness and seeking guidance before beginning a demanding program.
paras.zh: 较高强度的锻炼可能适合一些老年人，但不爱运动或患有健康问题的人可能会受益于逐渐增强体质并在开始要求较高的计划之前寻求指导。

paras.en: The central message from the Australian study remains compelling: what happens to muscle during fat loss may be just as important as the amount of weight someone loses.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚研究的中心信息仍然引人注目：减脂过程中肌肉发生的变化可能与减掉的体重一样重要。

paras.en: HIIT showed promise because it helped participants reduce body fat while maintaining lean tissue. Combined with newer findings, the research reinforces the value of exercise programs that support not just a lower number on the scale, but also the strength, fitness, and physical function needed for healthy aging.
paras.zh: HIIT 表现出了希望，因为它可以帮助参与者减少体内脂肪，同时保持瘦肉组织。结合最新的研究结果，该研究强化了锻炼计划的价值，这些锻炼计划不仅支持较低的数值，而且还支持健康衰老所需的力量、健身和身体机能。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of the Sunshine Coast. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由阳光海岸大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。
