paras.zh: 当谈到新妈妈时，婴儿通常占据中心舞台，吸引大多数人的注意力。但令人耳目一新的是，神经科学家苏珊娜·卡莫纳将焦点转移到了母亲身上。在《母亲的大脑》的开头几页中，卡莫纳愉快地告诉我们，“在这里，我们几乎不会讨论婴儿。”母亲是她的主角。

paras.en: What follows is a captivating, passionate and well-grounded journey through the fascinating process of “matrescence.” A word coined to echo “adolescence,” another time of seismic changes, matrescence includes the intense reorganization a woman’s brain undergoes as she becomes a mom. So far, early studies have revealed a sculpting of brain circuits (and Carmona is quick to point out that less can be more), heightened social instincts and perhaps even a boost of resilience during old age.
paras.zh: 接下来是一段引人入胜、充满激情且基础扎实的旅程，穿越令人着迷的“成熟期”过程。这个词是为了呼应“青春期”，即另一个发生巨大变化的时期，女性期包括女性在成为母亲后大脑所经历的剧烈重组。到目前为止，早期研究已经揭示了大脑回路的塑造（卡莫纳很快指出，少即是多）、社交本能的增强，甚至可能会增强老年时的适应能力。

paras.en: This mom found the book to be a treasure trove of motherly delights. Scientific concepts are woven with social and cultural strands, from the poignant to the weird to the profound. Certain passages in the book allowed me the pleasure of relistening to the song “The Mother” by Brandi Carlile, in which she sings, “Welcome to the end of being alone inside your mind.” A Mother’s Brain also kindly pointed me to the viral video, “Mother Rat Saves Baby from Snake.”
paras.zh: 这位妈妈发现这本书是母爱的宝库。科学概念与社会和文化脉络交织在一起，从深刻到怪异到深刻。书中的某些段落让我有幸重听布兰迪·卡莱尔的歌曲《母亲》，她在歌中唱道：“欢迎来到你内心孤独的终结。” 《妈妈的大脑》还好心地向我推荐了一段火爆的视频：“鼠妈妈从蛇手中拯救了婴儿。”

paras.en: As one of the foremost scientists studying matrescence, Carmona is an authoritative guide through the latest research, of which there is a dismayingly small amount. Still, the book covers scientific ground including hormones, evolution and brain networks. History, social constructs and the pressures of modern life come into the story, too.
paras.zh: 作为研究基质形成的最重要的科学家之一，卡莫纳是最新研究的权威指南，但这些研究的数量少得令人沮丧。尽管如此，这本书涵盖了科学领域，包括激素、进化和大脑网络。历史、社会结构和现代生活的压力也出现在故事​​中。

paras.en: If you prefer a light read, Carmona will occasionally warn you when a section is scientifically dense. Then she will invite you along anyway. “But if you do like hormones — well, we’re going to have fun,” Carmona writes at the beginning of a chapter. And it was fun. I was shocked to learn, for instance, just how massive the hormonal upheaval during pregnancy is. The amount of estrogen that floods a woman’s body, including her brain, during the 40 weeks of pregnancy is more than that of the amount that would otherwise accumulate over her entire fertile life, which lasts 35 years on average.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢轻松阅读，卡莫纳偶尔会在某个部分的科学密度很高时向您发出警告。然后她无论如何都会邀请你一起去。 “但如果你确实喜欢荷尔蒙——好吧，我们会玩得很开心，”卡莫纳在章节开头写道。这很有趣。例如，当我得知怀孕期间荷尔蒙的变化有多大时，我感到震惊。在怀孕 40 周期间，女性体内（包括大脑）所分泌的雌激素数量，超过了她整个生育期（平均持续 35 年）所积累的雌激素量。

paras.en: Along the way, Carmona thoughtfully addresses scientific puzzlers such as this: Mothers often report feeling less mentally sharp, yet laboratory studies show almost no neurological decline. Attributed to “mommy brain” or “momnesia,” mental slips might be due to a lack of sleep, or a shifting of attention, or even just an expectation.
paras.zh: 在此过程中，卡莫纳深思熟虑地解决了诸如此类的科学难题：母亲们经常报告感觉精神不那么敏锐，但实验室研究显示几乎没有神经功能下降。被认为是“妈妈脑”或“记忆症”的精神失误可能是由于睡眠不足、注意力转移、甚至只是一种期望造成的。

paras.en: This pervasive, negative stereotype of “mommy brain” can then build on itself, getting stronger as women buy into the incorrect idea that motherhood leaves them dumber. If a woman expects her memory to get worse, she’ll see signs of it in even normal mistakes. “I have watched brilliant women grow so insecure about their intelligence on becoming mothers that they abandon the projects that were once vital to them,” Carmona writes. Assumptions about their diminished brainpower can lead women to pull back from valuable parts of their lives. “It matters — a lot — how we talk to ourselves about these things.”
paras.zh: 这种普遍存在的、消极的“妈妈脑”刻板印象会不断增强，随着女性接受“母性会让她们变得更笨”的错误观念，这种刻板印象会变得更加强烈。如果一个女人预计自己的记忆力会变差，那么即使是正常的错误，她也会看到这种迹象。卡莫纳写道：“我看到才华横溢的女性在成为母亲后对自己的智力变得如此不自信，以至于放弃了曾经对她们至关重要的项目。”对女性脑力下降的假设可能会导致女性放弃生活中有价值的部分。 “我们如何与自己谈论这些事情很重要。”

paras.en: As a mother herself, Carmona brings her experiences into the narrative. It couldn’t be any other way. “Motherhood is lived,” she writes. “It happens in your gut, your identity, your core.”
paras.zh: 作为一名母亲，卡莫纳将她的经历融入到叙述中。不可能有其他方式。 “母性是活生生的，”她写道。 “它发生在你的直觉、你的身份、你的核心。”

paras.en: At its heart, this book is a love letter to moms, who have been invisible to the scientific gaze for too long. It’s time to write a new tale of matrescence, Carmona argues. “A story that recognizes mothers as the essence of the human species, the carriers of knowledge about how we create bonds — and, through them, society and culture.”
paras.zh: 从本质上讲，这本书是一封写给妈妈们的情书，她们已经在科学的视线中消失太久了。卡莫纳认为，是时候写一个新的女性成长故事了。 “这个故事承认母亲是人类的本质，是我们如何建立联系的知识载体，并通过母亲建立社会和文化。”

paras.en: By putting the intense and wild changes of motherhood into words, Carmona offers us a powerful and necessary story.
paras.zh: 通过用语言表达母性的强烈而疯狂的变化，卡莫纳为我们提供了一个有力而必要的故事。

paras.en: Buy A Mother’s Brain from Bookshop.org. Science News is a Bookshop.org affiliate and will earn a commission on purchases made from links in this article.
paras.zh: 从 Bookshop.org 购买《母亲的大脑》。 《科学新闻》是 Bookshop.org 的附属机构，通过本文中的链接进行购买将赚取佣金。

articles.title: An extinct crocodilian was found among rocks that built the Great Sphinx
articles.author: Jake Buehler

paras.en: The Great Sphinx of Giza isn’t the only ancient, stony visage in the area missing its nose.
paras.zh: 吉萨大狮身人面像并不是该地区唯一一座没有鼻子的古老石像。

paras.en: A fossil crocodilian discovered in the same 45-million-year-old limestone that ancient Egyptians used to build the Sphinx is also missing the tip of its snout. But the broken specimen is intact enough to be reclassified as a new branch of the gavial family tree, which may help uncover these mysterious animals’ evolutionary history, researchers report October 7 in Royal Society Open Science.
paras.zh: 在古埃及人用来建造狮身人面像的同一块 4500 万年前的石灰岩中发现的鳄鱼化石也缺失了鼻子。但研究人员 10 月 7 日在英国皇家学会开放科学杂志上报告称，破碎的标本足够完整，可以被重新分类为鳄类家族树的一个新分支，这可能有助于揭示这些神秘动物的进化历史。

paras.en: Most living crocodilians are in either the crocodile or alligator families. But there are also two species of gavial living in tropical Asia. These are huge, critically endangered, fish-eating crocodilians with long, slender snouts full of needlelike teeth. Fossils of extinct gavials have been found around the world. In 1927, German researchers reported a gavial skull fossil collected from hills near Cairo. The fossil was identified as an extinct species of Tomistoma, a genus found today only as a single species in Southeast Asia.
paras.zh: 大多数现存的鳄鱼属于鳄鱼科或短吻鳄科。但也有两种鳄鱼生活在热带亚洲。这些是巨大的、极度濒危的、以鱼为食的鳄鱼，它们的鼻子又长又细，长满了针状的牙齿。世界各地都发现了已灭绝的鳄鱼化石。 1927年，德国研究人员报道了从开罗附近的山上采集到的鳄类头骨化石。该化石被鉴定为已灭绝的 Tomistoma 物种，该属如今仅在东南亚作为单一物种发现。

paras.en: But more recent evolutionary studies including this fossil suggested this classification didn’t fit. In 2023, while working on a doctoral degree at University College London, paleontologist Paul Burke went to Germany to study the fossil in detail. Burke and his colleagues made careful measurements of the skull, using 3-D X-ray methods to measure the insides of the brain and nasal cavities.
paras.zh: 但最近的进化研究（包括这块化石）表明这种分类并不合适。 2023年，古生物学家保罗·伯克在伦敦大学学院攻读博士学位期间，前往德国详细研究这块化石。伯克和他的同事对头骨进行了仔细的测量，使用 3D X 射线方法测量大脑和鼻腔的内部。

paras.en: “As we’ve advanced in the last 100 years, we’ve got so many new methodologies we could implement to figure out what kind of species this fossil is,” says Burke, currently at the Sweden Museum of Natural History in Stockholm.
paras.zh: “随着我们在过去 100 年中取得的进步，我们已经有了很多新的方法可以用来弄清楚这块化石是什么物种，”目前在斯德哥尔摩瑞典自然历史博物馆工作的伯克说。

paras.en: The team compared the measurements to those taken of living and fossil gavials and found that this purported Egyptian Tomistoma was actually an undescribed gavial genus. The researchers named it Herugavialis cairensis, referencing the Egyptian god Heru (or Horus), who has been associated with the Great Sphinx. Coincidentally, the Herugavialis skull is missing the end of its snout — something it shares with the noseless statue.
paras.zh: 研究小组将测量结果与现存的和化石的鳄鱼进行了比较，发现这种所谓的埃及托米斯托马实际上是一种未被描述的鳄鱼属。研究人员将其命名为 Herugavialis cairensis，参考与大狮身人面像有关的埃及神赫鲁（或荷鲁斯）。巧合的是，Herugavialis 头骨缺少鼻子末端——这是它与无鼻子雕像共有的部分。

paras.en: “So many species are found from the same [geologic] formation,” Burke says, including fish, sharks and mammals. “But this is the first one with the name associated with the Sphinx.”
paras.zh: “在同一[地质]构造中发现了如此多的物种，”伯克说，包括鱼类、鲨鱼和哺乳动物。 “但这是第一个与狮身人面像相关的名字。”

paras.en: Today, gavials are only found in freshwater environments. But tens of millions of years ago, the reptiles also inhabited nearshore saltwater environments. Herugavialis appears to have been a coastal predator back when the ancient Tethys Ocean covered northern Egypt.
paras.zh: 如今，鳄鱼只生活在淡水环境中。但数千万年前，爬行动物也栖息在近岸咸水环境中。当古特提斯洋覆盖埃及北部时，Herugavialis 似乎是一种沿海掠食者。

paras.en: Khalafallah Salih, a paleontologist at Al Neelain University in Khartoum, Sudan, says the finding supports the idea that the evolution of gavials and their relatives in Africa was much more complex than researchers thought. Herugavialis doesn’t appear closely related to other known gavial-type crocodilians in Africa or the Mediterranean, he says. It appears to have branched off from the lineage early in its evolution.
paras.zh: 苏丹喀土穆阿尔尼兰大学的古生物学家 Khalafallah Salih 表示，这一发现支持了这样一种观点，即非洲的长吻鳄及其近亲的进化比研究人员想象的要复杂得多。他说，Herugavialis 似乎与非洲或地中海其他已知的鳄类鳄鱼没有密切关系。它似乎在进化的早期就从该谱系中分支出来。

paras.en: Burke notes that gavials barely breach the public consciousness compared to alligators and crocodiles.
paras.zh: 伯克指出，与短吻鳄和鳄鱼相比，长吻鳄几乎没有打破公众的意识。

paras.en: “They’re still alive today and they’re endangered,” he says. “So, we should know about them and their long history.”
paras.zh: “它们今天仍然活着，而且濒临灭绝，”他说。 “所以，我们应该了解它们以及它们悠久的历史。”

articles.title: Signs of Psychopathy Can Show Up in a Person's Writing
articles.author: Jess Cockerill

paras.en: Psychopathy is not listed in the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, and it's not an official diagnosis any psychiatrist or psychologist will give.
paras.zh: 《精神疾病诊断和统计手册》中没有列出精神病，也不是任何精神病学家或心理学家都会给出的正式诊断。

paras.en: But the term is still widely used, especially in criminology, to describe a problematic cluster of personality traits.
paras.zh: 但这个词仍然被广泛使用，特别是在犯罪学中，用来描述一组有问题的人格特征。

paras.en: The triarchic model says psychopathic personalities have three key features: boldness, disinhibition, and meanness.
paras.zh: 三元模型认为，精神病态人格具有三个关键特征：大胆、去抑制和卑鄙。

paras.en: A new study from clinical psychology researchers Ky Bray and Laura Drislane, both of the University of Mississippi, shows these traits can show up in people's writing, in ways that don't always fit with our stereotype of a 'psychopath'.
paras.zh: 密西西比大学临床心理学研究人员凯·布雷和劳拉·德里斯兰的一项新研究表明，这些特征可以在人们的写作中表现出来，但其方式并不总是符合我们对“精神病患者”的刻板印象。

paras.en: Their results are published in the journal Personality and Individual Differences.
paras.zh: 他们的研究结果发表在《人格与个体差异》杂志上。

paras.en: "People tend to think of psychopathy as one thing, but it's actually multidimensional," Bray says.
paras.zh: “人们倾向于认为精神病是一回事，但实际上它是多维的，”布雷说。

paras.en: Everyone exhibits these traits to some degree. It's when they appear together, at high levels across the board, that things can get dark.
paras.zh: 每个人都在某种程度上表现出这些特征。当它们一起出现在各个领域的高层时，事情就会变得黑暗。

paras.en: "That's in part why there's a movement away from calling people 'psychopaths,' because we don't view psychopathy as a category," says Drislane.
paras.zh: “这就是为什么有人开始不再称人们为‘精神病患者’，因为我们并不将精神病患者视为一个类别，”德里斯兰说。

paras.en: "But psychopathic dimensions can predict important outcomes, things like crime, recidivism, or intimate partner violence.
paras.zh: “但精神病态维度可以预测重要的结果，例如犯罪、累犯或亲密伴侣暴力。

paras.en: "What our research, including this paper, suggests is that it's important to look beyond that label and into the different components or dimensions of psychopathy, because each of those dimensions actually has a unique set of outcomes or things that it can predict."
paras.zh: “我们的研究，包括这篇论文，表明重要的是要超越这个标签，深入研究精神病的不同组成部分或维度，因为每个维度实际上都有一组独特的结果或可以预测的事情。”

paras.en: Bray and Drislane recruited 307 undergraduate students and 144 former incarcerated people from the community, who each completed a questionnaire (the Triarchic Psychopathy Measure, a.k.a. TriPM) designed to assess levels of the three psychopathic personality traits.
paras.zh: 布雷和德里斯兰从社区招募了 307 名本科生和 144 名前囚犯，他们每人完成了一份问卷（三元精神病测量，又称 TriPM），旨在评估三种精神病人格特征的水平。

paras.en: They were also asked to write about their lives, describing a high point, a low point, and a turning point.
paras.zh: 他们还被要求写下自己的生活，描述高潮、低谷和转折点。

paras.en: The goal with this study, Bray emphasizes, is not to use writing to diagnose psychopathy (which, again, isn't a formal diagnosis anyway), but to demonstrate how psychopathic traits can show up in everyday behaviors, including language.
paras.zh: 布雷强调，这项研究的目标不是用写作来诊断精神病（这又不是正式的诊断），而是为了证明精神病特征如何在日常行为（包括语言）中显现出来。

paras.en: For instance, people who scored high on the 'boldness' spectrum in the TriPM tended to use fewer anxiety-related words (for instance: 'worry', 'fear', 'afraid', or 'nervous') in their writing overall.
paras.zh: 例如，在 TriPM 中“大胆”得分较高的人在写作中倾向于较少使用与焦虑相关的词语（例如：“担心”、“恐惧”、“害怕”或“紧张”）。

paras.en: A person with a high score on 'meanness' was less likely to use words associated with negative emotions – 'bad', 'hate', 'hurt', or 'tired', for example – when writing about their life's major turning point.
paras.zh: “卑鄙”得分高的人在写下人生的重大转折点时，不太可能使用与负面情绪相关的词语，例如“坏”、“恨”、“受伤”或“累”。

paras.en: Disinhibition had the greatest effect on language of all three personality traits. People who scored high on disinhibition tended to refer to positive outcomes far less across all three writing prompts.
paras.zh: 抑制解除对所有三种人格特征的语言影响最大。在抑制解除方面得分较高的人在所有三个写作提示中往往很少提到积极的结果。

paras.en: They used more negative language when describing high points and turning points than their peers, but not when writing about low points.
paras.zh: 与同龄人相比，他们在描述高潮和转折点时使用更多负面语言，但在写低潮时却很少使用。

paras.en: They also tended to refer to substance use (words like 'beer', 'wine', 'drunk', and 'cigar') more when talking about low points and turning points, but not high points.
paras.zh: 当谈论低点和转折点时，他们还倾向于更多地提及物质使用（诸如“啤酒”、“葡萄酒”、“醉酒”和“雪茄”等词），而不是高点。

paras.en: "Viewing [psychopathy] from a multidimensional perspective allows us to observe how those traits might manifest in non-forensic populations, in people who have not committed a crime," Bray says.
paras.zh: 布雷说：“从多维角度观察[精神病]使我们能够观察这些特征如何在非法医人群、没有犯罪的人中表现出来。”

paras.en: "That allows us to see how these traits affect college students, business professionals, or interpersonal relationships."
paras.zh: “这使我们能够了解这些特征如何影响大学生、商业专业人士或人际关系。”

paras.en: The results suggest the language used by people with psychopathic traits is not necessarily lacking in emotion or personal meaning, counter to the stereotype of a cold, callous criminal.
paras.zh: 结果表明，具有精神病特征的人使用的语言不一定缺乏情感或个人意义，这与冷酷无情的罪犯的刻板印象相反。

paras.en: But it may not always match what other people would consider appropriate for the context.
paras.zh: 但它可能并不总是符合其他人认为适合上下文的内容。

paras.en: "If we want to be able to treat or ideally even prevent psychopathy from developing, we need to understand the mechanisms at play," Drislane says.
paras.zh: “如果我们希望能够治疗甚至理想情况下预防精神病的发展，我们需要了解起作用的机制，”德里斯兰说。

paras.en: "That comes down to understanding the unique contributors for all three of these dimensions."
paras.zh: “这归结为了解所有这三个维度的独特贡献者。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Personality and Individual Differences.
paras.zh: 该研究发表在《人格与个体差异》杂志上。

articles.title: Scientists Trace How Cancer Passed Between Twins Before Birth
articles.author: Esra Öz

paras.en: A facial mass detected before birth prompted the early delivery of identical twin sisters. A fetal MRI at 33 weeks showed the mass on one baby's face. When the sisters were born a week later, tumors were found in both.
paras.zh: 出生前检测到的面部肿块促使同卵双胞胎姐妹提前分娩。 33 周时的胎儿 MRI 显示一名婴儿脸上有肿块。一周后，姐妹俩出生时，两人都发现了肿瘤。

paras.en: Two children had the same cancer, raising a question that their shared beginnings alone could not answer.
paras.zh: 两个孩子患有同样的癌症，提出了一个仅靠他们共同的起点无法回答的问题。

paras.en: Had the disease started separately in each sister, or had cancer cells crossed from one to the other before birth?
paras.zh: 这种疾病是在姐妹俩身上分别开始的，还是癌细胞在出生前就从一个姐妹传播到了另一个姐妹？

paras.en: Researchers turned to a record hidden within their cells. DNA changes, accumulated as their bodies developed, allowed the team to reconstruct events that had happened months before anyone saw a tumor.
paras.zh: 研究人员求助于隐藏在细胞内的记录。随着身体发育而积累的 DNA 变化使研究小组能够重建人们看到肿瘤之前几个月发生的事件。

paras.en: The study in Nature Communications shows that the cancer began in one sister and passed to the other in the womb, most likely through a single transfer late in the second trimester. The same investigation uncovered clues to how the sisters themselves had formed.
paras.zh: 《自然通讯》杂志上的这项研究表明，癌症始于一位姐妹，并在子宫内传播给另一位姐妹，很可能是在妊娠中期后期通过单次转移传播的。同一项调查还揭示了姐妹俩如何形成的线索。

paras.en: The two girls, Amelia and Amaya, died soon after birth. Their family consented to post-mortem examinations for research. The authors dedicate the study to the sisters, whose mother wanted them acknowledged by name.
paras.zh: 这两个女孩阿米莉亚和阿玛亚在出生后不久就去世了。他们的家人同意进行尸检以进行研究。作者将这项研究献给这对姐妹，她们的母亲希望她们能说出她们的名字。

paras.en: The team included researchers from the Wellcome Sanger Institute, Great Ormond Street Hospital and the University of Cambridge.
paras.zh: 该团队包括来自威康桑格研究所、大奥蒙德街医院和剑桥大学的研究人员。

paras.en: The baby with the facial mass is called twin A in the paper. At birth, she had tumor deposits in several organs. Her sister, twin B, initially had lesions in her skin; disease involving the membranes around the brain and spinal cord was detected later.
paras.zh: 论文中将该面部肿块的婴儿称为双胞胎A。她出生时，多个器官就有肿瘤沉积。她的妹妹，双胞胎 B，最初皮肤有损伤；后来发现了涉及大脑和脊髓周围膜的疾病。

paras.en: The tumors were reported as undifferentiated sarcomas. Soft tissue sarcomas arise in tissues such as muscle, fat and the body's supporting structures. All the twins' tumor samples carried the same fusion of two genes, MN1 and ZNF341.
paras.zh: 据报道，肿瘤为未分化肉瘤。软组织肉瘤出现在肌肉、脂肪和身体支撑结构等组织中。所有双胞胎的肿瘤样本都携带两种基因的相同融合：MN1 和 ZNF341。

paras.en: Matching tumors were only the beginning: the team needed to identify whose cells had started the cancer.
paras.zh: 匹配肿瘤只是一个开始：研究小组需要确定是谁的细胞引发了癌症。

paras.en: Here, an apparent contradiction proved useful: identical twins are not necessarily genetically identical.
paras.zh: 在这里，一个明显的矛盾被证明是有用的：同卵双胞胎的基因不一定相同。

paras.en: They begin with the same fertilized egg, but DNA changes can arise as their cells multiply. A change acquired by one cell can pass to its descendants, marking a particular branch of the developing body's cellular family tree.
paras.zh: 它们从同一个受精卵开始，但随着细胞的繁殖，DNA 会发生变化。一个细胞获得的变化可以传递给它的后代，标志着发育中的机体细胞谱系的一个特定分支。

paras.en: Comparing those marks across tissues reveals shared ancestors and distinguishes one twin's cells from her sister's.
paras.zh: 比较不同组织中的这些标记可以揭示共同的祖先，并将其中一个双胞胎的细胞与她姐姐的细胞区分开来。

paras.en: The team sequenced 10 tumor samples, 12 normal tissue samples from the twins and 11 placental samples. They also examined 12 placental samples enriched for cells involved in forming the placenta.
paras.zh: 研究小组对双胞胎的 10 个肿瘤样本、12 个正常组织样本和 11 个胎盘样本进行了测序。他们还检查了 12 个富含参与胎盘形成的细胞的胎盘样本。

paras.en: The researchers found that cancer began in twin A, then cancer cells passed to twin B before birth and formed tumors there too. The evidence was in the second baby's tumors: their cells carried genetic markers belonging to her sister.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，癌症始于双胞胎A，然后癌细胞在出生前传给了双胞胎B，并在那里形成了肿瘤。证据就在第二个婴儿的肿瘤中：它们的细胞携带属于她姐姐的遗传标记。

paras.en: The study points to spread across the placenta they shared. The genetic analysis establishes which sister the cancer came from, but does not directly show the cells crossing or the route they took.
paras.zh: 研究指出病毒会通过他们共用的胎盘传播。遗传分析确定了癌症来自哪一个姐妹，但并没有直接显示细胞的交叉或它们采取的路线。

paras.en: The most likely starting site was twin A's facial mass. The cancer diversified into different cell populations and spread within her body before reaching her sister. The pattern in twin B supported a relatively late, single transfer.
paras.zh: 最有可能的起始部位是双胞胎 A 的面部肿块。癌症分化成不同的细胞群，并在她的体内扩散，然后到达她的姐姐。双 B 中的模式支持相对较晚的单一转移。

paras.en: The researchers then used accumulated mutations to estimate when this happened. Assuming mutations built up at a constant rate, they placed the tumor's origin near the end of the first trimester and its transfer late in the second trimester.
paras.zh: 然后研究人员利用累积的突变来估计这种情况发生的时间。假设突变以恒定速率累积，他们将肿瘤的起源置于妊娠早期末期附近，并将其转移置于妊娠中期后期。

paras.en: Those dates are estimates that depend on the assumed mutation rate, rather than direct observations.
paras.zh: 这些日期是取决于假设的突变率的估计值，而不是直接观察结果。

paras.en: There was another surprise: normal cells had moved in the opposite direction. Genetic markers in a spleen sample from twin A suggested around 75 percent of the sampled cells originated in twin B, consistent with blood-cell mixing between the sisters.
paras.zh: 还有另一个惊喜：正常细胞向相反的方向移动。双胞胎 A 的脾脏样本中的遗传标记表明，大约 75% 的样本细胞起源于双胞胎 B，这与姐妹之间的血细胞混合一致。

paras.en: The twins' earliest cell lineages also contributed unevenly to their bodies and placenta. One branch contributed almost exclusively to twin A, another to both sisters and the placenta, and a third to twin B and the placenta. The pattern favored an earlier embryonic split than the classical model for this type of identical twinning predicts.
paras.zh: 这对双胞胎最早的细胞谱系对他们的身体和胎盘的贡献也不均匀。其中一根分支几乎只对双胞胎 A 起作用，另一根对姐妹俩和胎盘起作用，第三根对双胞胎 B 和胎盘起作用。与此类同卵双胞胎的经典模型预测相比，该模式有利于更早的胚胎分裂。

paras.en: However, this was one pair of twins, and the analysis could recover only lineages that survived in the tissues sampled.
paras.zh: 然而，这是一对双胞胎，分析只能恢复在采样组织中存活的谱系。

paras.en: Earlier research on twins with leukemia has also explored cancer's beginnings before birth. This case adds a detailed reconstruction of a soft tissue tumor's journey, without establishing how often such transfers occur.
paras.zh: 早期对患有白血病的双胞胎的研究也探索了癌症在出生前的起源。该病例增加了对软组织肿瘤旅程的详细重建，但没有确定这种转移发生的频率。

paras.en: Nor does the study show that a cancer in one twin must reach the other. The researchers interpret the transfer as a rare event, rather than an unavoidable consequence of the sisters sharing their prenatal environment.
paras.zh: 这项研究也没有表明双胞胎中一个人的癌症一定会传染给另一个人。研究人员将这种转移解释为罕见事件，而不是姐妹们共享产前环境的不可避免的结果。

paras.en: The approach offers a way to investigate the developmental origins of childhood tumors alongside normal growth.
paras.zh: 该方法提供了一种研究儿童肿瘤与正常生长的发育起源的方法。

paras.en: The research has been published in Nature Communications.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《自然通讯》上。

articles.title: GLP-1 Users Are Reporting Their Fingernails Detaching
articles.author: Esra Öz

paras.en: When you start a medication and notice something different about your body, a question can follow: Is the drug responsible?
paras.zh: 当您开始服药并注意到身体出现异常时，可能会出现一个问题：药物是否对此负责？

paras.en: Changes to your nails might prompt that question, too.
paras.zh: 指甲的变化也可能会引发这个问题。

paras.en: In a new study, researchers investigating GLP-1 drugs used to treat obesity and type 2 diabetes wanted to know whether nail problems were more common among people taking them.
paras.zh: 在一项新的研究中，研究人员调查了用于治疗肥胖和 2 型糖尿病的 GLP-1 药物，想知道服用这些药物的人中指甲问题是否更常见。

paras.en: As it turns out, their study of 1,904 people across four countries found a difference.
paras.zh: 事实证明，他们对四个国家 1,904 人的研究发现了差异。

paras.en: Nail detachment was reported by 39 percent of GLP-1 users, compared with 9 percent of people with type 2 diabetes or obesity who had never taken the drugs.
paras.zh: 39% 的 GLP-1 使用者报告出现指甲脱落，而从未服用过该药物的 2 型糖尿病或肥胖患者中这一比例为 9%。

paras.en: However, around half of the drug users reported nail problems before treatment began.
paras.zh: 然而，大约一半的吸毒者在治疗开始前报告了指甲问题。

paras.en: The findings were presented at the European Academy of Dermatology and Venereology (EADV) Congress 2026 in Vienna.
paras.zh: 研究结果在 2026 年维也纳欧洲皮肤病学和性病学会 (EADV) 大会上公布。

paras.en: Researchers compared 575 GLP-1 users with 1,329 people with type 2 diabetes or obesity who had never used the medications, recruited across France, the United States, Brazil, and Mexico.
paras.zh: 研究人员在法国、美国、巴西和墨西哥招募了 575 名 GLP-1 使用者与 1,329 名从未使用过该药物的 2 型糖尿病或肥胖患者进行了比较。

paras.en: According to an EADV press release, 66 percent of users reported at least one nail disorder, compared with 53 percent of controls. Nail discoloration was reported by 46 percent of GLP-1 users versus 17 percent of controls.
paras.zh: 根据 EADV 新闻稿，66% 的用户报告至少有一种指甲疾病，而对照组的这一比例为 53%。 46% 的 GLP-1 用户报告指甲变色，而对照组为 17%。

paras.en: "Our findings show a clear association, but they also underline an important point," says study author Charles Taïeb, the managing director of the European Market Maintenance Assessment.
paras.zh: “我们的研究结果显示出明显的关联，但它们也强调了一个重要的观点，”该研究的作者、欧洲市场维护评估常务董事查尔斯·塔伊布（Charles Taïeb）说。

paras.en: "Not everything that happens during GLP-1 treatment is necessarily caused by the treatment itself."
paras.zh: “并非 GLP-1 治疗期间发生的所有事情都一定是由治疗本身引起的。”

paras.en: The study relied on participants describing their symptoms. It was cross-sectional, capturing their experiences at one point rather than following them through treatment with standardized dermatological examinations. That means it cannot establish that the medications caused the changes.
paras.zh: 该研究依赖于参与者描述他们的症状。它是横断面的，记录了他们在某个时刻的经历，而不是通过标准化皮肤病学检查跟踪他们的治疗过程。这意味着它无法确定药物导致了这些变化。

paras.en: The extent of nail detachment described in the study is also unclear. The researchers have not specified whether it covers partial separation from the nail bed, complete nail loss, or both, and the information currently available does not distinguish between fingernails and toenails.
paras.zh: 研究中描述的指甲脱落的程度也不清楚。研究人员尚未具体说明它是否涵盖甲床部分分离、指甲完全脱落或两者兼而有之，而且目前可用的信息并未区分手指甲和脚趾甲。

paras.en: In general, separation of the nail plate from its bed is called onycholysis. DermNet explains that this can affect fingers or toes and can have several causes, including injury, skin disease, and infection. That background does not establish which conditions participants in this study experienced.
paras.zh: 一般来说，指甲板与其床分离称为甲剥离。 DermNet 解释说，这可能会影响手指或脚趾，并且可能有多种原因，包括受伤、皮肤病和感染。该背景并不能确定本研究的参与者经历了哪些条件。

paras.en: The 39 percent figure, therefore, should not be read as evidence that nearly four in ten users lost their nails completely. It also does not estimate a new patient's chance of developing the problem after starting medication.
paras.zh: 因此，39% 的数字不应被视为近十分之四的用户完全失去指甲的证据。它也没有估计新患者在开始用药后出现问题的机会。

paras.en: Researchers accounted for dermatological conditions and nutritional deficiencies when analyzing the results. Some associations weakened, but nail detachment and discoloration remained around two to three times more frequent among users, according to the release.
paras.zh: 研究人员在分析结果时考虑了皮肤病状况和营养缺乏。据新闻稿称，一些关联性减弱，但指甲脱落和变色的频率仍然是用户的两到三倍左右。

paras.en: The exact adjusted estimates and confidence intervals are not provided. Without them, the precision of those comparisons cannot be assessed from the announcement alone.
paras.zh: 未提供准确的调整估计值和置信区间。如果没有它们，就无法仅从公告中评估这些比较的准确性。

paras.en: The team also examined weight loss. Differences remained statistically significant when the analysis focused on participants who had lost weight, suggesting weight loss alone might not explain the findings. This still does not demonstrate a direct effect on nails.
paras.zh: 研究小组还检查了体重减轻情况。当分析重点关注体重减轻的参与者时，差异仍然具有统计学意义，这表明体重减轻本身可能无法解释研究结果。这仍然没有显示出对指甲的直接影响。

paras.en: A companion study involving the same participants examined hair and scalp symptoms, adding to interest in possible links between GLP-1 pathways and hair loss.
paras.zh: 一项由相同参与者参与的配套研究检查了头发和头皮症状，增加了人们对 GLP-1 通路与脱发之间可能联系的兴趣。

paras.en: Unusual hair loss was reported by 50 percent of users versus 34 percent of controls. Reduced hair volume or density affected 42 percent versus 19 percent.
paras.zh: 50% 的使用者报告有异常脱发，而对照者则为 34%。头发体积或密度减少影响了 42% 和 19%。

paras.en: Among users, hair loss was usually accompanied by scalp symptoms such as itching, redness or scaling.
paras.zh: 在使用者中，脱发通常伴有头皮症状，如瘙痒、发红或脱屑。

paras.en: Study author and dermatologist Bruno Halioua from the Société Française des Sciences Humaines sur la Peau (SFSHP) suggests that this pattern could go beyond the shedding typically seen after rapid weight loss and involve inflammation.
paras.zh: 研究作者、法国人体科学协会 (SFSHP) 的皮肤科医生 Bruno Halioua 认为，这种模式可能超出了快速减肥后常见的脱落现象，还涉及炎症。

paras.en: The hair findings came from the same group of people, so they do not independently replicate the nail results. Instead, they offer another view of symptoms reported within this sample.
paras.zh: 头发的研究结果来自同一组人，因此他们不能独立复制指甲的结果。相反，他们提供了该样本中报告的症状的另一种观点。

paras.en: Whether similar patterns appear in other populations, and how often problems begin after treatment starts, remain questions for research to resolve.
paras.zh: 类似的模式是否出现在其他人群中，以及治疗开始后出现问题的频率，仍然是有待研究解决的问题。

paras.en: The release does not identify which GLP-1 medications participants took or provide results for any specific drug. The findings therefore cannot establish a nail effect tied to any one drug.
paras.zh: 该新闻稿并未明确参与者服用了哪些 GLP-1 药物，也没有提供任何特定药物的结果。因此，研究结果不能确定指甲效应与任何一种药物有关。

paras.en: The release cites conference presentations as the sources for both studies; it does not reference a published paper reporting them.
paras.zh: 该新闻稿引用了会议演讲作为这两项研究的来源；它没有引用报道这些问题的已发表论文。

paras.en: The nail study was conducted with institutional support from DUCRAY Laboratories, part of the Pierre Fabre Group, which develops dermatological and hair care products.
paras.zh: 这项指甲研究是在 DUCRAY 实验室的机构支持下进行的，DUCRAY 实验室是皮尔法伯集团的一部分，专门开发皮肤科和护发产品。

paras.en: Researchers now plan to follow patients from the start of treatment. Standardized dermatological examinations and biological monitoring could help establish when changes develop, what contributes to them, and whether they are reversible.
paras.zh: 研究人员现在计划从治疗开始就跟踪患者。标准化的皮肤病学检查和生物监测可以帮助确定变化何时发生、造成变化的原因以及变化是否可逆。

paras.en: Halioua describes the changes as frequent and usually benign. For people noticing nail changes, hair loss or an itchy or red scalp, his advice is to discuss those symptoms with their doctor rather than stop treatment themselves.
paras.zh: Halioua 描述这些变化是频繁且通常是良性的。对于注意到指甲变化、脱发或头皮发痒或发红的人，他的建议是与医生讨论这些症状，而不是自行停止治疗。

articles.title: Einstein Probe reveals a hidden phase of neutron star collisions

paras.en: Einstein Probe reveals a hidden phase of neutron star collisions
paras.zh: 爱因斯坦探测器揭示了中子星碰撞的隐藏阶段

paras.en: - Einstein Probe revealed nearly 10 minutes of soft X-ray activity following a short gamma-ray burst, exposing a phase of neutron star mergers that previous missions may have missed. The prolonged emission could have been powered by a newly formed magnetar and may provide a valuable new counterpart to gravitational-wave signals.
paras.zh: - 爱因斯坦探测器在短暂的伽马射线爆发后揭示了近 10 分钟的软 X 射线活动，揭示了之前的任务可能错过的中子星合并阶段。长时间的发射可能由新形成的磁星提供动力，并可能为引力波信号提供有价值的新对应物。

paras.en: Short gamma-ray bursts, or short GRBs, are believed to occur when two compact objects, such as neutron stars, spiral toward one another before colliding and merging. These extraordinarily violent events produce gravitational waves and rank among the most powerful explosions in the Universe.
paras.zh: 据信，当两个致密天体（例如中子星）在碰撞和合并之前相互螺旋运动时，就会发生短伽马射线爆发或短伽马暴。这些异常剧烈的事件会产生引力波，是宇宙中最强大的爆炸之一。

paras.en: For decades, astronomers have mainly detected these events through their gamma-ray flashes. Their earliest soft X-ray emission has been far more difficult to observe because most narrow-field X-ray telescopes depend on gamma-ray alerts to locate a burst before turning toward it. Einstein Probe's wide-field soft X-ray monitoring has now exposed this previously unseen stage, giving astronomers a direct look at the opening moments of a short GRB.
paras.zh: 几十年来，天文学家主要通过伽马射线闪光探测到这些事件。它们最早的软 X 射线发射很难观测到，因为大多数窄视场 X 射线望远镜都依靠伽马射线警报来定位爆发，然后再转向它。爱因斯坦探测器的宽视场软X射线监测现在已经暴露了这个以前看不见的阶段，使天文学家能够直接观察短GRB的开始时刻。

paras.en: A Half-Second Flash With a Much Longer Aftermath
paras.zh: 半秒的闪光带来更长的余波

paras.en: The event, designated EP250704a/GRB 250704B, caught researchers by surprise on July 4, 2025. An Li, a PhD student at Beijing Normal University and the Transient Advocate for EP, was on duty when the signal appeared.
paras.zh: 2025 年 7 月 4 日，这一事件被指定为 EP250704a/GRB 250704B，令研究人员感到惊讶。信号出现时，北京师范大学博士生、EP 瞬态倡导者李安正在值班。

paras.en: "The event initially appeared to be an ordinary short GRB, producing a bright flash lasting less than half a second that was detected simultaneously in gamma rays by SVOM-GRM and Insight-HXMT and X-rays by EP-WXT," said Li.
paras.zh: “该事件最初似乎是一个普通的短伽马暴，产生持续时间不到半秒的明亮闪光，SVOM-GRM 和 Insight-HXMT 在伽马射线中同时检测到，EP-WXT 在 X 射线中同时检测到，”李说。

paras.en: After receiving the onboard alerts from EP, Li quickly began the initial analysis. What happened next was unexpected.
paras.zh: 收到EP的船上警报后，李很快就开始了初步分析。接下来发生的事情出乎意料。

paras.en: "However, instead of fading away, the source continued emitting episodes of soft X-rays for nearly ten minutes."
paras.zh: “然而，源头并没有消失，而是继续发射软 X 射线近十分钟。”

paras.en: The extended X-ray activity was energetic, but it occurred at wavelengths that conventional gamma-ray instruments would have struggled to detect.
paras.zh: 扩展的 X 射线活动充满活力，但其发生的波长是传统伽马射线仪器难以检测到的。

paras.en: "Although this long-lasting emission carried substantial energy, its spectrum was so soft that, for a burst at this typical cosmological distance, it would have remained below the detection threshold of conventional gamma-ray instruments, such as Swift's Burst Alert Telescope. As a result, previous missions would have recorded only the brief gamma-ray flash, missing the prolonged activity revealed by EP," said Professor Bin-Bin Zhang of Nanjing University, a co-corresponding author of the paper who initiated the in-depth study of the event. "Our observations show that what appears to be a typical short gamma-ray burst can actually conceal a much longer and richer episode of activity at soft X-ray energies."
paras.zh: “虽然这种持久的发射携带了大量的能量，但它的光谱非常柔和，对于这种典型宇宙学距离的爆发，它仍低于传统伽马射线仪器的检测阈值，例如斯威夫特的爆发警报望远镜。因此，以前的任务只能记录短暂的伽马射线闪光，而错过了 EP 揭示的长期活动，”该论文的共同通讯作者、南京大学的张斌斌教授说，他发起了对伽玛射线的深入研究。事件。 “我们的观察表明，看似典型的短伽马射线暴实际上可以掩盖软 X 射线能量下更长、更丰富的活动事件。”

paras.en: Tracking the Explosion Across the Spectrum
paras.zh: 全方位追踪爆炸

paras.en: To determine what had produced the unusual signal, researchers organized an extensive international follow-up campaign using observations ranging from X-ray and optical wavelengths to radio.
paras.zh: 为了确定是什么产生了这种异常信号，研究人员利用从 X 射线、光波长到无线电等各种观测结果组织了一次广泛的国际后续活动。

paras.en: "The coordinated observations across multiwavelengths were essential," said Professor Eleonora Troja of the University of Rome "Tor Vergata," a co-corresponding author of the paper, whose group obtained the key information of the redshift from spectroscopic analysis. "They not only allowed us to identify and study the burst's host galaxy and measure its distance, but also enabled us to rule out an accompanying supernova and provide strong evidence linking this extraordinary X-ray emission to a compact object merger."
paras.zh: 该论文的共同通讯作者、罗马大学“Tor Vergata”的埃莱奥诺拉·特罗哈（Eleonora Troja）教授说：“跨多波长的协调观测至关重要。”他的团队从光谱分析中获得了红移的关键信息。 “它们不仅使我们能够识别和研究爆发的宿主星系并测量其距离，而且使我们能够排除伴随的超新星，并提供强有力的证据将这种非凡的X射线发射与致密天体合并联系起来。”

paras.en: The combined observations helped establish that the unusual X-ray activity was connected to a compact object merger rather than another type of stellar explosion.
paras.zh: 综合观测结果有助于确定这种不寻常的 X 射线活动与致密天体合并有关，而不是与另一种类型的恒星爆炸有关。

paras.en: Evidence for a Long-Lived Central Engine
paras.zh: 长寿中央引擎的证据

paras.en: A closer examination showed that the prolonged X-ray emission was being powered directly by the remnant left behind by the merger, rather than by the outward-moving blast wave.
paras.zh: 更仔细的检查表明，长时间的X射线发射是由合并留下的残余物直接提供动力的，而不是由向外移动的冲击波提供的。

paras.en: Yi-Han Iris Yin, a PhD student in the Department of Physics and the Hong Kong Institute of Astronomy and Astrophysics at The University of Hong Kong, led the analysis of the high-energy emission. As a co-corresponding author, she found that EP250704a's rapidly changing brightness, evolving spectrum, and later X-ray and optical afterglows all pointed to continued activity from the central engine after the initial short GRB had already faded.
paras.zh: 香港大学物理系和香港天文及天体物理研究所的博士生殷一涵领导了对高能发射的分析。作为共同通讯作者，她发现 EP250704a 快速变化的亮度、不断变化的光谱以及后来的 X 射线和光学余辉都表明，在最初的短伽马射线暴消退后，中央引擎的持续活动。

paras.en: "One plausible explanation is that the merger produced a rapidly rotating, highly magnetized neutron star -- known as a magnetar -- that powered the extended X-ray emission and continued energy injection," said Yin.
paras.zh: 尹说：“一个合理的解释是，这次合并产生了一颗快速旋转、高度磁化的中子星——称为磁星——为延长的X射线发射和持续的能量注入提供动力。”

paras.en: Such a magnetar could provide a natural explanation for why the system remained active long after the brief gamma-ray flash had ended.
paras.zh: 这样的磁星可以自然地解释为什么该系统在短暂的伽马射线闪光结束后很长时间仍保持活跃。

paras.en: A New Tool for Multi-Messenger Astronomy
paras.zh: 多信使天文学的新工具

paras.en: The discovery could have important consequences for the study of neutron star mergers and the sources of gravitational waves.
paras.zh: 这一发现可能对中子星合并和引力波来源的研究产生重要影响。

paras.en: Since electromagnetic radiation and gravitational waves were jointly detected from merging neutron stars for the first time in 2017, astronomers have been searching for additional electromagnetic signals that can reveal what occurs during and after these extreme collisions.
paras.zh: 自 2017 年首次联合检测到合并中子星的电磁辐射和引力波以来，天文学家一直在寻找额外的电磁信号，以揭示这些极端碰撞期间和之后发生的情况。

paras.en: "The newly discovered soft X-ray component provides a new probe, indicating that the fast X-ray transients are also electromagnetic counterparts to gravitational-wave sources and may originate from compact object mergers," said Professor Troja.
paras.zh: 特罗哈教授说：“新发现的软X射线成分提供了一种新的探针，表明快速X射线瞬变也是引力波源的电磁对应物，并且可能源自致密天体合并。”

paras.en: The researchers also suggest that this type of extended soft X-ray activity may not be unusual. Similar signals could accompany other short GRBs but may have gone unnoticed because earlier missions were not able to capture prompt emission at energies below the gamma-ray range.
paras.zh: 研究人员还认为，这种延长的软 X 射线活动可能并不罕见。类似的信号可能伴随着其他短伽马暴，但可能没有被注意到，因为早期的任务无法捕获能量低于伽马射线范围的瞬时发射。

paras.en: "This discovery extends our view of neutron star mergers beyond the brief gamma-ray flash," said Yin. "By revealing this previously hidden soft X-ray phase, Einstein Probe opens a new window for studying neutron star merger remnants and may ultimately help constrain the neutron star equation-of-state."
paras.zh: 尹说：“这一发现扩展了我们对中子星合并的看法，超越了短暂的伽马射线闪光。” “通过揭示这个先前隐藏的软X射线相，爱因斯坦探测器为研究中子星合并残余物打开了一个新窗口，并可能最终帮助约束中子星状态方程。”

paras.en: By revealing activity that traditional gamma-ray observations can miss, Einstein Probe may give astronomers a new way to study both the immediate aftermath of neutron star mergers and their connection to gravitational-wave events.
paras.zh: 通过揭示传统伽马射线观测可能错过的活动，爱因斯坦探测器可能为天文学家提供一种新方法来研究中子星合并的直接后果及其与引力波事件的联系。

paras.en: "The findings also demonstrate Einstein Probe's unique capability to uncover new classes of transient phenomena and strengthen its role in the era of multi-messenger astronomy, in which gravitational waves and electromagnetic radiation are studied together to understand some of the most extreme events in the Universe," added Professor Zhang.
paras.zh: 张教授补充道：“这些发现还证明了爱因斯坦探测器具有发现新型瞬态现象的独特能力，并加强了其在多信使天文学时代的作用，在这个时代，引力波和电磁辐射被一起研究，以了解宇宙中一些最极端的事件。”

paras.en: Materials provided by Science China Press. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 资料由中国科学出版社提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: NASA is searching for hidden caves to build its first Moon base

paras.en: NASA is searching for hidden caves to build its first Moon base
paras.zh: 美国宇航局正在寻找隐藏的洞穴来建造其第一个月球基地

paras.en: - NASA is preparing for humanityâs first Moon base with three investigations that will hunt for underground shelters, uncover hidden ice, and track dangerous conditions on the lunar surface. The findings could reveal how astronauts can survive and thrive on the Moon while laying the groundwork for future journeys to Mars.
paras.zh: - 美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 正在为人类第一个月球基地做准备，将进行三项调查，寻找地下庇护所、发现隐藏的冰层并追踪月球表面的危险状况。这些发现可以揭示宇航员如何在月球上生存和发展，同时为未来的火星之旅奠定基础。

paras.en: NASA is moving closer to establishing humanity's first Moon base with the selection of three scientific investigations designed to answer some of the biggest questions about living on the lunar surface. The missions will search for underground caves that could shelter astronauts, investigate hidden deposits of lunar ice, and monitor environmental hazards that could threaten future explorers.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局正在接近建立人类第一个月球基地，选择了三项科学研究，旨在回答有关月球表面生活的一些最大问题。这些任务将寻找可以庇护宇航员的地下洞穴，调查隐藏的月球冰沉积物，并监测可能威胁未来探险家的环境危害。

paras.en: The new instruments and technologies were selected through NASA's Payloads and Research Investigations on the Surface of the Moon (PRISM) program. They will be delivered to the lunar surface through the agency's CLPS (Commercial Lunar Payload Services) initiative as part of its Moon Base Program.
paras.zh: 这些新仪器和技术是通过美国宇航局月球表面有效载荷和研究调查（PRISM）计划选择的。作为月球基地计划的一部分，它们将通过该机构的 CLPS（商业月球有效载荷服务）计划运送到月球表面。

paras.en: Each investigation will address a different challenge of establishing a lasting human presence on the Moon. Researchers will examine potential natural shelters, identify resources that astronauts could use, and study dangerous conditions that future habitats and equipment will need to withstand. Together, the findings will support NASA's Artemis and Moon Base programs as the agency works toward long-term lunar exploration.
paras.zh: 每项调查都将解决在月球上建立人类持久存在的不同挑战。研究人员将检查潜在的自然庇护所，确定宇航员可以使用的资源，并研究未来的栖息地和设备需要承受的危险条件。这些发现将共同支持美国宇航局的阿耳忒弥斯和月球基地计划，因为该机构致力于长期月球探索。

paras.en: "NASA Science is building the ultimate interplanetary survival guide to ensure that science goes first to the lunar surface to provide our future astronaut crews with the vital information, resources, and safety precautions needed ahead of time to survive the night on the Moon," said Nicky Fox, associate administrator, Science Mission Directorate, at NASA Headquarters in Washington. "These PRISM selections will directly help NASA minimize risks to our astronauts while maximizing our agency goals as we set up humanity's first lunar outpost in preparation for sending the first astronauts to Mars."
paras.zh: 美国宇航局华盛顿总部科学任务理事会副局长尼基·福克斯表示：“美国宇航局科学部正在制定终极星际生存指南，以确保科学首先到达月球表面，为我们未来的宇航员提供在月球上过夜所需的重要信息、资源和安全预防措施。” “这些 PRISM 选择将直接帮助 NASA 最大限度地降低宇航员面临的风险，同时最大限度地提高我们的机构目标，因为我们建立了人类第一个月球前哨站，准备将第一批宇航员送往火星。”

paras.en: Monitoring Moonquakes and Other Lunar Hazards
paras.zh: 监测月震和其他月球灾害

paras.en: The first investigation, Lunar Environment Monitoring Station -- South Pole (LEMS-SP), will establish an autonomous station to track environmental conditions and potential threats over an extended period.
paras.zh: 第一项调查是月球环境监测站——南极（LEMS-SP），将建立一个自主站来长期跟踪环境状况和潜在威胁。

paras.en: One of its tasks will be detecting micrometeoroids, tiny pieces of space debris that strike the lunar surface. Unlike Earth, the Moon lacks a substantial atmosphere capable of burning up most incoming objects, making these impacts a concern for future equipment and habitats.
paras.zh: 它的任务之一是探测微流星体，即撞击月球表面的微小太空碎片。与地球不同，月球缺乏能够燃烧大多数进入物体的大气层，因此这些影响成为未来设备和栖息地的一个问题。

paras.en: The station will also measure the abundance of volatiles, substances that readily turn into gas, within the Moon's extremely thin outer layer of gases. Tracking these materials will help scientists better understand how the lunar environment changes over time.
paras.zh: 该站还将测量月球极薄外层气体中挥发物的丰度，这些物质很容易转化为气体。追踪这些材料将帮助科学家更好地了解月球环境如何随时间变化。

paras.en: Another important instrument will be a short-period seismometer, designed to detect vibrations and seismic activity, including moonquakes. These measurements could reveal hazards that NASA must consider when designing structures and installing sensitive equipment on the lunar surface.
paras.zh: 另一个重要的仪器是短周期地震仪，旨在检测振动和地震活动，包括月震。这些测量可以揭示美国宇航局在月球表面设计结构和安装敏感设备时必须考虑的危险。

paras.en: By collecting information about impacts, seismic activity, and the surrounding environment, LEMS-SP could help engineers develop safer and more reliable infrastructure for a permanent Moon base.
paras.zh: 通过收集有关影响、地震活动和周围环境的信息，LEMS-SP 可以帮助工程师为永久月球基地开发更安全、更可靠的基础设施。

paras.en: The investigation will be led by Dr. Mehdi Benna of the University of Maryland, Baltimore County.
paras.zh: 调查将由巴尔的摩县马里兰大学的迈赫迪·本纳博士领导。

paras.en: Searching for Hidden Caves Beneath the Moon
paras.zh: 寻找月球下隐藏的洞穴

paras.en: The second investigation will explore one of the Moon's most intriguing possibilities: enormous underground passages that could serve as natural shelters for astronauts.
paras.zh: 第二项调查将探索月球最有趣的可能性之一：巨大的地下通道，可以作为宇航员的天然庇护所。

paras.en: Known as Geophysical Instruments for Marius Lunar pit Investigation (GIMLI), the mission will examine the Marius Hills Pit, an opening in the lunar surface that may connect to an extensive underground lava tube.
paras.zh: 该任务被称为马吕斯月球坑调查地球物理仪器（GIMLI），将检查马吕斯山坑，这是月球表面的一个开口，可能与一个广阔的地下熔岩管相连。

paras.en: Lava tubes form when the outer surface of flowing lava cools and hardens while molten rock continues moving beneath it. Once the lava drains away, it can leave behind hollow tunnels. Scientists believe similar formations may exist beneath parts of the Moon's volcanic terrain.
paras.zh: 当流动的熔岩外表面冷却并硬化，而熔岩继续在其下方移动时，就会形成熔岩管。一旦熔岩排干，就会留下空心的隧道。科学家认为，月球部分火山地形下方可能存在类似的地层。

paras.en: GIMLI will use geophysical measurements to investigate what lies beneath the pit and determine whether it connects to a larger underground passage. The findings will also provide new insights into the volcanic processes that shaped the lunar landscape.
paras.zh: GIMLI 将使用地球物理测量来调查坑底下的情况，并确定它是否与更大的地下通道相连。这些发现还将为塑造月球景观的火山过程提供新的见解。

paras.en: If large underground spaces are confirmed, they could offer an important advantage for future human exploration.
paras.zh: 如果大型地下空间得到证实，它们可以为未来人类探索提供重要优势。

paras.en: The lunar surface is exposed to intense temperature changes, harmful ionizing radiation, and frequent impacts from tiny space rocks. Underground lava tubes could provide more stable temperatures and natural shielding from these dangers.
paras.zh: 月球表面暴露在剧烈的温度变化、有害的电离辐射以及微小太空岩石的频繁撞击之下。地下熔岩管可以提供更稳定的温度和天然的屏障来抵御这些危险。

paras.en: Instead of relying entirely on protective structures built on the surface, future astronauts might be able to use some of the Moon's existing geological formations as shelters.
paras.zh: 未来的宇航员或许可以利用月球现有的一些地质构造作为避难所，而不是完全依赖在月球表面建造的保护性结构。

paras.en: Confirming the presence and size of these underground spaces could therefore influence where NASA considers placing future habitats and how those habitats are designed.
paras.zh: 因此，确认这些地下空间的存在和大小可能会影响美国宇航局考虑放置未来栖息地的位置以及这些栖息地的设计方式。

paras.en: Dr. Nathaniel Putzig of the Planetary Science Institute will serve as the principal investigator for GIMLI.
paras.zh: 行星科学研究所的 Nathaniel Putzig 博士将担任 GIMLI 的首席研究员。

paras.en: Hunting for Hidden Ice and Usable Moon Resources
paras.zh: 寻找隐藏的冰和可用的月球资源

paras.en: The third investigation will focus on another resource that could be essential to a lasting human presence on the Moon: water ice.
paras.zh: 第三项调查将重点关注另一种对人类在月球上持久存在至关重要的资源：水冰。

paras.en: The Depth Imager with Spectral and Color Optics (DISCO) payload is designed to make the first direct measurements from the lunar surface of ice preserved inside small, exceptionally cold regions known as micro-cold traps.
paras.zh: 具有光谱和彩色光学器件的深度成像仪（DISCO）有效载荷旨在对月球表面的冰进行首次直接测量，这些冰保存在小型、异常寒冷的区域（称为微冷阱）内。

paras.en: These areas can remain cold enough for ice to persist because they receive little or no direct sunlight. Identifying where the ice is located, how much exists, and how it is distributed could help scientists understand whether it can become a practical resource for future lunar missions.
paras.zh: 这些区域可以保持足够冷，足以使冰持续存在，因为它们很少或没有阳光直射。确定冰的位置、存在量以及分布方式可以帮助科学家了解它是否可以成为未来月球任务的实用资源。

paras.en: Water brought from Earth is expensive to transport into space. Finding accessible ice on the Moon could eventually allow astronauts to obtain water locally and potentially process it into oxygen and hydrogen for other uses.
paras.zh: 从地球运来的水到太空的成本很高。在月球上找到可接近的冰最终可以让宇航员在当地获取水，并有可能将其加工成氧气和氢气以供其他用途。

paras.en: DISCO will also investigate the physical properties of the lunar surface.
paras.zh: DISCO 还将研究月球表面的物理特性。

paras.en: One challenge is understanding what happens when a spacecraft lands. Rocket exhaust can blast dust and loose material away from the ground, potentially affecting nearby equipment and structures.
paras.zh: 一项挑战是了解航天器着陆时会发生什么。火箭尾气会将灰尘和松散物质从地面吹走，可能会影响附近的设备和结构。

paras.en: Researchers will also examine the stability of the terrain to better understand how safely astronauts, robotic vehicles, and other equipment can move across the surface.
paras.zh: 研究人员还将检查地形的稳定性，以更好地了解宇航员、机器人车辆和其他设备如何安全地在地面上移动。

paras.en: Combining these measurements will help NASA develop safer landing and surface operations while advancing technologies that could turn lunar ice into a useful resource for the Moon Base Program.
paras.zh: 结合这些测量结果将有助于美国宇航局开发更安全的着陆和地面操作，同时推进可将月球冰变成月球基地计划有用资源的技术。

paras.en: Dr. Ariel Deutsch of NASA's Ames Research Center in California's Silicon Valley will lead the DISCO investigation.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局位于加州硅谷的艾姆斯研究中心的 Ariel Deutsch 博士将领导 DISCO 的调查。

paras.en: Building the Foundation for Humanity's First Moon Base
paras.zh: 为人类第一个月球基地奠定基础

paras.en: Together, the three investigations will address some of the most important challenges of establishing a sustained human presence beyond Earth.
paras.zh: 这三项调查将共同解决在地球以外建立人类持续存在的一些最重要的挑战。

paras.en: LEMS-SP will help scientists understand environmental threats, GIMLI will investigate whether underground lava tubes could provide natural protection, and DISCO will examine potential water resources and the behavior of the lunar surface.
paras.zh: LEMS-SP将帮助科学家了解环境威胁，GIMLI将调查地下熔岩管是否可以提供自然保护，DISCO将检查潜在的水资源和月球表面的行为。

paras.en: The results could influence everything from the placement of future habitats to the design of equipment and the development of systems that allow astronauts to make use of resources already available on the Moon.
paras.zh: 结果可能会影响一切，从未来栖息地的布局到设备的设计以及允许宇航员利用月球上现有资源的系统的开发。

paras.en: "Each new PRISM selection strengthens our ability to deliver ambitious, transformative science to the lunar surface," said Brad Bailey, director of the Exploration Science Strategy Integration Office in NASA's Science Mission Directorate. "These investigations exemplify how Artemis and Moon Base are expanding the frontier of lunar exploration, advancing innovative technologies, deepening our understanding of the Moon's environment, and paving the way for future astronaut missions."
paras.zh: NASA 科学任务理事会探索科学战略整合办公室主任布拉德·贝利 (Brad Bailey) 表示：“每一个新的 PRISM 选择都增强了我们向月球表面提供雄心勃勃的变革性科学的能力。” “这些调查体现了阿耳忒弥斯和月球基地如何扩大月球探索的前沿，推进创新技术，加深我们对月球环境的了解，并为未来的宇航员任务铺平道路。”

paras.en: NASA is working to increase the frequency of its lunar missions as it prepares to establish a Moon base. These missions will deliver scientific instruments and new technologies intended to expand American leadership in space science, support a sustained lunar presence, and prepare for more ambitious human exploration.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局正在努力增加其月球任务的频率，准备建立月球基地。这些任务将提供科学仪器和新技术，旨在扩大美国在太空科学领域的领导地位，支持月球的持续存在，并为更雄心勃勃的人类探索做好准备。

paras.en: The agency's CLPS initiative plays a central role in that effort by partnering with American companies to transport scientific, exploration, and technology payloads to the Moon's surface and orbit.
paras.zh: 该机构的 CLPS 计划在这一努力中发挥了核心作用，它与美国公司合作，将科学、探索和技术有效载荷运送到月球表面和轨道。

paras.en: Beyond helping astronauts live and work on the Moon, the knowledge gained from these investigations could prove essential to NASA's longer-term goal of sending humans to Mars.
paras.zh: 除了帮助宇航员在月球上生活和工作之外，从这些调查中获得的知识可能对美国宇航局将人类送上火星的长期目标至关重要。

articles.title: Scientists found Homo erectus 200,000 years earlier than expected

paras.en: Scientists found Homo erectus 200,000 years earlier than expected
paras.zh: 科学家发现直立人比预期早20万年

paras.en: - New fossils from South Africa are reshaping the story of early human evolution. Researchers have described 18 hominin fossils from Drimolen Cave, including an adult Homo erectus skull fragment dated to about 2 million years ago, supporting evidence that the species appeared in southern Africa roughly 200,000 years earlier than long thought. The finds also reveal that Paranthropus robustus, which lived alongside Homo erectus, was gradually evolving even larger teeth and stronger chewing muscles as the climate changed.
paras.zh: - 来自南非的新化石正在重塑早期人类进化的故事。研究人员描述了 Drimolen 洞穴中的 18 块古人类化石，其中包括大约 200 万年前的成年直立人头骨碎片，支持了该物种出现在南部非洲的时间比人们长期以来认为的要早大约 20 万年。这些发现还表明，随着气候的变化，与直立人一起生活的粗壮傍人逐渐进化出更大的牙齿和更强的咀嚼肌肉。

paras.en: Archaeologists from La Trobe University have described 18 newly published hominin fossils from South Africa, including a second skull fragment belonging to Homo erectus. The discovery adds stronger evidence that the species was present in southern Africa 2.0 million years ago, about 200,000 years earlier than traditionally believed.
paras.zh: 拉筹伯大学的考古学家描述了来自南非的 18 块新公布的古人类化石，其中包括第二块属于直立人的头骨碎片。这一发现提供了更有力的证据，证明该物种在 200 万年前就出现在南部非洲，比传统认为的早约 20 万年。

paras.en: The fossil collection also includes remains of P. robustus. Those specimens suggest the species was undergoing gradual evolutionary changes as it adapted to shifting environmental and climatic conditions.
paras.zh: 化石收藏还包括粗壮松树的遗骸。这些标本表明，该物种在适应不断变化的环境和气候条件时正在经历逐渐的进化变化。

paras.en: Fossils From South Africa's Cradle of Humankind
paras.zh: 来自南非人类摇篮的化石

paras.en: The fossils come from Drimolen Main Quarry in South Africa's 'Cradle of Humankind,' one of the world's richest sites for remains of ancient human relatives. Although the quarry was discovered in 1992 and excavated through 2019, many of the fossils recovered there had never been formally described and remained largely unknown to science.
paras.zh: 这些化石来自南非“人类摇篮”的德里莫伦主要采石场，这里是世界上古人类亲属遗骸最丰富的地点之一。尽管该采石场于 1992 年被发现，并于 2019 年进行了挖掘，但在那里发现的许多化石从未被正式描述过，并且在很大程度上仍然不为科学所知。

paras.en: Researchers from La Trobe, working with colleagues in South Africa and the United States, have now analyzed and described another 18 fossils from the site. The remains have been assigned to Homo erectus and P. robustus.
paras.zh: 来自拉筹伯的研究人员与南非和美国的同事合作，现已分析并描述了该地点的另外 18 块化石。这些遗骸已被归为直立人和粗壮人。

paras.en: In research published in Annals of Human Biology, the team reports the first known adult Homo erectus fossil from Drimolen. The specimen is about 2 million years old, making it roughly 200,000 years older than adult Homo erectus fossils discovered elsewhere, including specimens from Dmanisi in Georgia that date to about 1.8 million years ago.
paras.zh: 在《人类生物学年鉴》上发表的研究中，研究小组报告了来自德里莫伦的第一个已知的成年直立人化石。该标本距今约 200 万年，比其他地方发现的成年直立人化石大约早 20 万年，其中包括来自乔治亚州德马尼西的标本，其年代可追溯到约 180 万年前。

paras.en: "Homo erectus is the first species of hominin that researchers broadly agree fits within our own genus Homo and is likely directly ancestral to us. Drimolen preserves evidence for the first appearance of this species 2 million years ago; however, the original fossil, DNH 134, belonged to a child aged between two and four, and there was uncertainty about what the adult version may have looked like," lead researcher Dr. Jesse Martin said.
paras.zh: “直立人是研究人员普遍认为属于我们人类属的第一个古人类物种，很可能是我们的直接祖先。Drimolen 保存了该物种在 200 万年前首次出现的证据；然而，原始化石 DNH 134 属于一名 2 至 4 岁的儿童，成人版本可能是什么样子还不确定，”首席研究员 Jesse Martin 博士说。

paras.en: "This paper publishes a new adult fossil attributed to Homo erectus, DNH 127, providing further confirmation that this species first appeared in southern Africa 2 million years ago."
paras.zh: “这篇论文发表了一块新的直立人成体化石，DNH 127，进一步证实了该物种在 200 万年前首次出现在南部非洲。”

paras.en: Two Human Relatives Took Different Evolutionary Paths
paras.zh: 两个人类亲戚走了不同的进化道路

paras.en: The newly described fossils also provide evidence that P. robustus changed over time. Between about 2 million and 1.8 million years ago, the species developed larger teeth and more powerful chewing muscles.
paras.zh: 新描述的化石还提供了粗壮松树随时间变化的证据。大约200万至180万年前，该物种长出了更大的牙齿和更强大的咀嚼肌。

paras.en: According to Dr. Martin, the contrast with Homo erectus is striking. While Homo erectus was developing a larger brain and smaller molar teeth, possibly as a result of eating more meat, P. robustus retained a brain only slightly larger than that of chimpanzees. At the same time, it evolved enormous molars suited to grinding and crushing tough, hard foods, functioning much like a mortar and pestle.
paras.zh: 马丁博士认为，这与直立人的对比是惊人的。虽然直立人正在发育出更大的大脑和更小的臼齿，这可能是由于吃更多肉的结果，但粗壮人的大脑仅比黑猩猩的大脑稍大一些。与此同时，它进化出了巨大的臼齿，适合研磨和压碎坚硬的食物，其功能就像研钵和杵一样。

paras.en: "These two human species shared the same landscape and are both preserved in Drimolen cave. While we know that Homo erectus and the lineage leading to us was ultimately the successful one, 2 million years ago P. robustus outnumbered Homo erectus at Drimolen by more than 10 to one. During this time period, it was our ancestors that looked like the outside long-odds chance to survive," Dr. Martin said.
paras.zh: “这两个人类物种拥有相同的景观，并且都保存在 Drimolen 洞穴中。虽然我们知道直立人以及导致我们的谱系最终是成功的，但 200 万年前，Drimolen 的粗壮人种与直立人的数量之比超过 10 比 1。在这个时期，我们的祖先看起来有机会生存，”马丁博士说。

paras.en: The Drimolen fossils also help researchers compare P. robustus populations separated by about 200,000 years.
paras.zh: Drimolen 化石还可以帮助研究人员比较相隔约 20 万年的粗壮松种群。

paras.en: "This paper confirms that the P. robustus fossils from the 2-million-year-old Drimolen Cave are slightly but importantly different from the P. Robustus fossils at the 1.8-million-year-old Swartkrans cave.
paras.zh: “这篇论文证实，来自 200 万年历史的 Drimolen 洞穴的粗壮松树化石与来自 180 万年历史的 Swartkrans 洞穴的粗壮松树化石略有不同，但很重要。

paras.en: "During this 200,000-year period, P. robustus teeth became even larger, and so did the muscles associated with chewing. Hominin fossils are so rare that generally the differences between them are huge, and researchers are left to make educated guesses regarding what existed in the missing parts of the fossil record.
paras.zh: “在这 20 万年期间，粗壮猿的牙齿变得更大，与咀嚼相关的肌肉也变得更大。古人类化石非常罕见，因此它们之间的差异通常很大，研究人员只能对化石记录中缺失部分中存在的内容做出有根据的猜测。

paras.en: "However, the large number of fossils from Drimolen, some of which are published in this paper, allow an unprecedented insight into the micro-evolutionary changes that shaped human ancestors.
paras.zh: “然而，德里莫伦的大量化石（其中一些已在本文中发表）使我们能够对塑造人类祖先的微观进化变化有前所未有的了解。

paras.en: Dr. Martin said researchers had already recognized that the Drimolen population of P. robustus was distinctive enough to receive a separate subspecies designation, P. Robustus ukusa. The newly described fossils provide additional support for that formal classification.
paras.zh: 马丁博士说，研究人员已经认识到，P.Robustus 的 Drimolen 群体非常独特，足以获得一个单独的亚种名称：P.Robustus ukusa。新描述的化石为该正式分类提供了额外的支持。

paras.en: The research involved scientists from the Palaeoscience Labs, Department of Archaeology and History, La Trobe University, Palaeo-Research Institute, University of Johannesburg, Evolutionary Studies Institute, University of the Witwatersrand, and Department of Anthropology, Washington University.
paras.zh: 这项研究涉及来自拉筹伯大学考古与历史系古科学实验室、约翰内斯堡大学古研究所、威特沃特斯兰德大学进化研究所和华盛顿大学人类学系的科学家。

paras.en: Materials provided by La Trobe University. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由拉筹伯大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Jesse M. Martin, A. B. Leece, Stephanie Baker, Andy I. R. Herries, David S. Strait. New hominin cranial and mandibular remains from Drimolen Main Quarry, South Africa. Annals of Human Biology, 2026; 53 (1) DOI: 10.1080/03014460.2026.2725046
paras.zh: - 杰西·M·马丁、A·B·李斯、斯蒂芬妮·贝克、安迪·I·R·赫里斯、大卫·S·海峡。来自南非德里莫伦主要采石场的新人类颅骨和下颌骨遗骸。人类生物学年鉴，2026； 53（1）DOI：10.1080/03014460.2026.2725046

articles.title: Terran Orbital Names Jamin Brown Chief Operating Officer
articles.author: Terran Orbital

paras.en: IRVINE, Calif. – Sept. 29, 2026 – Terran Orbital, a Lockheed Martin company and a global leader in satellite-based solutions primarily serving the aerospace and defense industries, today announced the appointment of Jamin Brown as Chief Operating Officer (COO).
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州欧文 – 2026 年 9 月 29 日 – 洛克希德·马丁公司旗下公司、主要服务于航空航天和国防工业的卫星解决方案全球领导者 Terran Orbital 今天宣布任命 Jamin Brown 为首席运营官 (COO)。

paras.en: In this role, Brown will lead Terran Orbital’s operational execution, focusing on increasing production capacity, strengthening operational performance, and enabling the company to deliver at greater speed, scale, and cost efficiency. Based at Terran Orbital’s headquarters in Irvine, California, Brown will work closely with Peter Krauss, President and Chief Executive Officer, as the company prepares to meet growing customer demand.
paras.zh: 在此职位上，布朗将领导 Terran Orbital 的运营执行，重点关注提高产能、加强运营绩效，并使公司能够以更快的速度、更大的规模和更高的成本效率交付产品。布朗将驻扎在加利福尼亚州欧文市的 Terran Orbital 总部，与总裁兼首席执行官彼得·克劳斯 (Peter Krauss) 密切合作，帮助公司做好满足不断增长的客户需求的准备。

paras.en: “Terran Orbital is entering an important phase in our evolution, and our ability to scale while maintaining the agility, innovation, and mission focus that define us will be critical to our success,” said Krauss. “Jamin brings extensive experience leading complex technical organizations and executing some of the most demanding aerospace and defense programs. His operational leadership will help us strengthen execution, increase production, and ensure we are positioned to deliver for our customers as their needs continue to grow.”
paras.zh: 克劳斯说：“Terran Orbital 正在进入我们发展的一个重要阶段，我们在保持敏捷性、创新和任务重点的同时进行扩展的能力对于我们的成功至关重要。” “贾明带来了领导复杂技术组织和执行一些最苛刻的航空航天和国防项目的丰富经验。他的运营领导力将帮助我们加强执行力，增加产量，并确保我们能够随着客户需求的不断增长而为他们提供服务。”

paras.en: Brown joins Terran Orbital from Lockheed Martin Space, where he most recently served as Vice President of Missile Defense Programs and Huntsville Site General Manager. In that role, he led a diverse portfolio delivering integrated missile defense solutions for U.S. government and international military customers, including efforts involving Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD), Targets and Countermeasures Programs, directed energy, hypersonic defense, and space surveillance.
paras.zh: 布朗在加入人族轨道公司之前曾在洛克希德·马丁航天公司担任导弹防御项目副总裁和亨茨维尔基地总经理。在此职位上，他领导了多元化的产品组合，为美国政府和国际军事客户提供综合导弹防御解决方案，包括末段高空区域防御 (THAAD)、目标和对抗计划、定向能、高超音速防御和太空监视等方面的工作。

paras.en: Brown has more than two decades of experience at Lockheed Martin, beginning his career as an Electronics Engineer before progressing through positions of increasing responsibility across engineering, program management, and operations. His background includes P&L leadership roles, leadership in systems engineering, avionics development, and major program execution.
paras.zh: 布朗在洛克希德·马丁公司拥有二十多年的经验，他的职业生涯始于电子工程师，随后在工程、项目管理和运营等领域担任越来越重要的职务。他的背景包括损益领导角色、系统工程领导、航空电子设备开发和主要项目执行。

paras.en: He previously served as Deputy Vice President of the Hypersonic Strike Weapon Systems mission segment, where he helped lead rapid prototyping and fielding efforts for the Conventional Prompt Strike and Long-Range Hypersonic Weapon programs. Brown also served as Fleet Ballistic Missile Reshaping Site Director in Colorado, leading the transition of personnel and program operations from Sunnyvale, California, to Denver.
paras.zh: 他此前曾担任高超音速打击武器系统任务部分的副总裁，帮助领导常规快速打击和远程高超音速武器项目的快速原型设计和部署工作。布朗还担任科罗拉多州舰队弹道导弹改造基地主任，领导人员和项目运营从加利福尼亚州桑尼维尔到丹佛的过渡。

paras.en: “I’m excited to join Terran Orbital at such an important time for the company and our customers,” said Brown. “Terran Orbital has built a reputation for innovation, agility, and mission-focused execution. I look forward to working alongside Peter and the entire Terran Orbital team to build on that foundation, strengthen our operations and scale our capabilities to meet the growing needs of our customers.”
paras.zh: “我很高兴能在对公司和我们的客户来说如此重要的时刻加入 Terran Orbital，”布朗说。 “Terran Orbital 因创新、敏捷性和以任务为中心的执行力而享有盛誉。我期待着与 Peter 和整个 Terran Orbital 团队合作，在此基础上再接再厉，加强我们的运营并扩展我们的能力，以满足客户不断增长的需求。”

paras.en: Brown holds a Bachelor of Science in Electronics Engineering, a Master of Science in Industrial & Systems Engineering, and an MBA from San Jose State University. He is also a graduate of Stanford University’s Certified Program Manager program.
paras.zh: Brown 拥有圣何塞州立大学电子工程理学学士学位、工业与系统工程理学硕士学位以及 MBA 学位。他还是斯坦福大学认证项目经理项目的毕业生。

paras.en: Terran Orbital is a leading manufacturer of satellite solutions, providing end-to-end mission services for commercial, civil, and government customers. Terran Orbital specializes in designing, manufacturing, and operating advanced small satellites that support Earth observation, national security, and deep-space exploration missions. Terran Orbital is a wholly owned subsidiary of Lockheed Martin.
paras.zh: Terran Orbital 是领先的卫星解决方案制造商，为商业、民用和政府客户提供端到端任务服务。 Terran Orbital 专门从事设计、制造和运营支持地球观测、国家安全和深空探索任务的先进小型卫星。 Terran Orbital 是洛克希德·马丁公司的全资子公司。

articles.title: Commercial Defense Satcom Service Revenues to Surpass $22.6B by 2035
articles.author: Novaspace

paras.en: Paris, France | September 2026 — Novaspace’s Satellite Communications for Defense and Security, 2nd Edition highlights a defense Satcom market poised for rapid growth. By 2035, commercial satellite service revenues are projected to exceed $22.6 billion, while global defense Satcom demand is forecast to surpass 7.5 Tbps, driven by the adoption of next-generation non-geostationary orbit (NGSO) constellations.
paras.zh: 法国巴黎 | 2026 年 9 月——Novaspace 的国防和安全卫星通信第二版强调了国防卫星通信市场即将快速增长。到 2035 年，商业卫星服务收入预计将超过 226 亿美元，而在下一代非对地静止轨道 (NGSO) 星座采用的推动下，全球国防卫星通信需求预计将超过 7.5 Tbps。

paras.en: As defense organizations prioritize mobility, situational awareness, and network resilience, satellite communications are becoming a core element of modern military architectures, driving investment in secure, resilient connectivity for mission-critical operations.
paras.zh: 随着国防组织优先考虑移动性、态势感知和网络弹性，卫星通信正在成为现代军事架构的核心要素，推动对关键任务行动的安全、弹性连接的投资。

paras.en: “The growing adoption of distributed satcom architectures is rapidly enhancing military satcom resilience against disruption, jamming, and kinetic attacks,” notes Santiago Perez, Senior Manager at Novaspace. “As defense users increasingly adopt multi-orbit connectivity strategies, NGSO constellations will play a pivotal role in delivering the capacity, low latency, and resilience required for future military operations.”
paras.zh: Novaspace 高级经理圣地亚哥·佩雷斯 (Santiago Perez) 表示：“分布式卫星通信架构的日益普及正在迅速增强军用卫星通信抵御干扰、干扰和动能攻击的能力。” “随着国防用户越来越多地采用多轨道连接策略，NGSO 星座将在提供未来军事行动所需的容量、低延迟和弹性方面发挥关键作用。”

paras.en: NGSO service revenues are expected to reach $21.3 billion by 2035, supported by a 34% CAGR. Although GEO revenues will decline from $2.3 billion in 2025 to $1.3 billion in 2035, GEO capacity demand is forecast to triple, underscoring its strategic importance within hybrid, multi-orbit networks.
paras.zh: NGSO 服务收入预计到 2035 年将达到 213 亿美元，复合年增长率为 34%。尽管 GEO 收入将从 2025 年的 23 亿美元下降到 2035 年的 13 亿美元，但 GEO 容量需求预计将增加两倍，凸显其在混合多轨道网络中的战略重要性。

paras.en: The United States is expected to remain the largest defense Satcom market through 2035, accounting for more than 50% of global demand and 48% of revenues. China is projected to follow with around 30% of global demand and revenues, reinforcing the central role of satellite communications in the military modernization efforts of the world’s leading powers.
paras.zh: 预计到 2035 年，美国仍将是最大的国防卫星通信市场，占全球需求的 50% 以上和收入的 48% 以上。预计中国将占据全球约 30% 的需求和收入，从而加强卫星通信在世界主要大国军事现代化努力中的核心作用。

paras.en: “What we’re witnessing is not simply a shift in satellite capacity demand. This is a fundamental evolution in military communications,” adds Perez. “Multi-orbit connectivity is becoming the foundation of modern defense networks and will shape procurement, operations, and strategic planning for years to come.”
paras.zh: “我们看到的不仅仅是卫星容量需求的变化。这是军事通信的根本性演变，”佩雷斯补充道。 “多轨道连接正在成为现代国防网络的基础，并将影响未来几年的采购、运营和战略规划。”

paras.en: Novaspace’s Satellite Communications for Defense and Security, 2nd Edition delivers a comprehensive analysis of the military Satcom market, examining key industry trends and the evolving balance between supply and demand for broadband satellite communications. The report provides detailed qualitative and quantitative insights by region, military force, orbit, and frequency band, alongside profiles of the leading commercial satellite systems supporting defense and security operations.
paras.zh: Novaspace 的国防和安全卫星通信第二版对军用卫星通信市场进行了全面分析，研究了关键行业趋势以及宽带卫星通信供需之间不断变化的平衡。该报告提供了按地区、军事力量、轨道和频段详细的定性和定量见解，以及支持国防和安全行动的领先商业卫星系统的概况。

paras.en: Novaspace is the leading independent consulting and market intelligence firm dedicated to the global space sector. Leveraging over 40 years of industry expertise, the company supports public and private stakeholders across the entire space value chain with high-impact, data-driven advisory services, combining management and technology consulting, market intelligence, and executive summits to help organizations navigate complexity, manage risk, and capture growth opportunities.
paras.zh: Novaspace 是致力于全球航天领域的领先独立咨询和市场情报公司。该公司利用 40 多年的行业专业知识，通过高影响力、数据驱动的咨询服务，结合管理和技术咨询、市场情报和高管峰会，为整个空间价值链的公共和私人利益相关者提供支持，帮助组织应对复杂性、管理风险并抓住增长机会。

paras.en: Trusted by more than 1,200 clients in over 60 countries, Novaspace operates globally with offices in Bangalore, Brussels, London, Montreal, Munich, Paris, São Paulo, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo, Toulouse, and Washington, D.C.
paras.zh: Novaspace 深受 60 多个国家 1,200 多名客户的信赖，在全球范围内开展业务，在班加罗尔、布鲁塞尔、伦敦、蒙特利尔、慕尼黑、巴黎、圣保罗、新加坡、悉尼、东京、图卢兹和华盛顿特区设有办事处。

articles.title: Quantum Space Executes Launch Processing Agreement with All Points Logistics for Prime Mission
articles.author: Quantum Space

paras.en: ROCKVILLE, Md. and MERRITT ISLAND, Fla. — September 30, 2026 — Quantum Space, LLC (the “Company” or “Quantum Space”), a company developing the next generation of advanced maneuverable spacecraft for national security and commercial missions, today announced that it has executed a new spacecraft processing work order with All Points Logistics, LLC (“All Points”) for the launch campaign for Quantum Space’s Prime mission.
paras.zh: 马里兰州罗克维尔和佛罗里达州梅里特岛 - 2026 年 9 月 30 日 - Quantum Space, LLC（“公司”或“Quantum Space”）是一家为国家安全和商业任务开发下一代先进机动航天器的公司，今天宣布它已与 All Points Logistics, LLC（“All Points”）执行了一项新的航天器处理工作订单，用于 Quantum Space 的 Prime 任务的发射活动。

paras.en: Prime is a pathfinder mission for the Company’s Ranger and Scout platform and will help the Company evaluate spacecraft performance, payload hosting, and data collection. Quantum Space has completed a Systems Integration Review for the mission and is targeting the second half of 2027 for launch. Under the agreement, All Points will provide specialized spacecraft processing services in preparation for the launch, including clean-room facilities, propellant servicing support, launch-site safety and operational reviews, ground support activities, and transportation to the launch vehicle integration facility. The work is scheduled to support Prime launch preparations in 2027.
paras.zh: Prime 是该公司 Ranger 和 Scout 平台的探路者任务，将帮助该公司评估航天器性能、有效载荷托管和数据收集。 Quantum Space 已完成该任务的系统集成审查，并计划于 2027 年下半年发射。根据协议，All Points 将提供专门的航天器处理服务，为发射做准备，包括洁净室设施、推进剂服务支持、发射场安全和操作审查、地面支持活动以及运载火箭集成设施的运输。这项工作计划支持 2027 年 Prime 的推出准备工作。

paras.en: “This agreement comes as Prime moves into the detailed planning and execution stage required to successfully conduct a launch campaign,” said Kerry Wisnosky, President of Quantum Space. “Many activities must come together between completing a spacecraft and getting it safely integrated onto a launch vehicle, and All Points brings the specialized infrastructure, people and launch-site experience required to help us execute that process.”
paras.zh: Quantum Space 总裁 Kerry Wisnosky 表示：“这项协议的签署正值 Prime 进入成功开展发射活动所需的详细规划和执行阶段。” “在完成航天器和将其安全地集成到运载火箭上之间必须进行许多活动，而 All Points 提供了帮助我们执行该过程所需的专业基础设施、人员和发射场经验。”

paras.en: The new work order builds upon an existing Master Services Agreement between the two companies. It establishes a specific scope of work for the Prime mission, focused on ground processing and launch-site activities required for Prime at Vandenberg Space Force Base in California, representing another concrete step toward launch.
paras.zh: 新的工作订单建立在两家公司之间现有的主服务协议的基础上。它为 Prime 任务确定了具体的工作范围，重点关注 Prime 任务在加利福尼亚州范登堡太空部队基地所需的地面处理和发射场活动，这代表着发射又迈出了具体的一步。

paras.en: “Supporting Prime is exactly the type of mission where All Points’ launch infrastructure and spacecraft processing capabilities can make a difference,” said Phil Monkress, President and CEO of All Points Logistics. “We are pleased to expand our relationship with Quantum Space and support their team as Ranger Prime advances toward launch.”
paras.zh: All Points Logistics 总裁兼首席执行官 Phil Monkress 表示：“支持 Prime 正是 All Points 的发射基础设施和航天器处理能力可以发挥作用的任务类型。” “我们很高兴扩大与 Quantum Space 的关系，并在 Ranger Prime 即将发射之际为他们的团队提供支持。”

paras.en: Prime will be the first of Quantum Space’s high-performance class spacecraft, being developed to provide customers with significant maneuverability, long-duration operations and the ability to host and support a broad range of national security and commercial missions.
paras.zh: Prime 将成为 Quantum Space 高性能级航天器中的第一艘，其开发目的是为客户提供显着的机动性、长期运行以及托管和支持广泛的国家安全和商业任务的能力。

paras.en: “Securing our launch-site processing capability is another important element of mitigating execution risk as we move Prime toward flight,” Wisnosky added. “Our focus now is on completing the spacecraft, executing the environmental test campaign and moving through launch integration and ultimately to on-orbit operations.”
paras.zh: Wisnosky 补充道：“在我们将 Prime 推向飞行的过程中，确保我们的发射场处理能力是降低执行风险的另一个重要因素。” “我们现在的重点是完成航天器、执行环境测试活动并进行发射集成并最终进入在轨运行。”

paras.en: Quantum Space is building the next generation of advanced maneuverable spacecraft for national security, civil, and commercial space operations. Its highly maneuverable spacecraft are being designed to address the needs of national security and commercial operators. With patented propulsion, extended on-orbit endurance, and modular flexibility, these platforms are being engineered to outmaneuver legacy satellites and operate dynamically across diverse mission sets. For more information, visit www.quantumspaceinc.com.
paras.zh: 量子空间公司正在为国家安全、民用和商业太空运营建造下一代先进的可操纵航天器。其高度机动的航天器旨在满足国家安全和商业运营商的需求。凭借获得专利的推进力、延长的在轨续航力和模块化灵活性，这些平台的设计目的是超越传统卫星，并在不同的任务集中动态运行。欲了解更多信息，请访问 www.quantumspaceinc.com。

paras.en: Established in 1997 as a service-disabled veteran-owned small business (SDVOSB), All Points Logistics has operations in multiple states and has grown into a leading solution provider to a diverse array of government and commercial customers, with award-winning expertise in software development, IT services, modeling and simulation, launch support services, and integrated logistics. Learn more at allpointsllc.com.
paras.zh: All Points Logistics 成立于 1997 年，是一家退伍军人拥有的小型企业 (SDVOSB)，在多个州开展业务，现已发展成为面向各类政府和商业客户的领先解决方案提供商，在软件开发、IT 服务、建模和模拟、启动支持服务和综合物流方面拥有屡​​获殊荣的专业知识。如需了解更多信息，请访问 allpointsllc.com。

VI（“Inflection Point”）、Quantum Space 及其其他方之间拟议的业务合并（“业务合并”）、业务合并后合并后公司（“新 Quantum Space”）的估计或预期未来结果和收益，包括以下内容的可能性和能力： 量子空间和拐点成功完成业务合并、新量子空间的未来机会以及其他非历史事实的陈述。这些陈述基于拐点和/或量子空间管理层的当前预期，并非对实际业绩的预测。这些前瞻性陈述仅供说明之用，无意作为且不得被任何投资者视为保证、保证、预测或事实或概率的明确陈述。实际事件和情况很难或不可能预测，并且会与假设有所不同。许多实际事件和情况超出了拐点和量子空间的控制范围。这些陈述受到有关 Quantum Space 业务和业务合并的许多风险和不确定性的影响，实际结果可能存在重大差异。这些风险和不确定性包括但不限于：发生可能导致终止与业务相关的任何最终协议的任何事件、变化或其他情况 组合;在宣布企业合并及任何相关最终协议后，可能针对 Inflection Point、Quantum Space、合并后的公司或其他方提起的任何法律诉讼的结果；由于未能获得股东批准、未能获得完成业务合并的融资或其他交割条件而无法完成业务合并；根据适用的法律或法规，或作为获得企业合并监管部门批准的条件，可能需要或适当地对企业合并的拟议结构进行变更；新量子空间在业务合并完成后满足证券交易所上市标准的能力；由于业务合并的宣布和完成而导致业务合并扰乱量子空间当前计划和运营的风险； Quantum Space 无法成功完成其旗舰车辆 Ranger 的开发，该车辆目前正在开发中，迄今为止尚未制造、运营或销售，也无法满足 Quantum Space 的要求 设计标准，包括其预期燃料容量、具有可加油和模块化架构以及长达 15 年的使用寿命；新量子空间认识到业务合并的预期收益的能力，该收益可能会受到竞争等因素的影响，新量子空间发展和管理增长的能力，维持与客户和供应商的关系以及保留其管理层和关键员工的能力；与企业合并相关的成本；适用法律或法规的变更； Quantum Space 或合并后的公司可能受到其他经济、业务和/或竞争因素不利影响的可能性； Inflection Point 股东提出的赎回请求金额；量子空间卫星系统安全性能不理想或量子空间设施发生安全事件；卫星市场未能实现量子空间预期的增长潜力；任何延迟发射、发射失败、量子空间卫星未能到达计划轨道位置以及与卫星发射相关的成本大幅增加；处理， 在量子空间运营中生产和处置潜在爆炸性和可燃性高能材料以及其他危险化学品； Quantum Space 的产品无法按预期方式运行或其产品存在缺陷；与 Quantum Space 客户签订的合同的交易对手风险以及 Quantum Space 的主承包商未能维持与交易对手的关系并履行其合同义务；未能成功抵御其他政府合同投标人的抗议；与 Quantum Space 开展业务的各个政府实体的资金水平发生变化；以及已向美国证券交易委员会（“SEC”）提交或即将提交的拐点和/或量子空间文件中讨论的其他风险和不确定性。上述风险因素列表并不详尽。可能存在拐点和量子空间目前不知道的或拐点和量子空间目前认为无关紧要的其他风险，这些风险也可能导致实际结果与前瞻性陈述中包含的结果不同。此外， 前瞻性陈述提供了拐点和量子空间对未来事件的预期、计划或预测以及截至本新闻稿发布之日的观点。拐点和量子空间预计后续事件和发展将导致他们的评估发生变化。然而，虽然拐点和量子空间可能选择在未来更新这些前瞻性陈述，但拐点和量子空间明确表示不承担任何这样做的义务。这些前瞻性陈述不应被视为代表 Inflection Point 或 Quantum Space 在本新闻稿发布后任何日期的评估。因此，不应过度依赖前瞻性陈述。本文中的任何内容均不应被视为任何人表示本文中提出的前瞻性陈述将会实现或此类前瞻性陈述的结果将会实现。

paras.en: The Business Combination will be submitted to shareholders of Inflection Point for their consideration. In connection with the Business Combination, IPFX Pubco, Inc., Inflection Point and Quantum Space intend to file a Registration Statement with the SEC, which will include a proxy statement/prospectus and certain other related documents, which will serve as both the proxy statement to be distributed to shareholders of Inflection Point in connection with its solicitation for proxies for the vote by its shareholders in connection with the Business Combination and other matters to be described in the Registration Statement, as well as the prospectus relating to the offer and sale of the securities to be issued to securityholders of Inflection Point and equityholders of Quantum Space in connection with the completion of the Business Combination. After the Registration Statement is declared effective, Inflection Point will mail a definitive proxy statement and other relevant documents to its shareholders as of the record date established for voting on the Business Combination. This communication is not a substitute for the Registration Statement, the definitive proxy statement/prospectus or any other document that Inflection Point will send to its shareholders in connection with the Business Combination.
paras.zh: 业务合并将提交给 Inflection Point 股东审议。就业务合并而言，IPFX Pubco, Inc.、Inflection Point 和 Quantum Space 打算向 SEC 提交一份登记声明，其中将包括一份委托书/招股说明书和某些其他相关文件，这些文件将作为分发给 Inflection Point 股东的委托书，以征求其股东就业务合并和注册声明中描述的其他事项进行投票的委托书，以及与该业务合并相关的招股说明书。为完成业务合并而向 Inflection Point 的证券持有人和 Quantum Space 的股东发行和出售证券。注册声明宣布生效后，Inflection Point 将自企业合并投票登记日起向股东邮寄最终委托书和其他相关文件。本通讯不能替代注册声明、最终委托书/招股说明书或 Inflection Point 将向其股东发送的与业务合并相关的任何其他文件。

Additional information regarding the interests of participants in the proxy solicitation and their direct and indirect interests will be contained in the Registration Statement and the proxy statement/prospectus when they become available.
