articles.title: Man hit with angle grinder during attempted e-bike robbery
articles.author: Rachael Merritt

paras.en: Man left with head injuries after being hit with angle grinder during attempted e-bike theft
paras.zh: 一名男子在试图盗窃电动自行车时被​​角磨机击中头部受伤

paras.en: A man has been left with head injuries after he was hit with an angle grinder during an attempted robbery.
paras.zh: 一名男子在企图抢劫时被角磨机击中，头部受伤。

paras.en: Stephen Hoy, 60, was staying at a caravan park in Adelaide when the incident happened in the early hours of Friday morning.
paras.zh: 事件发生在周五凌晨，60 岁的史蒂芬·霍伊 (Stephen Hoy) 正在阿德莱德的一个房车公园住宿。

paras.en: Police are still looking for the offender.
paras.zh: 警方仍在寻找肇事者。

articles.title: Court hears teen under drug influence during attack on woman
articles.author: Eva Blandis

paras.en: A youth was under the influence of a "cocktail of drugs" when he assaulted a woman outside an Adelaide library, a court has heard.
paras.zh: 法庭获悉，一名年轻人在阿德莱德图书馆外袭击了一名妇女，当时他受到了“鸡尾酒毒品”的影响。

paras.en: He previously pleaded guilty to causing harm with intent and serious criminal trespass.
paras.zh: 他此前承认故意伤害罪和严重非法侵入罪。

paras.en: His sentence will be handed down next month.
paras.zh: 他的判决将于下个月宣判。

paras.en: A woman sleeping rough in Adelaide's inner south fell victim to a "sustained, malicious and intentional" attack at the hands of a teenager who was under the influence of a "cocktail of drugs", a court has heard.
paras.zh: 法庭获悉，一名在阿德莱德内南部露宿的妇女遭到一名受“鸡尾酒毒品”影响的青少年的“持续、恶意和故意”攻击。

paras.en: The now-18-year-old, who cannot be named for legal reasons, previously pleaded guilty to causing harm with intent over the attack on the woman in the vicinity of the Mitcham Memorial Library, on Belair Road at Hawthorn, on November 13, 2025.
paras.zh: 这名现年 18 岁的男子因法律原因无法透露姓名，他此前承认于 2025 年 11 月 13 日在 Hawthorn 的 Belair 路 Mitcham 纪念图书馆附近袭击了这名妇女，故意造成伤害。

paras.en: The 64-year-old suffered serious injuries and was rushed to hospital.
paras.zh: 64岁的老人受重伤，被送往医院。

paras.en: The youth, who was 17 at the time of the offending, also previously pleaded guilty to serious criminal trespass in relation to a series of break-ins after the attack.
paras.zh: 这名青少年犯罪时年仅 17 岁，此前他也承认在袭击后发生的一系列入室盗窃行为中犯有严重非法侵入罪。

paras.en: During a pre-sentence hearing today, defence barrister Patrick Dawes said a toxicology report identified a "cocktail of substances" in the teenager's system following his arrest.
paras.zh: 在今天的判前听证会上，辩护律师帕特里克·道斯表示，毒理学报告在这名少年被捕后发现他体内存在“多种物质”。

paras.en: "It's [his] memory and [his] position that he didn't voluntarily consume methylamphetamine, MDMA and benzodiazepines and other semi-synthetic opioids on the night of the 12th into the 13th," he told the court.
paras.zh: “根据（他的）记忆和（他的）立场，他在 12 日晚上到 13 日期间没有自愿服用甲基苯丙胺、摇头丸、苯二氮卓类药物和其他半合成阿片类药物，”他告诉法庭。

paras.en: Mr Dawes told the court the then-17-year-old was in a state of "dysregulation" at the time of the offending after he was "seemingly assaulted" by peers in the hours before.
paras.zh: 道斯先生告诉法庭，这名当时 17 岁的男子在犯罪发生时正处于“失调”状态，因为他在几小时前遭到了同龄人“看似袭击”。

paras.en: He added that, since the offending, his client has been diagnosed with autism and severe ADHD and that a cognitive assessment found his "overall intellectual function" is in the "low-average range".
paras.zh: 他补充说，自犯罪以来，他的当事人被诊断患有自闭症和严重的多动症，认知评估发现他的“整体智力功能”处于“低平均范围”。

paras.en: Mr Dawes said that a psychological report prepared before the hearing deduced that there was a "nexus" between the teenager's mental health conditions and the substances he was influenced by.
paras.zh: 道斯表示，听证会前准备的一份心理报告推断，这名青少年的心理健康状况与他受到的物质影响之间存在“联系”。

paras.en: The court also heard that the teenager has been diagnosed with alcohol use disorder but that he is "now in remission".
paras.zh: 法庭还获悉，这名少年已被诊断出患有酒精使用障碍，但他“现在正在缓解”。

paras.en: "He was admitted to the Women's and Children's Hospital within two or three days of his arrest due to severe alcohol withdrawal symptoms and spent six nights in hospital," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“他被捕后两三天内就因严重的酒精戒断症状被送进妇女儿童医院，并在医院住了六个晚上。”

paras.en: Mr Dawes said his client was in a state of "overwhelm" at the time of the offending and had "loss of control… which he takes responsibility" for.
paras.zh: 道斯先生表示，他的当事人在犯罪时处于“不知所措”的状态，并且“失去了控制......他对此承担责任”。

paras.en: He said a letter of apology by the teenager to his victim demonstrates his client's remorse.
paras.zh: 他说，这名少年给受害者写的一封道歉信表明了他当事人的悔恨。

paras.en: "He's really sorry for hurting her and wishes he could take back what he did," he said.
paras.zh: “他真的很抱歉伤害了她，并希望他能收回自己所做的事情，”他说。

paras.en: Mr Dawes read an excerpt from the apology letter in which he said "it really hurt" to see the video recording of the offending.
paras.zh: 道斯先生宣读了道歉信的摘录，他在信中表示，看到犯罪视频“真的很痛苦”。

paras.en: "I can't remember why this all took place but when I rewatch the footage it really hurt me seeing myself act and treat a person in such a terrible way and you can understand how sorry I am," it read.
paras.zh: “我不记得为什么发生这一切，但当我重看这段视频时，看到自己的行为和以如此可怕的方式对待一个人，我真的很受伤，你可以理解我有多么抱歉，”它写道。

paras.en: The court also heard that the psychological report concluded that the 18-year-old is at "moderate risk of reoffending of offences of violence".
paras.zh: 法庭还获悉，心理报告得出的结论是，这名 18 岁的男子“有重犯暴力犯罪的中等风险”。

paras.en: A prosecutor asked the court to sentence the youth, who has been in detention since November last year, to a "further period of detention".
paras.zh: 一名检察官要求法院判处这名自去年11月以来一直被拘留的年轻人“进一步拘留”。

paras.en: Mr Dawes conceded that a further period of detention would be appropriate.
paras.zh: 道斯先生承认延长拘留期限是适当的。

paras.en: Magistrate John Wells said he would sentence on the basis the attack was "intentional" and co-existed with the teenager's "meltdown".
paras.zh: 地方法官约翰·威尔斯表示，他的判决依据是这次袭击是“故意的”，并且与这名少年的“精神崩溃”并存。

paras.en: "I will sentence on the basis … that it was a sustained, malicious and intentional act,"
paras.zh: “我将根据……这是一种持续的、恶意的、故意的行为来判刑。”

paras.en: Magistrate Wells added that the victim can be seen putting up her umbrella to protect herself.
paras.zh: 威尔斯法官补充说，可以看到受害者撑起雨伞来保护自己。

paras.en: "She cowers behind the umbrella," he said.
paras.zh: “她躲在伞后面，”他说。

paras.en: The 18-year-old will be sentenced next month.
paras.zh: 这位 18 岁的男子将于下个月被判刑。

articles.title: Australia and New Zealand police target motorbike gang deemed 'high threat'

paras.en: An outlaw motorbike gang police say puts "profits ahead of public safety" has been targeted by Australian and New Zealand authorities in a bid to undermine its criminal control.
paras.zh: 警方称，一个非法摩托车团伙将“利润置于公共安全之上”，已成为澳大利亚和新西兰当局的目标，旨在破坏其对犯罪的控制。

paras.en: The Lone Wolf Outlaw Motorcycle Gang has been assessed as posing a "very high threat" in organised crime in Australia.
paras.zh: 独狼亡命之徒摩托车团伙被评估为对澳大利亚有组织犯罪构成“非常高的威胁”。

paras.en: Police say this is driven by its alleged involvement in illicit drug importation and trafficking, money laundering and violence.
paras.zh: 警方表示，这是由于该公司涉嫌参与非法毒品进口和贩运、洗钱和暴力活动。

paras.en: A national day of action by a specialised task force on Thursday ended in 20 arrests and 69 charges laid.
paras.zh: 周四，一个专门工作组在全国行动日中逮捕了 20 人，并提出了 69 项指控。

paras.en: Across Australia and New Zealand, Taskforce Morpheus conducted 18 search warrants, 10 firearms compliance checks and seized cocaine, MDMA, illicit tobacco and vapes.
paras.zh: Morpheus 特遣部队在澳大利亚和新西兰进行了 18 项搜查令、10 次枪支合规检查，并查获了可卡因、摇头丸、非法烟草和电子烟。

paras.en: The task force brings together all Australian state and territory police and Commonwealth law enforcement agencies.
paras.zh: 该工作组汇集了澳大利亚所有州和领地警察以及联邦执法机构。

paras.en: Queensland Detective Superintendent Troy Pukallus said Lone Wolf used violence, intimidation and organised offending for financial gain.
paras.zh: 昆士兰州侦探警司特洛伊·普卡勒斯表示，“独狼”利用暴力、恐吓和有组织的犯罪手段来获取经济利益。

paras.en: "They have no regard for the impact their actions have on the safety and wellbeing of the community," he said.
paras.zh: “他们不考虑自己的行为对社区安全和福祉的影响，”他说。

paras.en: Detective Superintendent Pukallus said police were sending a clear message that no matter how well-connected criminal gangs believe they are, authorities are committed to identifying, disrupting and dismantling organised crime networks.
paras.zh: 侦探警司普卡勒斯表示，警方发出了一个明确的信息，即无论犯罪团伙认为自己的人脉关系有多密切，当局都致力于识别、破坏和瓦解有组织的犯罪网络。

paras.en: Australian Border Force Commander Graeme Campbell said the illicit tobacco trade was a significant source of revenue for organised crime groups.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚边防部队指挥官格雷姆·坎贝尔表示，非法烟草贸易是有组织犯罪集团的重要收入来源。

paras.en: "With proven links between OMCG's (Outlaw Motorcycle Gang's) and illicit tobacco retail premises across Australia, profits are used to fund other serious criminal activity," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“经证实，OMCG（非法摩托车团伙）与澳大利亚各地的非法烟草零售场所之间存在联系，利润被用来资助其他严重的犯罪活动。”

paras.en: Commander Campbell said authorities would continue to target groups that "exploit legitimate businesses", including tobacco shops, to "conceal and facilitate organised criminal activity".
paras.zh: 坎贝尔指挥官表示，当局将继续针对“利用合法业务”的团体，包括烟草店，以“隐瞒和促进有组织的犯罪活动”。

paras.en: NSW Police Force Raptor Squad Commander, Detective Acting Superintendent Brad Abdy said outlaw motorcycle gangs should expect to be targeted "wherever they operate".
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州警察猛禽队指挥官、代理侦探警司布拉德·阿卜迪表示，非法摩托车团伙“无论在哪里活动”，都应该成为目标。

paras.en: "By combining intelligence and resources across jurisdictions, we're making it increasingly difficult for organised crime groups to profit from their criminal activity," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“通过整合各个司法管辖区的情报和资源，我们使有组织犯罪集团越来越难以从其犯罪活动中获利。”

articles.title: Spanish pensioner Maricarmen, symbol of country's housing crisis, dead at 87

paras.en: Spanish pensioner Maricarmen, symbol of country's housing crisis, dead at 87
paras.zh: 西班牙养老金领取者马里卡门去世，享年87岁，该国住房危机的象征

paras.en: Makeshift memorials crop up at several sites, while politicians exchange recriminations
paras.zh: 临时纪念碑出现在多个地点，政客们互相指责

paras.en: María del Carmen Abascal, a Spanish pensioner known widely as Maricarmen, died suddenly on Wednesday, two weeks after she was evicted from her apartment.
paras.zh: 西班牙养老金领取者玛丽亚·德尔·卡门·阿巴斯卡（María del Carmen Abascal）周三突然去世，距她被赶出公寓两周后。

paras.en: Her death is set to reinvigorate the protest movement and further polarize Spain ahead of a national election next month, in which housing will be a central issue.
paras.zh: 她的去世将重振抗议运动，并在下个月的全国大选之前进一步加剧西班牙的两极分化，住房将成为大选的核心问题。

paras.en: Sympathizers with Maricarmen's cause left candles, flowers and letters overnight at an impromptu shrine in Madrid's central Puerta del Sol, where around 1,000 people have camped for two weeks to protest Spain's housing affordability crisis since Maricarmen's eviction on Sept. 23 captured the nation's attention.
paras.zh: 马里卡门事业的同情者连夜在马德里市中心太阳门广场的一个临时神殿里留下了蜡烛、鲜花和信件。自马里卡门 9 月 23 日被驱逐引起全国关注以来，大约 1000 人已经在那里露营了两周，抗议西班牙的住房负担能力危机。

paras.en: On the door of her old home, a sixth-floor apartment near Madrid's Retiro park, a piece of paper was taped with the handwritten message "Rest in Peace Maricarmen," accompanied by the drawing of a black heart. Many left more messages on the street outside.
paras.zh: 她的老家是马德里丽池公园附近的一套六楼公寓，她的老家的门上贴着一张纸，上面写着手写的“马里卡门安息吧”，并画了一颗黑色的心。许多人在外面的街道上留下了更多信息。

paras.en: "Your death won't be in vain. We will continue the struggle," read one of the messages.
paras.zh: 其中一条信息写道：“你不会白白牺牲。我们将继续战斗。”

paras.en: In Barcelona, a popular graffiti artist painted Maricarmen, 87, in angelic form, complete with halo, wings and a white toga. She is holding a key up, apparently the key to the home she didn't return to.
paras.zh: 在巴塞罗那，一位受欢迎的涂鸦艺术家将 87 岁的马里卡门画成天使般的形象，配有光环、翅膀和白色长袍。她举着一把钥匙，显然是她没有返回的家的钥匙。

paras.en: Many protesters believe that Maricarmen's demise was caused by the eviction. Thousands protested when police carried Maricarmen, who used a wheelchair, on a stretcher from her home of seven decades last month. She died in a hospital where she was taken, and her lawyer did not disclose a cause of death.
paras.zh: 许多抗议者认为马里卡门的死是由驱逐造成的。上个月，当警察用担架将坐在轮椅上的马里卡门从她居住了七年的家中抬出来时，数千人抗议。她在被送往医院后死亡，她的律师没有透露死因。

paras.en: One sign in Puerta de Sol read, "These are not deaths, they are murders," echoing chants that rang out during a march toward the parliament late Wednesday, when news of her death spread.
paras.zh: 太阳门广场的一个标牌上写着：“这些不是死亡，而是谋杀”，与周三晚间前往议会的游行中响起的口号相呼应，当时她的死讯传开。

paras.en: "She was the flame that led us to start this camp-in and protest," 28-year-old receptionist María Holgado said outside her tent on Thursday. "Her death shocked us and left us all incredibly sad, but I believe it will give us more energy and conviction to keep protesting and demanding our rights so that there is not one more murder."
paras.zh: “她是引导我们开始露营和抗议的火焰，”28 岁的接待员玛丽亚·霍尔加多 (María Holgado) 周四在她的帐篷外说道。 “她的死让我们感到震惊，让我们所有人都感到无比悲伤，但我相信这会给我们更多的能量和信念，让我们继续抗议并要求我们的权利，这样就不会再发生一起谋杀案。”

paras.en: "The blame falls on the property owners and vulture funds that are taking advantage of a basic right and making loads of money from it," she added.
paras.zh: “责任归咎于业主和秃鹫基金，他们利用基本权利并从中赚取大量金钱，”她补充道。

paras.en: Maricarmen Abascal is shown taking part in a protest in Madrid on May 24 against the high cost of living. (Kacper Pempel/Reuters)
paras.zh: 5 月 24 日，马里卡门·阿巴斯卡 (Maricarmen Abascal) 参加了马德里举行的抗议高生活成本的抗议活动。 （卡克佩尔·彭佩尔/路透社）

paras.en: Holgado said she and her partner could only afford a tiny, one-room apartment, and are paying dearly for it. Her case is typical. The average rent for Spain has almost doubled in the last 10 years, according to the real estate website Idealista.
paras.zh: 霍尔加多说，她和她的伴侣只能买一套狭小的单室公寓，而且要为此付出高昂的代价。她的例子很典型。根据房地产网站 Idealista 的数据，过去 10 年西班牙的平均租金几乎翻了一番。

paras.en: Similar protests and camp-ins have stayed active in Barcelona and other major cities. The main organizers of the protests, Madrid's Tenants Union, has called for another march on Thursday.
paras.zh: 类似的抗议和露营活动在巴塞罗那和其他主要城市依然活跃。抗议活动的主要组织者马德里租户联盟呼吁周四再次举行游行。

paras.en: The televised images of Maricarmen being taken from her home last month shook Spanish politics to the core.
paras.zh: 上个月，电视播出的马里卡门被从家中带走的画面彻底震撼了西班牙政坛。

paras.en: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez first tried to push through emergency housing measures to stop evictions and curb real estate speculation. When right-wing parties aligned to stop the legislation in parliament, Sánchez doubled down by calling snap elections earlier this week.
paras.zh: 西班牙首相佩德罗·桑切斯首先试图推行紧急住房措施，以阻止驱逐并遏制房地产投机。当右翼政党联合起来阻止议会立法时，桑切斯加倍努力，在本周早些时候呼吁提前举行选举。

paras.en: Sánchez, who is hoping to use the housing question to galvanize progressives for the Nov. 29 election, was quick to send his condolences to Maricarmen's family and friends on social media.
paras.zh: 桑切斯希望利用住房问题来激励进步人士参加 11 月 29 日的选举，他很快在社交媒体上向马里卡门的家人和朋友表示哀悼。

paras.en: The protest camp in Madrid's Puerta del Sol, with demonstrators demanding political action to halt evictions and address the housing crisis, is shown on Oct. 6. (Violeta Santos Moura/Reuters)
paras.zh: 10 月 6 日，马德里太阳门广场的抗议营地中，示威者要求采取政治行动来停止驱逐并解决住房危机。（Violeta Santos Moura/路透社）

paras.en: To stay in power, Sánchez will likely need to maintain the current coalition between his Socialists and a smaller party further to the left. They have been trailing the right-wing parties in polls.
paras.zh: 为了继续掌权，桑切斯可能需要维持其社会党与更左翼的较小政党之间目前的联盟。他们在民意调查中一直落后于右翼政党。

paras.en: "In political terms, this will be remembered as a milestone," analyst Alejandro Quiroga, a politics professor at Madrid's Complutense University, told The Associated Press. "Her death completes the narrative that evictions and real estate speculation literally kill."
paras.zh: 马德里康普顿斯大学政治学教授分析师亚历杭德罗·基罗加告诉美联社：“从政治角度来说，这将被视为一个里程碑。” “她的死完成了驱逐和房地产投机真正杀死的叙述。”

paras.en: On Thursday, members of left-wing parties held a minute of silence outside both the regional parliament and town hall of Madrid. Right-wing politicians of the conservative Popular Party and far-right Vox did not participate in either, some folding their arms.
paras.zh: 周四，左翼政党成员在马德里地区议会和市政厅外默哀一分钟。保守派人民党和极右翼 Vox 的右翼政客都没有参加，有些人交叉双臂。

paras.en: Opposition leader Manuela Bergerot of the leftist Mas Madrid party said Maricarmen had died because of "miserable people who put gain above a person's life … those responsible will carry that with them for their remaining days."
paras.zh: 左翼马斯马德里党的反对党领袖曼努埃拉·贝杰罗特表示，马里卡门的死是因为“那些将利益置于生命之上的悲惨人们……那些对此负责的人将在余生中承受这种痛苦。”

paras.en: She added that the last thing Madrid leader Isabel Diaz Ayuso of the Popular Party had done while Maricarmen was alive was "laugh at her." That was reference to when Ayuso quipped on Sept. 28: "At what age do I get to stop paying my landlords? Let me know."
paras.zh: 她补充说，马德里人民党领导人伊莎贝尔·迪亚兹·阿尤索在马里卡门活着时所做的最后一件事就是“嘲笑她”。这是指阿尤索在 9 月 28 日打趣道：“我到什么年龄才能停止向房东付款？让我知道。”

paras.en: - Spanish PM calls snap election amid mounting housing crisis
paras.zh: - 西班牙首相在住房危机加剧之际呼吁提前大选

paras.en: - Analysis From riots to 'regularization,' U.K. and Spain show opposing attitudes to migrants
paras.zh: - 分析 从骚乱到“正规化”，英国和西班牙对移民表现出对立态度

paras.en: Right-wing parties have repeatedly called on the government to send in police to break up the camp-in in Puerta del Sol. The government has thus far refused.
paras.zh: 右翼政党多次呼吁政府派遣警察驱散太阳门的营地。政府迄今拒绝了。

paras.en: The regional and municipal governments held by the Popular Party have for years pushed back against attempts by Sánchez's government to regulate rental costs. The Popular Party argues that regulation hurts investment when Spain needs hundreds of thousands of new homes.
paras.zh: 人民党控制的地区和市政府多年来一直反对桑切斯政府监管租金成本的尝试。人民党认为，当西班牙需要数十万套新房时，监管会损害投资。

articles.title: U.S. ICE agents shoot and wound man during arrest in New York City, sparking protests

paras.en: U.S. ICE agents shoot and wound man during arrest in New York City, sparking protests
paras.zh: 美国ICE特工在纽约市逮捕期间开枪打伤一名男子，引发抗议

paras.en: Mayor says 5-year-old boy was in car when agents opened fire, but was not physically hurt
paras.zh: 市长称特工开枪时 5 岁男孩在车里，但没有受伤

paras.en: U.S. federal immigration agents shot and wounded a Dominican man while arresting him in New York City on Thursday, in what the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) called a "targeted enforcement operation."
paras.zh: 周四，美国联邦移民特工在纽约市逮捕一名多米尼加男子时开枪打伤他，国土安全部 (DHS) 称这是一次“有针对性的执法行动”。

paras.en: The man survived and is being treated at a hospital, DHS said. It did not describe exactly what led to the shooting, saying only that an Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officer "discharged his weapon" during the incident and the man was injured.
paras.zh: 国土安全部表示，该男子幸存下来，正在医院接受治疗。它没有具体描述导致枪击事件的原因，只说一名移民和海关执法局（ICE）官员在事件中“开枪”，导致该男子受伤。

paras.en: The incident drew outrage from people in the neighbourhood, and the city's mayor.
paras.zh: 这一事件引起了附近居民和该市市长的愤怒。

paras.en: "What happened today was an outrage," a visibly angry New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani said at a late news briefing Thursday night.
paras.zh: “今天发生的事情令人愤慨，”明显愤怒的纽约市长佐赫兰·马姆达尼在周四晚间的新闻发布会上说道。

paras.en: He said ICE agents who surrounded the car the man was in were dressed in construction vests and masks. "There was no reasonable way to identify them as ICE agents."
paras.zh: 他说，包围该男子所乘坐汽车的 ICE 特工身穿建筑背心，戴着口罩。 “没有合理的方法来识别他们是 ICE 特工。”

paras.en: Mamdani said a five-year-old child was in the car when one of the ICE agents opened fire, but was unhurt. He is believed to be the son of the man who was shot, identified by police as 28-year-old Oscar Belgal.
paras.zh: 马姆达尼说，一名 ICE 特工开枪时，车内有一名五岁儿童，但没有受伤。据信他是被枪杀男子的儿子，警方确认他是 28 岁的奥斯卡·贝尔加尔 (Oscar Belgal)。

paras.en: "We know that ICE is rotten to its core," Mamdani said. "Today's shooting is only further devastating confirmation of what we have long known, which is that ICE operates with impunity, that they sow chaos and terror across our country, that they have killed far more of our neighbours than they could ever have claimed to save."
paras.zh: “我们知道 ICE 已经彻底腐烂了，”马姆达尼说。 “今天的枪击事件进一步证实了我们早已知道的事实，即 ICE 的运作不受惩罚，他们在我们国家制造混乱和恐怖，他们杀死的邻居远远多于他们声称拯救的人数。”

paras.en: Mamdani said he spoke to U.S. President Donald Trump and U.S. Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin for two hours Thursday evening, trying to get the wounded man released from federal custody.
paras.zh: 马姆达尼说，他周四晚上与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和美国国土安全部部长马克韦恩·穆林进行了两个小时的交谈，试图让受伤男子从联邦拘留中获释。

paras.en: "Those negotiations were unsuccessful," he said.
paras.zh: “那些谈判没有成功，”他说。

paras.en: A person holds a sign near the scene of the shooting. (Seth Wenig/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 枪击现场附近有人举着牌子。 （塞斯·维尼格/美联社）

paras.en: 'We are heartbroken and enraged': council member
paras.zh: “我们感到心碎和愤怒”：理事会成员

paras.en: Homeland Security described the man as a "criminal illegal alien" with a prior grand larceny conviction and a history of other arrests. He was arrested in December 2023 but was released, DHS said, blaming "reckless" policies in Democrat-led cities such as New York.
paras.zh: 国土安全部称该男子为“犯罪非法外国人”，曾犯有重大盗窃罪，并有其他逮捕记录。国土安全部表示，他于 2023 年 12 月被捕，但被释放，并指责纽约等民主党领导的城市的“鲁莽”政策。

paras.en: The shooting happened in the Marble Hill neighbourhood, a small part of Manhattan attached to the Bronx.
paras.zh: 枪击事件发生在大理石山社区，该社区是曼哈顿的一小部分，隶属于布朗克斯区。

paras.en: Local elected officials also pushed for an end to federal immigration enforcement in the city, and some rushed to the scene shortly after the shooting happened to hold a heated news conference.
paras.zh: 当地民选官员也推动结束该市的联邦移民执法，一些人在枪击事件发生后不久赶到现场，召开了一场激烈的新闻发布会。

paras.en: "We are heartbroken and enraged," said city council member Carmen De La Rosa, a Democrat who emigrated from the Dominican Republic and now represents the neighbourhood where the shooting happened. Other elected officials cursed ICE and Trump.
paras.zh: “我们感到心碎和愤怒，”市议员卡门·德拉罗莎说，她是一名民主党人，来自多米尼加共和国，现在代表枪击事件发生的社区。其他民选官员咒骂 ICE 和特朗普。

paras.en: Demonstrators at the scene chanted, "ICE off our streets now!" and then marched to the hospital where the injured man was being treated.
paras.zh: 现场示威者高呼“ICE现在离开我们的街道！”然后游行到受伤男子正在接受治疗的医院。

paras.en: A sizable crowd blocked an intersection at the entry to the hospital. As police began to set barricades so ambulances and other vehicles could pass, some protesters shoved at the barriers and hurled water bottles at officers.
paras.zh: 一大群人堵塞了医院入口处的一个十字路口。当警察开始设置路障以便救护车和其他车辆通过时，一些抗议者推搡路障并向警察投掷水瓶。

paras.en: Protesters marched to the hospital where the wounded man was being treated, where police set up barricades. (Seth Wenig/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 抗议者游行到受伤男子正在接受治疗的医院，警方在那里设置了路障。 （塞斯·维尼格/美联社）

paras.en: DHS said its officers "are forced to make arrests at large in the community in unpredictable and dangerous environments" when "dangerous illegal aliens" get released. The agency blamed "reckless sanctuary policies" in Democrat-led areas.
paras.zh: 国土安全部表示，当“危险的非法外国人”被释放时，其官员“被迫在不可预测和危险的环境中在社区内进行大规模逮捕”。该机构指责民主党领导地区的“鲁莽的庇护政策”。

paras.en: There is no clear definition of sanctuary jurisdictions, but the term is generally applied to state and local governments that limit co-operation with federal immigration authorities.
paras.zh: 庇护管辖区没有明确的定义，但该术语通常适用于限制与联邦移民当局合作的州和地方政府。

paras.en: ICE agents have fired their guns during more than a dozen vehicle stops since last year, killing at least four people and wounding others. In late September, ICE ordered its officers not to engage in high-speed car chases and to make vehicle stops only if they have completed specific training.
paras.zh: 自去年以来，ICE 特工在十多个停车站开枪，造成至少四人死亡，多人受伤。 9月下旬，ICE命令其官员不得进行高速汽车追逐，并且只有在完成特定培训后才可以停车。

paras.en: New York Police Commissioner Jessica Tisch said members of her force were responding to an unrelated call nearby when they heard the report of shots fired. She said they then responded to the ICE shooting where they helped the wounded man and transported him to hospital.
paras.zh: 纽约警察局长杰西卡·蒂什表示，她的警员正在接到附近一个无关的电话，这时他们听到了枪击事件。她说，他们随后对 ICE 枪击事件做出了反应，帮助了受伤的男子并将他送往医院。

paras.en: "I want to be clear, the NYPD had no involvement in the federal operation prior to the shooting and no members of the NYPD were on scene at the time of the shooting, she said."
paras.zh: 她说：“我想澄清的是，枪击事件发生前，纽约警察局没有参与联邦行动，枪击事件发生时，纽约警察局的成员也没有在现场。”

paras.en: Difficult to identify ICE agents, resident says
paras.zh: 居民称很难识别 ICE 特工

paras.en: Pedro Almaraz, an employee at a restaurant close to the scene, said he heard about three or four gunshots and saw a man on the ground surrounded by several officers wearing face masks and vests with DHS branding.
paras.zh: 现场附近一家餐厅的员工佩德罗·阿尔马拉斯 (Pedro Almaraz) 表示，他听到了三四声枪响，并看到一名男子倒在地上，周围是几名戴着口罩、穿着印有国土安全部标志的背心的警察。

paras.en: Neighbourhood resident Alfred Silva, 38, called for federal officers to more clearly identify themselves, saying one was wearing a construction safety vest and carrying a rifle.
paras.zh: 38 岁的社区居民阿尔弗雷德·席尔瓦 (Alfred Silva) 呼吁联邦官员更清楚地表明自己的身份，称其中一人穿着建筑安全背心并携带步枪。

paras.en: "We need to have better transparency to understand who we're dealing with, because anybody in the street can just put on a vest and pull out a gun and claim to be ICE," Silva said.
paras.zh: 席尔瓦说：“我们需要提高透明度，以了解我们正在与谁打交道，因为街上的任何人都可以穿上背心并掏出枪，并声称自己是 ICE。”

paras.en: "I feel like regardless if you're left or right, we should understand that this shouldn't be happening."
paras.zh: “我觉得无论你是左派还是右派，我们都应该明白这种事不应该发生。”

paras.en: Hochul, a Democrat, said in a post on social media that New Yorkers deserve to know what happened.
paras.zh: 民主党人霍赫尔在社交媒体上发帖表示，纽约人应该知道发生了什么。

paras.en: "We expect federal authorities to provide a full and transparent accounting of the circumstances surrounding this incident. New Yorkers deserve to know exactly what happened and why," she said.
paras.zh: “我们希望联邦当局对这一事件的情况提供全面、透明的说明。纽约人应该确切地知道发生了什么以及为什么发生，”她说。

paras.en: Videos and photos posted by bystanders on social media show a man sitting on the ground with his hands behind his back in the immediate aftermath of the shooting.
paras.zh: 旁观者在社交媒体上发布的视频和照片显示，枪击事件发生后，一名男子背着手坐在地上。

paras.en: Another video shows New York City police officers picking up an apparently injured man and carrying him into a police vehicle. Nearby, a damaged car blocking the roadway is seen with small holes in two of its windows.
paras.zh: 另一段视频显示，纽约市警察抱起一名明显受伤的男子，并将他抬上警车。附近，一辆受损的汽车挡住了道路，两扇窗户上有小洞。

paras.en: The videos show agents wearing ICE badges on the scene, including one carrying a rifle.
paras.zh: 视频显示，特工在现场佩戴 ICE 徽章，其中一名特工携带步枪。

articles.title: Michigan Senate hopeful Mike Rogers faces pressure over Trump's trade war

paras.en: Michigan Senate hopeful Mike Rogers faces pressure over Trump's trade war
paras.zh: 密歇根州参议院候选人迈克·罗杰斯面临特朗普贸易战的压力

paras.en: Trump's trade war a ballot issue in close race between Rogers and Democratic nominee Abdul El-Sayed
paras.zh: 特朗普的贸易战是罗杰斯和民主党候选人阿卜杜勒·赛义德之间激烈竞争的选票问题

paras.en: Michigan Senate candidate Mike Rogers faced pressure over U.S. President Donald Trump's trade war with Canada during a heated debate Thursday that could sway voters in a consequential midterm race in which neither candidate ruled out future tariffs.
paras.zh: 密歇根州参议院候选人迈克·罗杰斯在周四的激烈辩论中面临美国总统唐纳德·特朗普与加拿大贸易战的压力，这场辩论可能会在随后的中期选举中影响选民，在这场辩论中，两位候选人都没有排除未来征收关税的可能性。

paras.en: "I would like to see the deal made," Rogers responded. "I have actually called the White House this week, talked to the secretary of Commerce, about getting the deal done."
paras.zh: “我希望看到这笔交易达成，”罗杰斯回应道。 “实际上，我本周已经给白宫打电话，与商务部长讨论了完成这笔交易的事宜。”

paras.en: Rogers said Canada imposes tariffs on U.S. goods, without providing details about the levies or addressing the Canada-U.S.-Mexico Agreement, which was negotiated during the first Trump administration.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯表示，加拿大对美国商品征收关税，但没有提供征税细节，也没有提及特朗普第一届政府期间谈判达成的《加拿大-美国-墨西哥协议》。

paras.en: - Trump administration faces 2 lawsuits for taxpayer-funded ads as midterms draw near
paras.zh: - 随着中期选举临近，特朗普政府因纳税人资助的广告面临两起诉讼

paras.en: - 'Canada is not our enemy': Michigan Republican Senate candidate breaks with Trump on trade war
paras.zh: - “加拿大不是我们的敌人”：密歇根州共和党参议员候选人在贸易战问题上与特朗普决裂

paras.en: But the Republican candidate said the U.S. tariffs on Canada are now too high and those should be eliminated.
paras.zh: 但这位共和党候选人表示，美国现在对加拿大征收的关税太高，应该取消。

paras.en: "This is about getting to the best deal possible. I'd like to it end. I think we need to end it," Rogers said before taking jabs at his Democratic opponent, Abdul El-Sayed, claiming El-Sayed's policies would raise prices.
paras.zh: “这是为了达成尽可能最好的协议。我希望结束它。我认为我们需要结束它，”罗杰斯在猛烈抨击他的民主党对手阿卜杜勒·赛义德之前说道，声称赛义德的政策会提高物价。

paras.en: The trade war with Canada has become a campaign issue in the close race between Rogers and El-Sayed ahead of the November midterm elections.
paras.zh: 与加拿大的贸易战已成为罗杰斯和埃尔-赛义德在 11 月中期选举前势均力敌的竞选中的一个竞选问题。

paras.en: Trump rapidly escalated his trade war and rhetoric against Canada after negotiations fell apart in August.
paras.zh: 八月份谈判破裂后，特朗普迅速升级了他的贸易战和针对加拿大的言论。

paras.en: Trump signed an order to rename Lake Ontario as Lake America, and the United States imposed 50 per cent tariffs on an array of Canadian goods. A few weeks later, Ottawa responded with retaliatory duties.
paras.zh: 特朗普签署命令，将安大略湖更名为美洲湖，美国对一系列加拿大商品征收 50% 的关税。几周后，渥太华以报复性关税作为回应。

paras.en: Last week, a U.S. import ban on some Canadian liquor, whey products and motorcycles officially took effect.
paras.zh: 上周，美国对加拿大部分酒类、乳清产品和摩托车的进口禁令正式生效。

paras.en: Rogers had also previously inserted himself into the dispute over the controversial delay of the Gordie Howe International Bridge connecting Windsor and Detroit, claiming "America will get a better financial deal and that there will be no Chinese cars pouring over that bridge."
paras.zh: 罗杰斯此前还介入了连接温莎和底特律的戈迪·豪国际大桥有争议的延误争议，声称“美国将获得更好的财务协议，而且不会有中国汽车涌入这座桥。”

paras.en: Polling has shown that a majority of Michigan voters disapprove of Trump's tariffs and his targeting of Canada. Michigan's economy is deeply integrated with Canada's, particularly in the auto industry.
paras.zh: 民意调查显示，大多数密歇根州选民不赞成特朗普的关税和针对加拿大的政策。密歇根州的经济与加拿大的经济紧密结合，特别是在汽车行业。

paras.en: That has put Rogers in a difficult position. He is among a growing number of Republicans distancing their campaigns from some of the president's policies.
paras.zh: 这让罗杰斯陷入了困境。他是越来越多的共和党人之一，他们的竞选活动与总统的一些政策保持距离。

paras.en: Thursday's fiery debate also featured clashes over the Iran war, cost of gas and diesel and properties owned by the candidates. Rogers argued El-Sayed's policies would be costly, while the Democrat sought to tie Rogers to Trump's controversial policies, as well as properties outside Michigan and campaign donations.
paras.zh: 周四的激烈辩论还围绕伊朗战争、天然气和柴油成本以及候选人拥有的财产等问题发生了冲突。罗杰斯认为，埃尔-赛义德的政策代价高昂，而民主党则试图将罗杰斯与特朗普有争议的政策以及密歇根州以外的房产和竞选捐款联系起来。

paras.en: Abdul El-Sayed, the Democrats' nominee for the U.S. Senate in Michigan in 2026, is seen participating in a televised debate against Rogers (unseen in the image above) in Grand Rapids, Mich., on Thursday. (Paul Sancya/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周四，民主党提名 2026 年密歇根州美国参议员候选人阿卜杜勒·赛义德 (Abdul El-Sayed) 在密歇根州大急流城参加了与罗杰斯 (上图中未出现) 的电视辩论。 （保罗桑西亚/美联社）

paras.en: Democrats would need a net gain of four seats to win a Senate majority, making the Michigan race particularly consequential.
paras.zh: 民主党需要净增加四个席位才能赢得参议院多数席位，这使得密歇根州的竞选尤为重要。

paras.en: But El-Sayed's response on tariffs is unlikely to reassure Canadians shaken by Trump's trade polices. He was asked about a statement on his website supporting tariffs as long as they are targeted.
paras.zh: 但埃尔赛义德对关税的回应不太可能让因特朗普贸易政策而动摇的加拿大人放心。有人问他，他的网站上是否有一份支持关税的声明，只要关税是有针对性的。

paras.en: While El-Sayed said the tariffs on Canada are costing Michiganders thousands of dollars, he said he supports duties as part of an "industrial policy that makes sense."
paras.zh: 尽管埃尔-赛义德表示，对加拿大征收的关税使密歇根人损失了数千美元，但他表示，他支持将关税作为“有意义的工业政策”的一部分。

paras.en: "We use tariffs to protect our own market," El-Sayed said.
paras.zh: “我们利用关税来保护我们自己的市场，”埃尔赛义德说。

paras.en: "This is, like everything, ham-fisted, chaotic, self-serving, that Donald Trump does."
paras.zh: “这就像唐纳德·特朗普所做的一切一样，笨拙、混乱、自私。”

articles.title: South Korea recalls Ukraine ambassador amid POW dispute

paras.en: South Korea said on Thursday that it would recall its ambassador to Ukraine amid a deepening diplomatic rift over making the transfer of North Korean prisoners of war to Seoul public last month.
paras.zh: 韩国周四表示，由于上个月公开向首尔移交朝鲜战俘的问题，外交分歧不断加深，韩国将召回驻乌克兰大使。

paras.en: The two countries have been at loggerheads since Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's speech at the UN General Assembly, during which he spoke about the capture and later the transfer of two North Korean soldiers who had been fighting against Ukraine alongside Russian forces.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基在联合国大会上发表讲话，谈到两名曾与俄罗斯军队一起对抗乌克兰的朝鲜士兵被俘并随后被移交，自此之后，两国一直处于争执之中。

paras.en: South Korea has called for an apology from Ukraine, saying the comments breached a confidentiality agreement and could put the POWs' families still in North Korea at risk.
paras.zh: 韩国要求乌克兰道歉，称这些言论违反了保密协议，可能会让仍在朝鲜的战俘家属面临危险。

paras.en: Kyiv, meanwhile, has said no such agreement existed and voiced a desire to smooth over a "diplomatic understanding," but stopped short of apologizing.
paras.zh: 与此同时，基辅表示不存在这样的协议，并表示希望达成“外交谅解”，但没有道歉。

paras.en: What did South Korea's Foreign Ministry say about recalling its ambassador?
paras.zh: 韩国外交部对召回大使有何评论？

paras.en: "The govenment has decided to recall its ambassador to Ukraine," Seoul's Foreign Ministry said on Thursday.
paras.zh: 首尔外交部周四表示：“政府已决定召回驻乌克兰大使。”

paras.en: "The government hopes that all outstanding issues between the two countries will be resolved amicably and wil continue consultations with the Ukrainian side to that end," it said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“政府希望两国之间所有悬而未决的问题都能得到友好解决，并将为此继续与乌克兰方面进行磋商。”

paras.en: Last week, President Lee Jae Myung called for a "public apology" from Kyiv and said South Korea would take "additional measures" if one was not forthcoming. He said that during the prisoner swap, "the Ukrainian side demanded confidentiality and agreed to it, but unilaterally disclosed it."
paras.zh: 上周，韩国总统李在明呼吁基辅“公开道歉”，并表示如果不及时道歉，韩国将采取“额外措施”。他说，在换俘过程中，“乌方要求保密并同意，但单方面披露”。

paras.en: When challenged with what Myung described as "utmost courtesy," he said Kyiv instead denied the existence of a confidentiality agreement, making him out to be a liar, and spoke of the prospect of war on the Korean peninsula.
paras.zh: 当被问及明所称的“极其礼貌”时，他说基辅否认了保密协议的存在，使他成为一个骗子，并谈到了朝鲜半岛爆发战争的前景。

paras.en: Ukraine's Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha, meanwhile, had spoken of a "diplomatic misunderstanding" that he said "we sincerely hope to resolve."
paras.zh: 与此同时，乌克兰外交部长安德里·西比哈(Andrii Sybiha)谈到了“外交误解”，并表示“我们真诚希望予以解决”。

paras.en: Bilateral tensions also emerged this week amid the publication of an investigative report in The Guardian claiming that fuel was being shipped to Russia from South Korea via sanctioned tankers, alleviating the strains on diesel supplies amid Ukraine targeting Russian refineries and other oil infrastructure.
paras.zh: 本周，《卫报》发表了一份调查报告，声称燃料正在通过受制裁的油轮从韩国运往俄罗斯，缓解了乌克兰针对俄罗斯炼油厂和其他石油基础设施的柴油供应压力，双边紧张局势也随之出现。

paras.en: South Korea has walked a fine line on Russia's war in Ukraine, providing humanitarian and non-lethal equipment to Kyiv, as well as financial assistance, but also seeking to maintain cordial ties with Russia, which has a small stretch of border with North Korea near Vladivostock.
paras.zh: 韩国在俄罗斯乌克兰战争问题上一直保持谨慎态度，向基辅提供人道主义和非致命设备以及财政援助，但也寻求与俄罗斯保持友好关系，俄罗斯与朝鲜在符拉迪沃斯托克附近有一小段边境。

paras.en: North Korea, meanwhile, sent troops to help Russia reclaim the border region of Kursk that Ukraine was able to partially occupy, and has since celebrated this deployment at home with much fanfare, while seeking closer ties to Putin's Russia.
paras.zh: 与此同时，朝鲜派遣军队帮助俄罗斯收复乌克兰部分占领的库尔斯克边境地区，此后朝鲜在国内大张旗鼓地庆祝这次部署，同时寻求与普京领导的俄罗斯建立更密切的关系。

paras.en: If you rely on our team for trusted reporting, please take a moment to select us as your Preferred Source on Google, so you'll always see our verified news first.
paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

articles.title: Security in the Black Sea region: is Bulgaria the weak link in Europe's defense against threats from Russia?

paras.en: Security in the Black Sea, a frontline in Russia's war in Ukraine, is a complex issue for several reasons, but two incidents in recent days have highlighted just how precarious the situation there is.
paras.zh: 黑海是俄罗斯乌克兰战争的前线，由于多种原因，黑海的安全是一个复杂的问题，但最近几天发生的两起事件凸显了那里的局势有多么不稳定。

paras.en: On October 6, drones struck two cargo ships, the Alfa Watan and the Able, in the Bulgarian exclusive economic zone in the Black Sea.
paras.zh: 10月6日，无人机袭击了黑海保加利亚专属经济区的两艘货船“Alfa Watan”号和“Able”号。

paras.en: The Alfa Watan sank, and its crew has not been recovered. Bulgaria conducted a search and rescue operation, which was called off on Wednesday morning.
paras.zh: Alfa Watan 号沉没，船员尚未找到。保加利亚进行了搜救行动，但周三上午被取消。

paras.en: The crew of the Able, which was damaged, was rescued by a passing Bulgarian ship. Two crew members were taken to the military hospital in Varna.
paras.zh: 受损的“Able”号船员被一艘路过的保加利亚船只救起。两名船员被送往瓦尔纳的军事医院。

paras.en: The day before, another cargo ship, the Royad Mammadov, was struck by a drone and sank off the coast of Romania, killing two crew members.
paras.zh: 前一天，另一艘货船“Royad Mammadov”号在罗马尼亚海岸被无人机击中沉没，造成两名船员死亡。

paras.en: These are not isolated incidents. In the past few months, there have been multiple attacks on cargo ships carrying grain from Ukraine.
paras.zh: 这些并非孤立事件。过去几个月，运载乌克兰粮食的货船发生多起袭击事件。

paras.en: As a result, doubt is increasingly being cast on the belief that the western part of the Black Sea — the area off the coast of Bulgaria and Romania — is relatively safe.
paras.zh: 因此，人们越来越怀疑黑海西部地区（保加利亚和罗马尼亚沿海地区）相对安全的信念。

paras.en: "Тhe Black Sea front is clearly expanding, and we should no longer look only to the Baltic Sea as a potential avenue for escalation and aggressive actions," said Ruslan Trad, global security expert and non-resident fellow at the Atlantic Council's Digital Forensic Research Lab.
paras.zh: 大西洋理事会数字取证研究实验室的全球安全专家兼非常驻研究员鲁斯兰·特拉德表示：“黑海战线显然正在扩大，我们不应再仅仅将波罗的海视为升级和侵略行动的潜在途径。”

paras.en: Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev downplayed the attack on the ships, remarking that ships are constantly being sunk in the Black Sea and that Tuesday's drone attacks were "probably not the most serious incident."
paras.zh: 保加利亚总理鲁门·拉德夫淡化了对船只的袭击，并表示船只不断在黑海沉没，周二的无人机袭击“可能不是最严重的事件”。

paras.en: Bulgaria's government called Tuesday's attack on the two vessels an "absolutely unacceptable violation of international law" but refrained from calling on Russia to end its war against Ukraine.
paras.zh: 保加利亚政府称周二对两艘船只的袭击是“绝对不可接受的违反国际法的行为”，但没有呼吁俄罗斯结束对乌克兰的战争。

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, on the other hand, was unequivocal. He said that the Ukrainian military had assured Bulgaria that it was not responsible for the attack and pointed the finger squarely at Russia.
paras.zh: 另一方面，乌克兰总统泽伦斯基则态度明确。他说，乌克兰军方已向保加利亚保证，它不对此次袭击负责，并将矛头直指俄罗斯。

paras.en: After a meeting of the National Security Council on Wednesday, a declaration was issued, which once again did not name the source of the threat in the Black Sea.
paras.zh: 周三国家安全委员会会议后发表了一份声明，其中再次没有指出黑海威胁的来源。

paras.en: Radev stated that the cargo and the direction of travel of the ships "logically speaking" provide grounds for a hypothesis pointing to Russia but stressed that there is no concrete evidence. He also contradicted Zelenskyy, saying no such conversation had taken place.
paras.zh: 拉德夫表示，“从逻辑上讲”，货物和船只的行驶方向为指向俄罗斯的假设提供了依据，但强调没有具体证据。他还反驳了泽伦斯基，称没有发生过这样的谈话。

paras.en: Earlier he said that "if the war is not brought to an end in due time, it will continue to expand."
paras.zh: 此前他曾表示，“如果战争不及时结束，战争将会继续扩大”。

paras.en: Similarly, Bulgaria's Foreign Minister Velislava Petrova said that "we need to support all possible diplomatic efforts to bring this war to an end."
paras.zh: 同样，保加利亚外交部长韦利斯拉瓦·佩特洛娃表示，“我们需要支持一切可能的外交努力，以结束这场战争。”

paras.en: The refusal to state clearly that it is Russian aggression that is putting the region at risk is not new for the Radev administration.
paras.zh: 对于拉德夫政府来说，拒绝明确表示是俄罗斯的侵略使该地区面临危险并不是什么新鲜事。

paras.en: Is Bulgaria a 'weak link' in European defense?
paras.zh: 保加利亚是欧洲防务的“薄弱环节”吗？

paras.en: For Rumena Filipova, chairperson of the Institute of Global Analytics, this is an example of how Bulgaria seems to be a weak link in Europe's defense against malicious influence from Russia and China.
paras.zh: 对于全球分析研究所所长鲁梅娜·菲利波娃来说，这是一个例子，说明保加利亚似乎是欧洲抵御俄罗斯和中国恶意影响的薄弱环节。

paras.en: "This weakness stems from the lack of a serious institutional response to hybrid attacks of any kind, the absence of appropriate measures and a general tendency to downplay incidents," she told DW.
paras.zh: 她告诉德国之声：“这一弱点源于对任何类型的混合攻击缺乏严肃的机构反应、缺乏适当的措施以及淡化事件的普遍倾向。”

paras.en: "The perpetrator is not named explicitly, even though our partners in the European Union and NATO have already issued numerous warnings about what aggressive steps Russia could take against Europe," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“尽管我们在欧盟和北约的合作伙伴已经多次警告俄罗斯可能对欧洲采取哪些侵略性措施，但肇事者的名字并未被明确提及。”

paras.en: According to Filipova, the Bulgarian government's narrative about peace without actually specifying the conditions or consequences for Ukrainian and European security is a demonstration of its leniency toward Moscow and raises the question of Sofia's geopolitical orientation.
paras.zh: 菲利波娃表示，保加利亚政府在没有具体说明乌克兰和欧洲安全的条件或后果的情况下关于和平的叙述，表明了其对莫斯科的宽大处理，并提出了索非亚地缘政治取向的问题。

paras.en: One of the surviving members of the Able's crew has said that he believes it was a Russian strike because the ship was carrying Ukrainian grain.
paras.zh: 一名幸存的阿布尔号船员表示，他认为这是俄罗斯的袭击，因为这艘船载有乌克兰谷物。

paras.en: Trad, the global security expert, says that the crew member's testimony is an eyewitness hypothesis, not hard proof.
paras.zh: 全球安全专家特拉德表示，船员的证词只是目击者的假设，而不是确凿的证据。

paras.en: "The logic of motive, however, points toward Russia, as it is the state systematically threatening navigation to Ukrainian ports," he told DW, adding, "Until more concrete data is revealed the most accurate phrasing is 'probable but unproven Russian responsibility' without excluding other possibilities."
paras.zh: 他告诉德国之声：“然而，动机的逻辑指向俄罗斯，因为它是系统性地威胁乌克兰港口航行的国家。”他补充道，“在披露更多具体数据之前，最准确的措辞是‘可能但未经证实的俄罗斯责任’，而不排除其他可能性。”

paras.en: Trad also pointed out that Bulgarian institutions lack experience in attributing maritime drones in Bulgaria's exclusive economic zone (EEZ). "When the system is uncertain, the safest institutional reaction is to say nothing until certainty is achieved," he said. "That is caution, but it is also a political choice."
paras.zh: 特拉德还指出，保加利亚机构缺乏对保加利亚专属经济区（EEZ）海上无人机归属的经验。他说：“当体系不确定时，最安全的机构反应是在确定性之前保持沉默。” “这是谨慎，但这也是一种政治选择。”

paras.en: A direct military response or the triggering of NATO's Article 5, which guarantees collective defense in the event of an attack on any member state, should not be expected.
paras.zh: 不应期望采取直接军事反应或触发北约第5条，该条保证在任何成员国受到攻击时进行集体防御。

paras.en: Bulgaria's EEZ in the Black Sea is not Bulgarian sovereign territory and, as such, the strikes on the ships in this zone do not constitute a direct attack on Bulgaria — or on Romania in the case of the Royad Mammadov.
paras.zh: 保加利亚在黑海的专属经济区不是保加利亚的主权领土，因此，对该区域内船只的袭击并不构成对保加利亚的直接攻击，也不构成对罗马尼亚的直接攻击（就“罗亚德·马梅多夫”号而言）。

paras.en: Nevertheless, Trad thinks these three incidents shatter the illusion that the western part of the Black Sea is a safe zone because of the distance between it and the frontlines in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，特拉德认为，这三起事件打破了人们的幻想，即黑海西部地区距离乌克兰前线较远，因此是一个安全区。

paras.en: "This will increase pressure for tighter maritime monitoring, anti‑mining capabilities, coordination between coastal guard services and intelligence‑sharing among allies," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“这将增加加强海上监测、反水雷能力、海岸警卫队之间的协调以及盟国之间情报共享的压力。”

paras.en: "The real effect will be a hardening of the shipping regime: stricter routing recommendations, higher insurance premiums and more difficulty hiring crews. Economic repercussions for local businesses can also be anticipated — imagine the impact on fishermen if they have to stay in ports constantly due to fear of further attacks. That is the intended effect of such strikes," he added.
paras.zh: “真正的影响将是航运制度的强化：更严格的路线建议、更高的保险费以及雇用船员的难度更大。当地企业的经济影响也是可以预见的——想象一下，如果渔民因为担心进一步的袭击而不得不一直留在港口，将会受到什么影响。这就是此类罢工的预期效果，”他补充道。

paras.en: Rumena Filipova believes that although Romania, Bulgaria and Turkey strengthened their Mine Countermeasures Black Sea Task Group at this year's NATO summit in Ankara, this is not enough.
paras.zh: 鲁梅纳·菲利波娃认为，尽管罗马尼亚、保加利亚和土耳其在今年的安卡拉北约峰会上加强了黑海反水雷工作组，但这还不够。

paras.en: She says there are far more substantial gaps in naval defense capabilities: "Modernization of Bulgaria's naval forces must be improved, much greater coordination — especially with Romania — is required. Yet, for more than a decade, Bulgarian authorities have downplayed or ignored the idea of developing joint naval defense forces and coordination, and that trend continues today," she said.
paras.zh: 她说，海军防御能力方面存在更严重的差距：“保加利亚海军的现代化必须得到改善，需要更大程度的协调，特别是与罗马尼亚的协调。然而，十多年来，保加利亚当局一直淡化或忽视发展联合海军防御力量和协调的想法，这种趋势至今仍在继续，”她说。

paras.en: Another question is how Turkey will react to recent developments. All three ships were owned by Turkish firms and some of the crew members were Turkish nationals. Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan on Wednesday spoke to Russian President Vladimir Putin about the security of navigation in the Black Sea.
paras.zh: 另一个问题是土耳其将如何应对最近的事态发展。所有三艘船均属于土耳其公司所有，部分船员是土耳其国民。土耳其总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安周三与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京就黑海航行安全进行了交谈。

paras.en: Trad notes that Ankara has several levers of influence in the Black Sea: control of the Straits under the Montreux Convention, the largest fleet in the Black Sea and its role as a mediator between Moscow and Kyiv.
paras.zh: 特拉德指出，安卡拉在黑海拥有多种影响力：根据蒙特勒公约控制海峡、黑海最大的舰队以及作为莫斯科和基辅之间调解人的角色。

paras.en: "A realistic scenario is intensified diplomacy, coordination with Bucharest and Sofia, and pressure for safe navigation, probably within the existing trilateral anti‑mining cooperation. If it turns out that Turkish citizens were killed in a deliberate attack, Ankara's stance could become markedly tougher," he said.
paras.zh: “现实的情况是加强外交、与布加勒斯特和索非亚的协调，以及安全航行的压力，可能是在现有的三边反采矿合作范围内。如果事实证明土耳其公民在蓄意袭击中丧生，安卡拉的立场可能会变得明显更强硬，”他说。

paras.en: Filipova thinks that Black Sea security is already being perceived as a core issue — not only for the region but for NATO as a whole.
paras.zh: 菲利波娃认为，黑海安全已经被视为一个核心问题——不仅对于该地区，而且对于整个北约而言。

paras.en: In her view, there's not enough coordination between the countries in the region, which means that any response to threats does not come from a united front — something she feels has to change urgently.
paras.zh: 在她看来，该地区国家之间缺乏足够的协调，这意味着对威胁的任何反应都不是来自统一战线——她认为这一点必须紧急改变。

paras.en: Filipova says that China's influence in the region and how it's connected with Russia is another factor.
paras.zh: 菲利波娃说，中国在该地区的影响力及其与俄罗斯的联系是另一个因素。

paras.en: "We see not only the concrete military threat from Russia but also a subtler threat from China, which is less publicly discussed. But Beijing is trying to acquire strategic assets in ports, thereby gaining influence over both trade and critical infrastructure," she said. "Given that China and Russia cooperate closely, this constitutes a double threat for the Black Sea region."
paras.zh: “我们不仅看到来自俄罗斯的具体军事威胁，还看到来自中国的微妙威胁，这种威胁较少公开讨论。但北京正试图获取港口的战略资产，从而获得对贸易和关键基础设施的影响力，”她说。 “鉴于中俄密切合作，这对黑海地区构成双重威胁。”

articles.title: South Korea warns of AI-aided hacking after bank data breaches

paras.en: The South Korean government has demanded a comprehensive overhaul of safeguards against hackers after seven of the nation's major financial institutions' cyber defenses were breached last week and the private data of thousands of customers was leaked.
paras.zh: 上周，韩国七家主要金融机构的网络防御遭到破坏，数千名客户的私人数据遭到泄露，韩国政府要求对黑客防护措施进行全面改革。

paras.en: The data breaches go beyond the financial sector, with two of the largest churches in the country and Korea Electric Power Corp. on Wednesday confirming that their online systems had been illegally accessed, although it is not clear whether the same perpetrator was responsible for all the attacks.
paras.zh: 数据泄露不仅限于金融领域，该国最大的两家教堂和韩国电力公司周三证实，他们的在线系统遭到非法访问，但目前尚不清楚是否同一肇事者对所有攻击负责。

paras.en: On Tuesday, Prime Minister Han Seong-sook called for measures to be taken swiftly to halt any further leaks.
paras.zh: 周二，韩国总理韩成淑呼吁迅速采取措施，阻止进一步的泄密。

paras.en: "This is a serious situation because this incident is believed to have taken advantage of artificial intelligence, and if AI is used in phishing attacks, it could lead to secondary damage," Yonhap News quoted Han as saying at a Cabinet meeting.
paras.zh: 韩联社援引韩联社在内阁会议上的话说：“情况很严重，因为这起事件被认为利用了人工智能，如果人工智能被用于网络钓鱼攻击，可能会导致二次损害。”

paras.en: "It is also a serious situation in that similar hacking methods could spread beyond the financial sector to industries, as well as government and public sectors."
paras.zh: “这也是一个严重的情况，因为类似的黑客方法可能会从金融部门蔓延到各行各业，以及政府和公共部门。”

paras.en: Han said government agencies, public institutions, the financial sector and private enterprises all need to "remain vigilant."
paras.zh: 韩正表示，政府机关、事业单位、金融部门、民营企业都需要“保持警惕”。

paras.en: Early reports from the US-based cybersecurity firm CrowdStrike suggest that the attack may have originated in China, although South Korea's Financial Supervisory Service (FSS) said it had identified 28 internet protocol addresses in the United States, Japan, Germany and at least 10 other countries that were involved in the bank breaches.
paras.zh: 美国网络安全公司 CrowdStrike 的早期报告表明，此次攻击可能源自中国，尽管韩国金融监督院 (FSS) 表示已在美国、日本、德国和至少 10 个其他国家发现了 28 个互联网协议地址，这些地址涉及银行违规事件。

paras.en: "South Korea officials are being careful about how they are framing their findings," said Aditya Das, an analyst at cryptocurrency research firm Brave New Coin in Auckland, New Zealand.
paras.zh: 新西兰奥克兰加密货币研究公司 Brave New Coin 的分析师阿迪亚·达斯 (Aditya Das) 表示：“韩国官员对如何制定调查结果非常谨慎。”

paras.en: In the bank logs, investigators found traces of a tool called ARTEX, an open-source "autonomous penetration-testing" agent built by a Chinese developer, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，在银行日志中，调查人员发现了一种名为 ARTEX 的工具的痕迹，这是一种由中国开发商开发的开源“自主渗透测试”代理。

paras.en: "It is freely available on the internet and officials have said explicitly that a Chinese-built tool doesn't mean Chinese attackers," Das told DW, adding that the use of multiple IP addresses is likely to be "a ploy by the hackers to hide their tracks."
paras.zh: 达斯告诉德国之声：“它可以在互联网上免费获得，官员们明确表示，中国制造的工具并不意味着中国的攻击者。”他补充说，使用多个IP地址很可能是“黑客隐藏踪迹的一种策略”。

paras.en: It appears that the hackers exploited weak authentication protocols in portals used by external loan recruiters, employees' mobile tools and sales-support systems.
paras.zh: 黑客似乎利用了外部贷款招聘人员、员工的移动工具和销售支持系统所使用的门户中的薄弱身份验证协议。

paras.en: According to South Korean media reports, data belonging to as many as 68,000 customers was taken, with Shinhan Bank, KB Kookmin Bank and Hana Bank among the worst affected. Names, phone numbers, annual income figures, loan limits and their loan products were accessed, along with a small number of national identification numbers.
paras.zh: 据韩国媒体报道，多达 68,000 名客户的数据被盗取，其中新韩银行、KB 国民银行和韩亚银行受影响最严重。姓名、电话号码、年收入数据、贷款限额及其贷款产品以及少量国民身份证号码都被获取。

paras.en: Das pointed out that if a scammer has a person's name, phone number, income figure and is aware that the individual has recently applied for a loan, a fake "bank security" call can be very convincing to the unwary. Once a victim has transferred funds to an account specified by the scammer, it is very difficult to get it back.
paras.zh: 达斯指出，如果诈骗者掌握了某人的姓名、电话号码、收入数据，并且知道该人最近申请了贷款，那么假冒的“银行担保”电话对于粗心的人来说可能非常有说服力。一旦受害者将资金转入诈骗者指定的账户，就很难取回。

paras.en: Hyobin Lee, a professor at Sogang University in Seoul, says the seriousness of the incident goes far beyond the simple exposure of personal information.
paras.zh: 首尔西江大学教授李孝彬 (Hyobin Lee) 表示，该事件的严重性远远超出了个人信息泄露这么简单。

paras.en: "If criminals obtain such information, they may be able to carry out sophisticated financial fraud, identity theft, or highly targeted phishing attacks," she said.
paras.zh: “如果犯罪分子获得此类信息，他们可能能够实施复杂的金融欺诈、身份盗窃或高度针对性的网络钓鱼攻击，”她说。

paras.en: "Another concern is that stolen personal information can be reused or combined with other leaked databases, potentially creating security risks that persist long after the original attack," Lee underlined.
paras.zh: “另一个担忧是，被盗的个人信息可能会被重复使用或与其他泄露的数据库结合起来，这可能会产生在最初的攻击发生后很长时间内持续存在的安全风险，”李强调说。

paras.en: "More broadly, such incidents can undermine public confidence in financial institutions and raise concerns about the security of the financial system as a whole."
paras.zh: “更广泛地说，此类事件可能会削弱公众对金融机构的信心，并引发对整个金融体系安全的担忧。”

paras.en: While major financial institutions have invested heavily in protecting their core systems, such as internet banking and mobile banking platforms, Lee said they have overlooked other elements of their networks.
paras.zh: 李表示，虽然主要金融机构投入巨资保护其核心系统，例如网上银行和手机银行平台，但他们却忽视了网络的其他要素。

paras.en: "Some auxiliary systems, such as loan agent information portals and internal mobile applications used by employees, appear to have received less security attention," she said, adding that the application of AI by the hackers is another concerning element.
paras.zh: 她说：“一些辅助系统，例如贷款代理信息门户和员工使用的内部移动应用程序，似乎受到的安全关注较少。”她补充说，黑客对人工智能的应用是另一个令人担忧的因素。

paras.en: "In the past, identifying security vulnerabilities, developing malicious code and conducting attacks against financial institutions required substantial technical expertise and considerable time," Lee pointed out. "Today, generative AI tools can assist with writing computer code, analyzing software vulnerabilities, processing large amounts of information and automating certain stages of cyber operations."
paras.zh: “过去，识别安全漏洞、开发恶意代码以及对金融机构进行攻击需要大量的技术专业知识和相当长的时间，”李指出。 “如今，生成式人工智能工具可以协助编写计算机代码、分析软件漏洞、处理大量信息以及自动化网络操作的某些阶段。”

paras.en: AI is "lowering the technical barriers to cybercrime" and making it accessible to more bad actors. At the same time, the technology is ramping up the speed and scale of attacks to overwhelm cyber defenses.
paras.zh: 人工智能正在“降低网络犯罪的技术壁垒”，并使更多的不良行为者可以利用它。与此同时，该技术正在提高攻击的速度和规模，以压倒网络防御。

paras.en: Given those developments, Lee fears that AI-assisted cyberattacks are only going to become more frequent.
paras.zh: 鉴于这些发展，李担心人工智能辅助的网络攻击只会变得更加频繁。

paras.en: "And the risks will not be limited to financial institutions," she said. "Hospitals, government agencies, energy infrastructure, telecommunications networks and other organizations holding sensitive information may also become increasingly attractive targets."
paras.zh: “风险不仅限于金融机构，”她说。 “医院、政府机构、能源基础设施、电信网络和其他持有敏感信息的组织也可能成为越来越有吸引力的目标。”

articles.title: Photos: Gaza before and after – a city transformed by war

paras.en: Gaza City – More than 80 percent of Gaza’s buildings have been damaged or destroyed since Israel launched its war on the besieged enclave in October 2023, according to the Palestinian Central Bureau of Statistics, turning whole neighbourhoods into rubble and wiping out much of its infrastructure.
paras.zh: 加沙城——据巴勒斯坦中央统计局称，自 2023 年 10 月以色列对被围困的飞地发动战争以来，加沙 80% 以上的建筑遭到损坏或摧毁，整个社区变成了瓦砾，大部分基础设施被毁。

paras.en: For generations, Gaza’s streets, markets, schools, hospitals and public spaces formed the backdrop to everyday life. They were places where people worked, studied, shopped, met friends and family, and built memories.
paras.zh: 几代人以来，加沙的街道、市场、学校、医院和公共场所构成了日常生活的背景。它们是人们工作、学习、购物、会见朋友和家人以及建立回忆的地方。

paras.en: Many of the city’s familiar landmarks also carried a much longer history, reflecting Gaza’s thousands of years as a crossroads of different civilisations.
paras.zh: 这座城市的许多熟悉的地标也拥有更悠久的历史，反映了加沙数千年来作为不同文明十字路口的历史。

paras.en: The war has also changed the face of Gaza by damaging or destroying many of those historic and recognisable landmarks.

UNESCO has verified damage to 164 cultural sites since October 2023, including 128 buildings of historical or artistic interest, 14 religious sites, nine monuments, eight archaeological sites, two museums and three depositories of movable cultural property.
paras.zh: 自2023年10月以来，教科文组织已核实164处文化遗址遭到破坏，其中包括128处具有历史或艺术价值的建筑、14处宗教场所、9处纪念碑、8处考古遗址、2处博物馆和3处可移动文化财产存放处。

paras.en: Among them are the Great Omari Mosque, Gaza’s oldest mosque, Qasr al-Basha, the ancient Samaritan Bathhouse, al-Qissariya Market and the Church of Saint Porphyrius complex.
paras.zh: 其中包括奥马里大清真寺、加沙最古老的清真寺、Qasr al-Basha、古老的撒玛利亚浴室、al-Qissariya 市场和圣波菲里乌斯教堂建筑群。

paras.en: Some of these places have been reduced to ruins, while others remain standing but heavily damaged. The destruction has altered not only individual buildings but the streets and neighbourhoods around them, removing landmarks that once helped people recognise and navigate their city.
paras.zh: 其中一些地方已成为废墟，而另一些地方仍然矗立，但遭到严重破坏。破坏不仅改变了个别建筑物，也改变了它们周围的街道和社区，消除了曾经帮助人们识别和导航城市的地标。

paras.en: This photo series contrasts archive images of some of Gaza’s most recognisable streets, markets and public buildings with new photographs taken three years into the war, showing how these familiar places have changed after years of bombardment and destruction.
paras.zh: 该照片系列将加沙一些最知名的街道、市场和公共建筑的档案图像与战争三年后拍摄的新照片进行了对比，展示了这些熟悉的地方在多年的轰炸和破坏后发生了怎样的变化。

articles.title: How October 7 changed Lebanon and Hezbollah’s political reality

paras.en: Beirut, Lebanon – A day after the October 7, 2023, attack on Israel and the beginning of Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza, Hezbollah made the decision to join the war, in what it said was support of the Palestinian people. It is a decision that analysts say has forever shaped Lebanese politics.

Experts said the group had underestimated the depth of Israel’s intelligence penetration in the run-up to the war, which later manifested in the bloody September 2024 pager attack and the assassination of much of Hezbollah’s leadership, including Secretary-General Hassan Nasrallah.

“Hezbollah got sucked into a vortex which culminated in the decapitation of their leadership and the invasion of south Lebanon,” Nicholas Blanford, a non-resident senior fellow at the Atlantic Council and author of a book about Hezbollah, told Al Jazeera. “That dealt Hezbollah a major blow to their popular standing and galvanised the election of Joseph Aoun as president and the formation of a new government that took a much stronger line against [the group].”

Hezbollah’s decisions have left the group politically weakened. And while analysts say the group has not been defeated, despite claims to the contrary from some critics, it is no longer the political or military hegemon in Lebanon it once was.

Before October 7, Hezbollah – a group representing Lebanon’s large Shia community – was the strongest political and military actor inside the country. The Iranian-backed group’s influence stretched across the region. Hezbollah was a key ally of the al-Assad regime in Syria and helped it retake territory from anti-Assad opposition groups. It also had connections with allies in places such as Iraq and Yemen.

Hezbollah had key electoral influence in Lebanon, where it often wielded its power to elect or collapse governments. It was also not against deploying its supporters against movements opposed to it, as in 2019 when they took to the streets of Beirut to beat back protesters calling for political reform of the country’s sectarian system, in which Hezbollah has become a key player in the years since the end of Lebanon’s 15-year civil war in 1990.

In the months leading up to October 2023, Hezbollah’s confidence was on clear display. Blanford pointed to examples such as a military parade in south Lebanon conducted by Hezbollah, and the group erecting tents in the Shebaa Farms – on territory that Lebanon considers occupied by Israel.

At the time, Israel was roiled by protests, and Nasrallah was delivering speeches predicting the imminent doom of Israel. The decision to join the fight against Israel in what became known in Lebanon as the War of Support came on October 8, 2023.

“October 7 set in motion a chain of events that Lebanon’s political system was not properly prepared to manage,” Jad Dilati, a political analyst from Nabatieh in southern Lebanon, told Al Jazeera. “Hezbollah opened its support front for Gaza on October 8 completely unilaterally, without any cabinet decision or governmental consensus or even taking into account the positions of the southern [Lebanese] residents who were most affected and still are most affected by these actions.”

“Hezbollah opened the support front on October 8, genuinely believing that it was operating from a position of strength,” Dilati said. “Most of the South believed that Hezbollah was operating from a position of strength after it had spent years building precision missile capabilities, an elaborate tunnel network and these missiles that we were told can hit every building in Tel Aviv.”

For the next 11 months, Israel and Hezbollah traded attacks, albeit with Israel hitting Lebanon more than five times for every Hezbollah attack. Tens of thousands from southern Lebanon and northern Israel fled their homes.

But in September 2024, Israel unilaterally intensified attacks. The Israeli-induced carnage came quickly and heavily, with nearly 500 people killed on September 23 alone. When Nasrallah was said to have accepted a ceasefire – according to Lebanese officials quoted in media reports – Israel ordered his assassination and the evacuation of areas of Beirut’s southern suburbs.
“When Nasrallah was amenable to a ceasefire, Israel was on the offensive and wasn’t going to return to the previous status quo,” Blanford said.

Israel invaded southern Lebanon in October 2024 and stayed in Lebanese territory for more than two months after a ceasefire was agreed in November. Despite the ceasefire, Israel continued to destroy homes and infrastructure in southern Lebanon and refused to pull its troops out of five locations on Lebanese territory. Next door in Syria, the fall of the al-Assad regime in December 2024 also dealt a blow to the group, as its land routes to receive weapons and funding from Iran were disrupted.

Over the next 14 months, Israel violated the ceasefire more than 10,000 times. Then in March 2026, Israel reintensified its war on Lebanon. The attacks came after Hezbollah fired rockets at Israel for the first time in more than a year as a response to the myriad ceasefire violations and the assassination of Iran’s Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, whom Hezbollah viewed as a religious and political leader.

Israel then invaded Lebanon again and launched widespread attacks on the country. It has killed more than 9,000 people in Lebanon since 2024 and displaced more than 1.2 million people, emptying entire regions of the country.

Israel now occupies large swathes of Lebanese territory, stretching up to 10 kilometres (more than 6 miles) from the border at some points. Dozens of villages, once filled with agriculture and people, are now uninhabited piles of dust and rubble. Hundreds of thousands remain displaced.

This has had a massive impact on Lebanon. The World Bank says the country’s economy has contracted by more than 6 percent in 2026. After the 2024 conflict, the World Bank said Lebanon needed around $11bn for recovery and reconstruction. That figure is likely much higher now.
paras.zh: 这对黎巴嫩产生了巨大影响。世界银行表示，2026 年该国经济萎缩了 6% 以上。2024 年冲突后，世界银行表示，黎巴嫩需要约 110 亿美元用于恢复和重建。现在这个数字可能要高得多。

paras.en: In the aftermath of past wars against Israel, such as in 2006, Hezbollah was able to support much of its community and supporters. Providing social welfare has been key to the group’s ability to maintain popularity and belief among its constituents.

But since 2024, the Lebanese state, along with much of the international community, has been working to expand its own services. The state is also openly claiming it is working to disarm Hezbollah, despite the group’s objections, as part of a framework agreement with Israel.

“Hezbollah is in a legitimacy crisis that it has not faced before,” Dilati said. “I wouldn’t say that there is a rupture in the community or a complete political realignment, but a big part of the communities that supported it for decades are saying that Iran left them behind, the war was fought on their land for someone else’s interests, and that they don’t want wars anymore.”
Still, while grumbles against the group are growing louder, analysts said Hezbollah remains the most popular representative among Lebanon’s Shia Muslims.

“Hezbollah is providing for their needs by and large, and there is no alternative politically for the Shia community at the moment,” Blanford said. “What is binding them to Hezbollah is the fact that several hundred thousand Shias were booted out of their homes and are living in non-Shia areas where they do not feel particularly welcome, and this can create a sense of vulnerability that naturally makes them gravitate to Hezbollah as communal protection, rightly or wrongly.”

The group also maintains fighting capacity, and despite critics calling it a spent force, analysts and foreign diplomats say its weakness has been overstated. Much of the group’s future depends on the outcome of regional events, particularly regarding the US-Israeli war on Iran. But analysts said the status quo – in which the state is negotiating with Israel and trying to extend its influence across Lebanese territory, and Hezbollah adapts to waning domestic influence – could work against the group.
paras.zh: 该组织还保持着战斗能力，尽管批评者称其为强弩之末，但分析人士和外国外交官表示，其弱点被夸大了。该组织的未来在很大程度上取决于地区事件的结果，特别是美以对伊朗的战争。但分析人士表示，现状 — — 国家正在与以色列谈判并试图将其影响力扩大到整个黎巴嫩领土，而真主党正在适应国内影响力的减弱 — — 可能对该组织不利。

paras.en: “The key thing is this looks like a long occupation, and you may get a situation where people who have not only lost their home but lost their village, orchards, banana plantations, tobacco fields and the rest of it may think life was good before and may start blaming Hezbollah,” Blanford said.
paras.zh: 布兰福德说：“关键是这看起来像是一个长期的占领，你可能会遇到这样的情况：人们不仅失去了家园，还失去了村庄、果园、香蕉种植园、烟草田和其他地方，可能会认为以前的生活很美好，并可能开始指责真主党。”

articles.title: From Aden to Sanaa, Yemenis struggle to deal with soaring living costs

paras.en: Sanaa, Aden and Marib, Yemen – As fighting intensifies across Yemen between the government and the Houthis, millions of people are confronting another battle far from the front lines: the deteriorating living and economic conditions in the country.

With salaries for large segments of the workforce either unpaid or irregularly disbursed – and the prices of goods and services rising – Yemen’s economic struggles have been compounded by a divided banking system that has made moving money between different parts of the country increasingly complicated.

From Aden’s struggling shoppers to displaced families in Marib and unpaid public-sector workers in Sanaa, Yemenis are being forced to make difficult choices about what they can afford, and what they must go without.
In Aden, the internationally recognised Yemeni government’s interim capital in the south, the problem is not so much a shortage of goods in markets as people’s inability to afford them.
Salaries have failed to keep pace with the rising costs of food, rent, healthcare and transport, leaving workers with little money left over at the end of the month.
The consequences are evident in the smaller quantities and cheaper products that now make up shoppers’ baskets, and the decisions they are forced to make about what to cut back on.

Bushra Abdullah Abdulwarith is a government employee in Aden. She earns 78,000 Yemeni riyals ($50) a month at the black market exchange rate while typical household food costs in government-held areas run about 130,366 riyals ($83), according to estimates by the Yemen Economic Tracking Initiative. And that’s before she factors in the cost of rent, transport, healthcare and other household expenses.

The economic difficulties facing Yemenis like Bushra illustrate how more than a decade of war has devastated the economy. According to the World Bank, real GDP per capita has fallen by approximately 58 percent since 2015.

The fragmentation of Yemen’s monetary institutions between the government and the Houthis – who have operated their own institutions since seizing the capital, Sanaa, in 2014 – along with the disruption of oil exports, and declining international assistance have all contributed to the economic decline.

Bushra told Al Jazeera that rising prices have forced many households to give up almost all non-essential purchases and cut back on some expensive basics, particularly meat. Other families, she said, have resorted to buying food in smaller quantities, sometimes on credit or loans.
The impact of rising prices is reflected not only in economic figures but also in the way people shop.
Ayman al-Maqtari, who works at a shopping centre in Aden’s Mansoura district, said that his customers now rarely buy non-essential items.

When it comes to the essentials such as rice, sugar, flour, and cooking oil, he has noticed that customers size up the price of each item before putting it in their baskets. They are also buying smaller quantities, for example, opting for a 5kg (11 pound) over a 40kg (90 pound) bag of rice.
“Many people have come to live day by day, or week by week,” Ayman told Al Jazeera, adding that more families are buying on credit when they run out of money before the end of the month.
The decline in purchasing power is also affecting commercial activity.

Weak demand, retailers say, is particularly evident for items that households can put off buying, such as clothing and household goods. A growing share of family income is spent on food, rent, healthcare and transport.

The Yemeni government approved a 20 percent cost-of-living allowance in May for public-sector employees in an attempt to ease the pressure of rising prices. But the amount is calculated based on each employee’s base salary, rather than their total pay, meaning the actual increase is relatively small for many workers.

Bushra, the government employee in Aden, said the increase has done little to improve her family’s financial circumstances. She described the allowance as “a temporary painkiller that does not reflect the scale of the actual pressure on people’s living standards”.

Her experience is far from isolated. In early October, the World Food Programme said its latest monitoring in accessible government-controlled areas showed that 74 percent of households were unable to meet their basic food needs.

One of the places where the crisis is evident is Marib, a government-controlled city east of Sanaa that is home to hundreds of thousands of displaced people. The sharp increase in the population over the war years, in what was previously a provincial backwater, has led to pressure on the city’s housing, employment and public services.

Government employees in Marib see their salaries disappear within the first few days after being paid, labourers struggle to find more than a few days of work and displaced families are forced to choose between buying water and milk.
Salah al-Zuhaifi works for a government institution in Marib. He said the war has separated him from his parents, who live in Houthi-controlled territory.
Alone in Marib, al-Zuhaifi said that inflation had eroded much of his salary’s purchasing power.
“No matter how much you earn, it will not be enough to meet your needs,” he said.
Abu Mohammed Nasser al-Asbahi, another government employee, described a similar struggle.
He told Al Jazeera that he earns 400,000 riyals ($250) a month, but more than half of that goes towards his rent, leaving little for his other expenses.
“We don’t even get to the first one-third of the month before the salary is gone,” he said, explaining that his family spends the rest of the month relying on loans and credit from local shops.
The healthcare sector in Marib has also been affected by widespread household spending cuts.

Pharmacist Khaled Mohsen told Al Jazeera that the rising price of medicines has prompted many patients to decline parts of their prescribed treatment and purchase only what they consider most essential.
People with chronic illnesses, meanwhile, have increasingly begun reducing their medication doses to make their supplies last longer before having to buy more, which creates serious health risks.

Residents of Sanaa and other areas of Yemen’s populous northwest, controlled by the Houthis – an armed group also known as Ansar Allah (Arabic for Supporters of God) – since 2014, are also facing a worsening economic and cost-of-living crisis similar to that affecting Yemenis elsewhere in the country.

Several factors are driving the crisis, particularly unpaid public-sector salaries, declining purchasing power, rising prices for goods and services, and the continuing consequences of the division of Yemen’s currency and banking systems in the early years of the war.
Many public-sector employees in Houthi-controlled areas have gone years without receiving regular salaries, with some sectors only receiving limited payments or half-salaries at irregular intervals.
Even when payments are made, they cannot cover families’ basic needs amid the rising cost of living.

Meanwhile, private-sector workers and business owners face growing pressures as a result of declining economic activity, multiple fees and levies, and a shortage of employment opportunities. The conditions have undermined incomes and job security.

The Yemeni riyal’s exchange rate in Houthi-controlled Sanaa is more stable than in areas controlled by the government. The Houthis have imposed strict monetary controls, banning the circulation of newer banknotes printed by the Yemeni government, and have also enforced a largely fixed exchange rate.

However, that does not necessarily translate into stronger purchasing power. Markets face difficulties caused by cash shortages and the division between monetary and banking systems operating in different parts of the country, including increased costs for moving funds.
That directly affects the many households relying on domestic and international remittances.

For residents in Houthi-controlled areas, the result is an economy in which the currency may be relatively stable, but livelihoods are precarious. Years of unpaid salaries and limited employment opportunities have left many families struggling to afford basic necessities, with few options beyond borrowing, cutting spending or relying on support from relatives.

articles.title: Russian strikes on Ukraine's public buses leave 30 dead as blackouts worsen in Kyiv
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Russian strikes on Ukraine's public buses leave 30 dead as blackouts worsen in Kyiv

KYIV, Ukraine — A Russian-guided bomb exploded next to public buses filled with passengers in eastern Ukraine, authorities said Thursday, killing 30 people as part of a wave of attacks that also worsened power outages in the capital.
The morning attack occurred next to a bus stop in the war-torn city of Kramatorsk in Ukraine's Donetsk region, prompting public transport to be suspended in the area.

"There is no doubt that Russia is cynically targeting civilians," Oleksandr Honcharenko, head of the city's military administration, said, adding that the rescue effort had been hampered by subsequent Russian attacks using small drones.

Russia and Ukraine are locked in a long-range aerial war while their armies remain largely deadlocked on the front line, more than 4 1/2 years since Moscow's full-scale invasion. Russia has escalated its aerial attack in recent weeks, putting pressure on Ukraine as it prepares for winter and hitting the infrastructure keeping its war-battered economy afloat. Recent targets have included energy systems, key industries, railways, post offices, shopping centers, telecom networks, gas stations and grain exports.
