paras.en: The wee little Lit Hero is GoPro's smallest, lightest, cheapest action camera. It's my favorite GoPro for selfies thanks to the included light. The cluster of four LEDs next to the lens ensures this camera keeps you well-lit in every scene. The Lit Hero isn't quite as capable video-wise as the Hero 13 Black (also on sale, see below), but it can shoot 4K at 60 fps, and the battery held up for a respectable 101 minutes during my test (shooting a 4K 60 fps video). —Scott Gilbertson
paras.zh: 小巧的 Lit Hero 是 GoPro 最小、最轻、最便宜的运动相机。由于附带的灯，它是我最喜欢的自拍 GoPro。镜头旁边的四个 LED 灯组确保这款相机在每个场景中都能保持良好的照明。 Lit Hero 在视频方面的能力不如 Hero 13 Black（也在销售，见下文），但它可以以 60 fps 拍摄 4K，并且在我的测试中（拍摄 4K 60 fps 视频），电池续航时间长达 101 分钟。 ——斯科特·吉尔伯森

paras.en: The Theragun Relief is our budget Theragun pick, and during Prime Day, it’s an even cheaper buy. It’s an older 2023 model, but massage guns don’t need the latest features to be effective. You get three attachments and three speed settings, and it’s half the weight of the Pro Plus, making it much easier to pack for travel. I’ve seen the price drop even lower, but $120 is still a solid discount on one of our favorite percussive guns. —Boutayna Chokrane
paras.zh: Theragun Relief 是我们在 Theragun 的预算之选，在 Prime Day 期间，它的价格甚至更便宜。这是 2023 年的较旧型号，但按摩枪不需要最新功能即可发挥作用。您可以获得三个附件和三种速度设置，而且它的重量是 Pro Plus 的一半，使其更容易打包旅行。我见过价格降得更低，但对于我们最喜欢的一款冲击枪来说，120 美元仍然是一个不错的折扣。 ——布泰纳·乔克兰

paras.en: The Theragun Mini Plus is our favorite portable massage gun. It’s not only compact and TSA-approved, but it also features heat therapy. At $238, it’s at the lowest price I’ve seen, making this the ideal time to snag one if you were considering it. The Mini Plus is also compatible with the Cold Plus and Vibration Plus attachments, which are both sold separately. —Boutayna Chokrane
paras.zh: Theragun Mini Plus 是我们最喜欢的便携式按摩枪。它不仅结构紧凑且获得 TSA 批准，而且还具有热疗功能。售价 238 美元，是我见过的最低价格，如果你正在考虑的话，现在是入手的理想时机。 Mini Plus 还与 Cold Plus 和 Vibration Plus 附件兼容，这两种附件均单独出售。 ——布泰纳·乔克兰

paras.en: Smart scales can be tough to justify when they cost hundreds of dollars, but $69 off makes our top pick even easier to recommend. The Withings Body Comp is among the most advanced smart scales we’ve tested, with a companion app that can track data for up to eight users. It’s also meant to last a lifetime; WIRED reviewer Christopher Null has Withings info dating back to 2010 and plans to keep the streak going. —Boutayna Chokrane
paras.zh: 智能秤售价数百美元，很难证明其合理性，但 69 美元的折扣让我们的首选产品更容易推荐。 Withings Body Comp 是我们测试过的最先进的智能体重秤之一，其配套应用程序可以跟踪最多八个用户的数据。它也意味着可以持续一生； 《连线》评论员 Christopher Null 拥有可追溯到 2010 年的 Withings 信息，并计划继续保持这一势头。 ——布泰纳·乔克兰

articles.title: Chile’s ALMA observatory expands studies of star and planet formation

paras.en: Oct. 2 (UPI) -- The Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array in northern Chile, the world's largest and most advanced radio observatory, has expanded its ability to study how stars and planets form with new receivers that detect signals from cold gas clouds and dust particles involved in those processes.
paras.zh: 10 月 2 日（UPI）——位于智利北部的阿塔卡马大型毫米/亚毫米阵列是世界上最大、最先进的射电天文台，它利用新的接收器扩大了研究恒星和行星如何形成的能力，这些接收器可以检测来自参与这些过程的冷气体云和尘埃颗粒的信号。

paras.en: The observatory, known as ALMA introduced the technology with the start of Cycle 13, its latest research and observation period, which runs through Sept. 30, 2027. For the first time, scientists can use Band 2 receivers during a regular observation cycle, according to an observatory announcement.
paras.zh: 被称为 ALMA 的天文台在第 13 周期开始时引入了这项技术，这是其最新的研究和观测周期，一直持续到 2027 年 9 月 30 日。根据天文台的公告，科学家第一次可以在常规观测周期中使用频段 2 接收器。

paras.en: Band 2 receivers are ALMA's new ultra‑sensitive detectors for the 67-116 GHz range, and they're important because they open a fresh window on cold interstellar gas, letting astronomers study how stars and galaxies form with far greater detail and speed.
paras.zh: Band 2 接收器是 ALMA 的新型超灵敏探测器，频率范围为 67-116 GHz，它们很重要，因为它们打开了了解冷星际气体的新窗口，让天文学家能够以更详细、更快的速度研究恒星和星系的形成方式。

paras.en: "One of the most distinctive capabilities of Band 2 is access to numerous spectral lines from deuterated molecules, which contain a heavy form of hydrogen," ALMA scientist John Carpenter told UPI.
paras.zh: ALMA 科学家约翰·卡彭特 (John Carpenter) 告诉合众国际社：“Band 2 最独特的功能之一是获取来自氘化分子的大量谱线，其中含有重氢。”

paras.en: These molecules are particularly abundant in the coldest and densest regions of interstellar clouds before stars form. Their signals allow astronomers to examine the physical and chemical conditions during the earliest stages of star formation, Carpenter said.
paras.zh: 在恒星形成之前，这些分子在星际云中最冷和最密集的区域特别丰富。卡彭特说，它们的信号使天文学家能够检查恒星形成最早阶段的物理和化学条件。

paras.en: Situated on the Chajnantor Plateau in Chile's Atacama Desert, ALMA uses more than 50 antennas working together to detect radiation at millimeter and submillimeter wavelengths. These signals, invisible to the human eye, allow scientists to study cold gas and dust in space.
paras.zh: ALMA 位于智利阿塔卡马沙漠的查南托高原，使用 50 多个天线协同工作来检测毫米和亚毫米波长的辐射。这些肉眼看不见的信号使科学家能够研究太空中的冷气体和尘埃。

paras.en: Stars form from clouds of gas and dust. As gravity causes the material to contract, a disk can develop around a growing young star, providing the environment in which planets take shape, according to ALMA.
paras.zh: 恒星是由气体和尘埃云形成的。 ALMA 表示，当重力导致物质收缩时，一个正在成长的年轻恒星周围就会形成一个圆盘，为行星的形成提供环境。

paras.en: Astronomer Lucas Cieza, a researcher at Diego Portales University's Institute of Astrophysical Studies who will participate in Cycle 13, said Band 2 covers wavelengths between 2.6 and 4.5 millimeters, making it particularly sensitive to emissions from dust grains that can help scientists understand the earliest stages of planet formation.
paras.zh: 将参加第 13 周期的天文学家、迭戈波塔莱斯大学天体物理研究所研究员卢卡斯·西扎 (Lucas Cieza) 表示，波段 2 覆盖了 2.6 至 4.5 毫米之间的波长，使其对尘埃颗粒的发射特别敏感，可以帮助科学家了解行星形成的最早阶段。

paras.en: "We're talking about macroscopic objects, about the size of a grain of rice," Cieza told UPI.
paras.zh: “我们谈论的是宏观物体，大约是一粒米的大小，”西扎告诉合众国际社。

paras.en: The telescope's receivers detect different frequency ranges. Band 2 covers frequencies that ALMA's other receivers cannot detect, Carpenter said.
paras.zh: 望远镜的接收器检测不同的频率范围。卡彭特说，频段 2 涵盖了 ALMA 的其他接收器无法检测到的频率。

paras.en: Cieza noted that while other telescopes, including Mexico's Large Millimeter Telescope, or LMT, and the U.S. Green Bank Telescope, or GBT, can observe at the same wavelengths, neither approaches ALMA's technical capabilities.
paras.zh: Cieza 指出，虽然其他望远镜，包括墨西哥的大型毫米望远镜（LMT）和美国的格林班克望远镜（GBT）可以在相同的波长下进行观测，但两者都无法达到 ALMA 的技术能力。

paras.en: "The LMT and GBT are single-dish telescopes, measuring 50 and 100 meters in diameter, respectively. ALMA is an interferometer with more than 50 antennas that can be separated by distances of up to 16 kilometers, allowing it to obtain images with hundreds of times more detail than other telescopes," he said.
paras.zh: “LMT和GBT是单口径望远镜，直径分别为50米和100米。ALMA是干涉仪，拥有50多个天线，天线间隔距离可达16公里，使其能够获得比其他望远镜多数百倍细节的图像。”他说。

paras.en: According to ALMA, the new equipment completes the 10 receiver bands originally planned for the observatory.
paras.zh: 据ALMA称，新设备补充了天文台原计划的10个接收频段。

paras.en: Sebastián Espinosa, an astrostatistician and professor at Chile's University of the Andes, said ALMA has already revealed rings and other structures that help researchers understand how material accumulates and how planets begin to form.
paras.zh: 智利安第斯大学天体统计学家兼教授塞巴斯蒂安·埃斯皮诺萨 (Sebastián Espinosa) 表示，ALMA 已经揭示了环和其他结构，帮助研究人员了解物质如何积累以及行星如何开始形成。

paras.en: The new receivers will allow scientists to investigate cold gas and the chemistry of environments where planets develop.
paras.zh: 新的接收器将使科学家能够研究冷气体和行星形成环境的化学成分。

paras.en: "Each new signal can help complete a story that we previously understood only partially," Espinosa said.
paras.zh: 埃斯皮诺萨说：“每个新信号都可以帮助完成我们之前仅部分了解的故事。”

paras.en: The technology will also help researchers study distant galaxies. As the universe expands, light from galaxies shifts toward lower frequencies. The new receivers broaden the range in which ALMA can detect signals from molecular gas in those galaxies, Carpenter said.
paras.zh: 该技术还将帮助研究人员研究遥远的星系。随着宇宙的膨胀，来自星系的光会向较低频率移动。卡彭特说，新的接收器扩大了 ALMA 探测这些星系中分子气体信号的范围。

paras.en: "This will help astronomers measure the distances to galaxies and study how the gas that fuels star formation has evolved over time," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“这将有助于天文学家测量到星系的距离，并研究为恒星形成提供燃料的气体如何随着时间的推移而演化。”

paras.en: U.S.-based researchers will help lead major projects during Cycle 13. North American teams received approximately 34% of the available observing time, Carpenter said.
paras.zh: 美国研究人员将在第 13 周期期间帮助领导重大项目。卡彭特说，北美团队获得了大约 34% 的可用观测时间。

paras.en: Their 89 approved high-priority proposals account for about 1,400 hours of observations using ALMA's 12-meter antenna array.
paras.zh: 他们批准的 89 项高优先级提案涉及使用 ALMA 12 米天线阵列进行的约 1,400 小时的观测。

paras.en: The largest approved program will devote approximately 200 hours to studying a region beyond the Milky Way that has already been extensively observed by the Hubble and James Webb space telescopes and other facilities. Alexandra Pope of the University of Massachusetts-Amherst is one of the project's principal investigators.
paras.zh: 批准的最大项目将投入大约 200 个小时来研究银河系以外的区域，该区域已经被哈勃和詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜和其他设施广泛观测过。马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校的亚历山德拉·波普 (Alexandra Pope) 是该项目的主要研究员之一。

paras.en: Another major program, led in part by principal investigator Luca Ricci of California State University, will dedicate about 100 hours to studying disks around young stars. Researchers will measure the amount, size and distribution of dust to understand how the building blocks of planets evolve, Carpenter said.
paras.zh: 加州州立大学首席研究员卢卡·里奇(Luca Ricci)部分领导的另一个重大项目将投入约 100 个小时来研究年轻恒星周围的圆盘。卡彭特说，研究人员将测量尘埃的数量、大小和分布，以了解行星的组成部分是如何演化的。

paras.en: Astronomers submitted a record 1,839 proposals for Cycle 13, requesting 37,471 hours of observation time on the 12-meter array, or 8.7 times the time initially available. ALMA awarded its highest-priority rankings to 229 research proposals.
paras.zh: 天文学家为第 13 周期提交了创纪录的 1,839 份提案，要求在 12 米阵列上进行 37,471 小时的观测时间，是最初可用时间的 8.7 倍。 ALMA 将最高优先级排名授予了 229 项研究提案。

paras.en: Espinosa said limited observing time makes it essential to assess how much information each measurement provides and how accurately it can determine the properties being studied.
paras.zh: 埃斯皮诺萨表示，有限的观测时间使得评估每次测量提供的信息量以及确定所研究特性的准确度至关重要。

paras.en: "High demand creates intense competition for available observing hours, forcing careful selection of projects, and some valuable research may be left out or have to wait until another cycle," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“高需求造成了对可用观测时间的激烈竞争，迫使我们仔细选择项目，一些有价值的研究可能会被排除在外，或者必须等到另一个周期。”

paras.en: Cieza noted that the high demand excludes worthwhile projects and forces some research teams to reapply over several years.
paras.zh: Cieza 指出，高需求排除了有价值的项目，并迫使一些研究团队在几年内重新申请。

paras.en: "The good news is that all ALMA data eventually become public. The observatory's archive already contains an enormous amount of data available to the international scientific community," he said.
paras.zh: “好消息是所有 ALMA 数据最终都会公开。天文台的档案已经包含了可供国际科学界使用的大量数据，”他说。

articles.title: Labor Department to block visas for Microsoft, Adobe, universities

paras.en: Oct. 8 (UPI) -- The Department of Labor Thursday announced it would suspend Microsoft and Adobe from the U.S. "green card" Permanent Labor Certification program as the Trump administration continues a crackdown on foreign labor.
paras.zh: 10 月 8 日（UPI）——随着特朗普政府继续打压外籍劳工，美国劳工部周四宣布，将暂停微软和 Adob​​e 的美国“绿卡”永久劳工认证计划。

paras.en: Labor Secretary Keith Sonderling said the department also won't accept or process any new green card applications under the program for Cognizant, Infosys, Capgemini, Tata, Wipro and HCL.
paras.zh: 劳工部长 Keith Sonderling 表示，该部门也不会根据该计划接受或处理 Cognizant、Infosys、Capgemini、Tata、Wipro 和 HCL 的任何新绿卡申请。

paras.en: Sonderling said Adobe and Microsoft were also suspended "due to multiple active federal investigations."
paras.zh: 桑德林表示，“由于多项正在进行的联邦调查”，Adobe 和微软也被暂停。

paras.en: "Since 2009, just these companies alone have requested almost 3 million foreign workers. They've received over 230,000 H-1B visa approvals and over 100,000 permanent labor certifications. That's hundreds of thousands of jobs that were taken from American workers," Sonderling said.
paras.zh: “自 2009 年以来，仅这些公司就需要近 300 万外国工人。他们已获得超过 23 万份 H-1B 签证批准和超过 10 万份永久劳工证。这相当于从美国工人手中抢走了数十万个工作岗位，”桑德林说。

paras.en: "The Department of Labor is taking historic action by shutting down the pipeline of systemic fraud," he said at a press conference while appearing with Vice President JD Vance, who is in charge of the White House's anti-fraud efforts.
paras.zh: “劳工部正在采取历史性行动，关闭系统性欺诈渠道，”他在新闻发布会上表示，同时与负责白宫反欺诈工作的副总统万斯一起出席。

paras.en: Vance mentioned Microsoft's 6,000 layoffs in 2025, asserting the company "replaced" those workers with foreign workers on H-1B visas.
paras.zh: 万斯提到微软将在 2025 年裁员 6,000 人，并声称该公司用持有 H-1B 签证的外国工人“取代”了这些工人。

paras.en: "So, we're going to continue to support Microsoft and have a great relationship with Microsoft, but we're also going to deny them the ability to apply for these permanent residencies until they show that they are going to get serious about putting American workers first," Vance said.
paras.zh: 万斯说：“因此，我们将继续支持微软并与微软保持良好的关系，但我们也将拒绝他们申请这些永久居留权，直到他们表明他们将认真对待将美国工人放在第一位。”

paras.en: Microsoft, however, pushed back on those accusations, arguing that the "vast majority" of its employees in the United States are Americans and that 80% of its applications to the H-1B visa program last year were to extend or change the status of existing employees.
paras.zh: 然而，微软反驳了这些指控，称其在美国的“绝大多数”员工都是美国人，去年其 H-1B 签证计划的申请中有 80% 是为了延长或改变现有员工的身份。

paras.en: "Microsoft only files H-1B petitions for those who meet the rigorous standards of this visa category," a company said in a blog post. "We pay our employees some of the highest compensation in the tech sector, and our wages are among the highest of all H-1B filings. We pay our H-1B employees the same as any other employees doing comparable work."
paras.zh: 一家公司在博客文章中表示：“微软只为那些符合该签证类别严格标准的人提交 H-1B 申请。” “我们向员工支付的薪酬是科技行业中最高的，而且我们的工资是所有 H-1B 申请中最高的。我们向 H-1B 员工支付的工资与从事类似工作的任何其他员工相同。”

paras.en: At the same event, Labor Department Inspector General Anthony D'Esposito announced an investigation into "visa fraud involving nine major American universities."
paras.zh: 在同一活动中，劳工部监察长安东尼·德斯波西托宣布对“涉及美国九所主要大学的签证欺诈行为”进行调查。

paras.en: He listed the University of Pittsburgh, Harvard University, Stanford University, Brown University, the University of California at Davis, the California Institute of Technology, Arizona State University and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.
paras.zh: 他列出了匹兹堡大学、哈佛大学、斯坦福大学、布朗大学、加州大学戴维斯分校、加州理工学院、亚利桑那州立大学和麻省理工学院。

paras.en: "Subpoenas have been served, investigations are underway and nobody will be getting a free pass because their name is carved into an expensive building," D'Esposito said.
paras.zh: 德斯波西托说：“传票已经送达，调查正在进行中，没有人会获得免费通行证，因为他们的名字被刻在一座昂贵的建筑上。”

paras.en: At the same summit where Sonderling and Vance made the announcement, President Donald Trump is scheduled to award the National Medal of Science to Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella and other tech leaders.
paras.zh: 在桑德林和万斯宣布这一消息的同一峰会上，唐纳德·特朗普总统计划将国家科学奖章授予微软首席执行官萨蒂亚·纳德拉和其他科技领袖。

paras.en: Nadella is from India and came to the United States in 1988. He was hired at Microsoft in 1992.
paras.zh: 纳德拉来自印度，1988 年来到美国。1992 年受聘于微软。

articles.title: Man accused in Cornell rape case seeks New York AG' James' removal

paras.en: Oct. 8 (UPI) -- Lawyers for one of the seven men accused of raping a former Cornell University student in 2024 are seeking to block the appointment of New York Attorney General Letitia James as a special prosecutor in the case.
paras.zh: 10 月 8 日（UPI）——被指控在 2024 年强奸一名康奈尔大学前学生的七名男子之一的律师正在寻求阻止任命纽约总检察长利蒂蒂亚·詹姆斯为本案特别检察官。

paras.en: In a court filing in Albany County Supreme Court on Wednesday, Gillio Lopes' attorneys said James should be removed as special prosecutor because she "unequivocally demonstrated a bias and presumption of guilt against the defendants named in the Civil Case."
paras.zh: 周三，在奥尔巴尼县最高法院提交的一份法庭文件中，吉利奥·洛佩斯的律师表示，詹姆斯应该被解除特别检察官的职务，因为她“明确表现出对民事案件中指定被告的偏见和有罪推定”。

paras.en: Lopes has denied he sexually assaulted the woman, who has sued him and six other men she accuses of "gang rape" at an on-campus fraternity house, as well as the university.
paras.zh: 洛佩斯否认他对这名女子进行了性侵犯，这名女子已起诉他和另外六名男子，指控他们在校内兄弟会会所以及大学进行“轮奸”。

paras.en: The woman, who is identified only as Jane Doe in court documents, filed a civil lawsuit last month, alleging she "was plied with alcohol and drugs to the point of intoxication" at the Chi Phi fraternity house and sexually assaulted and raped by members of the fraternity over about seven hours starting the night of Oct. 19, 2024.
paras.zh: 法庭文件中仅显示这名女子的名字为无名氏 (Jane Doe)，她上个月提起民事诉讼，指控她在 Chi Phi 兄弟会之家“酗酒和吸毒直至中毒”，并从 2024 年 10 月 19 日晚上开始，在大约七个小时的时间里遭到该兄弟会成员的性侵犯和强奸。

paras.en: No charges have been filed in the case so far.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，该案尚未受到任何指控。

paras.en: The Article 78 petition, which was also filed against Gov. Kathy Hochul, is used to challenge actions by state or local agencies or officials in the state.
paras.zh: 第 78 条请愿书也是针对州长 Kathy Hochul 提出的，用于质疑州或地方机构或州内官员的行为。

paras.en: Hochul last week tasked James with reopening an investigation into the woman's allegations, saying she did not have faith in Tompkins County District Attorney Matthew Von Houten to lead the inquiry.
paras.zh: 霍楚尔上周责成詹姆斯重新启动对这名妇女的指控的调查，称她对汤普金斯县地方检察官马修·冯·豪顿领导调查不抱信心。

paras.en: Tompkins County said last week it reopened its criminal investigation into the allegations.
paras.zh: 汤普金斯县上周表示，已重新启动对这些指控的刑事调查。

paras.en: Lopes' attorneys pointed to a social media post by James on Sept. 28 where she wrote in the days before she was named special prosecutor: "What this young woman has been forced to endure is horrific and unacceptable. I'm holding her in my heart and in my prayers. To her, and to all survivors: you're not alone. We stand with you."
paras.zh: 洛佩斯的律师指出，詹姆斯9月28日在社交媒体上发布的帖子中，她在被任命为特别检察官之前的几天里写道：“这位年轻女子被迫忍受的事情是可怕和不可接受的。我在心里为她祈祷。对她和所有幸存者来说：你并不孤单。我们与你站在一起。”

paras.en: James "believes the allegations made by Jane Doe, and that she has already reached the conclusion that Petitioner and the other named Defendants are guilty," the attorneys said.
paras.zh: 律师表示，詹姆斯“相信无名氏的指控，并且她已经得出申请人和其他指定被告有罪的结论”。

paras.en: James' office declined comment on the filing. After she was named special prosecutor on Oct. 1, James said in a statement the investigation would be conducted "fully and fairly."
paras.zh: 詹姆斯的办公室拒绝对这份文件发表评论。 10 月 1 日，詹姆斯被任命为特别检察官后，她在一份声明中表示，调查将“全面、公平”地进行。

articles.title: Mariska Hargitay Praises Taylor Swift’s Acting — and ‘Best Cookies’ — on Emmys ‘SVU’ Set
articles.author: Hannah Dailey

paras.en: Mariska Hargitay says that working with Taylor Swift on the set of their Emmys Law & Order: SVU sketch was sweet — literally and figuratively.
paras.zh: 玛莉丝卡·哈吉泰 (Mariska Hargitay) 表示，与泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift) 在艾美奖《法律与秩序：SVU》小品的拍摄现场合作非常甜蜜——无论是字面上还是比喻上。

paras.en: While speaking to People for a story published Wednesday (Oct. 7), the actress opened up about what it was like to have the pop superstar join her in the SVU universe. After playing Capt. Olivia Benson on the drama series for going into 28 seasons, she and her costars welcomed in “rookie” Det. Swift to help solve a mystery in a spoof that aired during Hargitay’s debut hosting stint at the 2026 award show.
paras.zh: 在接受《人物》杂志周三（10 月 7 日）发表的一篇报道时，这位女演员畅谈了这位流行巨星加入她的 SVU 宇宙的感受。在连续剧 28 季中饰演奥利维亚·本森上尉后，她和她的搭档迎来了“新秀”探员。斯威夫特帮助解开了 Hargitay 首次主持 2026 年颁奖典礼期间播出的恶搞节目中的谜团。

paras.en: But the 14-time Grammy winner’s baking skills weren’t the only highlight of getting Swift involved in the segment. “We just had such a great time,” Hargitay said. “It was so cozy and familiar, and she’s such a pro, and she was such a great sport to do anything and everything.”
paras.zh: 但这位 14 届格莱美奖得主的烘焙技巧并不是让斯威夫特参与这一领域的唯一亮点。 “我们度过了一段美好的时光，”哈吉泰说。 “这里是如此舒适和熟悉，她是如此专业，她是一项伟大的运动，可以做任何事情。”

paras.en: “She’s such a good actor and so charming and charismatic,” she added. “It was such a thrill for everybody — not only obviously me and the cast, but for everybody, the entire crew. She is extraordinary.”
paras.zh: “她是一位非常优秀的演员，非常有魅力，很有魅力，”她补充道。 “这对每个人来说都是一种兴奋——不仅是我和演员们，而且对每个人，整个工作人员来说。她是非凡的。”

paras.en: Aside from the pre-filmed cameo, Swift wasn’t present at the 2026 Emmys. The question of whether she would attend was actually the subject of the meta SVU skit; Benson and her team attempted to crack the case using “Swiftie” logic, but only after the Eras headliner appeared to help them did they finally conclude she’d be busy supporting Travis Kelce at the Kansas City Chiefs game the night of the ceremony.
paras.zh: 除了预先拍摄的客串之外，斯威夫特没有出席 2026 年艾美奖颁奖典礼。她是否会参加的问题实际上是元 SVU 短剧的主题；本森和她的团队试图用“Swiftie”逻辑来破案，但只有在这位时代头条新闻似乎帮助了他们之后，他们才最终得出结论，她将忙于在仪式当晚堪萨斯城酋长队的比赛中支持特拉维斯·凯尔斯。

paras.en: “Well, that case is solved: Taylor Swift will not be at the Emmys,” Hargitay said at the end of the spoof, to which Swift said cheekily, “Maybe she’s gonna do one of those cool pre-taped sketch things to support the host.”
paras.zh: “好吧，这个案子已经解决了：泰勒·斯威夫特不会参加艾美奖了，”哈吉泰在恶搞结束时说道，斯威夫特厚颜无耻地说，“也许她会做一些很酷的预先录制的小品来支持主持人。”

paras.en: Swift also used the skit as an opportunity to drop some Easter eggs, which ended up teasing The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore, a deluxe edition of her 2025 album that dropped at the end of September and featured four new tracks: Billboard Hot 100-topper “Patient Zero,” “Pink Clouding,” “Babylon” and “Cleveland!”
paras.zh: 斯威夫特还利用这个短剧作为机会掉落了一些复活节彩蛋，最终戏弄了她的 2025 年专辑的豪华版《The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore》，该专辑于 9 月底推出，其中收录了四首新曲目：Billboard 热门 100 首歌曲《零号病人》、《粉红云》、《巴比伦》和《克利夫兰！》

articles.title: Cardi B Cancels BZR WKND Jamaica Headlining Set, ‘Appreciates the Love & Support From Her Fans in Jamaica’
articles.author: Katie Atkinson

paras.en: Cardi B is no longer performing at BZR WKND Jamaica this month, her rep told Billboard on Thursday (Oct. 8).
paras.zh: Cardi B 的代表周四（10 月 8 日）告诉 Billboard，本月她将不​​再在 BZR WKND 牙买加演出。

paras.en: The “AH HA” rapper was slated to hit the stage Oct. 18 and deliver the headlining set for BZR WKND Jamaica, a four-day festival celebrating music, culture, food, tourism, fashion and entertainment. Bardi would have taken over Kingston’s National Stadium, the same venue Vybz Kartel sold out for his post-incarceration comeback concert on New Year’s Eve 2024.
paras.zh: 这位“AH HA”说唱歌手定于 10 月 18 日登上舞台，并为 BZR WKND 牙买加带来头条新闻，这是一个为期四天的节日，旨在庆祝音乐、文化、美食、旅游、时尚和娱乐。巴尔迪将接管金斯敦的国家体育场，Vybz Kartel 在 2024 年新年前夜举办的出狱后复出演唱会的门票已售罄。

paras.en: “Cardi B will not be performing at BZR WKND Jamaica on October 18, 2026,” reads a statement from Cardi’s reps to Billboard. “Cardi appreciates the love and support from her fans in Jamaica and hopes to see them in the future. For information regarding the status of BZR WKND Jamaica, ticketing, or other event-related matters, please contact the event organizers directly. Any information regarding Cardi B and her future performances will be communicated exclusively through Cardi B’s official channels.”
paras.zh: “Cardi B 将不会于 2026 年 10 月 18 日在牙买加 BZR WKND 演出，”Cardi 的代表在给 Billboard 的一份声明中写道。 “Cardi感谢牙买加粉丝的喜爱和支持，希望将来能见到他们。有关BZR WKND牙买加的状态、票务或其他活动相关事宜的信息，请直接联系活动组织者。任何有关Cardi B及其未来表演的信息都将通过Cardi B的官方渠道独家传达。”

paras.en: At press time, event organizers have not returned Billboard’s request for comment.
paras.zh: 截至发稿，活动组织者尚未回复 Billboard 的置评请求。

paras.en: Last week (Sept. 28), Billboard exclusively revealed that Grammy-nominated dancehall superstar Spice would host this year’s BZR WKND Jamaica, with additional performers including Grammy-nominated R&B star Keyshia Cole and dancehall artists Malie Donn, Ding Dong, Stalk Ashley, Shaneil Muir and DJ MAC.
paras.zh: 上周（9月28日），Billboard独家透露格莱美提名舞厅巨星Spice将主持今年的BZR WKND牙买加，其他表演者包括格莱美提名R&B明星Keyshia Cole和舞厅艺术家Malie Donn、Ding Dong、Stalk Ashley、Shaneil Muir和DJ MAC。

paras.en: Cardi’s BZR WKND appearance would have followed this year’s wildly successful Little Miss Drama Tour, which grossed more than $70 million and sold 453,000 tickets across Feb. 11-April 18, according to Billboard Boxscore. The “ErrTime” rapper launched her North American trek — her first proper string of live shows in seven years — in support of her 2025 Am I the Drama? LP, which debuted atop the Billboard 200 and spawned Billboard Hot 100 top 40 hits like “Outside” (No. 10), the Kehlani-assisted “Ring” (No. 28) and “Magnet” (No. 37).
paras.zh: Cardi 的 BZR WKND 演出是在今年大获成功的 Little Miss Drama Tour 巡演之后进行的，根据 Billboard Boxscore 的数据，该巡演在 2 月 11 日至 4 月 18 日期间票房收入超过 7,000 万美元，售出 453,000 张门票。这位“ErrTime”说唱歌手开启了她的北美之旅，这是她七年来第一次正式的现场表演，以支持她的 2025 年《我是戏剧吗？》 LP 首次亮相就登上了 Billboard 200 的榜首，并催生了 Billboard Hot 100 前 40 名热门单曲，如《Outside》（第 10 位）、Kehlani 协助的《Ring》（第 28 位）和《Magnet》（第 37 位）。

paras.en: Recently, Bardi has been enjoying Milan Fashion Week, where she attended Gucci’s “The Store Show” presentation. Last month, she won her fifth career Moon Person at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards for “Safe” in the best hip-hop category. Cardi has had quite the year at awards shows, with a trio of wins at May’s American Music Awards and her best female hip-hop artist triumph at June’s BET Awards. Notably, she also confirmed to The Breakfast Club that she’s already working on her third album, which she expects to release next year.
paras.zh: 最近，Bardi 很享受米兰时装周，她参加了 Gucci 的“The Store Show”发布会。上个月，她凭借《Safe》在 2026 年 MTV 音乐录影带奖最佳嘻哈类别中第五次获得职业生涯 Moon Person 奖。卡迪在颁奖典礼上度过了相当不错的一年，她在 5 月的全美音乐奖中获得三项大奖，并在 6 月的 BET 奖中获得最佳嘻哈女歌手奖。值得注意的是，她还向早餐俱乐部证实，她已经在制作第三张专辑，预计将于明年发行。

articles.title: Every Billboard Latin Music Week 2026 Showcase: Jay Wheeler, Zhamira, Fuerza Regida, Santos Bravos & More
articles.author: Jessica Roiz

paras.en: Miami is gearing up for an eventful 2026 Billboard Latin Music Week, returning to the Faena Forum from Oct. 19 to 22.
paras.zh: 迈阿密正在为 2026 年公告牌拉丁音乐周做准备，将于 10 月 19 日至 22 日重返 Faena Forum。

paras.en: More than 25 artist and industry panels are confirmed, including the coveted Superstar Q&As that this year include intimate and candid conversations with Anuel AA, Becky G, Fuerza Regida, Kany García, Maluma, Pitbull, and Ruben Blades.
paras.zh: 超过 25 名艺术家和行业小组已得到确认，其中包括今年令人垂涎的超级明星问答，其中包括与 Anuel AA、Becky G、Fuerza Regida、Kany García、Maluma、Pitbull 和 Ruben Blades 的亲密而坦诚的对话。

paras.en: Amongst the many speakers are Rawayana, who will talk about their massive touring year with ¿Dónde es el after?; Trueno, Quevedo & Kidd Voodoo, who will speak on the new urban movement; and for the first time, a panel on reparto music, featuring Cuba’s hottest music stars Bebeshito, Wow Popy, DJ Conds, Rey Tony and Helabusador. As well as the popular franchises such as the Women’s and Regional Mexican panels.
paras.zh: Rawayana 是众多演讲者中的一员，她将谈论他们与“Dónde es el after”的大规模巡演。 Trueno、Quevedo 和 Kidd Voodoo 将就新城市运动发表演讲；首次举办了 Reparto 音乐小组，邀请了古巴最热门的音乐明星 Bebeshito、Wow Popy、DJ Conds、Rey Tony 和 Helabusador。以及受欢迎的特许经营权，例如女子和墨西哥地区小组。

paras.en: But the fun doesn’t end there. Following a day of key conversations and networking sessions, Latin Music Week will host a wave of showcases, including two Billboard En Vivo Concerts: Fuerza Regida on Tuesday, and Jay Wheeler and Zhamira on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 但乐趣还不止于此。在一天的重要对话和社交会议之后，拉丁音乐周将举办一系列展示活动，包括两场 Billboard En Vivo 音乐会：周二的 Fuerza Regida 以及周三的 Jay Wheeler 和 Zhamira。

paras.en: For the first time in Latin Music Week history, Billboard is also teaming up with Eater for El Pre-Party, an evening celebrating Miami’s vibrant music and food scene. El Pre-Party will include salsa dancing lessons from Lenny Tavárez and his wife, Natasha Nazario, as well as special performances by Tavárez, Anthony Ramos and Micro TDH, and a DJ set by EP The Latino.
paras.zh: Billboard 还首次与 Eater 合作举办 El Pre-Party，庆祝迈阿密充满活力的音乐和美食场景，这在拉丁音乐周历史上尚属首次。 El Pre-Party 将包括 Lenny Tavárez 和他的妻子 Natasha Nazario 的萨尔萨舞课程，以及 Tavárez、Anthony Ramos 和 Micro TDH 的特别表演，以及 EP The Latino 的 DJ 表演。

paras.en: Tickets for 2026 Billboard Latin Music Week are on sale here. For the full showcases programming, see below:
paras.zh: 2026 年 Billboard 拉丁音乐周的门票现已发售。有关完整的展示节目，请参阅下文：

paras.en: Billboard Latin Music Week Opening Night by Boombastic 21+ will feature performances by Amigo de Artistas, Brray, Domelipa, Ela Taubert, Erick Brian, Exti, FLVCKKA, Javi Crespo, Kidd Voodoo, Kristina, LOrna, Naliah Blackman, Ramma, and Vius. Admission is free for Latin Music Week Registrants by RSVP HERE. Capacity is limited and attendance will be first come, first served. 21+
paras.zh: Boombastic 21+ 的 Billboard 拉丁音乐周开幕之夜将有 Amigo de Artistas、Brray、Domelipa、Ela Taubert、Erick Brian、Exti、FLVCKKA、Javi Crespo、Kidd Voodoo、Kristina、LOrna、Naliah Blackman、Ramma 和 Vius 进行表演。拉丁音乐周注册者可免费入场，请在此处回复。名额有限，先到先得。 21+

paras.en: The new global Latin pop group sits down for a conversation on their first year together, followed by an intimate performance. This exclusive event is available only to Latin Music Week registrants. Capacity for SANTOS BRAVOS presented by HYBE Latin America is limited and attendance will be first come, first served.

articles.title: Young Mazino Signs With CAA (Exclusive)
articles.author: Etan Vlessing

paras.en: Emmy-nominated actor Young Mazino has signed with CAA for representation.
paras.zh: 艾美奖提名演员 Young Mazino 已与 CAA 签约代理。

paras.en: The Hollywood actor stars in Via Negativa, Hannah Peterson’s adaptation of Daniel Hornsby’s novel of the same name that premiered at the 2026 Tribeca Festival. Mazino also voices the role of Gef in Netflix’s animated feature Steps, alongside Ali Wong and Stephanie Hsu, which premieres in November.
paras.zh: 这位好莱坞演员主演了汉娜·彼得森 (Hannah Peterson) 改编的丹尼尔·霍恩斯比 (Daniel Hornsby) 同名小说，该片在 2026 年翠贝卡电影节首映。 Mazino 还在 Netflix 动画长片《Steps》中为 Gef 配音，与 Ali Wong 和 Stephanie Hsu 一起配音，该片将于 11 月首播。

paras.en: After small roles in TV shows Blindspot, New Amsterdam and Blue Bloods, Mazino broke out in the role of Paul Cho in Netflix and A24’s Beef. Hollywood opportunities opened up for the Asian-American actor after his performance earned an Emmy nomination for best supporting actor in a limited series.
paras.zh: 在电视节目《盲点》、《新阿姆斯特丹》和《蓝血》中担任小角色后，马齐诺在 Netflix 和 A24 的《Beef》中饰演 Paul Cho，崭露头角。这位亚裔美国演员的表演获得了艾美奖限定剧最佳男配角提名，好莱坞的机会为他打开了。

paras.en: The first installment of Beef, created by Lee Sung Jin, also starred Steven Yeun and Ali Wong as two strangers who become embroiled in an escalating feud following a road-rage incident. The series returned with a new cast, led by Oscar Isaac and Carey Mulligan, for a second installment earlier this year.
paras.zh: 由李成镇创作的第一部《牛肉》还由史蒂文·元和黄阿丽主演，饰演两个陌生人，他们在一次路怒事件后卷入了不断升级的争斗。该剧于今年早些时候推出了第二部，由奥斯卡·伊萨克和凯瑞·穆里根领衔主演。

paras.en: Mazino went on to play the role of Jesse in the second season of HBO’s The Last of Us, created by Craig Mazin and Neil Druckmann.
paras.zh: 马齐诺继续在 HBO 的《最后生还者》第二季中扮演杰西，该剧由克雷格·麦辛和尼尔·德鲁克曼创作。

paras.en: His other credits include starring opposite Ayo Edebiri in A24’s Opus, written and directed by Mark Anthony Green. In the video game space, Mazino will next star offer his voice and motion-capture performances as Private Park, the main protagonist of Activision’s Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. The game is set for release on Oct. 23.
paras.zh: 他的其他作品包括与 Ayo Edebiri 演对手戏的 A24 的 Opus，由马克·安东尼·格林编剧和导演。在视频游戏领域，Mazino 接下来将扮演动视公司《使命召唤：现代战争 4》主角 Private Park 的配音和动作捕捉表演。该游戏将于 10 月 23 日发布。

paras.en: Mazino continues to be represented by Gerald Lee at 1V1 Entertainment, Stephanie Moy at M88, Michael Auerbach at Jackoway Austen and Narrative PR.
paras.zh: Mazino 继续由 1V1 Entertainment 的 Gerald Lee、M88 的 Stephanie Moy、Jackoway Austen 和 Narrative PR 的 Michael Auerbach 代表。

articles.title: How to Watch the Record-Breaking ‘Celebrity Traitors’ U.K. Online From the States
articles.author: Sophie Dunne

paras.en: If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission.
paras.zh: 如果您通过我们网站上的链接购买独立审查的产品或服务，《好莱坞报道》可能会收到附属佣金。

paras.en: The first season of the U.K.-based show The Celebrity Traitors became a major TV hit, with the finale seeing comedian Alan Carr come out on top in front of a record-breaking 12 million BBC viewers. Season two has plenty of reasons to keep that momentum going too, with a cast that boasts an unusually long A-list lineup. Hosted again by broadcaster Claudia Winkleman and renewed for three more years, viewers across Britain can watch the show on BBC One and BBC iPlayer starting Thursday, Oct. 1, while viewers overseas can use a VPN to connect through a U.K. server and access services that restrict viewing by location.
paras.zh: 英国电视剧《名人叛徒》第一季成为电视热门节目，在结局中喜剧演员艾伦·卡尔 (Alan Carr) 在破纪录的 1200 万 BBC 观众面前脱颖而出。第二季也有充分的理由保持这种势头，演员阵容拥有异常长的一线演员阵容。该节目再次由广播公司克劳迪娅·温克尔曼 (Claudia Winkleman) 主持，并续订三年，从 10 月 1 日星期四开始，英国各地的观众都可以在 BBC One 和 BBC iPlayer 上观看该节目，而海外观众可以使用 VPN 通过英国服务器进行连接，并访问按地点限制观看的服务。

paras.en: The second season brings 21 stars into the game as they try to work out who is a Faithful and who is secretly a Traitor. The cast includes The Last of Us star Bella Ramsey, singer James Blunt, actress and Lawyer Barbie Sharon Rooney, Little Mix’s Leigh-Anne Pinnock, Love Island host Maya Jama, comedian Miranda Hart, Oscar-nominated actor Richard E. Grant, Irish comedian Joanne McNally, model and actress Jerry Hall, Coronation Street legend Julie Hesmondhalgh and Tony Blair enactor Michael Sheen.
paras.zh: 第二季有 21 位明星加入游戏，他们试图找出谁是忠实者，谁是暗中的叛徒。演员阵容包括《最后生还者》明星贝拉·拉姆齐、歌手詹姆斯·布朗特、女演员兼律师芭比莎朗·鲁尼、Little Mix 的利-安妮·平诺克、爱情岛主持人玛雅·贾玛、喜剧演员米兰达·哈特、奥斯卡提名演员理查德·E·格兰特、爱尔兰喜剧演员乔安妮·麦克纳利、模特兼演员杰瑞·霍尔、加冕街传奇人物朱莉·赫斯蒙哈尔和托尼·布莱尔扮演者迈克尔·辛。

paras.en: Viewers outside of the United Kingdom will need a VPN to watch The Celebrity Traitors since BBC One and BBC iPlayer are intended for viewers in the U.K.
paras.zh: 英国以外的观众需要 VPN 才能观看《名人叛徒》，因为 BBC One 和 BBC iPlayer 面向英国观众。

paras.en: A VPN works by routing your internet connection through a server in another location, giving websites a different apparent IP address. By connecting to a U.K. server, your connection can appear to come from Britain rather than your actual location.
paras.zh: VPN 的工作原理是通过另一个位置的服务器路由您的互联网连接，为网站提供不同的明显 IP 地址。通过连接到英国服务器，您的连接可能看起来来自英国，而不是您的实际位置。

paras.en: NordVPN offers secure browsing with features including threat protection, a kill switch, double VPN, DNS leak protection and a large server network. The monthly Basic plan starts at $14.99. A one-year plan costs $5.49 per month, saving 52%, while the two-year plan costs $3.49 per month, saving 69%. NordVPN also includes a seven-day free trial, unlike a lot of other VPN platforms.

It supports up to 10 devices and includes high-speed VPN service, Lite Protection for blocking ads and malicious sites, optional Dedicated IP and ExpressMailGuard, plus a 30-day money-back guarantee. The Advanced plan costs $16.99 per month and adds features such as tracker blocking and password management, while the $22.99-per-month Pro plan supports up to 14 devices and includes additional privacy tools plus ExpressAI with 500 daily credits.

paras.en: Longer subscriptions can reduce the monthly equivalent considerably. A 12-month Basic offer starts at $4.99 per month, with 12 months plus three extra months billed at $74.85 for the first 15 months before annual renewal at $99.95. A two-year Advanced offer starts at $3.49 per month, with two years plus four extra months billed at $125.72 for the first 28 months before annual renewal at $119.95.

paras.en: While Proton offers a free VPN with no credit card required, it connects you to randomly selected servers in 10 countries. That means you’re not guaranteed to be able to access U.K. streaming services or shows. For more reliable access, Proton VPN Plus costs $9.99 per month on a month-to-month plan. paras.en: VPN Plus supports 10 devices, provides fast speeds, thousands of servers across 140+ countries, streaming support, ad and malware blocking, plus priority assistance. Proton VPN also helps protect privacy, prevent tracking, reduce cybercrime risks and access content abroad.

articles.title: Eric Stonestreet Returning for ‘Dexter: Resurrection’ Season 2; Krysten Ritter’s Role Teased
articles.author: Jackie Strause

paras.en: Eric Stonestreet is returning to the Dexter franchise as fellow serial killer Rapunzel, and Krysten Ritter‘s resurrection was made a bit clearer during the show’s newsy Thursday panel at New York Comic Con.
paras.zh: 埃里克·斯通斯特里特（Eric Stonestreet）将回归《嗜血法医》系列，饰演连环杀手长发公主（Rapunzel），克里斯滕·里特（Krysten Ritter）的复活在纽约动漫展周四举行的新闻专题讨论会上更加清晰。

paras.en: “I love the surprise of people seeing me in that role. I love the challenge of bringing my game. But I also love that he’s a family guy who seemingly has it all, which is what somebody else might covet and is jealous of in some ways,” Stonestreet said about why he wanted to return to the role of Al Walker a.k.a. Rapunzel for season two, which releases on Paramount+ Oct. 30. “I like the duality of that and knowing what an awful, awful person Al is, is really fun to play.”
paras.zh: “我喜欢人们看到我扮演这个角色时的惊喜。我喜欢带来我的游戏带来的挑战。但我也喜欢他是一个看起来拥有一切的顾家男人，这可能是其他人在某些方面所觊觎和嫉妒的，”Stonestreet 谈到为什么他想在 10 月 30 日于派拉蒙+上映的第二季中回归阿尔·沃克（又名长发公主）这个角色。“我喜欢这种双重性，我知道阿尔·沃克是一个多么糟糕的人。是，玩起来真的很有趣。”

paras.en: Stonestreet recalled his initial brush with the series, which came before he landed his role on the Emmy-winning comedy he starred on for 11 seasons, Modern Family. “I was a grinding actor going on every audition that I was fortunate enough to get, and Dexter popped up on my fax machine back then,” he said. “I made my way over to Paramount, looked for parking for probably an hour and a half, and then made my way in to see Clyde, and he said no thank you.
paras.zh: Stonestreet 回忆起他最初接触该剧的经历，当时他在获得艾美奖的喜剧《摩登家庭》中出演了 11 季。 “每次有幸参加试镜时，我都是一个苦逼的演员，当时《德克斯特》就出现在我的传真机上，”他说。 “我去了派拉蒙，找了大概一个半小时的停车位，然后进去见克莱德，他说不，谢谢。

paras.en: “To put a finer point on it, when you did not get the role in the first season, and had you gotten the role, you would not have been available to audition for Modern Family,” the showrunner noted. Added Stonestreet: “It worked out good. Thank you, Clyde.”
paras.zh: “说得更详细一点，当你在第一季没有得到这个角色时，如果你得到了这个角色，你就无法参加《摩登家庭》的试镜，”该剧制片人指出。 Stonestreet 补充道：“效果很好。谢谢你，克莱德。”

paras.en: The panel, which was timed to the franchise’s landmark 20th anniversary, featured Michael C. Hall, Uma Thurman in her first New York Comic Con appearance, James Remar, Jack Alcott, Bokeem Woodbine and Krysten Ritter, as well as showrunner and executive producer Clyde Phillips and executive producers Reynolds and Marcos Siega.
paras.zh: 该座谈会的时间恰逢该系列具有里程碑意义的 20 周年纪念日，嘉宾包括迈克尔·C·霍尔 (Michael C. Hall)、首次亮相纽约动漫展的乌玛·瑟曼 (Uma Thurman)、詹姆斯·雷马尔 (James Remar)、杰克·奥尔科特 (Jack Alcott)、博基姆·伍德拜因 (Bokeem Woodbine) 和克里斯滕·里特 (Krysten Ritter)，以及剧集主管兼执行制片人克莱德·菲利普斯 (Clyde Phillips) 以及执行制片人雷诺兹 (Reynolds) 和马科斯·西加 (Marcos Siega)。

paras.en: The second season of Dexter: Resurrection sees Hall’s Dexter Morgan “caught between two killers — one with decades of notoriety and a lifetime of kills behind him, and the other a fresh young face terrorizing New York in ways no one has ever seen.” Dexter will also battle a new, unexpected enemy — a mid-life crisis — as Harrison (Alcott) continues his own pursuit of justice as father and son face their darkest chapter yet.
paras.zh: 在《嗜血法医：复活》第二季中，霍尔饰演的德克斯特·摩根“夹在两个杀手之间——一个是臭名昭著的杀手，一生都在杀人，另一个是一张年轻的面孔，以前所未有的方式恐吓纽约。”德克斯特还将与一个意想不到的新敌人——中年危机——作斗争，哈里森（奥尔科特饰）继续自己追求正义，父子面临着迄今为止最黑暗的一章。

paras.en: Alongside Stonestreet’s return, Ritter is also back to the Dexter universe, but the cast and crew were more careful about not spoiling how. Her character, Lady Vengeance, died last season, but Ritter had teased to The Hollywood Reporter that she was keeping her fingers crossed about a resurrection of some sort.
paras.zh: 随着斯通街的回归，里特也回到了《德克斯特》宇宙，但演员和工作人员更加小心，以免剧透。她扮演的角色“复仇女神”在上一季去世了，但里特曾向《好莱坞报道》取笑说，她正在祈祷某种复活。

paras.en: “If you’re a fan of the show and you saw New Blood, we shot and killed Michael at the end of New Blood in the last in season one of Resurrection, Krysten was pronounced dead at the prison, and here they both are,” Phillips teased.
paras.zh: “如果你是该剧的粉丝，并且看过《新血》，我们会在《复活》第一季最后一季的《新血》结尾处枪杀迈克尔，克里斯汀在监狱里被宣布死亡，而他们都在这里，”菲利普斯开玩笑道。

paras.en: “The chemistry was undeniable, and we all looked at each other when we were shooting when Lady Vengeance died, and we thought, this can’t be the end of this thing,” added Siega. Added Reynolds: “She has a profound effect upon Dexter.”
paras.zh: “化学反应是不可否认的，当我们拍摄复仇女神去世时，我们都看着对方，我们想，这不可能是这件事的结束，”西加补充道。雷诺兹补充道：“她对德克斯特有着深远的影响。”

paras.en: While speaking to what’s ahead for the series, Phillips said the franchise’s location shift to New York “just brings an energy that I don’t think Miami had. Quite frankly, we’re in an environment where we really get to show the city as a character, and you know it’s a place where your Dexter gets to cross paths with a lot of interesting people, and no place better to hunt than in New York City.”
paras.zh: 在谈到该系列的未来时，菲利普斯表示，该系列的地点转移到纽约“带来了一种我认为迈阿密没有的能量。坦率地说，我们所处的环境可以真正展示这座城市的角色，你知道这是一个让你的德克斯特与很多有趣的人相遇的地方，没有比纽约市更好的狩猎地方了。”

paras.en: When asked about whether the location and focus changes this season will affect if Dexter is still an apex predator, according to Reynolds, “I mean, absolutely, but it’s a different kind of challenge. The core of Dexter, despite how dark he is and the stuff that he does — he kills people. You guys know that, right? But he’s optimistic at his core in a way that I think really launches into all of us, and why we love Dexter so much,” he shared. “Dexter’s thinking, ‘Can I have a family? Can I have it all?’ Questions that a lot of us will think about, whether it’s our actual family or friends that would make a family. Ultimately at the end of that season, it’s: no, he can’t, literally and figuratively. And yet Dexter’s like, ‘Maybe I can.’ I think that really helps us just love and feel so much hope toward this character.”
paras.zh: 当被问及本季地点和焦点的变化是否会影响《德克斯特》是否仍然是顶级掠夺者时，雷诺兹表示，“我的意思是，绝对是，但这是一种不同类型的挑战。《德克斯特》的核心，尽管他有多黑暗，他所做的事情——他杀人。你们都知道，对吧？但他对自己的核心持乐观态度，我认为这种乐观态度确实会影响到我们所有人，也是我们如此喜爱《德克斯特》的原因，”他分享道。 “德克斯特在想，‘我能拥有一个家庭吗？我能拥有一切吗？’这是我们很多人都会思考的问题，无论是我们真正的家人还是朋友组成的家庭。最终，在那个赛季结束时，结果是：不，他不能，无论是字面上还是比喻上。但德克斯特却说，‘也许我可以。’我认为这真的有助于我们热爱这个角色，并对这个角色充满希望。”

paras.en: In terms of whereHarrison and Dexter will go this season, “It’s nice to jump into a relationship, to the father-son relationship, with that little time skip, because we get to sit into a space where there’s familiarity and there’s there’s comfortability. The conflicts and the tension that you’re going to experience with somebody that you don’t know very well, it’s a different set of conflicts. It’s a different color. It’s a new flavor of what you’re going to run up against.”
paras.zh: 就哈里森和德克斯特这一季的去向而言，“很高兴能够在短暂的时间里跳入一段关系，进入父子关系，因为我们坐在一个既熟悉又舒适的空间里。你将与一个不太了解的人经历冲突和紧张，这是一组不同的冲突。这是一种不同的颜色。这是你将要运行的新风格对抗。”

paras.en: When it comes to Harrison’s love interest in season two, Reynolds shared that, “It’s really fun too because we placed Harrison between his father, who he very much loves and respects, and the sense of justice that his father has. Then he’s part of the cops, as you’ve probably seen online and he’ll be working possibly with Claudette, who has her own very moral code. So it’s fun to watch him play.”
paras.zh: 当谈到第二季中哈里森的爱情兴趣时，雷诺兹分享道，“这也很有趣，因为我们把哈里森放在他非常爱和尊重的父亲和他父亲所具有的正义感之间。然后他就是警察的一部分，正如你可能在网上看到的那样，他可能会和克劳黛特一起工作，克劳黛特有自己的道德准则。所以看他打球很有趣。”

paras.en: At another point, while teasing the first episode, Hall noted that “some time passes before we rejoin the show, and we fill in the blanks with a montage of sorts. I got to do a number of scenelets with some really, really amazing people who were playing these unsavory victims. That was fun.”
paras.zh: 在另一点上，在调侃第一集时，霍尔指出，“在我们重新加入节目之前，过了一段时间，我们用蒙太奇之类的东西填补了空白。我必须和一些非常非常了不起的人一起制作一些场景，他们扮演这些令人讨厌的受害者。这很有趣。”

paras.en: During the panel, the cast also reflected on their introductions to the franchise and why they took on roles in the Paramount+ universe. For Thurman, “I think it’s the best decision I ever made in my life, was to be the security guard.”
paras.zh: 在座谈会上，演员们还回顾了他们对该系列的介绍以及他们为何在派拉蒙+宇宙中扮演角色。对于瑟曼来说，“我认为当保安是我一生中做过的最好的决定。”

paras.en: “I received this script, and I don’t know. I’m not jaded. I swear. I just — my heart sinks when I go to crack a script. I’m just like, let’s see — and I couldn’t put it down. I burned through the whole season,” she continued. “Clyde and I had a Zoom that went on for about 90 minutes, and I just completely fell for the whole situation. I was like, you don’t need me. I mean, I’m a security guard. And I’m so glad.”
paras.zh: “我收到了这个剧本，但我不知道。我并不厌倦。我发誓。我只是——当我去破解剧本时，我的心沉了下去。我只是想，让我们看看——我无法放下它。我整个赛季都在燃烧，”她继续道。 “克莱德和我玩了大约 90 分钟的 Zoom，我完全被整个情况迷住了。我当时想，你不需要我。我的意思是，我是一名保安。我很高兴。”

paras.en: Thurman was also quick to speak up about how the set environment has been one of the better she’s experienced in her career. “I think there’s this incredibly high standard, both of moral character and warmth from the top down,” said Thurman. “People are treated with respect on the set from every single department across. It brings out the best in people. It’s not hard, shouldn’t be, but it’s so prevalent in this environment that as a very serious veteran of the show business profession, I will say it is absolutely a gift to get to have this kind of working community.”
paras.zh: 瑟曼还很快谈到，片场环境是她职业生涯中经历过的最好的环境之一。瑟曼说：“我认为，无论是道德品质还是自上而下的热情，都有着令人难以置信的高标准。” “在片场，每个部门的人都受到尊重。它激发了人们最好的一面。这并不难，也不应该如此，但在这种环境下，这种情况如此普遍，作为演艺界一位非常严肃的资深人士，我想说，拥有这样的工作社区绝对是一份礼物。”

paras.en: Added Ritter: “It’s a well-oiled machine, and you hear that about productions, but this one really is. I think because everybody’s been together for so long, it works, and you feel that when you get to set. Everybody is bringing their A game, and the way Marcos shoots is really efficient, so you have to be really efficient. It keeps you energized, it keeps you on your toes, and somehow Michael ends up going deeper every take, which makes you so much more engaged every take.”
paras.zh: 里特补充道：“这是一部运行良好的机器，你在制作时会听到这样的说法，但这确实是这样。我认为因为每个人都在一起这么久，所以它很有效，而且当你开始拍摄时你会感觉到。每个人都在发挥他们的出色表现，而马科斯的拍摄方式非常高效，所以你必须非常高效。它让你充满活力，让你保持警惕，不知何故，迈克尔最终在每一次拍摄中都更加深入，这让你在每一次拍摄中都更加投入。”

paras.en: Explaining how the show is able to pull actors like Stonestreet, Ritter and Thurman, Phillips first pointed to Hall. “It’s Michael. Everybody wants to work with Michael. He attracts these stars to come be on the show like this. Also, it’s the writers. We have a great writing room, and we work hard to tell [these stories].”
paras.zh: 在解释这部剧如何吸引斯通斯特里特、里特和瑟曼等演员时，菲利普斯首先提到了霍尔。 “是迈克尔。每个人都想与迈克尔合作。他吸引这些明星来参加这样的节目。还有编剧。我们有一个很棒的写作室，我们努力讲述[这些故事]。”

paras.en: He later added how potential stars are pitched on their roles, noting that the writers break the entire season so actors know exactly what they’re getting into. “We write all 10 scripts so that when the actors get them, they get the book of what the season is going to be, and they know they’re not going to get screwed over in the end,” he said. “They know what the ending is, and then they can make the decision if they want whether or not they want to be involved, which is why we have such an amazing cast.”
paras.zh: 后来他补充道，潜在明星是如何挑选自己的角色的，并指出编剧会打破整个赛季的时间，以便演员们确切地知道他们要进入的内容。 “我们写了全部 10 个剧本，这样当演员们拿到剧本时，他们就能得到本季的内容，并且知道自己最终不会被搞砸，”他说。 “他们知道结局是什么，然后他们可以根据自己的意愿做出是否参与的决定，这就是为什么我们有如此出色的演员阵容。”

paras.en: Earlier in the panel, Hall along with the rest of the cast reflected on the launch of the franchise, with the franchise’s long-running star noting, “We made this pilot just hoping that the first season would get picked up. It seemed like a crazy proposition to invite people to identify with a character like this, but it worked.”
paras.zh: 在座谈会的早些时候，霍尔和其他演员一起回顾了该系列的推出，该系列的长期明星指出，“我们制作这个试播集只是希望第一季能够被接续。邀请人们认同这样的角色似乎是一个疯狂的提议，但它确实有效。”

articles.title: Nvidia, Oracle, CoreWeave and other AI stocks sink on OpenAI revenue report

paras.en: Shares of Nvidia, Oracle, CoreWeave and other artificial intelligence names sank lower on Thursday after the market learned more details about OpenAI's revenue.
paras.zh: 在市场了解有关 OpenAI 收入的更多细节后，Nvidia、Oracle、CoreWeave 和其他人工智能公司的股价周四下跌。

paras.en: OpenAI told investors that it hit roughly $50 billion in annualized revenue at the end of September, CNBC confirmed, lower than the the $68 billion figure that was widely reported late last month. A person familiar with the matter said the $68 billion figure included gross revenue from OpenAI's partners, which helps investors make a more direct comparison with its chief rival, Anthropic.
paras.zh: CNBC 证实，OpenAI 告诉投资者，截至 9 月底，其年化收入约为 500 亿美元，低于上个月末广泛报道的 680 亿美元。一位知情人士表示，680 亿美元的数字包括来自 OpenAI 合作伙伴的总收入，这有助于投资者与其主要竞争对手 Anthropic 进行更直接的比较。

paras.en: The Financial Times was first to report the $50 billion figure.
paras.zh: 英国《金融时报》率先报道了 500 亿美元的数字。

paras.en: OpenAI shared an update about its finances in an investor presentation, said the person, who asked not to be named in order to discuss the numbers. In addition to the $50 billion in annualized revenue, OpenAI touted 77% total run rate growth during its third quarter, as well as 107% run rate growth for its enterprise business during the same period, the person said.
paras.zh: 这位不愿透露姓名的人士表示，OpenAI 在一次投资者演示中分享了有关其财务状况的最新信息。该人士表示，除了 500 亿美元的年化收入外，OpenAI 还宣称第三季度的总运行率增长了 77%，同期企业业务的运行率增长了 107%。

paras.en: The company is under pressure to justify its $852 billion valuation to investors as it gears up for what is widely expected to be a blockbuster IPO. OpenAI confidentially filed its prospectus with regulators in June, and executives have signaled that the company is eyeing a 2027 debut.
paras.zh: 该公司正面临着向投资者证明其 8520 亿美元估值合理性的压力，因为该公司正在为人们普遍预期的重磅 IPO 做准备。 OpenAI 于 6 月秘密向监管机构提交了招股说明书，高管们已表示该公司计划于 2027 年上市。

paras.en: In the interim, OpenAI is engaging in early stage discussions with investors about a potential new funding round. The company could raise around $30 billion, as CNBC previously reported, but that figure could change. The round is being driven by investor demand and no term sheet has been finalized yet.
paras.zh: 在此期间，OpenAI 正在与投资者就潜在的新一轮融资进行早期讨论。据 CNBC 此前报道，该公司可能筹集约 300 亿美元资金，但这一数字可能会发生变化。此轮融资是由投资者需求推动的，目前尚未最终确定投资意向书。

paras.en: OpenAI closed a historic $122 billion funding round in March, and CFO Sarah Friar told CNBC last week that it is still "very well capitalized."
paras.zh: OpenAI 在 3 月份完成了历史性的 1220 亿美元融资，首席财务官 Sarah Friar 上周告诉 CNBC，该公司“资本仍然非常充足”。

articles.title: Why a Starbucks takeover of Chipotle would — and wouldn't — make sense for both companies

paras.en: Starbucks has reportedly explored buying Chipotle Mexican Grill, but investors are split on whether the megadeal would make sense for both companies.
paras.zh: 据报道，星巴克已考虑收购 Chipotle Mexican Grill，但投资者对于这笔大型交易对两家公司是否有意义存在分歧。

paras.en: The coffee giant has been working with advisers on a takeover proposal of the fast-casual chain in recent months, the Financial Times reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter.
paras.zh: 英国《金融时报》周四援引知情人士的话报道称，近几个月来，这家咖啡巨头一直在与顾问就这家快餐休闲连锁店的收购提议进行合作。

paras.en: If Starbucks bought Chipotle, it would combine two of the largest U.S. restaurant chains. With about $31 billion in annual domestic sales, Starbucks is the second-biggest U.S. chain by sales. Chipotle sits in the number seven spot, with more than $11 billion in annual system-wide sales in its home market.
paras.zh: 如果星巴克收购了 Chipotle，它将合并美国最大的两家连锁餐厅。星巴克的国内年销售额约为 310 亿美元，按销售额计算是美国第二大连锁店。 Chipotle 排名第七，其国内市场全系统年销售额超过 110 亿美元。

paras.en: The report sent Chipotle stock up about 7% in afternoon trading, while shares of Starbucks fell roughly 4%. It is not unusual for deal rumors to lower the potential acquirer's value and increase the target's share price, but investor reactions show that a prospective takeover comes with pros and cons for each side of the deal.
paras.zh: 该报告导致 Chipotle 股价在下午交易中上涨约 7%，而星巴克股价则下跌约 4%。降低潜在收购方价值并提高目标公司股价的交易传闻并不罕见，但投资者的反应表明，潜在收购对交易双方来说都有利弊。

paras.en: To be sure, it is unclear if Starbucks will even pursue the takeover. D.A. Davidson analyst Matt Curtis wrote in a note to clients on Thursday that he views the odds of a deal being completed as "relatively low" — about 20%.
paras.zh: 可以肯定的是，目前尚不清楚星巴克是否会进行收购。 DA戴维森分析师马特·柯蒂斯 (Matt Curtis) 周四在给客户的一份报告中写道，他认为交易完成的几率“相对较低”，约为 20%。

paras.en: Starbucks declined to comment, and Chipotle did not immediately respond to a request for comment from CNBC.
paras.zh: 星巴克拒绝置评，Chipotle 也没有立即回应 CNBC 的置评请求。

paras.en: Starbucks CEO Brian Niccol knows more than a thing or two about Chipotle.
paras.zh: 星巴克首席执行官布莱恩·尼科尔 (Brian Niccol) 对 Chipotle 的了解不止一二。

paras.en: Before joining the coffee company in 2024, he was chief executive of Chipotle for more than six years. He led a turnaround of the burrito chain, helping it bounce back from a series of foodborne illness outbreaks that had turned into a full-blown crisis for the company.
paras.zh: 在 2024 年加入这家咖啡公司之前，他曾担任 Chipotle 首席执行官六年多。他领导了墨西哥卷饼连锁店的扭亏为盈，帮助该公司从一系列食源性疾病爆发中恢复过来，这些疾病已成为该公司的全面危机。

paras.en: In the wake of Niccol's departure, traffic to Chipotle restaurants fell in 2025, as budget-conscious consumers visited its restaurants less often. These days, the chain looks like it is starting to get back on track, with signs of "encouraging progress," Chipotle CEO Scott Boatwright said on the company's earnings conference call in late July.
paras.zh: Nicol 离开后，Chipotle 餐厅的客流量在 2025 年有所下降，因为精打细算的消费者光顾其餐厅的次数减少了。 Chipotle 首席执行官斯科特·博特赖特 (Scott Boatwright) 在 7 月底的公司财报电话会议上表示，如今，该连锁店似乎开始重回正轨，并出现了“令人鼓舞的进展”迹象。

paras.en: Still, its shaky 2025 means that the stock is trading at a 20% discount from a year ago, even with Thursday's big move. And since Niccol left, shares have lost about 40% of their value.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，2025 年的不稳定意味着该股的交易价格比一年前低了 20%，尽管周四出现了大幅波动。自从尼科尔离开后，股价已经下跌了约 40%。

paras.en: Chipotle would be a splashy acquisition for Niccol. More than that, it could create a new restaurant conglomerate, following in the footsteps of Yum Brands, Restaurant Brands International and Roark Capital-backed Inspire Brands.
paras.zh: 对于 Nicol 来说，Chipotle 的收购将是一次引人注目的收购。不仅如此，它还可以追随百胜餐饮集团、Restaurant Brands International 和 Roark Capital 支持的 Inspire Brands 的脚步，创建一个新的餐饮集团。

paras.en: Multi-brand restaurant companies are more diversified, which can be more attractive to investors. While Starbucks is still a much larger chain than Chipotle, the difference in their categories means that one's poor performance could be offset by growth at the other.
paras.zh: 多品牌餐饮公司更加多元化，对投资者更具吸引力。虽然星巴克仍然是比 Chipotle 大得多的连锁店，但它们品类的差异意味着一个公司的糟糕业绩可以被另一个公司的增长所抵消。

paras.en: Moreover, Starbucks could help Chipotle grow more quickly in international markets; the burrito chain only has about 100 locations outside of the U.S., while Starbucks has about 23,000.
paras.zh: 此外，星巴克可以帮助Chipotle在国际市场上更快地发展；墨西哥卷饼连锁店在美国境外仅拥有约 100 家门店，而星巴克则拥有约 23,000 家门店。

paras.en: Other restaurant companies have set a blueprint for that strategy: Yum has leaned on its international experience from KFC and Pizza Hut to launch Taco Bell outside of the U.S. And Restaurant Brands has leaned on Burger King's international expertise to grow Popeyes' international footprint.
paras.zh: 其他餐饮公司也为这一战略制定了蓝图：百胜集团凭借肯德基和必胜客的国际经验，在美国境外推出了 Taco Bell，而 Restaurant Brands 则依靠汉堡王的国际专业知识来扩大 Popeyes 的国际影响力。

paras.en: With any strategic acquisition, investors hope for synergies that justify the price tag and explain why the deal makes sense. A coffee shop and a burrito restaurant do not have much overlap in ingredients, but there are other potential benefits for both companies and their investors.
paras.zh: 对于任何战略收购，投资者都希望能够产生协同效应，证明价格合理，并解释交易的意义。咖啡店和墨西哥卷饼餐厅在成分上没有太多重叠，但对公司及其投资者来说还有其他潜在的好处。

paras.en: Combining Starbucks and Chipotle would open up potential cost cuts, like layoffs for some now-redundant corporate roles.
paras.zh: 星巴克和 Chipotle 的合并将带来潜在的成本削减，比如裁员一些目前已经裁员的公司职位。

paras.en: The two chains also have significant overlap in their U.S. real estate footprints. Roughly 90% of Chipotle restaurants are within one mile of a Starbucks cafe, according to a research note from Stephens analyst Jim Salera published on Thursday. Both companies could benefit from shared real estate development and even operating efficiencies as a result.
paras.zh: 这两家连锁店在美国房地产业务上也有很大的重叠。根据 Stephens 分析师 Jim Salera 周四发布的一份研究报告，大约 90% 的 Chipotle 餐厅距离星巴克咖啡馆不到一英里。两家公司都可以从共享房地产开发甚至运营效率中受益。

paras.en: But real estate is not the only area where they overlap. Many Starbucks customers also frequent Chipotle restaurants. As one entity, they could leverage that overlap through a combined rewards program, Salera suggested.
paras.zh: 但房地产并不是它们唯一重叠的领域。许多星巴克顾客也经常光顾 Chipotle 餐厅。萨莱拉建议，作为一个实体，他们可以通过联合奖励计划来利用这种重叠。

paras.en: Unlike many big restaurant players, both Chipotle and Starbucks operate most of their U.S. locations, although Starbucks also has thousands of licensed cafes in its home market.
paras.zh: 与许多大型餐厅玩家不同的是，Chipotle 和星巴克在美国的大部分门店均经营，尽管星巴克在其国内市场也拥有数千家特许咖啡馆。

paras.en: That marks a difference from Chipotle's last strategic owner — McDonald's.
paras.zh: 这标志着 Chipotle 的最后一个战略所有者——麦当劳的不同。

paras.en: The burger giant, which franchises the vast majority of its U.S. restaurants, made a majority investment in the upstart Mexican-inspired chain in 1998. But by 2006, McDonald's divested its ownership. Its restaurant investments, which also included Boston Market, were labeled a distraction by Wall Street as the Golden Arches struggled.
paras.zh: 这家汉堡巨头拥有绝大多数美国餐厅的特许经营权，并于 1998 年对这家墨西哥风格的新贵连锁店进行了大部分投资。但到 2006 年，麦当劳剥离了其所有权。当金拱门陷入困境时，其餐厅投资（其中还包括波士顿市场）被华尔街视为干扰。

paras.en: Before it sold its stake, McDonald's tried to franchise some of Chipotle's restaurants to its own franchisees. But Chipotle's leadership, including founder Steve Ells, pushed back. It was one sign of the cultural misalignment between the two brands.
paras.zh: 在出售其股份之前，麦当劳试图将 Chipotle 的一些餐厅特许经营给自己的特许经营商。但 Chipotle 的领导层，包括创始人史蒂夫·埃尔斯 (Steve Ells) 表示反对。这是两个品牌之间文化不一致的迹象之一。

paras.en: Chipotle also resisted efforts to make it more similar to McDonald's, declining suggestions like adding drive-thru windows and a breakfast menu.
paras.zh: Chipotle 还抵制了使其与麦当劳更加相似的努力，拒绝了添加得来速窗口和早餐菜单等建议。

paras.en: Niccol joined Starbucks more than two years ago to lead a turnaround of the embattled coffee chain. Early signs show that his efforts have improved its U.S. business — but the company is not done yet. Starbucks is aiming to be "the world's greatest customer service company," Niccol wrote in a memo to employees in September, part of a broader push to improve customer loyalty.
paras.zh: 两年多前，尼科尔加入星巴克，带领这家陷入困境的咖啡连锁店实现扭亏为盈。早期迹象表明，他的努力改善了其美国业务，但该公司尚未完成。尼科尔在 9 月份给员工的一份备忘录中写道，星巴克的目标是成为“世界上最伟大的客户服务公司”，这是提高客户忠诚度的更广泛努力的一部分。

paras.en: Starbucks also has other deals that it is reportedly considering. In September, Reuters reported that the company was considering selling a majority stake in its Japan business. The country has been the chain's largest overseas company-operated market since it formed a joint venture to operate its cafes in China less than a year ago.
paras.zh: 据报道，星巴克还正在考虑其他交易。 9 月，路透社报道称，该公司正在考虑出售其日本业务的多数股权。自从不到一年前该公司在中国成立合资企业经营咖啡馆以来，中国一直是该连锁店最大的海外公司运营市场。

paras.en: Integrating a new chain into the company would be a big distraction for Starbucks at a time when many investors think it should still be focusing on itself.
paras.zh: 在许多投资者认为星巴克应该继续专注于自身的时候，将一家新连锁店整合到公司中将是星巴克的一大干扰。

paras.en: "Starbucks is still executing its turnaround strategy, and acquiring Chipotle could consume significant senior management time on financing, integration, organizational design, systems, and personnel," BTIG analyst Pete Saleh wrote in a note. "Why introduce another major strategic initiative before demonstrating that Starbucks can deliver sustainable margin recovery?"
paras.zh: BTIG 分析师 Pete Saleh 在一份报告中写道：“星巴克仍在执行其扭亏为盈战略，收购 Chipotle 可能会消耗高级管理层在融资、整合、组织设计、系统和人员方面的大量时间。” “为什么在证明星巴克能够实现可持续的利润复苏之前还要引入另一项重大战略举措？”

paras.en: Starbucks' turnaround has also been expensive, which hasn't pleased investors.
paras.zh: 星巴克的扭亏为盈也代价高昂，这并没有令投资者满意。

paras.en: The company has been investing heavily in labor, cafe makeovers and store equipment to improve its service and the overall customer experience. Even layoffs and store closures, which will cut costs in the long term, have weighed on its quarterly earnings.
paras.zh: 该公司一直在劳动力、咖啡馆改造和商店设备方面投入巨资，以改善其服务和整体客户体验。即使是裁员和关闭商店（从长远来看将削减成本）也对其季度收益造成了压力。

paras.en: But Chipotle would be an even bigger expense. Even with shares' recent struggles, the company still has a market cap of roughly $42 billion. If Starbucks pursues the acquisition, it would be the biggest-ever restaurant takeover.
paras.zh: 但Chipotle 的花费会更大。尽管股价近期表现不佳，该公司的市值仍约为 420 亿美元。如果星巴克进行此次收购，这将是有史以来规模最大的餐厅收购案。

paras.en: Starbucks had about $9.4 billion in debt at the end of June. William Blair analyst Sharon Zackfia estimated that its leverage would balloon to about six times if the company paid a 20% premium and sought to finance the potential deal primarily through debt. An all-stock deal would not weigh on earnings as much, although Zackfia estimates it would still dilute earnings per share by about 10%.
paras.zh: 截至 6 月底，星巴克的债务约为 94 亿美元。 William Blair 分析师 Sharon Zackfia 估计，如果该公司支付 20% 的溢价并主要通过债务为潜在交易融资，其杠杆率将膨胀至约六倍。尽管 Zackfia 估计全股票交易仍会将每股收益稀释约 10%，但对收益的影响不会那么大。

paras.en: At Chipotle and Starbucks, Niccol was tasked with turning around struggling restaurants. But his corporate experience so far has not prepared him for a deal of this size.
paras.zh: 在 Chipotle 和星巴克，尼科尔的任务是扭转陷入困境的餐厅。但迄今为止，他的企业经验还没有让他为如此规模的交易做好准备。

paras.en: Merging two colossal restaurant companies would be a massive undertaking, potentially at the expense of the individual success of both brands.
paras.zh: 合并两家大型餐饮公司将是一项艰巨的任务，可能会以牺牲两个品牌各自的成功为代价。

paras.en: Two-brand restaurant companies often struggle to keep both operating with same-store sales growth, Citi Research analyst Jon Tower wrote in a note to clients. Additionally, he said internal employees usually gravitate toward the brand that is perceived to perform better or offer more career opportunities.
paras.zh: 花旗研究分析师乔恩·塔尔（Jon Tower）在给客户的一份报告中写道，双品牌餐饮公司往往难以维持同店销售增长的同时运营。此外，他表示，内部员工通常会倾向于那些被认为表现更好或提供更多职业机会的品牌。

paras.en: While the size of the deal makes the takeover unique, the restaurant industry already has plenty of examples of mergers and takeovers that did not work for either party.
paras.zh: 虽然交易的规模使得此次收购独一无二，但餐饮业已经有很多合并和收购的例子，但这些例子对任何一方都不起作用。

paras.en: The latest example comes from Jack in the Box, which bought Del Taco in a $585 million deal in 2022. At the time that the deal was announced, executives said it was "strategically and financially compelling."
paras.zh: 最新的例子来自 Jack in the Box，该公司于 2022 年以 5.85 亿美元的价格收购了 Del Taco。该交易宣布时，高管们表示该交易“在战略和财务上都具有吸引力”。

paras.en: During the period that Jack in the Box officially owned Del Taco, shares of the company cratered 73%. The burger chain shuttered dozens of locations as its sales struggled. And Del Taco reported even worse results, including more than a year straight of quarterly same-store sales declines.
paras.zh: 在 Jack in the Box 正式拥有 Del Taco 期间，该公司的股价下跌了 73%。由于销售困难，这家汉堡连锁店关闭了数十家门店。 Del Taco 的业绩甚至更糟，同店季度销售额连续一年多下降。

paras.en: More than three years later, Jack in the Box sold Del Taco to a franchisee for about $119 million.
paras.zh: 三年多后，Jack in the Box 将 Del Taco 以约 1.19 亿美元的价格出售给特许经营商。

articles.title: U.S. suspends Microsoft, Adobe from green card labor program in foreign worker crackdown

paras.en: The U.S. Department of Labor announced it would suspend Microsoft and Adobe from its Permanent Labor Certification program on Thursday, Labor Secretary Keith Sonderling said, as the Trump administration continues to take aim at immigration and foreign hiring programs ahead of November's midterm elections.
paras.zh: 劳工部长基思·桑德林 (Keith Sonderling) 表示，美国劳工部周四宣布将暂停微软和 Adob​​e 的永久劳工认证计划，因为特朗普政府在 11 月中期选举之前继续针对移民和外国人招聘计划。

paras.en: Sonderling said the Labor Department won't accept or process any new applications under the program for a host of companies, including Cognizant, Infosys, Capgemini, Tata, Wipro and HCL.
paras.zh: Sonderling 表示，劳工部不会接受或处理许多公司根据该计划提出的任何新申请，包括 Cognizant、Infosys、Capgemini、Tata、Wipro 和 HCL。

paras.en: The secretary said Adobe and Microsoft were also suspended "due to multiple active federal investigations."
paras.zh: 这位部长表示，“由于多项正在进行的联邦调查”，Adobe 和微软也被暂停。

paras.en: "Since 2009, just these companies alone have requested almost 3 million foreign workers. They've received over 230,000 H-1B visas approvals and over 100,000 permanent labor certifications. That's hundreds of thousands of jobs that were taken from American workers," Sonderling said.
paras.zh: “自 2009 年以来，仅这些公司就需要近 300 万外国工人。他们已获得超过 23 万份 H-1B 签证批准和超过 10 万份永久劳工证。这相当于从美国工人手中抢走了数十万个工作岗位，”桑德林说。

paras.en: Vice President JD Vance criticized Microsoft specifically, pointing to the firm's 6,000 layoffs in 2025. Vance claimed that the company "replaced" those workers with people on H-1B visas.
paras.zh: 副总裁 JD Vance 特别批评了微软，指出该公司将在 2025 年裁员 6000 人。Vance 声称该公司用 H-1B 签证的员工“取代”了这些员工。

paras.en: "So we're going to continue to support Microsoft and have a great relationship with Microsoft, but we're also going to deny them the ability to apply for these permanent residencies until they show that they are going to get serious about putting American workers first," Vance said.
paras.zh: 万斯说：“因此，我们将继续支持微软并与微软保持良好的关系，但我们也将拒绝他们申请这些永久居留权，直到他们表明他们将认真对待将美国工人放在第一位。”

paras.en: Microsoft responded to Vance's claims and defended its hiring practices in a statement Thursday, saying "the vast majority of Microsoft employees in the United States are Americans."
paras.zh: 微软周四在一份声明中回应了万斯的说法，并为其招聘行为辩护，称“微软在美国的绝大多数员工都是美国人。”

paras.en: "Of the approximately 6,000 H-1B visa applications we submitted in the last fiscal year, 80% percent were to extend or change the status of existing Microsoft employees," the company said.
paras.zh: “在我们上一财年提交的大约 6,000 份 H-1B 签证申请中，80% 是为了延长或改变现有微软员工的身份，”该公司表示。

paras.en: President Donald Trump is set to award the National Medal of Science to Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella and other leading technology CEOs on Thursday at the same summit where the suspension announcement was made.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统将于周四在宣布暂停的同一峰会上向微软首席执行官萨蒂亚·纳德拉和其他领先技术首席执行官授予国家科学奖章。

paras.en: Nadella is from India and moved to the U.S. in 1988. He joined Microsoft in 1992.
paras.zh: 纳德拉来自印度，1988 年移居美国。他于 1992 年加入微软。

paras.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, SpaceX CEO Elon Musk and Advanced Micro Devices CEO Lisa Su are also being honored at Thursday's medal ceremony. Each of the leaders immigrated to the U.S. Musk was born in South Africa and Su and Huang were born in Taiwan.
paras.zh: Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋、SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克和 Advanced Micro Devices 首席执行官 Lisa Su 也在周四的颁奖典礼上获奖。每一位移民美国的领导人都出生在南非，苏和黄出生在台湾。

paras.en: "It's one thing if you want to bring in a person like Elon Musk," Vance said. "I think 99% of American citizens look at somebody like Elon Musk or Lisa Su, the CEO of AMD, and they say, obviously, if that person wants to come in and build something great in the United States of America, we support that."
paras.zh: “如果你想引进埃隆·马斯克这样的人，这是一回事，”万斯说。 “我认为 99% 的美国公民都会关注像埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 或 AMD 首席执行官苏姿丰 (Lisa Su) 这样的人，他们会说，显然，如果这个人想进来并在美利坚合众国创造伟大的东西，我们会支持。”

paras.en: Tech giants like Microsoft, Google, Amazon and Apple have been among the top sponsors of H-1B visas for decades. This year, Amazon had the highest number of petitions at 35,426 workers, followed by Cognizant and EY, according to 2026 data from Levels.fyi.
paras.zh: 几十年来，微软、谷歌、亚马逊和苹果等科技巨头一直是 H-1B 签证的最大赞助商之一。根据 Levels.fyi 2026 年的数据，今年亚马逊收到的请愿书数量最多，为 35,426 名工人，其次是 Cognizant 和 EY。

paras.en: Microsoft was a close fourth at 21,706 petitions for 2026, with a median base salary of $180,710.
paras.zh: 微软以 21,706 份 2026 年申请位居第四，基本工资中位数为 180,710 美元。

paras.en: Microsoft said that petitions were only filed for workers "who meet the rigorous standards of this visa category," and said Microsoft's wages for H-1B workers were among the highest of all H-1B filings.
paras.zh: 微软表示，申请只针对“符合该签证类别严格标准”的员工，并表示微软为 H-1B 员工提供的工资是所有 H-1B 申请中最高的。

paras.en: CNBC has reached out to Adobe for comment.
paras.zh: CNBC 已联系 Adob​​e 征求意见。

articles.title: The ‘Kelvin wave’ hitting California is a potent warning about sea-level rise

paras.en: A slow-moving surge of water called a Kelvin wave is arriving in southern California and looks to be about as large as these waves can get. Though it’s not like the wall of water from a tsunami, the pulse is expected to cause record-breaking sea levels and coastal flooding across the state.
paras.zh: 一种被称为开尔文波的缓慢移动的水流正在抵达加利福尼亚州南部，看起来与这些波浪所能达到的大小差不多。虽然它不像海啸造成的水墙，但预计脉冲将导致破纪录的海平面和全州沿海洪水。

paras.en: It’s also potentially a preview of what California’s sea levels will look like decades from now because of climate change, says Daniel Swain, a climate scientist at University of California Agriculture and Natural Resources. “What we’ll see at the worst this winter will be something that is closer to the norm later this century in terms of sea level,” he says.
paras.zh: 加州大学农业与自然资源分校的气候科学家丹尼尔·斯温说，这也可能预示着几十年后由于气候变化，加州海平面的情况。他说：“今年冬天最糟糕的情况将是本世纪晚些时候海平面更接近正常情况。”

paras.en: The Kelvin wave, which is currently pushing sea levels about a foot above normal in southern California, originated at the equator as part of the superstrong El Niño happening right now. Normally, trade winds push warm water toward the western tropical Pacific. In El Niño years, these winds weaken or reverse. This bulge rolled slowly east until it hit the northern coast of South America. Blocked by the continents, it spread north and south, becoming what’s called a coastally trapped Kelvin wave. The Coriolis effect caused by the planet’s rotation then pinned the waves against the western coasts of North and South America, preventing the water from sloshing back out to sea.
paras.zh: 开尔文波目前正在使南加州的海平面比正常水平高出约一英尺，它起源于赤道，是目前正在发生的超强厄尔尼诺现象的一部分。通常，信风将温暖的海水推向西热带太平洋。在厄尔尼诺年，这些风会减弱或逆转。这个隆起慢慢向东滚动，直到到达南美洲北部海岸。受大陆阻挡，它向北和向南传播，成为所谓的沿海开尔文困波。行星自转引起的科里奥利效应将波浪固定在北美和南美的西海岸，防止海水回流到大海。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Kelvin waves are a typical feature of El Niño, says Severine Fournier, an ocean circulation researcher at NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in California. This year the first such wave originated in January, and several arrived in May and June. And more Kelvin waves are developing and expected to arrive in the next several months. The waves move at about 125 to 155 miles per day, so they take a couple of months to cross the Pacific and about a week to crawl up the California coast.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局加利福尼亚州喷气推进实验室的海洋环流研究员塞维琳·福尼尔说，开尔文波是厄尔尼诺现象的典型特征。今年第一波此类浪潮始于一月，几波浪潮在五月和六月抵达。更多的开尔文波正在形成，预计将在未来几个月内到达。海浪每天移动约 125 至 155 英里，因此它们需要几个月的时间才能穿越太平洋，大约需要一周的时间才能爬上加利福尼亚海岸。

paras.en: The one hitting now is about as big as Kelvin waves get, Swain says. “This is an unprecedented El Niño event with extremely strong westerly wind bursts,” he says. The strength of these winds determines how much water sloshes across the ocean. The sea-level rise caused by Kelvin waves typically tops out at about 18 inches, Swain says. California may see sea levels rise by around 14 inches this winter because the size of the bulge attenuates as it reaches the coast like ripples spreading from a rock tossed in a pond, he adds.
paras.zh: 斯温说，现在的冲击力大约与开尔文波一样大。 “这是一次史无前例的厄尔尼诺事件，伴随着极其强烈的西风爆发，”他说。这些风的强度决定了有多少水流过海洋。斯温说，开尔文波引起的海平面上升通常最高可达 18 英寸左右。他补充说，今年冬天，加州海平面可能会上升约 14 英寸，因为隆起的尺寸在到达海岸时会减弱，就像扔进池塘的岩石产生的涟漪一样。

paras.en: That’s not the West Coast’s only problem, though—several factors will exacerbate coastal flooding.
paras.zh: 不过，这并不是西海岸唯一的问题——有几个因素会加剧沿海洪水。

paras.en: For one, water expands at it warms, and this year’s strong El Niño is expected to bring record-breaking warm water to the California coast. “The temporary ocean level elevation from the combination of these Kelvin waves themselves plus the thermal expansion associated with El Niño could be on the order of two feet or even a little bit higher,” Swain says, “and that’s a very alarming number.”
paras.zh: 其一，水温随温度升高而膨胀，今年强劲的厄尔尼诺现象预计将为加州海岸带来破纪录的温暖海水。斯温说：“这些开尔文波本身加上与厄尔尼诺现象相关的热膨胀相结合，导致海平面暂时升高约两英尺，甚至更高一点，这是一个非常惊人的数字。”

paras.en: California also sees seasonal extreme high tides known as “king tides” in November through January that will further push water onshore. And then El Niño also raises the chances of storms in the Pacific, making storm surges more likely this winter. “Particularly in southern or central California, we tend to get stronger waves than usual during El Niño,” says Mark Merrifield, an oceanographer at the Scripps Institution of Oceanography at the University of California, San Diego. The result will likely be serious coastal flooding and beach erosion.
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州在 11 月至 1 月期间还会出现被称为“大潮”的季节性极端高潮，这将进一步将水推上岸。此外，厄尔尼诺现象还增加了太平洋发生风暴的可能性，使今年冬天更有可能出现风暴潮。加州大学圣地亚哥分校斯克里普斯海洋学研究所的海洋学家马克·梅里菲尔德说：“特别是在加利福尼亚州南部或中部，厄尔尼诺现象期间，我们往往会遇到比平常更强的波浪。”结果可能是严重的沿海洪水和海滩侵蚀。

paras.en: All of these effects presage what the state may have to deal with as the planet continues to warm because of continued fossil fuel burning.
paras.zh: 所有这些影响都预示着随着化石燃料持续燃烧导致地球持续变暖，国家可能必须应对。

paras.en: Climate change has already driven sea levels up by about eight inches over the past century in San Francisco and La Jolla, Calif., according to a 2022 state-level report. (Local sea rise can differ depending on whether geological forces are also simultaneously pushing up coastlines.) There is uncertainty about future rise, depending on the rate of the planet’s melting of the ice caps, Swain says, but “we expect at least another two feet of sea level rise in California [later this century].” That forecast is similar to the temporary rise that is expected this winter.
paras.zh: 根据 2022 年的一份州级报告，在过去的一个世纪里，气候变化已经导致旧金山和加利福尼亚州拉霍亚的海平面上升了约 8 英寸。 （当地的海平面上升可能会有所不同，具体取决于地质力量是否同时推高海岸线。）未来的海平面上升存在不确定性，具体取决于地球冰盖融化的速度，斯温说，但“我们预计加利福尼亚州的海平面（本世纪后期）至少还会上升两英尺。”该预测与今年冬天预计的暂时上涨类似。

paras.en: “What it really tells us is: if our infrastructure can’t handle this winter,” Swain says, “that means it definitely won’t handle that being the average condition.”
paras.zh: “它真正告诉我们的是：如果我们的基础设施无法应对今年冬天，”斯温说，“那就意味着它肯定无法应对一般情况。”

articles.title: Hurricane Isaias just set a new record for Atlantic storms

paras.en: Isaias is officially the first hurricane of this year’s Atlantic season—marking the latest arrival of a first hurricane in the region since reliable tracking began.
paras.zh: 伊萨亚斯正式成为今年大西洋季节的第一场飓风，标志着自可靠追踪开始以来该地区第一场飓风最新抵达。

paras.en: As of this writing, the Category 1 hurricane is about 385 miles (620 kilometers) off the U.S. Gulf Coast and is expected to make landfall late on Friday or early on Saturday, according to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration. Isaias’s winds are currently about 80 miles per hour (130 kilometers per hour), with “additional strengthening” expected before landfall, NOAA said in its recent forecast.
paras.zh: 据美国国家海洋和大气管理局称，截至撰写本文时，1 级飓风距离美国墨西哥湾沿岸约 385 英里（620 公里），预计将于周五晚些时候或周六早些时候登陆。 NOAA 在最近的预测中表示，伊萨亚斯的风速目前约为每小时 80 英里（130 公里），预计在登陆前“进一步增强”。

paras.en: As Scientific American previously reported, the Atlantic hurricane season has been historically quiet this year. That’s in no small part because of a strong, brewing El Niño, which typically dampens Atlantic hurricanes with unfavorable wind conditions. The region had seen no hurricanes form between June and September—an unparalleled dry spell.
paras.zh: 正如《科学美国人》此前报道的那样，今年大西洋飓风季节历来平静。这在很大程度上是由于正在酝酿的强烈厄尔尼诺现象，它通常会在不利的风力条件下抑制大西洋飓风。六月至九月期间，该地区没有出现飓风，这是一段前所未有的干旱期。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Officials officially upgraded Isaias’s status from a tropical storm to a hurricane—a storm with wind speeds at or above 74 mph (119 kph)—at 3:30 A.M. UTC on October 8. According to meteorologists, that’s the latest first hurricane since satellite tracking began. (Prior to that, a hurricane that didn’t make landfall could go unnoticed, making it hard to say if this is the latest-forming storm for the region ever.)
paras.zh: 凌晨 3 点 30 分，官员们正式将伊萨亚斯的状态从热带风暴升级为飓风，即风速达到或超过 74 英里/小时（119 公里/小时）的风暴。 UTC 时间 10 月 8 日。据气象学家称，这是自卫星跟踪开始以来最新的第一场飓风。 （在此之前，没有登陆的飓风可能会被忽视，因此很难说这是否是该地区有史以来最新形成的风暴。）

paras.en: Still, Isaias beat the previous record by a stunning 27 days, hurricane researcher Brian McNoldy wrote on social media.
paras.zh: 飓风研究员布赖恩·麦克诺迪（Brian McNoldy）在社交媒体上写道，尽管如此，伊萨亚斯仍以惊人的 27 天时间打破了之前的纪录。

paras.en: “There was beginning to be some uncertainty about whether the Atlantic would get any hurricanes at all this season, but having the first one occur so late in the season is undoubtedly a result of the very strong El Niño building in the central Pacific Ocean,” McNoldy tells Scientific American. “Activity in the deep tropical Atlantic has been shut down this year due to the El Niño–induced wind shear, so the Gulf is one of the few places where this could happen.”
paras.zh: 麦克诺迪告诉《科学美国人》：“对于这个季节大西洋是否会出现飓风，人们开始存在一些不确定性，但在这个季节如此晚的时候第一次出现飓风无疑是太平洋中部非常强烈的厄尔尼诺现象的结果。” “由于厄尔尼诺现象引发的风切变，今年热带大西洋深处的活动已经停止，因此海湾是少数可能发生这种情况的地方之一。”

paras.en: Like any hurricane, Isaias poses a real danger: Officials have put a hurricane warning—meaning, extreme wind and rain conditions are expected—in effect for parts of Mississippi, Alabama and Florida. Dangerous storm surge is possible from Louisiana to the Florida Panhandle. There is also the possibility of “isolated tornadoes” in parts of Alabama, Florida and southwestern Georgia, according to NOAA.
paras.zh: 与任何飓风一样，伊萨亚斯也构成了真正的危险：官员们已经对密西西比州、阿拉巴马州和佛罗里达州的部分地区发出了飓风警告，这意味着预计将出现极端的风雨天气。从路易斯安那州到佛罗里达州狭长地带，可能会出现危险的风暴潮。据美国国家海洋和大气管理局称，阿拉巴马州、佛罗里达州和佐治亚州西南部的部分地区也有可能出现“孤立的龙卷风”。

paras.en: “Preparations to protect life and property should be rushed to completion,” the agency said.
paras.zh: 该机构表示：“保护生命和财产的准备工作应该尽快完成。”

paras.en: Editor’s Note (10/8/26): This is a breaking news story and may be updated.
paras.zh: 编者注（10/8/26）：这是一个突发新闻报道，可能会更新。

articles.title: Artemis II images boost NASA’s moon base plans

paras.en: NASA’s Artemis II mission—a slingshot around the moon earlier this year that sent four astronauts to lunar space for the first time in more than half a century—was an unequivocal success. The voyage was chiefly a technological stepping stone for future crewed forays to the lunar surface, which should culminate with the founding of a small base near the moon’s south pole. But it was also a chance to carry out novel observations of the lunar farside, a largely mysterious realm that has been rarely glimpsed by human eyes.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局的阿耳忒弥斯二号任务——今年早些时候的一次绕月弹弓，半个多世纪以来首次将四名宇航员送入月球太空——取得了明确的成功。这次航行主要是未来载人登陆月球表面的技术垫脚石，最终将在月球南极附近建立一个小型基地。但这也是对月球背面进行新奇观测的机会，这是一个人类肉眼很少看到的神秘领域。

paras.en: Although Artemis II’s Orion spacecraft carried minimal science payloads, its astronauts were equipped with digital cameras (and iPhones)—and between April 1 and 10, they captured 814 gigabytes of lunar science data. At a press conference yesterday NASA presented its preliminary findings, which touch on everything from the moon’s surprisingly colorful craters to a series of curious flashes that the astronauts spied in lunar shadows. The release also includes more than eight hours of audio from the crew, videos of their nail-biting return to Earth, hand-annotated images, and much more—all available in a vast online repository.
paras.zh: 尽管阿耳忒弥斯二号的猎户座飞船携带的科学有效载荷很少，但其宇航员配备了数码相机（和 iPhone），在 4 月 1 日至 10 日期间，他们捕获了 814 GB 的月球科学数据。在昨天的新闻发布会上，美国宇航局公布了其初步发现，其中涉及从月球令人惊讶的多彩陨石坑到宇航员在月球阴影中发现的一系列奇怪闪光的一切。该版本还包括机组人员超过八小时的音频、他们返回地球的紧张视频、手工注释的图像等等，所有这些都可以在庞大的在线存储库中找到。
