paras.en: In the meantime, Netanyahu has called on the head of the National Security Council to appoint an examiner to review “all security aspects” of Israel’s civil aviation in the aftermath of the incident.
paras.zh: 与此同时，内塔尼亚胡呼吁国家安全委员会主席任命一名审查员，对事件发生后以色列民航的“所有安全方面”进行审查。

paras.en: Elsewhere, Vice President JD Vance underlined the concerns about potential security failures.
paras.zh: 在其他地方，副总裁 JD Vance 强调了对潜在安全故障的担忧。

paras.en: “That person should not have been flying an airline, and so we’re certainly looking at our procedures within the United States to make sure that people who are obviously flight risks are not getting behind the wheel of an airplane,” he told a reporter at Joint Base Andrews, Maryland, on Monday.
paras.zh: 他周一在马里兰州安德鲁斯联合基地对记者表示：“那个人不应该乘坐航空公司的航班，因此我们肯定会审查美国境内的程序，以确保明显有飞行风险的人不会驾驶飞机。”

articles.title: Russia says no plague found in contacts of Siberian lab worker who died
articles.author: Yuliya Talmazan

paras.en: Plague had not been detected among close contacts of a worker in an anti-plague laboratory in Siberia who died last week, with 60% of the identified group tested so far, officials in Russia said Tuesday.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯官员周二表示，西伯利亚一家抗鼠疫实验室上周死亡的一名工作人员的密切接触者中尚未发现鼠疫，目前已对已确定人群中的 60% 进行了检测。

paras.en: News from Russia’s consumer and health watchdog Sunday that a female staffer at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia and the Far East had died from a “pneumonia of undetermined” origin last week has raised public health fears worldwide.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯消费者和健康监管机构周日发布消息称，西伯利亚和远东伊尔库茨克抗鼠疫研究所的一名女工作人员上周死于“不明原因肺炎”，这一消息引发了全世界的公共卫生担忧。

paras.en: “Laboratory testing identified two cases of Covid-19 and two cases of rhinovirus infection,” watchdog Rospotrebnadzor said in a statement, referring to the virus that causes the common cold. “No other infectious disease pathogens were detected among the contacts,” the statement said, without mentioning the word “plague.”
paras.zh: 监管机构 Rospotrebnadzor 在一份声明中表示，“实验室检测发现了两例 Covid-19 病例和两例鼻病毒感染病例”，指的是引起普通感冒的病毒。声明称，“在接触者中未发现其他传染病病原体”，但没有提及“鼠疫”一词。

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump said Tuesday he had a call scheduled with Russian President Vladimir Putin to discuss the matter.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周二表示，他计划与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京通话，讨论此事。

paras.en: Darya Shipilova, 28, was identified by her mother and Russian media outlets as the lab worker who died.
paras.zh: 28 岁的达莉亚·希皮洛娃 (Darya Shipilova) 被她的母亲和俄罗斯媒体确认为死亡的实验室工作人员。

paras.en: Regional and national Russian authorities have not confirmed that plague was involved in her death. However, a State Department spokesperson said Monday there had been “reports of a fatal case of suspected pneumonic plague” in Irkutsk oblast.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯地区和国家当局尚未证实她的死亡与瘟疫有关。然而，美国国务院发言人周一表示，伊尔库茨克州有“疑似肺鼠疫死亡病例的报告”。

paras.en: Separately, a State Department official told NBC News on Tuesday that the U.S. had been in contact with the Russian government as early as Friday. Health experts at the State Department had taken part in the contact along with the Russian Foreign Affairs Ministry, the official said.
paras.zh: 另外，美国国务院一名官员周二对 NBC 新闻表示，美国早在周五就已与俄罗斯政府进行了接触。这位官员说，国务院的卫生专家与俄罗斯外交部一起参与了接触。

paras.en: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention also said on X that it was “working across the U.S. government to assess developments as additional information becomes available.”
paras.zh: 美国疾病控制与预防中心也在 X 上表示，它“正在与美国政府合作，在获得更多信息时评估事态发展”。

paras.en: “At this time, there is no indication of a broader threat to the United States, but CDC and our interagency partners are prepared and will continue to monitor the situation closely,” it added.
paras.zh: 声明补充说：“目前没有迹象表明美国面临更广泛的威胁，但疾病预防控制中心和我们的跨机构合作伙伴已做好准备，并将继续密切监视局势。”

paras.en: The World Health Organization, which oversees global public health matters, said Tuesday that Russian health officials had informed it in response to its request about the lab worker’s death that no case of plague has been recorded in Irkutsk.
paras.zh: 负责监督全球公共卫生事务的世界卫生组织周二表示，俄罗斯卫生官员已根据其有关实验室工作人员死亡的要求告知其，伊尔库茨克尚未记录到鼠疫病例。

paras.en: “According to the authorities, the woman’s illness initially presented as a typical acute respiratory viral infection,” it said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“据当局称，该妇女的病情最初表现为典型的急性呼吸道病毒感染。”

paras.en: No case of plague or other high-threat pathogen has reportedly been found among the woman’s close contacts, the WHO said, quoting the response from the Russian officials, adding that it’s awaiting confirmation from the Russian side about “what pneumonia-causing pathogen had led to the individual’s death.”
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织援引俄罗斯官员的回应称，据报道在该妇女的密切接触者中尚未发现鼠疫或其他高威胁病原体病例，并补充说，正在等待俄罗斯方面确认“哪种肺炎病原体导致了该人的死亡”。

paras.en: On Friday, Maksim Modin, mayor of the Shelekhov municipal district near the border with Mongolia, said that the inpatient facility where the worker is said to have been treated had been closed for quarantine. Russian media cited officials saying that nearly 200 people who had been in contact with the woman had been placed under precautionary medical observation.
paras.zh: 周五，靠近蒙古边境的谢列霍夫市市长马克西姆·莫丁表示，据称这名工人接受治疗的住院设施已关闭进行隔离。俄罗斯媒体援引官员的话称，近200名与该女子有过接触的人已接受预防性医学观察。

paras.en: Russian media outlets have named the woman and identified her as being 28 years old. These details have not been announced by officials.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯媒体已公布这名女子的姓名，确认她今年 28 岁。这些细节尚未由官方公布。

paras.en: Irkutsk’s governor, Igor Kobsev, said Monday that no “microorganisms linked to the employee’s professional activities were detected” in her body.
paras.zh: 伊尔库茨克州州长伊戈尔·科布采夫周一表示，在她的体内“未检测到与该员工职业活动相关的微生物”。

paras.en: The Irkutsk regional branch of Rospotrebnadzor on Tuesday denied what it called “fake” reports circulating online that an “enhanced sanitary-epidemiological regime” and strict restrictions have been imposed in the region.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯联邦运输局伊尔库茨克地区分公司周二否认了网上流传的“虚假”报道，称该地区已实施“加强卫生流行病学制度”和严格限制。

paras.en: “No such decisions have been made at this time,” it said in a statement, saying the situation in the region remains stable.
paras.zh: 它在一份声明中表示，“目前尚未做出此类决定”，并称该地区局势保持稳定。

paras.en: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Monday that even though there is “very limited travel between the U.S. and Russia,” if “something like that gets out, it could quickly spread.”
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥周一表示，尽管“美国和俄罗斯之间的旅行非常有限”，但如果“类似的事情传出去，它可能会迅速蔓延。”

paras.en: Rospotrebnadzor, the health watchdog, said Tuesday its probe found “no incidents involving the handling of pathogenic microorganisms.”
paras.zh: 卫生监督机构 Rospotrebnadzor 周二表示，其调查发现“没有涉及处理病原微生物的事件”。

paras.en: Trump told reporters Monday the United States would do what it could to help Russia.
paras.zh: 特朗普周一告诉记者，美国将尽其所能帮助俄罗斯。

paras.en: “I hate to see them having it,” Trump said. “It’s a rough disease.”
paras.zh: “我讨厌看到他们拥有它，”特朗普说。 “这是一种很严重的疾病。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, some of Russia’s neighbors have been stepping up preventive measures and quarantine controls at border crossings.
paras.zh: 与此同时，俄罗斯的一些邻国一直在加强边境口岸的预防措施和检疫控制。

paras.en: The Kremlin has called for those concerned to heed official statements.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫呼吁有关人士留意官方声明。

paras.en: “Rospotrebnadzor provides comprehensive information,” Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said when reporters pressed him about rumors spreading amid sparse official statements.
paras.zh: 当记者追问克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫（Dmitry Peskov）称，“俄罗斯联邦通讯社”提供了全面的信息。

paras.en: Peskov also deferred to Rospotrebnadzor when asked if the worker’s lab results would be released or if an autopsy has been conducted.
paras.zh: 当被问及是否会公布该工人的实验室结果或是否已进行尸检时，佩斯科夫也听取了俄罗斯联邦俄罗斯局的意见。

paras.en: On its website, the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia and the Far East says it was founded in 1934 “as a scientific and operational body for combating plague,” but over the years, its scope of responsibility expanded to include “other highly dangerous diseases,” including cholera and anthrax.
paras.zh: 西伯利亚和远东伊尔库茨克抗鼠疫研究所在其网站上表示，它成立于 1934 年，“是一个抗击鼠疫的科学和业务机构”，但多年来，其责任范围扩大到包括“其他高度危险的疾病”，包括霍乱和炭疽。

paras.en: The institute says it’s a “multidisciplinary research and anti-epidemic facility” that helps ensure epidemic safety in the region.
paras.zh: 该研究所表示，这是一个“多学科研究和抗疫设施”，有助于确保该地区的疫情安全。

articles.title: At least 30 people killed after Russia bombs two buses in Ukraine
articles.author: Yuliya Talmazan

paras.en: At least 30 people were killed when a Russian bomb struck two buses in the Ukrainian front-line city of Kramatorsk on Thursday, local officials said, as Moscow’s intensifying attacks grow ever more deadly.
paras.zh: 当地官员称，周四，乌克兰前线城市克拉马托尔斯克的两辆公共汽车遭到俄罗斯炸弹袭击，造成至少 30 人死亡，莫斯科愈演愈烈的袭击变得越来越致命。

paras.en: Another 18 people were wounded when the bomb hit a street in the city at 10 a.m. local time (3 a.m. ET), Ukraine’s National Police said in a statement.
paras.zh: 乌克兰国家警察在一份声明中称，当地时间上午 10 点（美国东部时间凌晨 3 点），炸弹袭击该市街道，另有 18 人受伤。

paras.en: Kramatorsk’s regional governor, Vadym Filashkin, accused Russia of deliberately targeting civilians, sharing images of a charred bus wreckage and bodies and body parts on the road next to it. Filashkin said he was shutting down public transport in the city and neighboring Sloviansk in light of “the sharp deterioration of the security situation.”
paras.zh: 克拉马托尔斯克地区州长瓦迪姆·菲拉什金 (Vadym Filashkin) 指责俄罗斯故意针对平民，并分享了烧焦的巴士残骸以及旁边道路上的尸体和身体部位的图像。菲拉什金表示，鉴于“安全局势急剧恶化”，他将关闭该市和邻近斯洛维斯克的公共交通。

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said in a statement on his social media channels that Russia struck “an ordinary public transport stop” in Kramatorsk with an aerial bomb.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基在其社交媒体频道上发表声明称，俄罗斯用航空炸弹袭击了克拉马托尔斯克的“一个普通公共交通站点”。

paras.en: In a later post, he said doctors were fighting to save the lives of those injured and “some of those killed have still not been identified because of the severity of their injuries.”
paras.zh: 在后来的帖子中，他表示医生正在努力挽救伤者的生命，“由于伤势严重，一些遇难者的身份仍未确定。”

paras.en: Kramatorsk is close to the active front line and part of Ukraine’s industrial Donbass region, which has been central to Russian President Vladimir Putin war plans.
paras.zh: 克拉马托尔斯克靠近活跃的前线，也是乌克兰工业顿巴斯地区的一部分，该地区一直是俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京战争计划的核心。

paras.en: Civilian casualties have surged as Russia intensifies attacks across Ukraine, which is running low on air defense munitions.
paras.zh: 随着俄罗斯加强对乌克兰境内的袭击，平民伤亡人数激增，而乌克兰的防空弹药已经不足。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said in a social media post that it was important the country received “new packages for Ukraine’s defense” promised by its allies. “Supplies of anti-ballistic capabilities, ammunition for our combat aircraft and investments in interceptors — all of this is directly helping save lives every day,” he added.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基在社交媒体帖子中表示，该国收到其盟友承诺的“乌克兰国防新方案”非常重要。他补充说：“反弹道能力的供应、战斗机的弹药以及拦截器的投资——所有这些都在直接帮助每天拯救生命。”

paras.en: Russian bombs hit Ukrainian public buses
paras.zh: 俄罗斯炸弹袭击乌克兰公共汽车

paras.en: His comments came as Ukraine has suffered from an uptick in daytime attacks in recent weeks, creating a round-the-clock threat to civilians.
paras.zh: 他发表此番言论之际，乌克兰最近几周白天的袭击事件有所增加，对平民造成了全天候的威胁。

paras.en: Thursday’s strike came a day after a missile strike on a residential building in the north of the country killed 22 people, including five children.
paras.zh: 周四的袭击发生前一天，该国北部一栋住宅楼遭到导弹袭击，造成 22 人死亡，其中包括 5 名儿童。

paras.en: Zelenskyy visited the site of that attack Thursday, saying in a Telegram post: “Over a hundred residential buildings were damaged, as well as educational institutions, kindergartens, shops, enterprises, and infrastructure that supports normal life in the city.”
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基周四视察了袭击现场，并在一份电报中表示：“一百多栋住宅楼以及支持城市正常生活的教育机构、幼儿园、商店、企业和基础设施遭到破坏。”

paras.en: Moscow has repeatedly denied that it deliberately targets civilians in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 莫斯科一再否认其故意针对乌克兰平民。

paras.en: Elsewhere, Reuters reported Zelenskyy as saying that Ukrainian negotiators will visit the United States for talks Friday and Saturday.
paras.zh: 其他地方，路透社报道泽伦斯基表示，乌克兰谈判代表将于周五和周六访问美国进行会谈。

paras.en: Urging President Donald Trump to step up pressure on Russia, he said: “One cannot, on the one hand, negotiate with the Russians about future economic projects, whilst on the other hand say that we find ourselves in some sort of... diplomatic stalemate.”
paras.zh: 他敦促唐纳德·特朗普总统加大对俄罗斯的压力，他说：“我们不能一方面与俄罗斯就未来的经济项目进行谈判，另一方面又说我们发现自己陷入了某种……外交僵局。”

articles.title: Car burnt in driveway in Melbourne's south-east 14th this week

paras.en: Police are investigating another car fire in Melbourne after a week of arson attacks across the city.
paras.zh: 在全市发生一周纵火袭击后，警方正在调查墨尔本的另一起汽车火灾。

paras.en: The vehicle was parked in the driveway of a home on Horizon Boulevard in Hampton Park when it was engulfed in flames just after 4am.
paras.zh: 这辆车停在汉普顿公园地平线大道上一户人家的车道上，凌晨 4 点刚过就被大火吞没。

paras.en: It is the 14th vehicle destroyed by fire in the past five days.
paras.zh: 这是过去五天里第14辆被火灾烧毁的车辆。

paras.en: Arson Squad detectives will examine the scene as investigations continue into the spate of firebombings that have happened outside homes in Taylors Hill, Keilor, Balwyn North, Maidstone, Reservoir and Oakleigh East.
paras.zh: 纵火队侦探将检查现场，继续对泰勒山、凯勒、博文北、梅德斯通、水库和奥克利东的房屋外发生的一系列燃烧弹事件进行调查。

paras.en: Acting Commander Troy Papworth yesterday said police believed the rise in arson attacks was linked to organised crime and appeared to be an intimidation tactic.
paras.zh: 代理指挥官特洛伊·帕普沃斯昨天表示，警方认为纵火袭击事件的增加与有组织犯罪有关，似乎是一种恐吓策略。

paras.en: He said the practice posed a major danger to both victims and culprits, with several of the fires spreading to homes this week and a 13-year-old boy clinging to life with burns to 90 per cent of his body after the Taylors Hill blaze.
paras.zh: 他表示，这种做法对受害者和肇事者都构成了重大危险，泰勒山大火本周有多起火灾蔓延至民宅，一名 13 岁男孩全身 90% 被烧伤，仍幸存。

articles.title: Katie Lynch wants to see AFL 'harness the momentum' of Pride Round
articles.author: Marnie Vinall

paras.en: The Gold Coast Suns' Katie Lynch says Pride Round comes at exactly the moment needed every season.
paras.zh: 黄金海岸太阳队的凯蒂·林奇表示，骄傲回合的到来正是每个赛季所需的时刻。

paras.en: Two weeks out from the men's season finishing and a month before the women start finals, it provides an injection of enthusiasm, celebration and joy.
paras.zh: 距离男子赛季结束还有两周，距离女子决赛开始还有一个月，这一天充满了热情、庆祝和欢乐。

paras.en: "A different energy comes into the competition on Pride Round," Lynch told ABC Sport.
paras.zh: “骄傲回合比赛中注入了不同的能量，”林奇告诉美国广播公司体育频道。

paras.en: "Because so many of our players connect with the movement and understand the power of the round for the community and who we represent," Lynch told ABC Sport.
paras.zh: 林奇告诉美国广播公司体育频道：“因为我们有很多球员都参与了这项运动，并且了解这项运动对社区的力量以及我们所代表的人。”

paras.en: However, Lynch would like to see that movement grow beyond the AFLW competition and across the whole AFL, to include not just the men's teams but all club staff and fans of the game.
paras.zh: 然而，林奇希望看到这种运动超越 AFLW 比赛并扩展到整个 AFL，不仅包括男子球队，还包括所有俱乐部工作人员和比赛的球迷。

paras.en: The dedicated league-wide Pride Round was introduced annually in 2021.
paras.zh: 专门的全联盟骄傲回合比赛于 2021 年推出。

paras.en: It celebrates inclusion and diversity over two weeks, while honouring the contributions of the LGBTQ+ community to the game and providing a platform for education on queer issues, particularly those entwined with the game.
paras.zh: 它在两周内庆祝包容性和多样性，同时表彰 LGBTQ+ 社区对游戏的贡献，并提供一个关于酷儿问题（尤其是与游戏相关的问题）的教育平台。

paras.en: "I think that can be perhaps transferred across more of the whole code essentially," Lynch said.
paras.zh: “我认为这或许可以本质上转移到整个代码的更多部分，”林奇说。

paras.en: "A pride round in the men's would be awesome to see, and I know from my experience, it's nothing but a positive experience, and so I can see that going enormously well and being enormously helpful for the entire code."
paras.zh: “男子骄傲赛真是太棒了，从我的经验来看，这只是一次积极的经历，所以我可以看到这一切进展得非常顺利，并且对整个代码有极大的帮助。”

paras.en: Some LGBTQ+ Australian Rules fans and community members have felt the pang of exclusion from the sport in recent years.
paras.zh: 近年来，一些 LGBTQ+ 澳大利亚规则粉丝和社区成员感受到了被排除在这项运动之外的痛苦。

paras.en: In the past three years, there have been 10 cases of AFL-listed players or coaches sanctioned for homophobic language, including Suns players Max Knobel this year and star defender Wil Powell in 2024.
paras.zh: 过去三年，已有10起AFL球员或教练因恐同言论受到制裁的案例，其中包括今年的太阳队球员马克斯·诺贝尔和2024年的明星后卫威尔·鲍威尔。

paras.en: When put to Lynch whether an extended Pride Round would help in this regard, she said the game of Aussie Rules had always been excellent at creating a space for people to connect, converse and interact, and that Pride Round was an incredible vehicle to do that around LGBTQ+ issues and experiences.
paras.zh: 当被问及林奇延长“骄傲回合”是否会在这方面有所帮助时，她表示，澳大利亚规则游戏在为人们创造联系、交谈和互动的空间方面一直表现出色，而“骄傲回合”是围绕 LGBTQ+ 问题和体验做到这一点的令人难以置信的工具。

paras.en: "We know that the players and the code have significant ability to influence, of course, and we've seen that probably have a negative effect on our fans more recently," she said.
paras.zh: “当然，我们知道玩家和代码具有显着的影响力，而且我们最近发现这可能会对我们的粉丝产生负面影响，”她说。

paras.en: "So I think for me, it's how do we shift that dial to come back the other way?
paras.zh: “所以我认为对我来说，问题是我们如何转动旋钮以其他方式返回？

paras.en: "And that's why I talk about things like visibility and representation."
paras.zh: “这就是为什么我谈论可见性和代表性等问题。”

paras.en: She said it was also a great opportunity to connect more fans to the game, and have them feel seen within it.
paras.zh: 她表示，这也是一个很好的机会，让更多粉丝参与到游戏中，让他们感受到自己在游戏中被看到。

paras.en: This year Lynch helped design the club's Pride guernsey alongside her teammate Lily Mithen and good friend and tattoo artist Mady Peters.
paras.zh: 今年，林奇与她的队友莉莉·米森（Lily Mithen）以及好朋友兼纹身艺术家玛迪·彼得斯（Mady Peters）一起帮助设计了俱乐部的骄傲根西岛。

paras.en: It resembles patchwork tattoos and stickers, including a tramp stamp on the back, which Lynch says is proof they had a lot of fun putting it together.
paras.zh: 它类似于拼凑而成的纹身和贴纸，包括背面的流浪汉印记，林奇说这证明他们把它们组合在一起很有趣。

paras.en: But more than that, Lynch said it felt special to have her friend Peters "who doesn't even know what a drop punt is" now have an attachment to the game of AFLW through the Pride movement, where she is represented as a queer person.
paras.zh: 但更重要的是，林奇表示，让她的朋友彼得斯“甚至不知道什么是弃踢”现在通过骄傲运动对 AFLW 比赛产生了依恋，这感觉很特别，在骄傲运动中，她被描绘成一个酷儿。

paras.en: Lynch said she noticed the boost in attendance during Pride Round, including within her own friend group.
paras.zh: 林奇说，她注意到骄傲回合的出席人数有所增加，其中包括她自己的朋友团体。

paras.en: "My friends are great, very supportive of me … but if they're going to come to a game, it's Pride Round," she said.
paras.zh: “我的朋友们都很棒，非常支持我……但如果他们要来看一场比赛，那就是骄傲回合，”她说。

paras.en: "Pride Round has the power to bring people, even loose fans of AFL, to the game … and not only to experience the joy of it but they're there because they feel like they belong there."
paras.zh: “骄傲回合有能力让人们，甚至是 AFL 的铁杆球迷，参与到比赛中……不仅是为了体验比赛的乐趣，而且是因为他们觉得自己属于那里。”

paras.en: She wants that "special feeling" to reach even further.
paras.zh: 她希望这种“特殊的感觉”能够延伸得更远。

paras.en: "That's what I've felt, particularly this year, is the support for us and this Pride Round has been enormous, and it's growing," she said.
paras.zh: “这就是我所感受到的，特别是今年，对我们的支持，这次骄傲回合的支持是巨大的，而且还在不断增长，”她说。

paras.en: "The opportunity now is to harness the momentum we've got and use it in a growth capacity.
paras.zh: “现在的机会是利用我们现有的动力并将其用于增长能力。

paras.en: "We'll probably never know the enormity of pride and visibility, particularly as players … I feel there's so much impact that I don't see, but I know is there."
paras.zh: “我们可能永远不会知道自豪感和知名度的巨大性，特别是作为球员……我觉得有很多我看不到的影响，但我知道它就在那里。”

articles.title: South Africa vs Australia Test series, everything you need to know
articles.author: Simon Smale

paras.en: Australia is back in South Africa for one of the most eagerly anticipated Test series in recent history.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚回到南非，参加近代历史上最受期待的系列测试之一。

paras.en: It has been eight long years since Australia last toured South Africa in red-ball cricket, in a series that will forever be remembered for its ignominy.
paras.zh: 距离澳大利亚上一次在南非进行红球板球巡回赛已经过去八年了，这场系列赛因其耻辱而将永远被人们铭记。

paras.en: Sandpapergate is what that contest will be remembered for, but even before that, it was crossing a red line in despicable behaviour unbecoming of the sport.
paras.zh: 沙纸门是那场比赛将被铭记的地方，但即使在此之前，它的卑鄙行为也已经跨越了红线，与这项运动不相称。

paras.en: Here's everything you need to know ahead of the three-Test series.
paras.zh: 以下是您在三项测试系列之前需要了解的所有信息。

paras.en: The first is at Kingsmead in Durban from October 9 to 13.
paras.zh: 第一个活动将于 10 月 9 日至 13 日在德班 Kingsmead 举行。

paras.en: The second is at St George's Park in Gqeberha from October 18 to 22.
paras.zh: 第二场比赛将于 10 月 18 日至 22 日在 Gqeberha 的圣乔治公园举行。

paras.en: And Newlands in Cape Town will host the third from October 27 to 31.
paras.zh: 第三届比赛将于 10 月 27 日至 31 日在开普敦纽兰兹举办。

paras.en: The Durban Test starts at 6:30pm AEDT and will likely run through to 2am AEDT.
paras.zh: 德班测试于澳大利亚东部时间下午 6:30 开始，并可能持续到澳大利亚东部时间凌晨 2 点。

paras.en: That AEDT time relates to New South Wales, the ACT, Victoria and Tasmania.
paras.zh: 该 AEDT 时间适用于新南威尔士州、首都领地、维多利亚州和塔斯马尼亚州。

paras.en: In Queensland, the action begins at 5:30pm.
paras.zh: 在昆士兰州，活动于下午 5:30 开始。

paras.en: And the first ball will be bowled at 3:30pm in Western Australia.
paras.zh: 第一个球将于下午 3:30 在西澳大利亚举行。

paras.en: The entire series is live on Fox Sports and Kayo.
paras.zh: 整个系列赛均由福克斯体育频道和 Kayo 直播。

paras.en: ABC Sport will also have live radio commentary on the ABC Listen App or online.
paras.zh: ABC Sport 还将在 ABC Listen 应用程序或在线上提供现场广播评论。

paras.en: You can also follow every ball in our live blog on the ABC Sport website.
paras.zh: 您还可以在 ABC Sport 网站上的实时博客中关注每一个球。

paras.en: Australia's squad: Pat Cummins (c), Scott Boland, Alex Carey (wk), Cooper Connolly, Cameron Green, Sam Harper (wk), Josh Hazlewood, Travis Head, Matthew Kuhnemann, Marnus Labuschagne, Nathan Lyon, Nic Maddinson, Michael Neser, Matt Renshaw, Steven Smith, Mitchell Starc, Beau Webster.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚队：帕特·康明斯（中）、斯科特·博兰、亚历克斯·凯里（周）、库珀·康诺利、卡梅伦·格林、萨姆·哈珀（周）、乔什·黑兹尔伍德、特拉维斯·海德、马修·库尼曼、马努斯·拉布沙涅、内森·里昂、尼克·麦丁森、迈克尔·内瑟、马特·伦肖、史蒂文·史密斯、米切尔·斯塔克、博·韦伯斯特。

paras.en: South Africa's squad: Temba Bavuma (c), Marques Ackerman, David Bedingham, Corbin Bosch, Gerald Coetzee, Tony de Zorzi, Simon Harmer, Marco Jansen, Keshav Maharaj, Aiden Markram, Wiaan Mulder, Senuran Muthusamy, Anrich Nortje, Dane Paterson, Kagiso Rabada, Ryan Rickelton (wk), Tristan Stubbs (wk), Kyle Verreynne (wk).
paras.zh: 南非队：Temba Bavuma（中）、Marques Ackerman、David Bedingham、Corbin Bosch、Gerald Coetzee、Tony de Zorzi、Simon Harmer、Marco Jansen、Keshav Maharaj、Aiden Markram、Wiaan Mulder、Senuran Muthusamy、Anrich Nortje、Dane Paterson、Kagiso Rabada、Ryan Rickelton（wk）、Tristan Stubbs （周），凯尔·维雷恩（周）。

paras.en: Australia has won 54 of the 102 Test matches between the two teams, with 21 draws and 27 defeats since their first meeting in 1902.
paras.zh: 自1902年首次交手以来，澳大利亚队在两队之间的102场测试赛中赢了54场，其中21平27负。

paras.en: On South African soil, Australia also has a winning record, with 29 victories against 16 defeats and nine draws.
paras.zh: 在南非的土地上，澳大利亚也有29胜16负9平的胜利记录。

paras.en: Australia has won six of the 11 Tests played at St George's in Durban, including winning each of the last three Tests it has played there, while South Africa has won three with two draws.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚在德班圣乔治举行的 11 场测试赛中赢得了 6 场，包括在过去的 3 场测试赛中全部获胜，而南非则以 2 场平局赢得了 3 场比赛。

paras.en: The two teams also drew a Test at the city's old Lord's ground in 1921, before the venue's demolition in 1922.
paras.zh: 1921 年，两支球队还在这座城市的老勋爵球场进行了一场测试赛，随后该球场于 1922 年被拆除。

paras.en: South Africa has a much better record at St George's Park in Gqeberha though, winning four of the seven matches played there, including the last two.
paras.zh: 不过，南非在格凯贝哈圣乔治公园的战绩要好得多，在那里举行的七场比赛中赢了四场，包括最后两场。

paras.en: Before 2021, Gqeberha was Port Elizabeth, but is now known by its Xhosa name, and this is the first time Australia will play in the city under its new name.
paras.zh: 2021 年之前，格克贝哈是伊丽莎白港，但现在以科萨语名称为人所知，这是澳大利亚第一次以新名称在这座城市进行比赛。

paras.en: Australia has a great record at Newlands though, winning 10 of the 14 Tests played in the shadow of Table Mountain. However, it has only won one of its last four Tests at the ground considered one of the most beautiful in the world.
paras.zh: 不过，澳大利亚在纽兰兹的记录非常出色，在桌山下举行的 14 场测试赛中赢得了 10 场。然而，它在被认为是世界上最美丽的场地之一的最近四次测试中只赢得了其中一次。

paras.en: The two teams last played a Test in June 2025, when South Africa shocked Australia at Lord's to win the World Test Championship.
paras.zh: 两队上一次进行测试赛是在 2025 年 6 月，当时南非队在洛德赛上震惊澳大利亚，赢得了世界测试赛冠军。

paras.en: In the 2022/23 summer of cricket, Australia claimed a 2-0 Test series victory over South Africa on home soil.
paras.zh: 在 2022/23 年夏季板球比赛中，澳大利亚在主场以 2-0 战胜南非。

paras.en: The last time Australia played a Test series in South Africa was 2018, and it's safe to say things were … complicated.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚上次在南非参加测试系列赛是在 2018 年，可以肯定地说事情非常……复杂。

paras.en: It is fair to say the 2018 series was combative, fiery, febrile and chaotic.
paras.zh: 可以说，2018 年的系列赛充满了战斗性、火热性、狂热性和混乱性。

paras.en: Australia won the first Test at Kingsmead in Durban, but not before David Warner and Quinton de Kock almost came to blows in a stairwell at the end of the fourth day.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚队在德班 Kingsmead 举行的首场测试中获胜，但在第四天结束时，大卫·华纳 (David Warner) 和昆顿·德科克 (Quinton de Kock) 差点在楼梯间里打起来。

paras.en: South Africa won the second Test in Gqeberha, but man of the match Kagiso Rabada, who took 5/96 and 6/54, was subsequently banned for barging into Steve Smith after dismissing him in the first innings.
paras.zh: 南非队在格克贝哈赢得了第二场测试赛，但本场比赛的最佳球员卡吉索·拉巴达（Kagiso Rabada）以5/96和6/54的成绩，在第一局将史蒂夫·史密斯驱逐出局后，因闯入史蒂夫·史密斯而被禁赛。

paras.en: Rabada was then handed a reprieve after an appeal involving one of South Africa's highest-profile lawyers, freeing him to play the next two matches.
paras.zh: 在南非最著名的律师之一提起上诉后，拉巴达获得缓刑，从而可以参加接下来的两场比赛。

paras.en: The third Test was in Cape Town where, in the shadows of Table Mountain, Australia's descent into the dark arts was exposed.
paras.zh: 第三次测试在开普敦举行，桌山的阴影下，澳大利亚的黑暗艺术堕落暴露无遗。

paras.en: On the third day, host broadcaster Supersport captured Cameron Bancroft rubbing the ball with a square of sandpaper to help encourage the prodigious reverse swing that had featured throughout the series thus far.
paras.zh: 第三天，主播 Supersport 捕捉到卡梅伦·班克罗夫特 (Cameron Bancroft) 用一块方形砂纸摩擦球，以帮助鼓励迄今为止整个系列赛中的惊人反向挥杆。

paras.en: While South Africa romped to a 322-run win and a series lead, the full extent of Australia's cheating was exposed, leading to a moral reckoning about the team's approach back home, with then-prime minister Malcolm Turnbull leading the criticism of the offending players.
paras.zh: 当南非队以 322 分获胜并取得系列赛领先时，澳大利亚作弊行为的全部暴露，导致人们对球队在国内的做法进行道德反思，时任总理马尔科姆·特恩布尔带头批评了违规球员。

paras.en: Smith, Bancroft and Warner were all sent home in disgrace, and an under-manned Australian team was thumped by 492 runs at the Wanderers in Johannesburg.
paras.zh: 史密斯、班克罗夫特和华纳都耻辱地被送回家，一支人手不足的澳大利亚队在约翰内斯堡以 492 分的成绩惨败于流浪者队。

paras.en: Australia has toured South Africa twice since the 2018 Test series, in 2020 and 2023 for limited-overs matches, with Smith and Warner both involved.
paras.zh: 自 2018 年测试系列赛以来，澳大利亚已两次前往南非，分别在 2020 年和 2023 年进行有限轮比赛，史密斯和华纳都参加了比赛。

articles.title: Ousted Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro, wife Celia Flores charged with torture in new indictment

paras.en: Ousted Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro, wife Celia Flores charged with torture in new indictment
paras.zh: 被罢黜的委内瑞拉总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗及其妻子西莉亚·弗洛雷斯在新起诉书中被控酷刑

paras.en: - The U.S. charged former Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro and his wife Cilia Flores with conspiracy to commit torture in a new indictment today.
paras.zh: - 美国今天在一份新起诉书中指控委内瑞拉前总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗和他的妻子西莉亚·弗洛雷斯合谋实施酷刑。

paras.en: - Maduro and Flores are accused of torturing political opponents with beatings, electric shocks and other methods. Prosecutors alleged the Maduro government tortured and killed thousands of Venezuelans.
paras.zh: - 马杜罗和弗洛雷斯被指控以殴打、电击和其他方式折磨政治对手。检察官指控马杜罗政府折磨并杀害了数千名委内瑞拉人。

paras.en: - Maduro and Flores were captured by the United States in a special military operation in January and brought to New York to face drug trafficking charges. They have pleaded not guilty and are set to go on trial next year.
paras.zh: - 马杜罗和弗洛雷斯在一月份的一次特别军事行动中被美国抓获，并被带到纽约接受贩毒指控。他们已不认罪，并将于明年接受审判。

paras.en: - Flores appeared in court today seeking release from her Brooklyn jail for health reasons, but her request was denied.
paras.zh: - 弗洛雷斯今天出庭，因健康原因寻求从布鲁克林监狱获释，但她的请求被拒绝。

paras.en: - October 8 Graphic allegations of torture in new charges against ousted Venezuelan leader Mark Gollom The U.S. government announced today it was adding torture related charges to those already faced by former Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro and his wife Cilia Flores. The details in the indictment about the alleged torture of prisoners, filed in a U.S. court, were graphic, including accusations of "electric shock, asphyxiation, starvation, beatings and rape." Prosecutors alleged the Maduro government tortured and killed thousands of Venezuelans. The indictment also included the stories of three U.S. victims, who prosecutors allege were tortured while held in custody. Maduro and Flores have been behind bars in New York since early January when U.S. military forces seized them from their Caracas home in a nighttime raid. They already face potential life prison sentences if convicted on their January charges of being part of a conspiracy to send cocaine into the U.S. Separately today, a U.S. judge denied a request by Flores to be released on bail for medical reasons. Flores' lawyers had said their client needs a cardiac procedure and want her released to recover in a New York City residence with round-the-clock private security.
paras.zh: - 10 月 8 日 针对被驱逐的委内瑞拉领导人马克·戈洛姆 (Mark Gollom) 的新指控中的酷刑指控 美国政府今天宣布，将在委内瑞拉前总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗 (Nicolás Maduro) 及其妻子西莉亚·弗洛雷斯 (Cilia Flores) 已经面临的指控中增加与酷刑相关的指控。向美国法院提交的关于涉嫌酷刑囚犯的起诉书中的细节非常生动，包括对“电击、窒息、饥饿、殴打和强奸”的指控。检察官指控马杜罗政府折磨并杀害了数千名委内瑞拉人。起诉书还包括三名美国受害者的故事，检察官称他们在被拘留期间遭受酷刑。自一月初美国军队在夜间突袭中将马杜罗和弗洛雷斯从加拉加斯的家中抓获以来，他们一直被关在纽约的监狱里。如果一月份被指控共谋向美国运送可卡因，他们可能面临终身监禁。今天，一名美国法官拒绝了弗洛雷斯因医疗原因保释的请求。弗洛雷斯的律师曾表示，他们的当事人需要接受心脏手术，并希望她被释放，在纽约市一处有全天候私人保安的住所中康复。

paras.en: - 'Truly unthinkable' conduct: U.S. attorney Mark Gollom Speaking to reporters outside a New York courthouse today, U.S. Attorney James M. McDonald said the indictment lays out allegations of conduct that was "truly unthinkable." He said the indictment charges that Maduro, Flores, and other Venezuelan leaders tried to silence political opposition "through murder and threats to murder victims' families, electric shock, asphyxiation, starvation, so-called punishment cells, beatings and rape." "The members of Maduro's broad conspiracy were not just sitting behind a desk. These members of the conspiracy were holding a shovel." McDonald said that today they were also adding Flores to the narco terrorism charge.
paras.zh: -“真正不可想象”的行为：美国检察官马克·戈洛姆 今天在纽约法院外对记者发表讲话，美国检察官詹姆斯·M·麦克唐纳表示，起诉书列出了“真正不可想象”的行为指控。他说，起诉书指控马杜罗、弗洛雷斯和其他委内瑞拉领导人试图“通过谋杀和威胁谋杀受害者家属、电击、窒息、饥饿、所谓的惩罚牢房、殴打和强奸”来压制政治反对派。 “马杜罗广泛阴谋的成员不仅仅坐在桌子后面。这些阴谋成员还拿着一把铲子。”麦克唐纳表示，今天他们还将弗洛雷斯列入毒品恐怖主义指控中。

paras.en: - 'Incredible to see dictator in court,' alleged torture victim says Mark Gollom Warning: This entry includes alleged details of torture. A U.S. citizen who alleges he was tortured while held in custody in Venezuela for two years says "it's incredible to see a dictator in court." "The Maduro prosecution will do more to prevent the kidnapping of Americans by rogue regimes than 100 press releases from the United Nations," Matthew Heath, a former U.S. marine corporal from Tennessee, told The Associated Press. Heath, who was arrested at a roadblock in Venezuela in 2020, had separately sued Maduro in a U.S. court over the alleged beatings he said he received. In May, Heath and another former prisoner won a $300 million US default judgment against Maduro and other top Venezuelan officials. But Maduro has ignored such lawsuits. The lawsuit included allegations of waterboarding, electrocution, threats of rape with a nightstick and administration of mind-altering medications, all taking place in a cramped cell, AP reported.
paras.zh: - 据称酷刑受害者马克·戈洛姆 (Mark Gollom) 表示，“在法庭上看到独裁者令人难以置信” 警告：此条目包含据称的酷刑细节。一名美国公民声称自己在委内瑞拉被拘留两年期间遭受酷刑，他说“在法庭上看到独裁者真是令人难以置信”。来自田纳西州的前美国海军陆战队下士马修·希思对美联社表示：“对马杜罗的起诉比联合国发布的 100 份新闻稿更有助于防止流氓政权绑架美国人。”希思于 2020 年在委内瑞拉的路障中被捕，他曾在美国法院单独起诉马杜罗，指控他声称自己受到殴打。今年 5 月，希思和另一名前囚犯赢得了美国对马杜罗和其他委内瑞拉高级官员的缺席判决，赔偿金额为 3 亿美元。但马杜罗却无视此类诉讼。据美联社报道，这起诉讼包括水刑、电刑、用警棍威胁强奸以及服用改变精神药物的指控，所有这些都发生在一间狭窄的牢房里。

paras.en: - Flores looks 'no worse' than previous court appearance: judge Mark Gollom A U.S. district judge said Cilia Flores, who appeared in court on Thursday, looks no worse than her previous court appearance, as her lawyers attempt to get her released on bail for medical reasons. U.S. District Judge Alvin Hellerstein said Flores appeared to be relatively healthy, Reuters reported. "For whatever it's worth, her appearance today is no worse and perhaps a little better than when I first met with her on her arraignment," Hellerstein said. Flores' lawyers say their client needs a cardiac procedure and want her released to recover in a New York City residence with round-the-clock private security. They say she is not a danger to the community. Prosecutors oppose her release.
paras.zh: - 弗洛雷斯看起来比上次出庭“不差”：法官马克·戈洛姆 美国地区法官表示，周四出庭的西莉亚·弗洛雷斯看起来并不比上次出庭差，因为她的律师试图以医疗原因让她保释。 U.S. District Judge Alvin Hellerstein said Flores appeared to be relatively healthy, Reuters reported.海勒斯坦说：“无论价值如何，她今天的表现并不比我第一次在提审时见到她时更糟糕，甚至可能还好一点。”弗洛雷斯的律师表示，他们的当事人需要接受心脏手术，并希望她被释放，在纽约市一处有全天候私人保安的住所中康复。他们说她不会对社区构成威胁。检察官反对释放她。

paras.en: - Maduro government tortured, killed thousands: indictment Mark Gollom Warning: This entry includes alleged details of torture. The indictment, according to The Associated Press, claims that Maduro "authorized the use of torture against specific individuals and oversaw a system designed to use torture, arbitrary detention and violence as a means of repression against the political opposition." It alleges Maduro and Flores stayed in power by "terrorizing perceived opponents through persecution and violence." Prosecutors claim that thousands of Venezuelans were "harassed, threatened, arrested, prosecuted, assaulted, tortured or killed" by people acting at the behest of the government Maduro controlled. The allegations include electric shocks, beatings and asphyxiation at Maduro's behest. The indictment claims that Maduro signed off on methods of torture and personally threatened the killing of one prisoner’s child "as a form of psychological torture."
paras.zh: - 马杜罗政府折磨并杀害数千人：起诉书马克·戈洛姆警告：此条目包含据称的酷刑细节。据美联社报道，起诉书称马杜罗“授权对特定个人使用酷刑，并监督旨在使用酷刑、任意拘留和暴力作为镇压政治反对派手段的制度”。报告称，马杜罗和弗洛雷斯通过“通过迫害和暴力恐吓被视为反对者”来维持权力。检察官声称，数千名委内瑞拉人受到按照马杜罗控制的政府的要求行事的人“骚扰、威胁、逮捕、起诉、袭击、酷刑或杀害”。这些指控包括按照马杜罗的要求实施电击、殴打和窒息。起诉书称，马杜罗签署了酷刑方法，并亲自威胁要杀死一名囚犯的孩子，“作为一种心理折磨”。

paras.en: - Indictment alleges torture including electric shocks, beatings Mark Gollom Warning: This entry includes details of torture. Prosecutors, according to Reuters, allege that Maduro's military counterintelligence officers tortured prisoners. One claim, according to the indictment, is that in 2013, Maduro ordered the arrest of a Venezuelan military officer he suspected of planning a coup. The officer was interrogated and shocked with a live electric wire around 20 times, prosecutors say. He was also hung by his hand and feet for several minutes, according to the claim. In another incident in 2022, a U.S. citizen accused of conspiring to assassinate Maduro was allegedly tortured through beatings and shocks to the person's arms, legs and genitals according to the indictment, Reuters reported.
paras.zh: - 起诉书指控酷刑，包括电击、殴打 Mark Gollom 警告：本条目包含酷刑细节。据路透社报道，检察官指控马杜罗的军事反情报官员折磨囚犯。起诉书称，2013 年，马杜罗下令逮捕一名涉嫌策划政变的委内瑞拉军官。检察官称，这名警官被审问并用带电电线电击了大约 20 次。据称，他的手脚还被吊了几分钟。据路透社报道，在 2022 年的另一起事件中，一名被控密谋刺杀马杜罗的美国公民据称因殴打和电击其手臂、腿部和生殖器而遭受酷刑。

paras.en: - Maduro, Flores face torture related charge Mark Gollom The indictment, according to Reuters, specifically charges Maduro and Flores with conspiracy to commit torture. They have been accused of torturing political opponents, including Americans, to hold onto their power in Venezuela. This charge is in addition to the drug trafficking charges they already face.
paras.zh: - 马杜罗和弗洛雷斯面临酷刑相关指控 马克·戈洛姆 据路透社报道，起诉书特别指控马杜罗和弗洛雷斯合谋实施酷刑。他们被指控折磨包括美国人在内的政治对手，以保住委内瑞拉的权力。这项指控是他们已经面临的贩毒指控之外的指控。

paras.en: - Flores's lawyers detail medical issues The Associated Press Flores's lawyers said she suffered permanent scarring when she was "thrown against a wall or dresser" during the U.S. military action that led to her capture. They also said she has lost 11 kilograms while imprisoned at the Metropolitan Detention Center in Brooklyn and has been told that she might need heart surgery. They said she also suffers from "lingering lightheadedness, dizziness and shortness of breath" and might have suffered a minor heart attack in July. Prosecutors opposed their bail request in September. In a court filing, they wrote that Flores would pose an "extreme risk of flight and danger to the public" if released. They also said she has been taken from the jail to get treatment at a local hospital, when care was needed. U.S. President Donald Trump's administration has defended the raid to capture Maduro as a "surgical law enforcement operation." Maduro has called himself a prisoner of war and his capture a kidnapping. Flores is charged with participating in a cocaine importation conspiracy with her husband, Maduro, who served as Venezuela's president from 2013 until his capture by American forces.
paras.zh: - 弗洛雷斯的律师详细介绍了医疗问题 美联社 弗洛雷斯的律师表示，在导致她被捕的美国军事行动中，她被“扔到墙上或梳妆台上”，从而留下了永久性疤痕。他们还表示，她在布鲁克林大都会拘留中心被监禁期间体重减轻了 11 公斤，并被告知她可能需要进行心脏手术。他们说，她还患有“挥之不去的头晕、头晕和呼吸短促”的症状，并且可能在七月份遭受了轻微的心脏病发作。检察官在九月份反对了他们的保释请求。他们在一份法庭文件中写道，如果弗洛雷斯获释，他将面临“逃跑的极端风险，并对公众构成危险”​​。他们还表示，当需要护理时，她已被带出监狱，前往当地医院接受治疗。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普政府为抓捕马杜罗的突袭行动进行了辩护，称其为“外科手术式执法行动”。马杜罗称自己是战俘，他的被捕是绑架。弗洛雷斯被指控与她的丈夫马杜罗一起参与可卡因进口阴谋，马杜罗从 2013 年起担任委内瑞拉总统，直至被美军抓获。

paras.en: - Flores and Maduro's defences Verity Stevenson The couple's attorneys have previously asked for the case to be dismissed on the grounds that they have immunity as the leader and first lady of a foreign country. Lawyers for Flores, 69, have also argued that she has medical issues that cannot be treated effectively in jail, and that she could instead be allowed to live under 24-hour guard at a residence in New York. The United States, on the other hand, will likely argue it does not recognize Maduro as the legitimate leader of Venezuela, and hasn't since 2019, when it said his re-election was fraudulent. "I could see the Department of Justice convincing a judge of their position that he actually isn't a true head of state and he was not properly elected, and I think most nations in the world would agree with that," Margaret Donovan, a Yale Law School lecturer and former U.S. federal prosecutor, told CBC News in January. Still, the defence is a natural choice given some parallels with the U.S.'s own leadership, according to Donovan "Of course, we have a leader here in the United States … who is very keen on having immunity from criminal offences when you are the head of state," she said. Toward the end of the couple's first brief court appearance in January, where both Maduro and Flores pleaded not guilty, Maduro's defence lawyer Barry J. Pollack said his client "is head of a sovereign state and entitled to the privilege" that the status ensures. -With files from The Associated Press
paras.zh: - 弗洛雷斯和马杜罗的辩护维里蒂·史蒂文森这对夫妇的律师此前曾要求驳回此案，理由是他们作为外国领导人和第一夫人享有豁免权。 69 岁的弗洛雷斯的律师还辩称，她的健康问题无法在监狱中得到有效治疗，因此可以允许她住在纽约的一处住所，接受 24 小时看守。另一方面，美国可能会辩称，它不承认马杜罗是委内瑞拉的合法领导人，自 2019 年以来一直没有承认马杜罗的连任，当时美国称马杜罗的连任存在欺诈行为。耶鲁大学法学院讲师、前美国联邦检察官玛格丽特·多诺万 (Margaret Donovan) 一月份对 CBC 新闻表示：“我可以看到司法部让法官相信他们的立场，即他实际上不是真正的国家元首，而且他没有经过适当选举产生，我认为世界上大多数国家都会同意这一点。”尽管如此，考虑到与美国自己的领导层有一些相似之处，辩护是一个自然的选择，多诺万表示，“当然，我们美国有一位领导人……他非常热衷于在担任国家元首时享有刑事犯罪豁免权，”她说。 说。一月份，这对夫妇第一次短暂出庭，马杜罗和弗洛雷斯均表示无罪，马杜罗的辩护律师巴里·J·波拉克(Barry J. Pollack)表示，他的当事人“是一个主权国家的元首，有权享受这一地位所确保的特权”。 -来自美联社的文件

articles.title: Trump says he'll award former Blue Jays pitcher Roger Clemens Medal of Freedom
articles.author: Michelle L. Price, Will Weissert

paras.en: Trump says he'll award former Blue Jays pitcher Roger Clemens Medal of Freedom
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，他将授予前蓝鸟队投手罗杰·克莱门斯自由勋章

paras.en: President says athlete deserves Hall of Fame recognition, despite link to steroid use
paras.zh: 总统表示，尽管与使用类固醇有关，运动员仍应获得名人堂认可

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump announced Wednesday night he would award the Presidential Medal of Freedom to retired MLB pitcher Roger Clemens, calling the seven-time Cy Young winner "maybe the greatest pitcher of all time."
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周三晚间宣布，他将向美国职业棒球大联盟退役投手罗杰·克莱门斯授予总统自由勋章，称这位七届赛扬奖得主“也许是有史以来最伟大的投手”。

paras.en: Addressing a rally in San Antonio, Trump renewed his calls for the hurler to be inducted into the Baseball Hall of Fame. That's an honour the pitcher known as "The Rocket" has yet to receive because of suspicions he used steroids during a 24-year career that featured time with the Boston Red Sox, Toronto Blue Jays, New York Yankees and Houston Astros.
paras.zh: 特朗普在圣安东尼奥的一次集会上发表讲话，再次呼吁将这位投手纳入棒球名人堂。这位被称为“火箭”的投手尚未获得这项荣誉，因为有人怀疑他在效力于波士顿红袜队、多伦多蓝鸟队、纽约洋基队和休斯顿太空人队的 24 年职业生涯中使用了类固醇。

paras.en: "We're giving him the Presidential Medal of Freedom," Trump said. "And, along with the Congressional Medal of Honor, it's the highest award bestowed upon anyone."
paras.zh: 特朗普说：“我们将授予他总统自由勋章。” “而且，与国会荣誉勋章一样，这是授予任何人的最高奖项。”

paras.en: The president continued: "He'll be in the Hall of Fame someday, but he deserves it. One of the greatest athletes, and maybe the greatest pitcher, of all time."
paras.zh: 总统继续说道：“有一天他会进入名人堂，但他应得的。他是有史以来最伟大的运动员之一，也许也是最伟大的投手。”

paras.en: He added the medal "is a big step up from the Hall of Fame."
paras.zh: 他补充说，这枚奖牌“是比名人堂迈出的一大步”。

paras.en: Trump has given the medal to various athletes during his two terms in the White House, including golfing legend Tiger Woods, former Dallas Cowboys quarterback Roger Staubach, famed Yankees closer Mariano Rivera and Lou Holtz, former coach of Notre Dame football.
paras.zh: 特朗普在白宫的两届任期内向多位运动员颁发了这枚奖章，其中包括高尔夫传奇人物泰格·伍兹、前达拉斯牛仔队四分卫罗杰·斯托巴赫、著名洋基队终结者马里亚诺·里维拉和圣母大学橄榄球队前教练卢·霍尔茨。

paras.en: He's bestowed the same honour on Elvis Presley posthumously and Rush Limbaugh the year before the conservative radio host died.
paras.zh: 他在埃尔维斯·普雷斯利（Elvis Presley）死后和拉什·林堡（Rush Limbaugh）去世前一年授予了同样的荣誉。

paras.en: Wednesday's surprise revelation came near the end of a Trump speech that lasted more than 100 minutes, and with the crowd having lost some of its enthusiasm. Clemens was attending the event, and the president called him to the stage, where the retired right-hander offered, "Well, I'm stunned."
paras.zh: 周三的这一令人惊讶的消息是在特朗普长达 100 多分钟的演讲即将结束时公布的，人群已经失去了一些热情。克莱门斯正在参加这次活动，总统把他叫到台上，这位退休的右撇子说道：“嗯，我很震惊。”

paras.en: - Clemens denied Hall of Fame entry in 2022, his final year of consideration
paras.zh: - 克莱门斯在 2022 年被拒绝进入名人堂，这是他考虑的最后一年

paras.en: - Clemens added to Red Sox Hall of Fame in 2014
paras.zh: - 克莱门斯于 2014 年入选红袜队名人堂

paras.en: "This supersedes anything that obviously I've done in my playing career," Clemens said. "And to get it from this man, this president, there wouldn't be another president I'd want to get it from."
paras.zh: “这显然取代了我在职业生涯中所做的任何事情，”克莱门斯说。 “为了从这个人、这位总统那里得到它，我不会想从另一位总统那里得到它。”

paras.en: Clemens, who was raised in Houston, said he was honoured the announcement came in Texas and added of Trump: "You're talking about a winner. That's a winner right there."
paras.zh: 在休斯敦长大的克莱门斯表示，他很荣幸在德克萨斯州宣布这一消息，并补充说特朗普：“你谈论的是胜利者。那就是胜利者。”

paras.en: Clemens, like slugger Barry Bonds and many other stars widely suspected of using performance-enhancing drugs, was repeatedly rejected by baseball writers in his bid for the Hall of Fame. There are other avenues where Clemens and others could eventually make it, but the road is not easy.
paras.zh: 克莱门斯与重击手巴里·邦兹和许多其他被广泛怀疑使用兴奋剂的明星一样，在竞选名人堂时多次被棒球作家拒绝。克莱门斯和其他人最终可以通过其他途径取得成功，但这条路并不容易。

paras.en: Clemens isn't the first star baseball player Trump has made a Hall of Fame case for. The president issued a posthumous federal pardon last year for the late Pete Rose, which led to Major League Baseball lifting its ban on the all-time career hits leader.
paras.zh: 克莱门斯并不是特朗普第一个入选名人堂的明星棒球运动员。总统去年对已故的皮特·罗斯（Pete Rose）发布了死后联邦赦免令，美国职业棒球大联盟解除了对这位历史上职业命中率领军人物的禁令。

paras.en: Trump has called for Rose to be inducted in the Hall of Fame too — also, so far, unsuccessfully..S.
paras.zh: 特朗普也呼吁罗斯入选名人堂——但到目前为止，还没有成功。

articles.title: British police admit they bungled search warrant in legal win for former prince Andrew

paras.en: British police admit they bungled search warrant in legal win for former prince Andrew
paras.zh: 英国警方承认他们在前安德鲁王子的法律胜利中搞砸了搜查令

paras.en: While the development is an embarrassment for police, they insist the investigation remains open
paras.zh: 虽然事态的发展让警方感到尴尬，但他们坚称调查仍在进行中

paras.en: British police on Thursday said that search warrants they secured to search properties linked to Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor had been issued unlawfully and must be quashed, but said the investigation into King Charles's younger brother was ongoing.
paras.zh: 英国警方周四表示，他们为搜查与安德鲁·蒙巴顿-温莎有关的财产而获得的搜查令是非法发出的，必须撤销，但表示对查尔斯国王弟弟的调查仍在进行中。

paras.en: Andrew, 66, was arrested on suspicion of misconduct in public office in February, linked to his relationship with the late U.S. sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, and searches were carried out at properties in Sandringham and Windsor.
paras.zh: 66 岁的安德鲁今年 2 月因涉嫌公职不当行为而被捕，原因与他与美国已故性犯罪者杰弗里·爱泼斯坦 (Jeffrey Epstein) 的关系有关，并对桑德灵厄姆和温莎的房产进行了搜查。

paras.en: The arrest of the senior royal, eighth in line to the throne, was unprecedented in modern times and a Reuters photo of the ashen-faced former prince leaving the police station made front pages around the world.
paras.zh: 这位王位第八顺位继承人的高级皇室成员被捕，这在现代是史无前例的，路透社一张脸色铁青的前王子离开警察局的照片登上了世界各地的头条新闻。

paras.en: Police have said their investigation, which relates to Andrew's time as a British special representative for trade between 2001 and 2011, would be lengthy and incredibly complex.
paras.zh: 警方表示，他们的调查涉及安德鲁在 2001 年至 2011 年间担任英国贸易特别代表期间的情况，调查将是漫长且极其复杂的。

paras.en: Andrew, who has not made any public comment since his arrest, subsequently launched a legal challenge and applied for the search warrants to be quashed.
paras.zh: 安德鲁自被捕后未发表任何公开评论，随后发起法律挑战，并申请撤销搜查令。

paras.en: Thames Valley Police said it now agreed these had not been properly granted by the courts.
paras.zh: 泰晤士河谷警方表示，现在他们同意法院没有适当批准这些请求。

paras.en: "We accept the position that the initial court's decision to issue warrants under the specific piece of legislation used was incorrect and therefore these must be legally quashed," a Thames Valley Police spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 泰晤士河谷警方发言人表示：“我们接受这样的立场，即初审法院根据所使用的具体立法发出逮捕令的决定是不正确的，因此必须在法律上撤销这些决定。”

paras.en: "Legal proceedings are currently ongoing to decide how material seized during the searches will be managed and whether we can lawfully retain it in support of our ongoing investigation."
paras.zh: “目前正在进行法律程序，以决定如何管理搜查期间查获的材料，以及我们是否可以合法保留这些材料以支持我们正在进行的调查。”

paras.en: At a hearing at London's High Court on Thursday, Judge Nicholas Hilliard said the force was applying to keep the seized property, which Andrew was opposing, and the issue would not be settled until next year. The former prince was not in attendance at the hearing.
paras.zh: 周四在伦敦高等法院举行的听证会上，法官尼古拉斯·希利亚德表示，警方正在申请保留被扣押的财产，安德鲁对此表示反对，而且这个问题要到明年才能得到解决。前王子没有出席听证会。

paras.en: A spokesperson for Thames Valley Police said it had not returned any material to the royal, other than that which was not deemed to be connected to their investigation.
paras.zh: 泰晤士河谷警方发言人表示，除了被认为与调查无关的材料外，他们没有向王室返还任何材料。

paras.en: While the quashing of the warrants is an embarrassment, it does not stop the police investigation, which began after the release of millions of documents by the U.S. Department of Justice relating to Epstein.
paras.zh: 虽然逮捕令的撤销令人尴尬，但这并不能阻止警方的调查，调查是在美国司法部公布数百万份与爱泼斯坦有关的文件后开始的。

paras.en: Andrew, the second son of the late Queen Elizabeth, has always denied any wrongdoing in relation to Epstein, and said he regrets their friendship.
paras.zh: 已故伊丽莎白女王的次子安德鲁一直否认与爱泼斯坦有任何不当行为，并表示他对他们的友谊感到遗憾。

paras.en: The offence of misconduct in public office, which carries a maximum sentence of life imprisonment, can relate to any serious wrongdoing — from sharing confidential information to corruption and sexual misconduct.
paras.zh: 公职不当行为罪最高可判处无期徒刑，该罪可能涉及任何严重的不当行为——从分享机密信息到腐败和不当性行为。

paras.en: - After former prince Andrew's arrest, the Royal Family tries to keep calm and carry on
paras.zh: - 前安德鲁王子被捕后，王室试图保持冷静并继续前进

paras.en: Andrew is believed to have met Epstein through the British socialite Ghislaine Maxwell.
paras.zh: 据信安德鲁是通过英国社交名流吉斯莱恩·麦克斯韦尔认识了爱泼斯坦。

paras.en: His behaviour while in their company came under scrutiny in 2011 when the Daily Mail interviewed Virginia Roberts Giuffre, an American woman who was employed by Epstein and Maxwell when she was a teenager.
paras.zh: 2011 年，《每日邮报》采访了美国女性维吉尼亚·罗伯茨·吉弗尔 (Virginia Roberts Giuffre)，他在公司期间的行为受到了密切关注，她十几岁时曾受雇于爱泼斯坦和马克斯韦尔。

paras.en: Roberts Giuffre would later accuse Andrew of sexual assault in an incident she said occurred when she was 17. Andrew denied the allegations but reached a financial settlement with her in a U.S.-based civil lawsuit in 2022.
paras.zh: 罗伯茨·朱弗尔 (Roberts Giuffre) 后来指控安德鲁性侵，她说这起事件发生在她 17 岁的时候。安德鲁否认了这些指控，但在 2022 年在美国提起的民事诉讼中与她达成了财务和解。

paras.en: Andrew was forced to quit all official royal duties in 2019 over his ties with Epstein, just days after a poorly received interview he sat for with BBC News.
paras.zh: 2019年，安德鲁因与爱泼斯坦的关系而被迫辞去所有王室官方职务，就在几天前，他接受了英国广播公司新闻频道的采访，反响不佳。

paras.en: King Charles last year stripped Andrew's titles and honours, and he was forced to move from his palatial Royal residence in Windsor to a smaller residence in Norfolk not publicly funded.
paras.zh: 查尔斯国王去年剥夺了安德鲁的头衔和荣誉，他被迫从温莎的富丽堂皇的皇家住所搬到诺福克的一处较小的非公共资助的住所。

paras.en: Police officers walk the road to the Royal Lodge in Windsor on Feb. 19 after Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor was arrested by British police on suspicion of misconduct in public office. (Alberto Pezzali/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 2月19日，安德鲁·蒙巴顿-温莎因涉嫌公职不当行为被英国警方逮捕后，警察走在通往温莎皇家别墅的路上。 （阿尔贝托·佩扎利/美联社）

paras.en: Epstein was found dead in his Manhattan jail cell in August 2019 in what was ruled a suicide.
paras.zh: 2019 年 8 月，爱泼斯坦被发现死于曼哈顿监狱牢房内，被判定为自杀。

paras.en: Maxwell was convicted of federal sex trafficking charges in New York and sentenced to 20 years in prison in 2022.
paras.zh: 2022 年，麦克斯韦在纽约被判犯有联邦性贩运罪，并被判处 20 年监禁。

paras.en: Roberts Giuffre died at her Australian residence last year in a death that was ruled a suicide.
paras.zh: 罗伯茨·朱弗雷(Roberts Giuffre)去年在澳大利亚的住所去世，死因被判定为自杀。

paras.en: A U.S. congressional committee since last year has interviewed several prominent individuals, including former president Bill Clinton, who in the past had dealings with Epstein or Maxwell. While some members of the committee expressed a desire to speak to Andrew, the committee has no legal authority to compel him to appear before the panel.
paras.zh: 自去年以来，美国国会的一个委员会采访了几位知名人士，其中包括前总统比尔·克林顿，他过去曾与爱泼斯坦或麦克斯韦有过交往。虽然委员会的一些成员表示希望与安德鲁交谈，但委员会没有法律权力强迫他出席专家组。

articles.title: India faces water and power shortages after weak monsoon

paras.en: Ramesh Reddy, 44, put everything he had into his 3.5 acre tomato farm in June. The farmer from Kolar district in the south of the state of Karnataka invested 320,000 rupees (€3,000, $3,357), borrowing 250,000 rupees at 24% annual interest and pledging his wife's wedding jewelry as collateral.
paras.zh: 44 岁的拉梅什·雷迪 (Ramesh Reddy) 于 6 月份将自己所有的一切都投入了自己 3.5 英亩的番茄农场。这位来自卡纳塔克邦南部科拉尔地区的农民投资了 32 万卢比（3,000 欧元，3,357 美元），以年利率 24% 的利率借了 25 万卢比，并以妻子的结婚珠宝作为抵押。

paras.en: The harvest was meant to repay the loan and cover his son's overdue college fees. But then the farm's irrigation well ran dry. Within three weeks, the tomato plants had turned brown and Reddy could not salvage a single crate.
paras.zh: 收获的目的是偿还贷款并支付儿子逾期的大学学费。但后来农场的灌溉井干涸了。三周之内，番茄植株变成了棕色，雷迪无法抢救一个板条箱。

paras.en: "I have lost everything I invested," he told DW. "I have no money left for the next crop and I don't know how I will repay the loan."
paras.zh: “我已经失去了我投资的一切，”他告诉德国之声。 “我没有钱买下一季的作物，我不知道如何偿还贷款。”

paras.en: He is now negotiating a job as a security guard in the state capital, Bengaluru, and preparing to leave his farmland behind.
paras.zh: 他现在正在邦首府班加罗尔寻找一份保安工作，并准备离开自己的农田。

paras.en: ForIndia, the monsoon is more than just a four-month rainy season. It replenishes reservoirs, supports agriculture and helps sustain water supplies and power generation across much of the country.
paras.zh: 对于印度来说，季风不仅仅是一个为期四个月的雨季。它补充水库、支持农业并帮助维持全国大部分地区的供水和发电。

paras.en: Nearly half of India's workforce depends on farming for their livelihood, doing jobs that are both tough and economically insecure.
paras.zh: 印度近一半的劳动力依靠务农为生，从事的工作既辛苦又经济不稳定。

paras.en: This year, the country received 759.4 millimeters (ca. 30 inches) of rain between June and September, against a long-term average of 868.6 millimeters. The 12.6% deficit made it the country's driest monsoon in 11 years and the fourth driest this century.
paras.zh: 今年，该国 6 月至 9 月期间的降雨量为 759.4 毫米（约 30 英寸），而长期平均降雨量为 868.6 毫米。 12.6%的逆差使其成为该国11年来最干旱的季风，也是本世纪第四个最干旱的季风。

paras.en: Madhavan Nair Rajeevan, a climate scientist and former secretary in the Indian Ministry of Earth Sciences, said the main factor behind the poor monsoon was a severe El Nino. He had warned earlier that this global climate phenomenon would posed a serious risk to rainfall.
paras.zh: 印度地球科学部前秘书、气候科学家马达万·奈尔·拉杰万表示，季风不佳的主要原因是严重的厄尔尼诺现象。他早些时候曾警告说，这种全球气候现象将对降雨构成严重风险。

paras.en: "As far as the Indian monsoon is concerned, El Nino is the most important influencing factor, which we should consider very seriously,” Rajeevan told DW.
paras.zh: “就印度季风而言，厄尔尼诺现象是最重要的影响因素，我们应该认真考虑，”拉杰万告诉德国之声。

paras.en: The effects are now hitting India's water and energy systems. The country's major reservoirs ended the monsoon with less water than usual, leaving both farmers and the power sector with less of a buffer going into the months ahead.
paras.zh: 目前，印度的水和能源系统正受到影响。季风结束时，该国主要水库的水量比平时减少，导致农民和电力部门在未来几个月的缓冲能力减少。

paras.en: Combined storage in the 178 reservoirs monitored by the Central Water Commission stood at 132.7 billion cubic meters, below the 10-year average of 151.1 billion cubic meters.
paras.zh: 中央水委监测的178座水库合计库容1327亿立方米，低于10年平均1511亿立方米。

paras.en: That shortfall is already being felt in electricity generation. Hydropower output fell nearly 16% in September from a year earlier, according to Grid India data. At the same time, electricity shortages reached 560 million kilowatt-hours, the highest monthly shortfall in more than three years. After sunset, when solar generation drops off, the grid has fewer options to make up the difference.
paras.zh: 发电领域已经感受到了这种短缺。印度电网数据显示，9 月份水力发电量同比下降近 16%。与此同时，电力短缺达到5.6亿千瓦时，为三年多来最高的月度缺口。日落之后，当太阳能发电量下降时，电网弥补差额的选择就会减少。

paras.en: Coal-fired plants have, therefore, had to shoulder more of the load, but they face a problem of their own. Data from the Central Electricity Authority showed that around 40% of coal-fired plants had critically low stocks, with supplies below a quarter of the required level.
paras.zh: 因此，燃煤电厂不得不承担更多的负荷，但它们也面临着自己的问题。中央电力局的数据显示，约 40% 的燃煤电厂库存极低，供应量低于所需水平的四分之一。

paras.en: The government has ordered some private industrial power plants to operate at full capacity and feed surplus electricity into the grid.
paras.zh: 政府已下令一些私营工业发电厂满负荷运行，并将剩余电力并入电网。

paras.en: Manufacturers are already feeling the strain. "Uninterrupted power supply is of paramount importance for manufacturing units, as power cuts disrupt production cycles," said Ashok Gupta, the president of the Mohali Industries Association, which represents nearly 600 small and medium-sized manufacturers.
paras.zh: 制造商已经感受到了压力。代表近 600 家中小型制造商的莫哈里工业协会 (Mohali Industries Association) 会长阿肖克·古普塔 (Ashok Gupta) 表示：“不间断供电对于制造单位至关重要，因为停电会扰乱生产周期。”

paras.en: "Such disruptions not only cause losses to manufacturers but also result in wastage of raw materials."
paras.zh: “这种中断不仅给制造商造成损失，而且还造成原材料的浪费。”

paras.en: The economic impact of a poor monsoon can extend well beyond agriculture. Weaker farm output can hit rural incomes, employment and consumption, while higher food prices put further pressure on household budgets.
paras.zh: 季风不佳的经济影响可能远远超出农业范围。农业产出疲软可能会影响农村收入、就业和消费，而食品价格上涨则给家庭预算带来进一步压力。

paras.en: Arun Kumar, a retired professor of economics, said the effects could be wider than the headline economic numbers suggest, particularly because much of India's rural economy operates outside the formal sector.
paras.zh: 退休经济学教授阿伦·库马尔表示，影响可能比整体经济数据所显示的更广泛，特别是因为印度大部分农村经济都在正规部门之外运作。

paras.en: "Economic development needs to be assessed through a wider set of indicators," Kumar told DW. He said weaker agricultural output could push up food prices while putting pressure on incomes and consumption.
paras.zh: 库马尔告诉德国之声：“经济发展需要通过更广泛的指标来评估。”他表示，农业产出疲软可能推高食品价格，同时给收入和消费带来压力。

paras.en: Himanshu, a development economist at Delhi's Jawaharlal Nehru University, described the situation as a "twin shock" for rural households, with weaker farm incomes coming alongside higher food prices.
paras.zh: 德里贾瓦哈拉尔尼赫鲁大学的发展经济学家希曼舒称，这种情况对农村家庭来说是“双重冲击”，农业收入减少，食品价格上涨。

paras.en: "When agricultural incomes fall and food prices rise, rural households face a squeeze on their purchasing power," he told DW.
paras.zh: 他告诉德国之声：“当农业收入下降、食品价格上涨时，农村家庭的购买力就会受到挤压。”

paras.en: The economist said that the uneven distribution of rainfall could compound the problem, with some farming regions suffering much heavier losses than the national rainfall figure indicates. "The impact on rural consumption could also be significant, as households facing lower incomes and higher food costs have less money to spend on other goods and services."
paras.zh: 这位经济学家表示，降雨分布不均可能会使问题更加复杂，一些农业地区遭受的损失比全国降雨数据显示的要严重得多。 “这对农村消费的影响也可能很大，因为收入较低和食品成本较高的家庭用于购买其他商品和服务的钱较少。”

paras.en: Outlook increasingly difficult to predict as climate warms
paras.zh: 随着气候变暖，前景变得越来越难以预测

paras.en: The pressure is also being felt in urban households. A survey in September by India's central bank found that households were expecting inflation to rise as food and fuel prices increasingly affected sentiment.
paras.zh: 城市家庭也感受到了压力。印度央行9月份的一项调查发现，随着食品和燃料价格日益影响情绪，家庭预期通胀将会上升。

paras.en: Sunita Sharma, a homemaker in New Delhi, said her usual shopping list now costs hundreds of rupees more than it did a few months ago.
paras.zh: 新德里的家庭主妇苏尼塔·夏尔马 (Sunita Sharma) 表示，她平时的购物清单现在比几个月前贵了数百卢比。

paras.en: "We have no option but to cut down on discretionary expenses just to afford basic, everyday meals," she told DW.
paras.zh: 她告诉德国之声：“我们别无选择，只能减少可自由支配的开支，只为了支付基本的日常膳食。”

paras.en: The prices of some staples have risen sharply recently. An analysis by ISignal using Department of Consumer Affairs data found that onions were 93% more expensive in September than a year earlier, while sugar prices rose by 28% and rice by about 8%.
paras.zh: 近期部分生活必需品价格大幅上涨。 ISignal 使用消费者事务部数据进行的分析发现，9 月份洋葱价格比去年同期上涨 93%，而食糖价格上涨 28%，大米价格上涨约 8%。

paras.en: The next test will be the rabi, or winter, crop. Farmers are now preparing to plant wheat, mustard and chickpeas, but success will depend largely on how much moisture remains in the soil after the weak monsoon.
paras.zh: 下一个测试将是冬季作物。农民们现在正准备种植小麦、芥菜和鹰嘴豆，但能否成功在很大程度上取决于弱季风过后土壤中还剩下多少水分。

paras.en: Rajeevan said the longer-term outlook was also becoming increasingly difficult to predict as the climate warms.
paras.zh: 拉吉万表示，随着气候变暖，长期前景也变得越来越难以预测。

paras.en: "In a warming climate, longer dry spells and greater rainfall variability is a possibility," he said. "In future, in addition to the influence of El Nino events, we should expect the influence of a warmer climate."
paras.zh: “在气候变暖的情况下，可能会出现更长的干旱期和更大的降雨变化，”他说。 “未来，除了厄尔尼诺事件的影响外，我们还应该预计气候变暖的影响。”

paras.en: Reddy, the farmer in Karnataka state, is now waiting to hear whether he has got the security job in Bengaluru, and preparing to leave his farm behind.
paras.zh: 卡纳塔克邦的农民雷迪现在正在等待他是否找到了班加罗尔的保安工作，并准备离开他的农场。

articles.title: How the Houthi-Saudi conflict is affecting countries on Africa's Red Sea coast — and beyond

paras.en: In September, one of the major conflicts in the Middle East came within sight of Africa, as Iran-backed Houthi rebels captured Yemen's Perim Island.
paras.zh: 9月，随着伊朗支持的胡塞叛军占领也门的佩里姆岛，中东的重大冲突之一来到了非洲。

paras.en: The island forms the narrowest point of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, which connects the southern entrance of the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden. It is roughly 20 kilometers (12 miles) from Djibouti and 20-minutes by air to Ethiopia.
paras.zh: 该岛是曼德海峡的最窄点，连接红海南部入口和亚丁湾。距吉布提约 20 公里（12 英里），乘飞机 20 分钟即可到达埃塞俄比亚。

paras.en: In early October, Yemen's armed forces and their Saudi allies launched a counteroffensive. TheIran-backed Houthis have been firing on merchant ships since the start of the Gaza war in 2023.
paras.zh: 10月初，也门武装部队及其沙特盟友发起反攻。自 2023 年加沙战争爆发以来，伊朗支持的胡塞武装一直向商船开火。

paras.en: The economic consequences for Africa is coupled with a refugee inflow
paras.zh: 对非洲的经济影响伴随着难民的涌入

paras.en: African economies are already suffering from crisis in the Strait of Hormuz, which is making particularly fuel and fertilizer scarce and more expensive.
paras.zh: 非洲经济体已经遭受霍尔木兹海峡危机的影响，这使得燃料和化肥尤其稀缺且更加昂贵。

paras.en: If the Bab el-Mandeb Strait also becomes impassable, the situation could deteriorate further. Shipping companies would have to make detours via the Suez Canal, which is controlled by Egypt or the southern tip of Africa, as some already do. The additional costs would be passed on to consumers.
paras.zh: 如果曼德海峡也无法通行，局势可能会进一步恶化。航运公司将不得不绕道埃及或非洲南端控制的苏伊士运河，有些公司已经这样做了。额外的成本将转嫁给消费者。

paras.en: The human cost of the escalation in Yemen hit Djibouti almost immediately. According to the UN Refugee Agency (UNHCR), at least 3,700 refugees have crossed from Yemen into Djibouti since September 10. Most of those who made it to the country's northern Obock region are women and children.
paras.zh: 也门局势升级造成的人员伤亡几乎立刻就波及到了吉布提。据联合国难民署 (UNHCR) 称，自 9 月 10 日以来，至少有 3,700 名难民从也门越境进入吉布提。抵达该国北部奥博克地区的大多数是妇女和儿童。

paras.en: The UNHCR is preparing to assist another 10,000 people who have not yet crossed into Djibouti. But Obock, which is on the border with Eritrea, is extremely dry and this is causing other issues.
paras.zh: 联合国难民署正准备援助另外一万名尚未进入吉布提的人。但与厄立特里亚接壤的奥博克非常干燥，这导致了其他问题。

paras.en: "We don't have much water here; there's no groundwater at all," Alessandra Roccasalvo, the UN Development Program (UNDP) representative for Djibouti, told DW. "Everything has to be desalinated."
paras.zh: 联合国开发计划署驻吉布提代表亚历山德拉·罗卡萨尔沃 (Alessandra Roccasalvo) 告诉德国之声：“我们这里没有太多水；根本没有地下水。” “一切都必须淡化。”

paras.en: Despite its small size, Djibouti — a Muslim-majority Horn of Africa country with a population of just over a million — is a major player in the region. Its position at at the entrance to the Red Sea makes it an attractive commercial and military shipping hub.
paras.zh: 尽管面积不大，但吉布提这个穆斯林占多数的非洲之角国家，人口略多于一百万，却是该地区的重要参与者。它位于红海入口处的位置使其成为一个有吸引力的商业和军事航运枢纽。

paras.en: The United States, China, France, Italy, and Japan all operate military bases in Djibouti. The German Bundeswehr was also present until 2021, as part of a naval mission to combat maritime piracy.
paras.zh: 美国、中国、法国、意大利和日本都在吉布提设有军事基地。德国联邦国防军也一直驻扎到 2021 年，作为打击海盗的海军任务的一部分。

paras.en: The country's civilian ports serve as transshipment, or intermediate, hubs for global shipping cargo, goods and containers. So far, the Houthi advance has not led to empty docks in Djibouti.
paras.zh: 该国的民用港口是全球运输货物、货物和集装箱的转运或中间枢纽。到目前为止，胡塞武装的推进并未导致吉布提的码头空荡荡。

paras.en: But there are still potential consequences, said Roccasalvo: "Basically, there's an economic upswing here — which means, as in any country experiencing an upswing, building materials are needed: cement, raw materials, and other things."
paras.zh: 但仍然存在潜在的后果，罗卡萨尔沃说：“基本上，这里的经济正在复苏，这意味着，就像任何正在经历经济复苏的国家一样，需要建筑材料：水泥、原材料和其他东西。”

paras.en: Less of that money is now coming in because ships have to pay nearly twice as much for insurance and reinsurance as they used to. "Many ships no longer want to pass through the Suez Canal; many no longer want to pass through the Red Sea."
paras.zh: 现在流入的资金减少了，因为船舶必须支付几乎是以前两倍的保险和再保险费用。 “许多船只不再想通过苏伊士运河；许多船只不再想通过红海。”

paras.en: Knock-on effects for landlocked neighboring Ethiopia
paras.zh: 对内陆邻国埃塞俄比亚的连锁反应

paras.en: Ethiopia — the world's most populous landlocked country — handles about 95% of its imports and exports through Djibouti's ports. Price hikes resulting from higher war-risk shipping insurance premiums are affecting the country greatly.
paras.zh: 埃塞俄比亚是世界上人口最多的内陆国家，约 95% 的进出口业务是通过吉布提港口处理的。战争险航运保险费上涨导致的价格上涨对该国产生了巨大影响。

paras.en: Shortly after the Houthis seized Perim, Ethiopia's economy faced another, even more immediate threat: On September 23, fighting broke out in the country's northern Tigray region.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装占领佩林后不久，埃塞俄比亚经济面临另一个更为直接的威胁：9月23日，该国北部提格雷地区爆发战斗。

paras.en: Since then, the Ethiopian National Defense Forces (ENDF) have reportedly made gains against the Tigray-led rebel coalition that aims to overthrow the national government. The rebels briefly advanced toward the main corridor used for transporting goods between Djibouti's ports and the Ethiopian hinterland.
paras.zh: 据报道，此后，埃塞俄比亚国防军（ENDF）在对抗提格雷领导的旨在推翻国家政府的叛军联盟方面取得了进展。叛乱分子短暂地向吉布提港口和埃塞俄比亚腹地之间运输货物的主要走廊推进。

paras.en: According to certain experts, the ENDF's advances have since reduced the threat of yet another trade blockade — but as long as the conflict remains unresolved, the situation could potentially deteriorate again.
paras.zh: 据某些专家称，ENDF 的进展已经减少了再次贸易封锁的威胁，但只要冲突仍未解决，局势就有可能再次恶化。

paras.en: For months now, Ethiopia has suffered more than almost any other African country from the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz and has already had to ration fuel at times. In the long term, the country aims to reduce its dependence on imports, for example by powering vehicles with domestically generated electricity instead of imported gasoline.
paras.zh: 几个月来，埃塞俄比亚因霍尔木兹海峡封锁而遭受的苦难比几乎所有其他非洲国家都要严重，并且有时不得不实行燃料配给。从长远来看，该国的目标是减少对进口的依赖，例如用国内发电代替进口汽油为车辆提供动力。

paras.en: Can the conflict in Ethiopia affect Bab el-Mandeb access?
paras.zh: 埃塞俄比亚的冲突会影响曼德海峡的通行吗？

paras.en: Ethiopia and its northern neighbor, Eritrea, have severed diplomatic ties; other regional powers such as Sudan, Egypt, and Somalia may find themselves siding with Eritrea rather than with Ethiopia.
paras.zh: 埃塞俄比亚与其北部邻国厄立特里亚断绝了外交关系；苏丹、埃及和索马里等其他地区大国可能会发现自己站在厄立特里亚而不是埃塞俄比亚一边。

paras.en: Eritrea sees itself as facing a threat that Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed has reiterated on several occasions: With Ethiopia deprived of access to the sea since Eritrea's independence, Abiy has often alluded to rectifying this perceived injustice — either through a political agreement, as was once sought with Somalia's breakaway region of Somaliland, or by force.
paras.zh: 厄立特里亚认为自己面临着埃塞俄比亚总理阿比·艾哈迈德多次重申的威胁：自厄立特里亚独立以来，埃塞俄比亚被剥夺了出海权，阿比经常暗示要纠正这种不公正现象——要么通过政治协议，就像曾经与索马里分离地区索马里兰寻求的那样，要么通过武力。

paras.en: The port of Assab is located on the edge of Eritrea's panhandle — and is often described as the most likely target should Abiy choose the path of aggression. If the fighting within Ethiopia further escalates into a full-blown regional war, this could also lead to additional restrictions on safe passage through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait and the surrounding waters.
paras.zh: 阿萨布港位于厄立特里亚狭长地带的边缘，通常被描述为如果阿比选择侵略道路最有可能的目标。如果埃塞俄比亚境内的战斗进一步升级为全面的地区战争，这也可能导致曼德海峡及周边水域的安全通行受到额外限制。

paras.en: Experts have also raised concerns about the Shiite Houthis increasingly collaborating with the Sunni terrorist group Al-Shabab, which is based in Somalia. Although their ideologies are fundamentally different, they are united by their hostility toward Israel and the US among other things.
paras.zh: 专家们还对什叶派胡塞武装日益与总部位于索马里的逊尼派恐怖组织青年党合作表示担忧。尽管他们的意识形态根本不同，但他们因对以色列和美国的敌意等而团结在一起。

paras.en: What tools are at the disposal of African countries to help remedy the situation?
paras.zh: 非洲国家可以使用哪些工具来帮助扭转局面？

paras.en: The three African non-permanent members of the UN Security Council — the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Liberia, and Somalia — held an emergency meeting in mid-September on this issue, during which they jointly called for free shipping lanes and endorsed the demand that the crisis in Yemen be resolved under the auspices of the UN.
paras.zh: 联合国安理会三个非洲非常任理事国——刚果民主共和国、利比里亚和索马里——9月中旬就此问题召开紧急会议，共同呼吁建立自由航线，并支持在联合国主持下解决也门危机的要求。

paras.en: The situation at Bab el-Mandeb and in northern Ethiopia is once again demanding flexibility from Africa. In fact, some African economies can also benefit from relocation activities: Ports inKenya and Tanzania, for example, are becoming increasingly attractive for transshipment.
paras.zh: 曼德门和埃塞俄比亚北部的局势再次要求非洲表现出灵活性。事实上，一些非洲经济体也可以从搬迁活动中受益：例如，肯尼亚和坦桑尼亚的港口对转运的吸引力越来越大。

paras.en: And while many countries are suffering from high oil prices, Nigeria's Dangote Group has announced an initial public offering and a new refinery in Kenya.
paras.zh: 尽管许多国家都在遭受高油价的困扰，尼日利亚丹格特集团却宣布进行首次公开​​募股，并在肯尼亚开设新炼油厂。

paras.en: This article was originally published in German. It has been updated.
paras.zh: 本文最初以德文发表。它已经更新了。

articles.title: EU pulls sponsorship from Disinfo2026 event in Lithuania

paras.en: The European Union on Thursday offered its reasons for withdrawing sponsorship for a disinformation event in Lithuania, following media reports claiming that it did so after pressure from the US government.
paras.zh: 欧盟周四提出了撤回对立陶宛虚假信息活动赞助的理由，此前有媒体报道称，欧盟是在美国政府的压力下这样做的。

paras.en: The EU's foreign affairs division, the European External Action Service (EEAS), and the governments of Canada and Lithuania all pulled their support from the event at short notice. Sponsors' logos on flyers and placards at the event were hastily covered over with paper strips.
paras.zh: 欧盟外交部门、欧洲对外行动署（EEAS）以及加拿大和立陶宛政府都在短时间内取消了对该活动的支持。活动传单和标语牌上的赞助商标志被匆忙用纸条覆盖。

paras.en: They withdrew participation in Disinfo2026 after pressure from the US State Department, according to reports in several media outlets, including the British newspaper The Guardian.
paras.zh: 据英国《卫报》等多家媒体报道，在美国国务院的压力下，他们退出了 Disinfo2026。

paras.en: EU spokesperson Christian Wigand made no mention of the US or external pressure on Thursday but also did not repudiate the reports.
paras.zh: 欧盟发言人克里斯蒂安·维甘德周四没有提及美国或外部压力，但也没有否认这些报道。

paras.en: "We were not comfortable with the framing of some of the discussions at the event," he told reporters in Brussels.
paras.zh: “我们对活动中一些讨论的框架感到不满意，”他在布鲁塞尔告诉记者。

paras.en: "The organizers chose to frame some of the discussions in way which does not align with the official positions held by the EU," he said.
paras.zh: “组织者选择以与欧盟官方立场不符的方式进行一些讨论，”他说。

paras.en: He refused to discuss details of which discussions or what framing had perturbed the EEAS. He also would not comment on whether there had been talks with US officials on the matter.
paras.zh: 他拒绝讨论哪些讨论或哪些框架扰乱了 EEAS 的细节。他也不愿评论是否与美国官员就此事进行了会谈。

paras.en: "I'm not commenting on diplomatic exchanges as a matter of principle," he said.
paras.zh: “原则上我不会评论外交交往，”他说。

paras.en: What signs of potential controversy at Disinfo2026 were visible?
paras.zh: Disinfo2026 上有哪些明显的潜在争议迹象？

paras.en: While a number of the sessions planned on the event's website across two days at the Radisson Blu Lietuva Hotel in Vilnius appeared to have the potential to perturb more sensitive members of Donald Trump's administration, the opening two sessions on Wednesday morning stood out.
paras.zh: 虽然该活动网站上计划在维尔纽斯丽笙酒店举行的为期两天的多场会议似乎有可能令唐纳德·特朗普政府中更敏感的成员感到不安，但周三上午开幕的两场会议却引人注目。

paras.en: The opening of the conference was an interview with Kimberly Prost, a judge at the International Criminal Court (ICC), which has come under sustained and heavy fire from Trump and his administration during his second term.
paras.zh: 会议开幕式是对国际刑事法院（ICC）法官金伯利·普罗斯特（Kimberly Prost）的采访，该法院在特朗普第二任期内受到了特朗普及其政府的持续猛烈攻击。

paras.en: This was followed by an hourlong session entitled "USA as a FIMI threat: acknowledge, adapt, push back," using the acronym for Foreign Information Manipulation and Interference. One of the planned speakers was a former CIA officer.
paras.zh: 接下来是一个长达一小时的会议，题为“美国作为 FIMI 威胁：承认、适应、反击”，使用外国信息操纵和干扰的缩写。计划的演讲者之一是一名前中央情报局官员。

paras.en: Strong US free speech safeguards in the First Amendment to its Constitution mean the US has maintained a comparatively hands-off approach to combating disinformation — both in the political and legal spheres. This has arguably intensified, however, under President Donald Trump's leadership, with critics alleging it's partly because of his own often uneasy relationship with the truth.
paras.zh: 美国宪法第一修正案对言论自由提供强有力的保障，这意味着美国在打击虚假信息方面一直保持着相对不干涉的态度——无论是在政治还是法律领域。然而，在唐纳德·特朗普总统的领导下，这种情况可以说有所加剧，批评者声称，部分原因是他自己与真相的关系经常不稳定。

paras.en: If you rely on our team for trusted reporting, please take a moment to select us as your Preferred Source on Google, so you'll always see our verified news first.
paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

articles.title: Two Latvian men arrested inside UK military base after breach

paras.en: Two Latvian men have been arrested inside a military base in southeast England that houses United States and NATO intelligence hubs after the perimeter fence was breached, police have said.
paras.zh: 警方称，两名拉脱维亚男子在英格兰东南部的一个军事基地内被捕，该基地是美国和北约情报中心，围栏被冲破。

paras.en: The arrests come amid heightened concerns about security at military bases in the United Kingdom after a separate incident last month.
paras.zh: 此次逮捕行动正值英国军事基地上个月发生另一起事件后，人们对军事基地安全的担忧加剧。

paras.en: Counterterrorism police said on Thursday that the two men, aged 36 and 32, were arrested at the Royal Air Force (RAF) Molesworth base in Cambridgeshire.
paras.zh: 反恐警察周四表示，这两名男子分别为 36 岁和 32 岁，在剑桥郡皇家空军 (RAF) 莫尔斯沃思基地被捕。

paras.en: They are being held on suspicion of trespass and of entering a prohibited place “for a purpose prejudicial to the UK”, said police.
paras.zh: 警方表示，他们因涉嫌非法侵入和“出于损害英国的目的”进入禁止地点而被拘留。

paras.en: A security patrol had spotted an abandoned vehicle near the base late on Wednesday night. Police found a “small breach” in the perimeter fence before locating and arresting the men in the early hours of Thursday, they said.
paras.zh: 周三深夜，安全巡逻队在基地附近发现了一辆废弃的车辆。他们说，警方在周四凌晨找到并逮捕了这些人之前，发现了周边围栏上有一个“小缺口”。

paras.en: The men were taken to a police station in Cambridgeshire where they are still in custody. Both are Latvian nationals residing in the UK.
paras.zh: 这些人被带到剑桥郡的一个警察局，目前仍被拘留。两人都是居住在英国的拉脱维亚国民。

paras.en: The arrests come after a major incident at RAF Fairford in western England on September 27 that led to the arrest of seven men, all in their 20s, who have since been released on bail. One is a dual UK-Iranian national.
paras.zh: 此次逮捕行动是在 9 月 27 日英格兰西部费尔福德皇家空军基地发生重大事件之后进行的，该事件导致 7 名 20 多岁的男子被捕，此后他们已被保释。其中一名拥有英国和伊朗双重国籍。

paras.en: Due to the nature of the incident, UK counterterrorism police are leading the investigation into the security breach, police said.
paras.zh: 警方表示，鉴于事件的性质，英国反恐警察正在牵头对安全漏洞进行调查。

paras.en: “We’re very aware of the recent heightened interest and concern around military sites,” said Commander Helen Flanagan, head of Counter Terrorism Policing London.
paras.zh: 伦敦反恐警务负责人海伦·弗拉纳根指挥官表示：“我们非常清楚最近人们对军事地点的兴趣和担忧日益浓厚。”

paras.en: “But at this stage there is nothing to suggest this incident is connected to the events at RAF Fairford,” she added.
paras.zh: “但现阶段没有任何迹象表明这一事件与英国皇家空军费尔福德事件有关，”她补充道。

paras.en: Flanagan said that the investigation at RAF Molesworth is at an early stage but added that enquiries would home in on “any potential motivation as to why the men were present at the site”.
paras.zh: 弗拉纳根表示，英国皇家空军莫尔斯沃思的调查还处于早期阶段，但他补充说，调查将集中于“这些人为何出现在现场的任何潜在动机”。

paras.en: RAF Molesworth, formerly a World War II airbase, is now a non-flying facility managed by the United States Air Force.
paras.zh: 英国皇家空军莫尔斯沃思前身是二战时期的空军基地，现在是由美国空军管理的非飞行设施。

paras.en: US intelligence has based its operation centres for Europe and Africa at the base near Huntingdon. It is also a NATO intelligence hub, according to a Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) website.
paras.zh: 美国情报机构将其欧洲和非洲行动中心设在亨廷顿附近的基地。据中央情报局（CIA）网站称，它也是北约情报中心。

paras.en: On Sunday, US military planes were abruptly flown out of the RAF base at Fairford in Gloucestershire, after three suspicious vehicles were seen near the base, prompting a major incident to be declared.
paras.zh: 周日，在格洛斯特郡费尔福德的英国皇家空军基地附近发现三辆可疑车辆后，美国军用飞机突然从该基地起飞，促使宣布发生重大事件。

paras.en: That base had been used by the US military to conduct strikes in its war against Iran.
paras.zh: 该基地曾被美国军方用来在对伊朗的战争中发动袭击。

articles.title: Colombian embassy to open in Jerusalem, Israeli FM says

paras.en: Israel has announced that Colombia will open an embassy in Jerusalem, becoming the latest country to establish a diplomatic mission in the disputed city claimed as a capital by Israelis and Palestinians. Most countries have their embassies in Israel in Tel Aviv.
paras.zh: 以色列宣布哥伦比亚将在耶路撒冷设立大使馆，成为最新一个在这座被以色列人和巴勒斯坦人宣称为首都的争议城市设立外交使团的国家。大多数国家在以色列特拉维夫设有大使馆。

paras.en: Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Saar said Thursday the Latin American country’s embassy would open next week as he touted expanding relations with the region.
paras.zh: 以色列外交部长吉迪恩·萨尔周四表示，拉丁美洲国家的大使馆将于下周开放，并宣扬扩大与该地区的关系。

paras.en: “Next Wednesday, we are going to inaugurate … the Colombian embassy,” Saar told attendees at a conference in Jerusalem.
paras.zh: “下周三，我们将为……哥伦比亚大使馆举行落成典礼，”萨尔在耶路撒冷举行的一次会议上对与会者说。

paras.en: An official at the Colombian Foreign Ministry in Bogota told AFP news agency the country’s Foreign Minister Omar Bula Escobar would travel to Jerusalem on Sunday ahead of the opening.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚外交部驻波哥大的一名官员告诉法新社，该国外交部长奥马尔·布拉·埃斯科瓦尔将于周日在开幕前前往耶路撒冷。

paras.en: Colombian President Abelardo De la Espriella, who was sworn in as president in August, promised close relations with Israel during his election campaign. When he came into office, he restored diplomatic ties between Colombia and Israel. Colombia had previously severed ties with the country over Israel’s genocidal war in Gaza.
paras.zh: 八月宣誓就职的哥伦比亚总统阿韦拉多·德拉埃斯普里埃拉在竞选期间承诺与以色列建立密切关系。他上任后恢复了哥伦比亚与以色列的外交关系。哥伦比亚此前因以色列在加沙的种族灭绝战争而断绝了与该国的关系。

paras.en: The announcement comes as a small but growing list of countries has opted to route their diplomatic ties with Israel through Jerusalem.
paras.zh: 这一消息发布之际，越来越多的国家选择通过耶路撒冷与以色列建立外交关系。

paras.en: Since 2018, the US, Guatemala, Paraguay, Kosovo, Honduras, Papua New Guinea, Fiji, Nauru and Somaliland, which has been recognised as an independent entity only by Israel, have opened embassies in the city.
paras.zh: 自2018年以来，美国、危地马拉、巴拉圭、科索沃、洪都拉斯、巴布亚新几内亚、斐济、瑙鲁和仅被以色列承认为独立实体的索马里兰均在该市设立了大使馆。

paras.en: Other countries that have diplomatic relations with Israel have located their embassies in Tel Aviv, as Jerusalem is not recognised by the international community as Israel’s capital.
paras.zh: 其他与以色列有外交关系的国家都将大使馆设在特拉维夫，因为耶路撒冷不被国际社会承认为以色列首都。

paras.en: “We will work hard because this is the diplomatic battle over the truth. And the truth is, Jerusalem was always the capital of one nation,” Saar said, dismissing Palestinian claims to the capital.
paras.zh: “我们将努力工作，因为这是一场关于真相的外交斗争。事实是，耶路撒冷一直是一个国家的首都，”萨尔说道，并驳斥了巴勒斯坦人对首都的主权要求。

paras.en: The Israeli minister said the Democratic Republic of the Congo would open its embassy in Jerusalem “very soon” and hinted at another opening.
paras.zh: 以色列部长表示，刚果民主共和国将“很快”在耶路撒冷开设大使馆，并暗示将再次开设大使馆。

paras.en: “I think that with the possible results in Brazil, they might have the same move,” he said after right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro won the first round in the country’s presidential election.
paras.zh: “我认为，鉴于巴西可能出现的结果，他们可能会采取同样的举措，”他在右翼参议员弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗赢得该国总统选举第一轮后表示。

paras.en: Protesters in Colombia took to the streets of Bogota on Wednesday to rally against the new far-right government’s policy towards Israel, including the decision to open the Jerusalem embassy.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚的抗议者周三走上波哥大街头集会，反对新的极右翼政府对以色列的政策，包括开放耶路撒冷大使馆的决定。

paras.en: “When diplomatic relations with Israel were broken off, the message was that we would not be a nation complicit in their atrocities,” Nicolas Isaza, who took part in the protest, told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “当与以色列断绝外交关系时，传达的信息是我们不会成为他们暴行的同谋，”参加抗议活动的尼古拉斯·伊萨萨告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: “Today our government is no longer drawing a line against the atrocities being committed in Palestine,” he added.
paras.zh: “今天，我们的政府不再对巴勒斯坦发生的暴行划定界限，”他补充道。

articles.title: Israel opens first-ever pavilion at Morocco defence show
