paras.en: Israel’s Ministry of Defence says it is participating for the first time in a defence exhibition in Morocco, as it announced its first-ever national pavilion at the Marrakesh Air Show 2026.
paras.zh: 以色列国防部表示，这是该国首次参加在摩洛哥举行的国防展，并宣布在 2026 年马拉喀什航展上设立首个国家展馆。

paras.en: “This marks Israel’s first official participation in the defence exhibition held in Morocco since the signing of the Abraham Accords”, Israel’s Defence Ministry said in a statement on Thursday.
paras.zh: 以色列国防部周四在一份声明中表示，“这标志着自《亚伯拉罕协议》签署以来以色列首次正式参加在摩洛哥举行的防务展”。

paras.en: The ministry said eight Israeli defence companies exhibited “advanced, combat-proven technologies at the show” in Marrakesh, which runs until Saturday.
paras.zh: 该部表示，八家以色列国防公司在马拉喀什展出了“先进的、经过实战验证的技术”，该展览将持续到周六。

paras.en: The Marrakech Air Show, taking place from October 7 to October 10 this year at the Marrakech Royal Moroccan Air Force Base, is organised every two years and is meant for civil and military aeronautics and space industries to highlight their latest offerings.
paras.zh: 马拉喀什航空展于今年 10 月 7 日至 10 日在马拉喀什摩洛哥皇家空军基地举行，每两年举办一次，旨在让民用和军用航空航天工业展示其最新产品。

paras.en: “Israel’s three major defence industries, Elbit Systems, IAI, and Rafael, also exhibited, presenting solutions across the air, land, sea, space, intelligence, cyber, and digital domains,” it said.
paras.zh: 以色列三大国防工业埃尔比特系统公司、以色列航空工业公司和拉斐尔公司也参展，展示了空中、陆地、海上、太空、情报、网络和数字领域的解决方案，”它说。

paras.en: The announcement is the latest sign of increasing ties between the Arabic-speaking North African country and Israel, since the two established ties in 2020 as part of the US-backed Abraham Accords.
paras.zh: 这一声明是阿拉伯语北非国家与以色列之间关系加强的最新迹象，因为两国作为美国支持的《亚伯拉罕协议》的一部分于 2020 年建立了关系。

paras.en: Last month, Israel and Morocco agreed to upgrade their diplomatic ties, including elevating their respective missions to embassies and appointing ambassadors to both countries.
paras.zh: 上个月，以色列和摩洛哥同意升级外交关系，包括将各自的使团提升为大使馆并任命驻两国大使。

paras.en: The move followed a meeting between the two countries’ foreign ministers, hosted by the US ambassador to the United Nations, Mike Waltz, on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly in New York.
paras.zh: 此前，美国驻联合国大使迈克·瓦尔兹在纽约联合国大会期间主持了两国外交部长的会晤。

paras.en: They also agreed to expand air travel, including by reinstating direct flights operated by carriers from both nations, and confirmed plans for high-level bilateral visits in the coming months.
paras.zh: 他们还同意扩大航空旅行，包括恢复两国航空公司运营的直飞航班，并确认了未来几个月高层双边访问的计划。

paras.en: Morocco is also one of the five countries that have pledged to send troops to Gaza, under the US-backed International Stabilization Force (ISF) as part of US President Donald Trump’s so-called Board of Peace.
paras.zh: 摩洛哥也是承诺在美国支持的国际稳定部队（ISF）的领导下向加沙派遣军队的五个国家之一，该部队是美国总统唐纳德·特朗普所谓的和平委员会的一部分。

articles.title: South Korea test-flies its first domestically developed hypersonic weapon
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: South Korea test-flies its first domestically developed hypersonic weapon
paras.zh: 韩国试飞首款国产高超音速武器

paras.en: SEOUL, South Korea — South Korea flight-tested on Thursday its first domestically developed hypersonic weapon, designed to fly at least five times the speed of sound and evade missile defense systems, bringing Seoul closer to what it says could be game-changing weapons capabilities.
paras.zh: 韩国首尔——周四，韩国对其首款国产高超音速武器进行了飞行测试，该武器的飞行速度至少是音速的五倍，可以躲避导弹防御系统，使首尔更接近其所说的可能改变游戏规则的武器能力。

paras.en: There was no immediate response from North Korea, which last week tested its own hypersonic missile that landed in the waters near Japan.
paras.zh: 朝鲜没有立即做出回应，上周朝鲜测试了自己的高超音速导弹，该导弹降落在日本附近海域。

paras.en: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung attended the test, saying it's a major step in strengthening the country's conventional defense capabilities, according to a statement. It did not elaborate where the test took place.
paras.zh: 一份声明称，韩国总统李在明出席了这次测试，称这是加强该国常规防御能力的重要一步。它没有详细说明测试在哪里进行。

paras.en: The statement said the weapon separated from its booster rocket at the planned altitude, then descended and maneuvered both vertically and horizontally before hitting a test target. It said once developed, the weapon would be able to strike key targets by surprise in the "Korean Peninsula theater of operations."
paras.zh: 声明称，该武器在计划高度与其助推火箭分离，然后下降并在垂直和水平方向上进行机动，然后击中测试目标。据称，一旦研制成功，该武器将能够对“朝鲜半岛战区”的关键目标实施突然袭击。

paras.en: Lee stressed that South Korea "must secure our security through our own strength," and also inspected the country's most powerful Hyunmoo-5 ballistic missile on Thursday, his office said. It did not mention any direct comments by Lee on the North.
paras.zh: 他的办公室表示，李强调韩国“必须通过自己的力量确保我们的安全”，并于周四视察了该国最强大的 Hyunmoo-5 弹道导弹。它没有提及李明博对朝鲜的任何直接评论。

paras.en: Tensions between the Koreas have increased in recent weeks after three South Korean soldiers were injured in land mine explosions last month near the heavily armed inter-Korean border.
paras.zh: 上个月，在全副武装的朝韩边境附近，三名韩国士兵在地雷爆炸中受伤，导致近几周韩朝之间的紧张局势加剧。

paras.en: The South's military and the U.S.-led United Nations Command concluded the blasts were caused by devices planted by North Korea, which has denied responsibility and ridiculed the South's demands for an apology.
paras.zh: 韩国军方和以美国为首的联合国司令部得出结论，爆炸是由朝鲜安装的装置造成的，朝鲜否认对此负责，并嘲笑韩国的道歉要求。

paras.en: North Korea has also stepped up weapons testing activity as its leader Kim Jong Un expands his military nuclear program while taking an increasingly hard line toward Seoul.
paras.zh: 随着朝鲜领导人金正恩扩大军事核计划，同时对首尔采取越来越强硬的立场，朝鲜也加强了武器试验活动。

paras.en: Kim has so far rebuffed U.S. President Donald Trump's calls to revive their diplomacy that broke down in 2019, with his government demanding that Washington abandon its "hostile" policy toward Pyongyang and drop demands for its denuclearization as a precondition for talks.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，金正恩拒绝了美国总统唐纳德·特朗普恢复2019年破裂的外交的呼吁，金正恩政府要求华盛顿放弃对平壤的“敌对”政策，并放弃将其无核化作为谈判先决条件的要求。

paras.en: The tensions have been a setback for Lee, who favors engagement with North Korea and has tempered his rhetoric toward the North even as public anger grows over the mine blasts.
paras.zh: 这种紧张局势对李明博来说是一个挫折，尽管公众对地雷爆炸的愤怒日益加剧，但他赞成与朝鲜接触，并缓和了对朝鲜的言论。

paras.en: Lee has also called for strengthening South Korea's conventional defense capabilities while reducing its reliance on the United States, which unilaterally decided to scale back a major military exercise with the South in August, with Trump citing his "very good relationship" with Kim.
paras.zh: 李还呼吁加强韩国的常规防御能力，同时减少对美国的依赖，美国8月份单方面决定缩减与韩国的大型军事演习，特朗普称他与金正恩的“关系非常好”。

paras.en: In its latest weapons test on Oct. 3, North Korea launched what it described as a hypersonic intermediate-range missile that it said flew more than 1,000 kilometers (621 miles). Japan said the missile landed in waters outside of its exclusive economic zone.
paras.zh: 在 10 月 3 日的最新武器试验中，朝鲜发射了一枚高超音速中程导弹，据说飞行距离超过 1,000 公里（621 英里）。日本表示，导弹落在其专属经济区以外的海域。

paras.en: South Korea said it detected the missile flying more than 700 kilometers (435 miles), while Japan's Defense Ministry said it assessed that the missile flew about 680 kilometers (422 miles).
paras.zh: 韩国表示，它检测到这枚导弹飞行了超过700公里（435英里），而日本防卫省表示，它评估该导弹飞行了约680公里（422英里）。

paras.en: Kim Yo Jong, the powerful sister of the North Korean leader, claimed the differing flight estimates by the two U.S. allies showed they are incapable of properly tracking such a missile during its flight and would therefore not be able to intercept it.
paras.zh: 朝鲜领导人的强势妹妹金与正声称，这两个美国盟友的不同飞行估计表明，他们无法在飞行过程中正确跟踪这种导弹，因此无法拦截它。

articles.title: South Korea to recall its ambassador to Ukraine over North Korean POW dispute
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: South Korea to recall its ambassador to Ukraine over North Korean POW dispute
paras.zh: 韩国因朝鲜战俘纠纷召回驻乌克兰大使

paras.en: SEOUL, South Korea — South Korea said Thursday it will recall its ambassador to Ukraine, stepping up its protest against Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's recent revelation of a supposedly secret transfer of two North Korean prisoners of war to South Korea.
paras.zh: 韩国首尔——韩国周四表示，将召回驻乌克兰大使，加大力度抗议乌克兰总统泽连斯基最近披露的据称将两名朝鲜战俘秘密转移到韩国的事件。

paras.en: The South Korean announcement came days after its President Lee Jae Myung threatened to take unspecified punitive steps if Ukraine refuses to apologize over the revelation.
paras.zh: 韩国宣布这一消息的几天前，韩国总统李在明威胁称，如果乌克兰拒绝就此事道歉，将采取未具体说明的惩罚措施。

paras.en: South Korea's Foreign Ministry didn't say when the ambassador, Park Hee-chang, will be brought back home. A ministry statement said that South Korea will continue consultations with Ukraine, adding it hopes the dispute between the two countries would be resolved smoothly.
paras.zh: 韩国外交部没有透露大使朴熙昌何时回国。韩国外交部声明称，韩国将继续与乌克兰进行磋商，并希望两国之间的争端能够顺利解决。

paras.en: South Korea and Ukraine became embroiled in a diplomatic row after Zelenskyy spoke about the transfer of the North Korean soldiers during his U.N. speech on Sept. 23. South Korea has accused Ukraine of violating a nondisclosure agreement on their transfer in mid-September, but Kyiv has denied agreeing to such a deal.
paras.zh: 9月23日，泽伦斯基在联合国演讲中谈到朝鲜士兵的移交问题后，韩国和乌克兰陷入了外交争端。韩国指责乌克兰违反了9月中旬移交朝鲜士兵的保密协议，但基辅否认同意这样的协议。

paras.en: The soldiers were among thousands of North Korean troops deployed to support Russia's war against Ukraine. Since their capture in early 2025, the soldiers had expressed their desires to resettle in South Korea, because they could face persecution if repatriated home. South Korea had said it would accept them, because it legally regards the North as part of its territory and has a policy of accepting and financially supporting North Korean defectors.
paras.zh: 这些士兵是为支持俄罗斯对乌克兰战争而部署的数千名朝鲜军队中的一员。自 2025 年初被捕以来，这些士兵表示希望在韩国重新定居，因为如果被遣返回国，他们可能会面临迫害。韩国曾表示会接受他们，因为韩国在法律上将朝鲜视为其领土的一部分，并制定了接受和财政支持脱北者的政策。

paras.en: South Korean officials said the non-disclosure agreement was made because they were concerned about the safety of the North Korean soldiers and their relatives in the North. But many experts say South Korea's liberal government likely also worries the disclosure of their arrival may hurt its efforts to improve ties with North Korea.
paras.zh: 韩国官员表示，签署保密协议是因为他们担心朝鲜士兵及其在朝鲜的亲属的安全。但许多专家表示，韩国自由派政府可能还担心，他们抵达的消息可能会损害其改善与朝鲜关系的努力。

paras.en: North Korea's state media hasn't commented on the soldiers' transfer. But the North previously reacted with fury to major defections of its citizens, accusing South Korea of kidnapping them. North Korea has shunned any talks with South Korea and the U.S. and focused on bolstering its nuclear program since 2019.
paras.zh: 朝鲜官方媒体尚未对士兵的调动发表评论。但朝鲜此前对其公民的重大叛逃做出了愤怒的反应，指责韩国绑架了他们。自 2019 年以来，朝鲜一直回避与韩国和美国进行任何谈判，并专注于加强其核计划。

paras.en: It's unclear what other steps South Korea would take. Experts say maintaining good relations with Ukraine is in South Korean national interests because Kyiv could provide Seoul with intelligence about North Korea's expanding cooperation with Russia and its battlefield experiences. They say cooperation with Ukraine is important for South Korea's partnerships with many Western countries supporting Ukraine over the war.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚韩国还会采取哪些其他措施。专家表示，与乌克兰保持良好关系符合韩国的国家利益，因为基辅可以向首尔提供有关朝鲜与俄罗斯扩大合作及其战场经验的情报。他们表示，与乌克兰的合作对于韩国与许多支持乌克兰战争的西方国家的伙伴关系非常重要。

paras.en: Observers say Zelenskyy disclosed the transfer of the North Korean POWs to expose the danger of North Korea's military support to Russia as a way to win more international assistance.
paras.zh: 观察人士称，泽伦斯基披露朝鲜战俘移交事件是为了暴露朝鲜向俄罗斯提供军事支持的危险，以此赢得更多国际援助。

paras.en: South Korea has provided $445 million in humanitarian assistance to Ukraine since 2022. In July, Lee pledged $100 million in aid to Ukraine in a meeting with Zelenskyy,
paras.zh: 自2022年以来，韩国已向乌克兰提供了4.45亿美元的人道主义援助。7月，李在镕会见泽连斯基时承诺向乌克兰提供1亿美元的援助。

articles.title: New U.S. indictment charges former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro with torture
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: New U.S. indictment charges former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro with torture
paras.zh: 美国新起诉书指控委内瑞拉前总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗遭受酷刑

paras.en: NEW YORK — U.S. authorities added new torture charges Thursday to their case against former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, ramping up pressure on the ousted authoritarian leader already fighting drug trafficking allegations.
paras.zh: 纽约——美国当局周四在针对委内瑞拉前总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗的案件中增加了新的酷刑指控，加大了对这位已经在与贩毒指控作斗争的被驱逐的独裁领导人的压力。

paras.en: Maduro and wife Cilia Flores, already charged with participating in a conspiracy to send cocaine into the U.S., now also face allegations of human rights abuses during his time as president of the oil-rich South American nation.
paras.zh: 马杜罗和妻子西莉亚·弗洛雷斯已经被指控参与阴谋向美国运送可卡因，现在他们还面临在担任这个石油资源丰富的南美国家总统期间侵犯人权的指控。

paras.en: The updated indictment "alleges conduct that is truly unthinkable," New York-based U.S. Attorney Jamie McDonald said outside the courthouse where the case is being handled. He said thousands of Venezuelans, and some Americans, were tortured to ensure that Maduro and Flores held onto power.
paras.zh: 纽约美国检察官杰米·麦克唐纳在处理此案的法院外表示，更新后的起诉书“指控其行为确实令人难以置信”。他说，数千名委内瑞拉人和一些美国人遭受酷刑，以确保马杜罗和弗洛雷斯继续掌权。

paras.en: "This is the epitome of corruption," McDonald said.
paras.zh: “这是腐败的缩影，”麦克唐纳说。

paras.en: The allegations include electric shocks, beatings and asphyxiation at Maduro's behest. Maduro, the indictment claims, signed off on torture methods, sought and got updates on specific victims' treatment, watched a video of a forced confession and personally threatened the killing of one prisoner's child "as a form of psychological torture."
paras.zh: 这些指控包括按照马杜罗的要求实施电击、殴打和窒息。起诉书称，马杜罗签署了酷刑方法，寻求并获取具体受害者待遇的最新信息，观看了强迫认罪的视频，并亲自威胁要杀死一名囚犯的孩子，“作为一种心理折磨”。

paras.en: Flores, a former legislator and attorney general, helped develop the repressive system and ordered the torture of some specific people, the indictment contends.
paras.zh: 起诉书称，前立法委员和总检察长弗洛雷斯帮助制定了镇压制度，并下令对一些特定的人施以酷刑。

paras.en: A message seeking comment was sent to Maduro's lawyer. Flores' attorney said he hadn't yet had time to review the new allegations.
paras.zh: 寻求评论的消息已发送给马杜罗的律师。弗洛雷斯的律师表示，他还没有时间审查新的指控。

paras.en: The couple pleaded not guilty in the U.S. drug case first brought years ago against them and numerous alleged co-conspirators. Their attorneys have asked for the case to be dismissed on the grounds that they have immunity as the leader and first lady of a foreign country.
paras.zh: 这对夫妇在几年前首次针对他们和众多涉嫌同谋的美国毒品案件中表示无罪。他们的律师要求驳回此案，理由是他们作为外国领导人和第一夫人享有豁免权。

paras.en: They face potential sentences of life in prison if convicted.
paras.zh: 如果罪名成立，他们可能面临终身监禁。

paras.en: Maduro, who served as Venezuela's president from 2013 until his capture in January, has been under investigation for years by the International Criminal Court over allegations of crimes against humanity, tied to his crackdown on opponents. He has always denied any wrongdoing.
paras.zh: 马杜罗自 2013 年担任委内瑞拉总统直至 1 月被捕，多年来一直因与镇压反对派有关的反人类罪指控而受到国际刑事法院的调查。他一直否认有任何不当行为。

paras.en: Both Maduro and Flores have been behind bars in New York since early January, when forces seized them from their Caracas home in a middle-of-the-night raid. Flores' lawyers unsuccessfully asked a judge Thursday to release her on house arrest.
paras.zh: 马杜罗和弗洛雷斯自一月初以来一直被关在纽约监狱，当时部队在半夜突袭中从加拉加斯的家中将他们抓获。弗洛雷斯的律师周四请求法官释放她软禁，但没有成功。

paras.en: Outside the courthouse, over a dozen demonstrators chanted slogans and held signs supporting her request.
paras.zh: 法院外，十几名示威者高呼口号，举着支持她请求的标语。

paras.en: Alleged torture victims included U.S. citizens
paras.zh: 据称酷刑受害者包括美国公民

paras.en: The revised indictment includes several mentions of the involvement of Venezuela's feared DGCIM military intelligence agency, which was headed for many years by one of Maduro's co-defendants, Gen. Hugo Carvajal. He broke with Maduro years ago, pleaded guilty last year to drug trafficking charges in New York and has offered to testify against his former boss.
paras.zh: 修订后的起诉书多次提到委内瑞拉令人畏惧的 DGCIM 军事情报机构的参与，该机构多年来一直由马杜罗的同案被告之一乌戈·卡瓦哈尔将军领导。他多年前与马杜罗决裂，去年在纽约承认了贩毒指控，并主动提出出庭作证指控他的前任老板。

paras.en: While the indictment doesn't name the alleged torture victims, three are described as U.S. citizens. One was punched, subjected to electric shocks and forced to eat his own vomit during eight months of imprisonment, the indictment says. Another was beaten badly enough to necessitate a long hospital stay and had a gun stuck in his mouth. A third was handcuffed, hooded and beaten for two days every half an hour, suffering a permanent eye injury, the indictment said.
paras.zh: 虽然起诉书没有提及所谓的酷刑受害者的名字，但三人被描述为美国公民。起诉书称，其中一人在八个月的监禁期间遭到殴打、电击并被迫吃自己的呕吐物。另一个人被殴打得很严重，需要长期住院，嘴里还插着一把枪。起诉书称，三分之一的人被戴上手铐、蒙住头巾，连续两天每半小时遭到殴打，造成眼部永久性损伤。

paras.en: Maduro has long ignored lawsuits brought in U.S. courts by Americans who alleged they were beaten while in custody in Venezuela.
paras.zh: 马杜罗长期以来一直无视美国人向美国法院提起的诉讼，这些美国人声称自己在委内瑞拉被拘留期间遭到殴打。

paras.en: Among those who sued is Matthew Heath, a former U.S. Marine corporal from Tennessee. He was arrested at a roadblock in Venezuela in 2020 and held in custody for more than two years.
paras.zh: 来自田纳西州的前美国海军陆战队下士马修·希思（Matthew Heath）是提起诉讼的人之一。 2020年，他在委内瑞拉的路障中被捕，并被关押了两年多。

paras.en: In May, Heath and another former prisoner won a $300 million default judgment against Maduro and other top Venezuelan officials for overseeing a pattern of torture. The lawsuit, brought under a federal anti-terrorism law, included allegations of waterboarding, electrocution, threats of rape with a nightstick, administration of mind-altering medications and the repeated use of a cramped cell nicknamed "El Tigrito."
paras.zh: 今年 5 月，希思和另一名前囚犯赢得了针对马杜罗和其他委内瑞拉高级官员监督酷刑模式的 3 亿美元缺席判决。这起诉讼是根据联邦反恐法提起的，其中包括水刑、电刑、用警棍威胁强奸、服用改变思想的药物以及反复使用绰号为“El Tigrito”的狭窄牢房的指控。

paras.en: "It's incredible to see a dictator in court," Heath said Thursday upon learning of the new charges. "The Maduro prosecution will do more to prevent the kidnapping of Americans by rogue regimes than a hundred press releases from the United Nations."
paras.zh: “在法庭上看到独裁者真是令人难以置信，”希思周四在得知新指控后表示。 “对马杜罗的起诉对于防止流氓政权绑架美国人的作用比联合国发布的一百份新闻稿还要多。”

paras.en: Former first lady denied release for medical treatment
paras.zh: 前第一夫人被拒绝释放接受治疗

paras.en: Meanwhile, Flores' lawyers argued that Flores, 69, has medical problems that cannot be treated effectively in jail. She has lost 25 pounds (11 kilograms) while imprisoned at the Metropolitan Detention Center in Brooklyn, might have suffered a minor heart attack in July, has "lingering lightheadedness, dizziness and shortness of breath" and has been told that she might need heart surgery, the attorneys said.
paras.zh: 与此同时，弗洛雷斯的律师辩称，69岁的弗洛雷斯患有健康问题，无法在监狱中得到有效治疗。律师称，她在布鲁克林大都会拘留中心被监禁期间体重减轻了 25 磅（11 公斤），可能在 7 月份遭受了轻微的心脏病发作，出现“持续的头晕、头晕和呼吸急促”，并被告知她可能需要进行心脏手术。

paras.en: They also said she suffered permanent scarring when she was "thrown against a wall or dresser" during her capture.
paras.zh: 他们还表示，她在被捕期间被“扔到墙上或梳妆台上”，留下了永久性的疤痕。

paras.en: Prosecutors opposed the bail request, saying that Flores was an "extreme" flight risk and has been taken for treatment at a local hospital when needed.
paras.zh: 检察官反对保释请求，称弗洛雷斯有“极端”潜逃风险，需要时已被送往当地医院接受治疗。

paras.en: U.S. District Court Judge Alvin Hellerstein denied Flores' request. He noted, among other things, that she's unwilling to undergo catheterization in jail in order to determine the cause of her heart problems and the appropriate steps for treatment.
paras.zh: 美国地方法院法官阿尔文·海勒斯坦驳回了弗洛雷斯的请求。他指出，除其他外，她不愿意在监狱里接受导管插入术，以确定她的心脏问题的原因和适当的治疗步骤。

paras.en: He also pushed back at the notion that her high blood pressure was life threatening, noting she's already on medication for that.
paras.zh: 他还反驳了她的高血压危及生命的观点，并指出她已经在接受药物治疗。

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump's administration has defended the raid to capture Maduro as a "surgical law enforcement operation." Maduro has called himself a prisoner of war and his capture a kidnapping.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普政府为抓捕马杜罗的突袭行动进行了辩护，称其为“外科手术式执法行动”。马杜罗称自己是战俘，他的被捕是绑架。

articles.title: 0% intro APR until 2024 is 100% insane

paras.en: If you're on a Galaxy Fold, consider unfolding your phone or viewing it in full screen to best optimize your experience.
paras.zh: 如果您使用的是 Galaxy Fold，请考虑展开手机或全屏查看手机，以最大程度地优化您的体验。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card (rates and fees) is one of the best cards you can get for paying down debt or financing a big purchase interest-free. It carries one of the longest 0% intro APR periods on the market, plus a $0 annual fee.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡（费率和费用）是您可以用来偿还债务或为大宗购物提供无息融资的最佳卡之一。它具有市场上最长的 0% 年利率之一，并且年费为 0 美元。

paras.en: The catch: once that intro APR window closes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards and hands you no ongoing perks. So it's not a great long-term keeper.
paras.zh: 问题是：一旦 APR 介绍窗口关闭，Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡将不会获得任何奖励，也不会为您提供持续的福利。所以它不是一个很好的长期保存者。

paras.en: If your only goal is to stop interest cold, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is hard to beat. Here's my honest review.
paras.zh: 如果您的唯一目标是停止利息，富国银行 Reflect® 卡将是您的最佳选择。这是我的诚实评论。

paras.en: Intro APR 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers
paras.zh: 初始年利率 0% 初始年利率，自购买账户开户和合格余额转账起 21 个月内

paras.en: Purchases: 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases
paras.zh: 购买：自购买账户开户起 21 个月内 0% 初始年利率

paras.en: Balance Transfers: 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers
paras.zh: 余额转账：合格余额转账开户后 21 个月内年利率为 0%

paras.en: This no-frills card is a solid choice if your priority is to avoid credit card interest for as long as possible. It offers an incredible 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers (17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR after). The balance transfer fee (5%; $5 min.) is higher than some cards, but if you want an equally long intro APR on purchases and balance transfers, this card is hard to beat.
paras.zh: 如果您的首要任务是尽可能长时间地避免信用卡利息，那么这张简单的卡是一个不错的选择。从购买账户开户和合格余额转账起，它提供令人难以置信的 0% 介绍年利率 21 个月（之后为 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率）。余额转账费用（5%；至少 5 美元）比某些卡要高，但如果您想要购买和余额转账时有同样长的年利率介绍，那么这张卡很难被击败。

paras.en: These cards are designed for people looking to pay off a large purchase or transfer a balance — so our ratings emphasize interest-free periods, fee structures, and how much time you really get to pay things down.
paras.zh: 这些卡是为那些希望还清大额购买或转移余额的人而设计的，因此我们的评级强调免息期、费用结构以及您真正还清贷款的时间。

paras.en: We don’t penalize cards for a lack of long-term rewards here – this category is all about interest savings, and our ratings reflect that.
paras.zh: 我们不会因为缺乏长期奖励而对信用卡进行处罚——这一类别主要是为了节省利息，我们的评级反映了这一点。

paras.en: We combine these factors with an evaluation of brand reputation and customer satisfaction to ensure you're getting the best high limit card recommendations. Our aim is to maintain a balanced best-of list featuring top-scoring high limit credit cards from reputable brands. 'Best for' category selections on this page are determined by our editors, and a single card may be recognized in multiple categories.
paras.zh: 我们将这些因素与品牌声誉和客户满意度评估相结合，以确保您获得最佳的高限额卡推荐。我们的目标是维持一个平衡的最佳列表，其中包括来自知名品牌的得分最高的高限额信用卡。此页面上的“最佳”类别选择由我们的编辑确定，单张卡片可能会在多个类别中被识别。

paras.en: Ordering within lists is influenced by advertiser compensation, including featured placements at the top of a given list, but our product recommendations are NEVER influenced by advertisers. Learn more about how Motley Fool Money rates credit cards.
paras.zh: 列表中的排序受到广告商补偿的影响，包括给定列表顶部的特色展示位置，但我们的产品推荐永远不会受到广告商的影响。详细了解 Motley Fool Money 如何对信用卡进行评级。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is best for people carrying high-interest debt or planning a large purchase they want to spread out over time.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡最适合背负高息债务或计划长期进行大额购买的人士。

paras.en: You get nearly two years of breathing room with no interest, which can save a lot of money while you pay things off.
paras.zh: 您将获得近两年的无息喘息空间，这可以在您还清债务的同时节省大量资金。

paras.en: If you're looking for cash back or travel rewards, this is not the card for you. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card has no rewards program and no welcome bonus. It loses most of its value the moment the intro period ends.
paras.zh: 如果您正在寻求现金返还或旅行奖励，那么这张卡不适合您。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡没有奖励计划，也没有欢迎奖金。一旦介绍期结束，它就失去了大部分价值。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card's headline feature is 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. (A 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR applies after.)
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的主要特点是，自开户购买和合格余额转账起 21 个月内，年利率为 0%。 （此后适用 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率。）

paras.en: That's one of the longest 0% APR periods you'll find anywhere -- which is why it earned Motley Fool Money's award for Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 这是您能在任何地方找到的最长的 0% 年利率卡之一 - 这就是为什么它获得 Motley Fool Money 颁发的 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡奖。

paras.en: This long intro APR is particularly handy for large balances (think anything $5,000+). The longer the promo window, the less you need to pay each month to clear your balance while paying no interest.
paras.zh: 这个长篇介绍年利率对于大额余额（想想任何 5,000 美元以上的东西）特别方便。促销窗口越长，您每月需要支付的费用就越少，无需支付利息即可结清余额。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges no annual fee, so it costs nothing to keep in your wallet. For anyone building credit history -- or, like me, holding onto a top credit card for the long haul -- that's a real plus.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取年费，因此放在钱包中无需支付任何费用。对于任何建立信用记录的人来说——或者像我一样长期持有顶级信用卡——这是一个真正的优势。

paras.en: Keeping the card open can help your credit score by lengthening your average credit history over time.
paras.zh: 保持信用卡开放可以随着时间的推移延长您的平均信用记录，从而提高您的信用评分。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card includes cellphone protection when you pay your monthly phone bill with the card. It covers up to $600 per claim for theft or damage, with a $25 deductible, and you can file up to two claims per 12-month period.
paras.zh: 当您使用 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡支付每月的电话费时，该卡包含手机保护功能。每次盗窃或损坏索赔的赔付额最高为 600 美元，免赔额为 25 美元，并且每 12 个月最多可以提出两次索赔。

paras.en: I've never had to use cellphone insurance, but as a frequent phone-dropper and generally clumsy person, I've always loved having it in my back pocket.
paras.zh: 我从来没有使用过手机保险，但作为一个经常丢手机而且通常很笨拙的人，我一直喜欢把它放在我的后口袋里。

paras.en: We recommend comparing options to ensure the card you're selecting is the best fit for you. To make your search easier, here's a short list of standout credit cards.
paras.zh: 我们建议比较选项，以确保您选择的卡最适合您。为了让您的搜索更容易，这里列出了一些优秀的信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards. If you want a card with long-term perks like cash back or travel points, this isn't it.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不赚取任何奖励。如果您想要一张具有现金返还或旅行积分等长期福利的卡，那么这张卡不合适。

paras.en: A strong alternative is the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card (rates and fees), which earns a flat 2% cash rewards on purchases for a $0 annual fee. It's our Best Overall Credit Card of 2026, and a fan favorite for flat-rate rewards.
paras.zh: 一个强有力的替代方案是 Wells Fargo Active Cash® 卡（费率和费用），该卡以 0 美元年费购买即可获得 2% 的固定现金奖励。这是我们 2026 年最佳整体信用卡，也是粉丝最喜欢的统一费率奖励卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a balance transfer fee of 5%, min: $5 -- this is on the high side for a balance transfer card.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 5% 的余额转账费用，最低 5 美元——这对于余额转账卡来说偏高。

paras.en: If you move a $10,000 balance, you'd owe a $500 fee, even though you'd pay the balance off at 0% during the intro period.
paras.zh: 如果您转移 10,000 美元的余额，则需要支付 500 美元的费用，即使您在介绍期内以 0% 的利率还清余额。

paras.en: Run the math before you transfer, because the fee should cost less than the interest you'd otherwise pay. If you won't clear the balance within the 0% APR period, then an alternative balance transfer card with a lower transfer fee may serve you better.
paras.zh: 在转账之前先计算一下，因为费用应该低于您原本支付的利息。如果您无法在 0% 年利率期间清除余额，那么转账费用较低的替代余额转账卡可能会为您提供更好的服务。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a 3% foreign transaction fee, so you'll pay extra on purchases made outside the U.S. If you travel abroad and want to skip that cost, consider one of our favorite travel credit cards.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 3% 的国外交易费，因此您在美国境外购物时需要支付额外费用。如果您出国旅行并想跳过这笔费用，请考虑我们最喜欢的旅行信用卡之一。

paras.en: It also has no purchase protection or extended warranty on purchases.
paras.zh: 它也没有购买保护或延长购买保修。

paras.en: You'll generally need good to excellent credit (Motley Fool Money estimates this to be a FICO® Score of about 670 or higher) to qualify for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card. Wells Fargo doesn't publish an official cutoff, and applicants closer to 700 tend to be the best-qualified candidates.
paras.zh: 您通常需要良好到优秀的信用（Motley Fool Money 估计 FICO® 分数约为 670 或更高）才有资格获得 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡。富国银行没有公布官方截止日期，接近 700 名的申请者往往是最合格的候选人。

paras.en: Keep in mind, your score isn't the only factor. Wells Fargo also weighs your income, existing debt, and overall credit history. You can check for pre-selected offers on Wells Fargo's site without a hard inquiry to gauge your chances first.
paras.zh: 请记住，您的分数并不是唯一的因素。富国银行还会衡量您的收入、现有债务和整体信用记录。您可以在富国银行网站上查看预先选定的优惠，无需进行严格询问即可首先评估您的机会。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card comes with a minimum credit limit of $1,000, and higher scores and income generally earn higher limits. Wells Fargo sets your limit individually based on your full credit profile, so two applicants can get very different lines of credit.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的最低信用额度为 1,000 美元，分数和收入越高，信用额度通常越高。富国银行根据您的完整信用状况单独设置您的限额，因此两个申请人可以获得截然不同的信用额度。

paras.en: Your starting limit isn't permanent, though. Once your account is open and in good standing, usually after six to 12 months, you can request an increase. Or, Wells Fargo may raise it automatically for on-time payments and low utilization.
paras.zh: 不过，您的起始限制并不是永久的。一旦您的账户开设且信誉良好，通常在 6 到 12 个月后，您就可以请求增加金额。或者，富国银行可能会因按时付款和利用率低而自动提高费用。

paras.en: To get the 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers (then 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR), you must complete qualifying transfers within 120 days of opening your account.
paras.zh: 要在开户后 21 个月内通过合格余额转账获得 0% 初始年利率（然后是 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率），您必须在开户后 120 天内完成合格转账。

paras.en: I recommend starting the transfer online or by phone as soon as you're approved. Having your old account details ready speeds things up.
paras.zh: 我建议您在获得批准后立即开始在线或通过电话转移。准备好旧帐户详细信息可以加快速度。

paras.en: One important note: you can't transfer a balance from another Wells Fargo or affiliated card. Transfers have to come from a different issuer, and the 5%, min: $5 transfer fee applies to each one.
paras.zh: 一个重要的注意事项：您无法从另一张富国银行或附属卡转移余额。转账必须来自不同的发行人，并且每笔转账均需缴纳 5%（最低 5 美元）的转账费。

paras.en: Applying for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is quick. Here's what to do:
paras.zh: 申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的速度很快。该怎么做：

paras.en: Approvals are usually instant, but can take a few days if Wells Fargo needs to verify some of your information.
paras.zh: 批准通常是即时的，但如果富国银行需要验证您的某些信息，则可能需要几天的时间。

paras.en: Yes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is worth it if your priority is paying off debt or financing a large purchase without interest. Very few cards give you a long no-interest runway like this.
paras.zh: 是的，如果您的首要任务是偿还债务或为大额购买提供无息融资，那么 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡是值得的。很少有卡可以给你这样一条漫长的无息跑道。

paras.en: It's not worth it if you want rewards or perks after the intro period, since it offers neither.
paras.zh: 如果您在介绍期后想要奖励或福利，那么这是不值得的，因为它两者都没有提供。

paras.en: Ready to make a dent in your debt? Apply for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card today -- awarded Motley Fool Money's Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 准备好减少债务了吗？立即申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡 - 荣获 Motley Fool Money 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡。

paras.en: When the 0% intro APR period ends, any remaining balance starts accruing interest at your regular variable APR from that point forward. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card doesn't charge deferred or retroactive interest, so you only pay on what's left -- not on the full original balance.
paras.zh: 当 0% 介绍年利率期结束时，任何剩余余额将开始按照您的常规可变年利率计息。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取递延或追溯利息，因此您只需支付剩余金额，而不是全额原始余额。

paras.en: No, the 0% intro APR does not cover cash advances. Cash advances start accruing interest immediately at a separate, higher APR and come with their own fee. The intro offer only applies to purchases and qualifying balance transfers.
paras.zh: 不可以，0% 的年利率不包括现金预支。现金预支立即开始以单独的、较高的年利率计息，并收取自己的费用。介绍优惠仅适用于购买和符合条件的余额转账。

paras.en: Keeping the card open is usually the better move, even after your balance hits $0. If it has no annual fee, it costs nothing to hold, and the open account helps your credit score by supporting your total available credit and length of history.
paras.zh: 即使您的余额达到 0 美元，保持卡打开通常是更好的选择。如果它没有年费，那么持有它就不需要任何成本，并且开放账户通过支持您的总可用信用和历史长度来帮助您的信用评分。

paras.en: Wells Fargo is an advertising partner of Motley Fool Money. Joel O'Leary has no position in any of the stocks mentioned. The Motley Fool has no position in any of the stocks mentioned. The Motley Fool has a disclosure policy.
paras.zh: 富国银行是 Motley Fool Money 的广告合作伙伴。乔尔·奥利里 (Joel O'Leary) 没有持有上述任何股票的头寸。 Motley Fool 没有持有上述任何股票的头寸。 Motley Fool 有披露政策。

paras.en: The Motley Fool owns shares of and recommends Visa.
paras.zh: The Motley Fool 拥有 Visa 的股份并推荐该公司。

articles.title: The most beautiful sections of China's Great Wall

paras.en: Editor’s Note: Monthly Ticket is a CNN Travel series that spotlights some of the most fascinating topics in the travel world. In September, we’re celebrating superlatives as we look at some of the world’s biggest, tallest and most expensive attractions and destinations.
paras.zh: 编者注：《月票》是 CNN 的旅游系列节目，重点关注旅游界一些最有趣的话题。九月，当我们参观世界上一些最大、最高和最昂贵的景点和目的地时，我们正在庆祝最高级。

paras.en: Having lived in Beijing for almost 12 years, I’ve had plenty of time to travel widely in China.
paras.zh: 在北京生活了近12年，我有足够的时间去中国各地旅行。

paras.en: I’ve visited more than 100 cities, not to mention countless towns and villages throughout the mainland’s 31 provinces.
paras.zh: 我去过100多个城市，更不用说遍布大陆31个省份的无数城镇和村庄。

paras.en: Looking back, I’ve come to realize it was my frequent visits to different parts of the Great Wall in Beijing that were a driving force behind my desire to explore the rest of the country and, along with it, the many sections of wall that lie outside the capital’s boundaries.
paras.zh: 回想起来，我逐渐意识到，正是我对北京长城不同部分的频繁访问，推动了我探索中国其他地区以及首都边界之外的许多长城的愿望。

paras.en: Work on the Great Wall began more than 2,500 years ago, its origins dating back to China’s Spring and Autumn Period of around 770 BCE to 476 BCE. Various sections were added in subsequent eras as competing dynasties and factions sought to exert their control.
paras.zh: 长城的修建始于 2500 多年前，其起源可以追溯到公元前 770 年至公元前 476 年左右的中国春秋时期。在随后的时代中，随着相互竞争的王朝和派别试图施加控制，各个部分被添加。

paras.en: Work eventually stopped in the 17th century.
paras.zh: 工程最终于 17 世纪停止。

paras.en: Though not a single, unbroken structure, the wall spans over 21,000 kilometers, winding through 15 provinces, 97 prefectures and 404 counties.
paras.zh: 长城虽然不是一个完整的结构，但全长超过 21,000 公里，蜿蜒穿过 15 个省、97 个地区和 404 个县。

paras.en: And while certain sections have been incredibly popular among tourists, many parts have slipped into obscurity, disrepair and sometimes oblivion.
paras.zh: 虽然某些部分非常受游客欢迎，但许多部分却变得默默无闻、年久失修，有时甚至被遗忘。

paras.en: Whether you’re planning to visit the Great Wall for the first time or the 50th, the following destinations are sure to make your trip to China even more worthwhile. (Check out the above video for dramatic aerial footage of some of these amazing sites.)
paras.zh: 无论您是第一次还是第 50 次游览长城，以下目的地一定会让您的中国之旅更加值得。 （查看上面的视频，了解其中一些令人惊叹的景点的戏剧性航拍镜头。）

paras.en: The Great Wall is not simply a brick and mortar bulwark; in certain places, towers on jagged mountain peaks, fortress towns or even wide rivers count as sections of “wall.”
paras.zh: 长城不仅仅是一座砖砌的堡垒，更是一座砖砌的堡垒。在某些地方，锯齿状山峰上的塔楼、要塞城镇甚至宽阔的河流都算作“墙”的一部分。

paras.en: The Turtle City, built in the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644) as part of the Great Wall’s “Yellow River Defense Line,” was completed in 1608 and was home to around 2,000 infantrymen and 500 cavalry units during peak use.
paras.zh: 龟城建于明朝（1368-1644 年），是长城“黄河防线”的一部分，于 1608 年竣工，在高峰期可容纳约 2,000 名步兵和 500 名骑兵。

paras.en: Today, this fortress city is located in the Sitan Township of Jingtai County in north central Gansu province.
paras.zh: 如今，这座要塞城市位于甘肃省中北部景泰县泗滩乡。

paras.en: While there aren’t many real turtles in the “Turtle City,” the garrison town got its nickname due to its unique shape.
paras.zh: 虽然“龟城”中真正的乌龟不多，但这座驻军小镇因其独特的形状而得名。

paras.en: The south gate acts as the head and the west and east gates as the flippers. The town’s oval wall is the body, while the north gate acts as its tail. As one of the most well-preserved and truly authentic walled cities left in China today, it’s definitely worth your time.
paras.zh: 南门为头，西门、东门为脚蹼。椭圆形城墙为城身，北门为城尾。作为当今中国保存最完好、最真实的城墙之一，这里绝对值得您花时间。

paras.en: Staying in the Jingtai County center is recommended. The ancient city is only a 30-minute cab ride from your lodgings, so you can visit whenever the light is best for photos.
paras.zh: 推荐住在景泰县城中心。从您的住处乘坐出租车仅需 30 分钟即可到达古城，因此您可以在光线最适合拍照的时候前往游览。

paras.en: When in Jingtai, try local specialties such as the five Buddha tofu and the Jingtai cold mixed noodles – both are spicy vegetarian dishes. A walk through the sprawling night market in Jingtai County People’s Square, which boasts more than 50 snack stalls, is also recommended for adventurous foodies.
paras.zh: 到了景泰，一定要尝尝当地的特色菜，比如五佛豆腐和景泰冷拌面——都是麻辣素菜。景泰县人民广场的夜市拥有 50 多个小吃摊位，值得喜欢冒险的美食家们前往逛一逛。

paras.en: Getting there: Lanzhou, the capital of Gansu province, has a major international airport and high-speed train connections from many cities in China. The drive to Yongtai Turtle City from downtown Lanzhou takes about 2.5 hours (195 kilometers). From Lanzhou Zhongchuan Airport, it’s only 1.5 hours (125 kilometers).
paras.zh: 交通：兰州是甘肃省的省会，拥有一个主要的国际机场和连接中国许多城市的高速列车。从兰州市区驾车至永泰龟城，车程约2.5小时（195公里）。距兰州中川机场仅1.5小时（125公里）。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are two parts of the same Stone Dragon – two contiguous sections of the Great Wall that together stretch for roughly 25 kilometers along Beijing’s mountaintops.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口是同一条石龙的两个部分——长城的两个连续部分，沿着北京的山顶绵延约 25 公里。

paras.en: Historical records show that millions of men spent centuries constructing the Great Wall. Stand atop the wall at either Mutianyu or Jiankou, and you’ll begin to comprehend the gravity of this statement.
paras.zh: 历史记录表明，数百万人花费了几个世纪的时间建造长城。站在慕田峪或剑口的城墙上，你就会开始理解这句话的严重性。

paras.en: These two sections are arguably the two most classic examples of Ming Dynasty Great Wall surviving today, and climbing either is guaranteed to be a life-changing experience.
paras.zh: 这两段可以说是现存明代长城中最经典的两个例子，攀登其中任何一段都将是一次改变人生的经历。

paras.en: Mutianyu is the best portion of the “tourist wall.” Restored in the 1980s, it’s very commercial but also superbly beautiful. Visitors not up for the hike can take a cable car to the top.
paras.zh: 慕田峪是“旅游墙”中最好的部分。它于 20 世纪 80 年代修复，非常商业化，但也非常美丽。不适合徒步的游客可以乘坐缆车到达山顶。

paras.en: To the west of Mutianyu, Jiankou is colloquially known as the “wild wall” – no ticket needed and not commercialized. That being said, as of 2020, hiking at Jiankou has become somewhat frowned upon by the local government because of safety concerns.
paras.zh: 慕田峪以西的剑口俗称“野墙”，不需门票，不商业化。尽管如此，从2020年开始，出于安全考虑，当地政府对剑口徒步有些不满。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are less than a 90-minute drive (without traffic) from downtown Beijing, yet it’s highly recommended to enjoy a night in the countryside if time allows.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口距离北京市中心不到 90 分钟车程（不堵车），但如果时间允许，强烈建议在乡村享受一晚。

paras.en: Jiankou can be accessed via Xizhazi village; if dates align, you might even be able to spend a few days with William Lindesay, world-renowned Great Wall historian, and his wonderful family at The Barracks, their wall-side courtyard home.
paras.zh: 经西栅子村可到达剑口；如果日期一致，您甚至可以与世界著名的长城历史学家威廉·林德赛 (William Lindesay) 和他的家人一起在军营 (The Barracks) 度过几天，这是他们位于墙边的庭院住宅。

paras.en: For lodgings around Mutianyu, The Brickyard is a superbly comfortable choice.
paras.zh: 对于慕田峪周边的住宿而言，瓦厂是一个非常舒适的选择。

paras.en: In fall and spring, shades of the wall’s gray brick contrast with nature’s vibrant colors. Peak autumn foliage and spring cherry blossoms provide stunning backdrops for photos.
paras.zh: 在秋季和春季，灰色砖墙的色调与大自然充满活力的色彩形成鲜明对比。秋天的枫叶和春天的樱花为照片提供了令人惊叹的背景。

paras.en: For winter sports enthusiasts, there’s skiing and skating next to the Wall at locations not far from Mutianyu.
paras.zh: 对于冬季运动爱好者来说，距离慕田峪不远的长城旁有滑雪场和滑冰场。

paras.en: Getting to Mutianyu: Restrictions on applying for temporary driving licenses in China were relaxed in September 2019, so renting a car as a foreign tourist is entirely possible. (International driving licenses are not accepted in China.)
paras.zh: 前往慕田峪：2019年9月，中国放宽了申请临时驾驶执照的限制，因此外国游客完全可以租车。 （中国不接受国际驾照。）

paras.en: You can also hire a car with a driver for the day or take the Mutianyu Special Tourism Bus from the Dongzhimen Wai Bus Station.
paras.zh: 您也可以当天租一辆带司机的汽车，或者从东直门外汽车站乘坐慕田峪旅游专线巴士。

paras.en: Getting to Jiankou: Renting a car or booking private transport is recommended. As Xizhazi is a small village, buses are scarce so it can take up to five hours to get there by public transport, as opposed to 90 minutes by car.
paras.zh: 前往剑口：建议租车或预订私人交通工具。由于西栅子是一个小村庄，公交车很少，因此乘坐公共交通工具最多需要 5 个小时才能到达那里，而开车则需要 90 分钟。

paras.en: Bataizi village sits just inside the Motianling section of the Great Wall and is home to the ruins of a Gothic church built in 1876 under the direction of a German missionary.
paras.zh: 八台子村位于磨天岭长城内，是一座哥特式教堂的遗址，这座教堂建于 1876 年，由一位德国传教士主持建造。

paras.en: The church has been damaged and repaired numerous times in its nearly 150-year history; the bell tower is the only part still standing.
paras.zh: 这座教堂在近150年的历史中曾多次遭到损坏和修复。钟楼是唯一仍然矗立的部分。

paras.en: The juxtaposition of its ruins against the rammed-earth Great Wall makes Bataizi a unique place to spend a morning or afternoon.
paras.zh: 其遗址与夯土长城并列，使八台子成为度过早晨或下午的独特场所。

paras.en: After finishing your hike along the wall and visiting the church ruins, drop in to the village’s “new” church to say hello to Father Pan; if you speak Chinese, he can answer any questions about the village’s long connection with Catholicism.
paras.zh: 完成沿着城墙的徒步旅行并参观教堂遗址后，顺便去村里的“新”教堂向潘神父问好；如果你会说中文，他可以回答任何有关该村与天主教的悠久联系的问题。

paras.en: Besides Bataizi, Datong should also be on your tourist map; visiting the Yungang Grottoes (a UNESCO world heritage site) and the Hengshan Hanging Temple will make your trip even more memorable.
paras.zh: 除了八台子，大同也应该出现在你的旅游地图上；参观云冈石窟（联合国教科文组织世界遗产）和恒山悬空寺将使您的旅行更加难忘。

paras.en: Late summer is an ideal time to visit Bataizi, as you’ll see a wonderful contrast between the Great Wall and the lush green hills.
paras.zh: 夏末是游览八台子的理想时间，因为您会看到长城和郁郁葱葱的青山之间的奇妙对比。

paras.en: Getting there: Bataizi village is 80 kilometers west of Datong, one of Shanxi province’s largest and most famous cities. Zuoyun County is only 22 kilometers away from Bataizi – about a 35-minute drive.
paras.zh: 交通：八台子村位于山西省最大、最著名的城市之一大同以西 80 公里处。左云县距八台子仅22公里，车程约35分钟。

paras.en: Datong is easily accessible by plane or high-speed train from other cities in China; a taxi from downtown Datong to Bataizi should cost roughly 300 yuan (about $43).
paras.zh: 从中国其他城市乘坐飞机或高铁可轻松抵达大同；从大同市中心到八台子的出租车费用约为 300 元（约合 43 美元）。

paras.en: Alternatively, you can make your way to Zuoyun County by bus then hop in a taxi.
paras.zh: 或者，您也可以乘坐巴士前往左云县，然后乘坐出租车。

paras.en: In Datong, luxury seekers will want to head for the five-star Yunzhong Traditional Courtyard Hotel. Zuoyun County has one hotel that can accept foreigners: Zuoyun Jinshan International Hotel. Both can be found on popular hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: 在大同，追求奢华的游客将会前往五星级的云中传统四合院酒店。左云县有一家可以接待外国人的酒店：左云金山国际酒店。两者都可以在热门酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Laoniuwan (aka the Old Ox Bend Great Wall)
paras.zh: 老牛湾（又名老牛弯长城）

paras.en: As the locals say, Laoniuwan is where the Great Wall and the mighty Yellow River shake hands.
paras.zh: 当地人说，老牛湾是长城与浩瀚黄河握手的地方。

paras.en: The Laoniuwan Fortress was built in 1467, while the most famous tower of the Great Wall in this area, Wanghe Tower (literally meaning river-watching tower), was constructed in 1544.
paras.zh: 老牛湾城建于1467年，而该地区最著名的长城塔望河楼则建于1544年。

paras.en: Laoniuwan village is located in Pianguan County, part of Xinzhou city in Shanxi province, just across the river from Inner Mongolia.
paras.zh: 老牛湾村位于山西省忻州市偏关县，与内蒙古隔江相望。

paras.en: Late summer or early fall is a great time to visit, as you’ll avoid the potentially dangerous mountain roads during spring rainstorms, or being uncomfortably cold in a place without great infrastructure.
paras.zh: 夏末或初秋是游览的好时机，因为您可以避开春季暴雨期间潜在危险的山路，或者在没有良好基础设施的地方感到不舒服的寒冷。

paras.en: Along the Great Wall, there are only a few places where it meets bodies of water; of all those, this is the most stunning.
paras.zh: 长城沿线只有少数地方与水体交汇；其中，这是最令人惊叹的。

paras.en: A boat ride along the river is highly recommended. You’ll be able to soak in the natural beauty of the Yellow River Gorge while marveling at the steadfast resolve of these ancient architects.
paras.zh: 强烈推荐沿河乘船游览。您将能够沉浸在黄河峡谷的自然美景中，同时惊叹于这些古代建筑师的坚定决心。

paras.en: Getting there: Laoniuwan is difficult to get to by public transportation. The best option is to rent or book a car to take you from Datong to Laoniuwan via Bataizi – this way, you’ll be able to see two incredible locations along the Great Wall in one trip.
paras.zh: 交通：老牛湾乘坐公共交通不太方便。最好的选择是租赁或预订一辆车，从大同经八台子前往老牛湾——这样，您将能够在一次旅行中看到长城沿线的两个令人难以置信的景点。

paras.en: Pianguan is the nearest city, about one hour away. Pianguan does not have a train station or an airport. The only option is to arrive by bus. Shuozhou, 140 kilometers from Laoniuwan, has an airport opening later this year.
paras.zh: 偏关是最近的城市，大约一小时车程。偏关没有火车站和机场。唯一的选择是乘坐巴士到达。距离老牛湾 140 公里的朔州机场将于今年晚些时候开业。

paras.en: Construction on the Great Wall in Simatai began in 1373. It was expanded and reinforced periodically throughout the Ming Dynasty.
paras.zh: 司马台长城始建于 1373 年。明代期间不断扩建和加固。

paras.en: The Fairy Tower is one of the best-known towers of the wall at Simatai but also one of the least visited due to how difficult it is to access.
paras.zh: 仙塔是司马台最著名的城墙塔楼之一，但由于难以进入，也是参观人数最少的塔楼之一。

paras.en: Instead, aim to take in incredible views of the Fairy Tower from Wangjing Tower (just a few hundred meters away). It’s a journey that will satiate even the most adventurous hikers, yet can be done without any ropes, ladders or other essential safety gear.
paras.zh: 相反，您的目标是从望京塔（仅数百米外）欣赏仙女塔的壮丽景色。这是一次即使是最具冒险精神的徒步旅行者也能满足的旅程，而且无需任何绳索、梯子或其他必要的安全装备即可完成。

paras.en: As with a visit to Mutianyu/Jiankou, this section of wall is guaranteed to deliver stunning views any time of year. My only suggestion is to wait for a clear day (usually visibility is great the day after it rains or snows), as the view from Wangjing Tower is unobstructed in every direction.
paras.zh: 与游览慕田峪/剑口一样，这一段城墙保证在一年中的任何时候都能呈现出令人惊叹的景色。我唯一的建议是等待晴天（通常下雨或下雪后的第二天能见度很好），因为从望京塔的各个方向都一览无余。

paras.en: The hike to the Fairy Tower will leave you in awe of the Northern Barbarians’ supposed determination to reach the capital; the mountains are nearly impassable on foot, let alone by horse, with sheer cliff faces on either side.
paras.zh: 徒步前往仙塔，会让您对北蛮人到达首都的决心感到敬畏；这些山脉几乎无法步行通过，更不用说骑马了，两侧都是陡峭的悬崖。

paras.en: It makes for absolutely world-class hiking and an interesting history lesson.
paras.zh: 它绝对是世界一流的徒步旅行和有趣的历史课。

paras.en: Five-star lodgings are available at Hobo Farm; they also have an incredible restaurant that serves delicious Western and Chinese fare. For 4.5 star lodgings with a lower price tag, try Yatou’s Homestay. Both can be found on major hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: Hobo农场提供五星级住宿；他们还有一家令人难以置信的餐厅，供应美味的西餐和中餐。如果想要价格较低的 4.5 星级住宿，可以试试丫头民宿。两者都可以在主要的酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Getting there: Both the Fairy Tower and Wangjing Tower should be accessed via Tangjiazhai village, located in Beijing’s Miyun district.
paras.zh: 交通：仙女塔和望京塔均需经由位于北京密云区的唐家寨村到达。

paras.en: Tangjiazhai village is 140 kilometers from downtown Beijing, depending on your route. Booking a private car from the city is probably the most time-effective way to get there.
paras.zh: 唐家寨距离北京市中心 140 公里，具体取决于您的路线。从市区预订私家车可能是到达那里最省时的方式。

paras.en: You can also take a high-speed train from Beijing Station to Miyun district and switch to a bus or taxi from there.
paras.zh: 您也可以从北京站乘坐高铁到密云区，然后从那里换乘公交车或出租车。

paras.en: Constructed during the reign of Emperor Jiajing (1507-1567), this single-wall section stands seven meters tall in some spots – no small feat considering it was made by piling stones.
paras.zh: 这座单墙建筑建于嘉靖年间（1507-1567 年），有些地方高达 7 米，考虑到它是用石头堆砌而成，这可不是一件小事。

paras.en: It’s located just across the road from the town of Dushikou, in Chicheng in Hebei province.
paras.zh: 它位于河北省赤城独市口镇的马路对面。

paras.en: The piled-stone wall at Dushikou is unique, as many other sections of the Great Wall close to Beijing were constructed using kiln-fired bricks.
paras.zh: 独市口的石堆墙是独一无二的，因为许多靠近北京的长城都是用窑烧砖建造的。

paras.en: Dushikou is best visited in the summer, specifically July and August, when the rolling hills of the surrounding grasslands are peak green. Cool evenings make for perfect outdoor barbecue/bonfire weather.
paras.zh: 独石口的最佳旅游时间是夏季，特别是七月和八月，此时周围草原连绵起伏的山丘呈现出翠绿的景色。凉爽的夜晚是完美的户外烧烤/篝火天气。

paras.en: You’ll be able to find clean and comfortable farmhouse lodgings in Dushikou town; alternatively, Chicheng, 45 minutes away, has a range of hotels to choose from.
paras.zh: 在都市口镇你可以找到干净舒适的农家住宿；或者，距酒店 45 分钟路程的赤城也有多家酒店可供选择。

paras.en: Lamb skewers and roast leg of lamb are specialties in these parts, as this part of Hebei is very close to the border with Inner Mongolia. Noodle lovers should also try the local oat noodles, which are delicious.
paras.zh: 河北这一地区靠近内蒙古边境，羊肉串、烤羊腿是这些地区的特色菜。喜欢吃面食的人还应该尝尝当地的燕麦面，味道鲜美。

paras.en: Getting there: Thanks to all the infrastructure built for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the drive to Dushikou has been shortened by almost two hours. If you prefer not to drive, hop on a bus to Chicheng from the Liuliqiao Transport Hub in Beijing and take a 45-minute taxi ride to Dushikou.
paras.zh: 交通：得益于为 2022 年冬奥会建设的所有基础设施，前往都市口的车程缩短了近两个小时。如果您不想开车，可以从北京六里桥交通枢纽搭乘巴士前往赤城，然后乘坐出租车 45 分钟即可到达独市口。

paras.en: Note that public transportation will take one or two hours longer than private car.
paras.zh: 请注意，公共交通会比私家车多花一两个小时。

articles.title: Israeli actress calls out Hollywood stars 'silencing artists' who support Jewish state

paras.en: Israeli actress Noa Cohen pushed back against celebrities "silencing artists" supporting the Jewish state, according to comments reported by The Hollywood Reporter on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 据《好莱坞报道》周三报道，以色列女演员诺亚·科恩对支持犹太国家的名人“压制艺术家”进行了反击。

paras.en: Cohen spoke to The Hollywood Reporter about her latest film "Our Loves," a drama set during the deadly Oct. 7 terror attacks in 2023. The film, one of the first to dramatize the events, drew criticism for being told largely through Israeli citizens' perspectives as Hollywood stars continue to speak out against Israel.
paras.zh: 科恩在接受《好莱坞报道》采访时谈到了她的最新电影《我们的爱》，该片以 2023 年 10 月 7 日发生的致命恐怖袭击为背景。这部电影是最早将这些事件戏剧化的电影之一，由于好莱坞明星继续公开反对以色列，影片主要通过以色列公民的视角来讲述，因此受到了批评。

paras.en: The 24-year-old actress, who knew many victims of the Hamas attacks, expressed dismay at celebrities' actions, particularly their calls to boycott Israeli film institutions.
paras.zh: 这位 24 岁的女演员认识哈马斯袭击的许多受害者，她对名人的行为，特别是他们呼吁抵制以色列电影机构表示失望。

paras.en: "Silencing artists because of government policies closes conversation. And don’t we need to keep that open?" Cohen said.
paras.zh: “因为政府政策而压制艺术家的声音就结束了对话。难道我们不需要保持开放吗？”科恩说道。

paras.en: In 2025, over 1,000 Hollywood stars, directors and other film workers, including Emma Stone and Mark Ruffalo, signed a pledge to boycott institutions such as festivals, cinemas, broadcasters and production companies that "are implicated in genocide and apartheid against the Palestinian people."
paras.zh: 2025年，包括艾玛·斯通和马克·鲁法洛在内的1000多名好莱坞明星、导演和其他电影工作者签署了一项承诺，抵制“涉嫌对巴勒斯坦人民进行种族灭绝和种族隔离”的节日、电影院、广播公司和制作公司等机构。

paras.en: Cohen denied films like "Our Loves" erased the Palestinian people and encouraged a more open mind.
paras.zh: 科恩否认像《我们的爱》这样的电影抹杀了巴勒斯坦人民，并鼓励人们采取更加开放的态度。

paras.en: "I mean, you don’t have to agree with a government to hear the stories of its people," Cohen said.
paras.zh: “我的意思是，你不必同意政府的观点才能听到其人民的故事，”科恩说。

paras.en: In the meantime, she told The Hollywood Reporter that she and several others are still grieving the losses of that day.
paras.zh: 与此同时，她告诉《好莱坞报道》，她和其他几人仍然为那天的损失感到悲痛。

paras.en: "You couldn’t really grieve until all the hostages were home," Cohen said. "So really we’re not even at the end of the first year of grieving. And there will be many more years."
paras.zh: 科恩说：“在所有人质都回家之前，你无法真正感到悲伤。” “所以实际上，我们的悲伤还没有结束。而且还会有很多年。”

paras.en: Cohen is perhaps best known for her portrayal as the Virgin Mary in Netflix's "Mary" film which premiered in 2024. At the time, Cohen's casting caused an uproar among anti-Israel critics for casting an Israeli woman in the role, insisting that the real Mary was "Palestinian."
paras.zh: 科恩最出名的作品可能是她在 2024 年首映的 Netflix 电影《玛丽》中扮演的圣母玛利亚。当时，科恩的选角引起了反以色列评论家的轩然大波，因为她让一名以色列女性出演这个角色，坚称真正的玛丽是“巴勒斯坦人”。

paras.en: The film's director, D.J. Caruso, previously defended the casting in a statement, saying, "It was important to us that Mary, along with most of our primary cast, be selected from Israel to ensure authenticity."
paras.zh: 这部电影的导演 D.J.卡鲁索此前在一份声明中为选角进行了辩护，他说：“对我们来说，重要的是玛丽和我们的大多数主要演员都从以色列挑选，以确保真实性。”

paras.en: In a comment to Fox News Digital, the Israeli-American Council (IAC) stood by Cohen's comments and called out efforts to target Israeli institutions and citizens.
paras.zh: 在对福克斯新闻数字频道的评论中，以色列-美国委员会（IAC）支持科恩的评论，并呼吁针对以色列机构和公民的行动。

paras.en: "Artists have every right to express their views, including views we may strongly disagree with. But freedom of speech does not mean freedom to apply a double standard and engage in discrimination," the IAC said. "There is a clear difference between criticizing Israel's government policies and targeting Israeli artists because of their faith or national origin. Boycotting Israeli artists in the name of artistic freedom is disingenuous, wrong, and a clear act of antisemitism."
paras.zh: “艺术家完全有权表达自己的观点，包括我们可能强烈不同意的观点。但言论自由并不意味着实行双重标准和进行歧视的自由，”IAC 表示。 “批评以色列政府政策和因为以色列艺术家的信仰或民族血统而针对以色列艺术家之间存在明显的区别。以艺术自由的名义抵制以色列艺术家是不诚实的、错误的，也是明显的反犹太主义行为。”

paras.en: Fox News' Hanna Panreck contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻的汉娜·潘雷克对此报道做出了贡献。

articles.title: Fox News AI Newsletter: 7 key midterm states put tech boom in focus

paras.en: - America’s multibillion tech boom comes into focus as 7 key states put it to a midterm test
paras.zh: - 美国数十亿美元的科技繁荣成为焦点，七个关键州对其进行中期测试

paras.en: - Jeff Bezos reveals his vision for America's next frontier — from AI to the moon
paras.zh: - 杰夫·贝索斯揭示了他对美国下一个前沿领域的愿景——从人工智能到月球

paras.en: - America’s new blue-collar job boom is one nobody saw coming — and it’s just getting started
paras.zh: - 美国新的蓝领就业热潮是没有人预料到的——而且它才刚刚开始

paras.en: PEOPLE DECIDE: The rapid buildout of data centers powering America’s artificial intelligence boom is heading to the ballot box this November, as voters across the country weigh measures that could shape where and how the massive facilities are built. Voters will decide 34 data center-related ballot measures across seven states — California, Florida, Illinois, Kansas, Nevada, Ohio and Wisconsin.
paras.zh: 人们决定：推动美国人工智能热潮的数据中心的快速建设将于今年 11 月进入投票箱，全国各地的选民都会权衡可能影响大型设施建设地点和方式的措施。选民将决定七个州（加利福尼亚州、佛罗里达州、伊利诺伊州、堪萨斯州、内华达州、俄亥俄州和威斯康星州）的 34 项与数据中心相关的投票措施。

paras.en: NEXT GIANT LEAP: Amazon founder Jeff Bezos laid out a sweeping vision for America’s future Wednesday, telling Fox News the U.S. must beat China to the moon, artificial intelligence could help families get by with less work and data centers could one day operate in space.
paras.zh: 下一个巨大飞跃：亚马逊创始人杰夫·贝佐斯周三对美国的未来提出了宏伟的愿景，他告诉福克斯新闻，美国必须击败中国登上月球，人工智能可以帮助家庭减少工作量，数据中心有一天可以在太空中运行。

paras.en: TRUST ISSUES: As artificial intelligence rapidly evolves to make financial scams hyperrealistic, cybersecurity experts warn that the best defense isn't sophisticated detection software. It's good old-fashioned human skepticism.
paras.zh: 信任问题：随着人工智能的迅速发展，金融诈骗变得超现实，网络安全专家警告说，最好的防御不是复杂的检测软件。这是很好的老式人类怀疑论。

paras.en: 'OUR CITY': A Memphis City Council meeting descended into chaos Tuesday night after lawmakers postponed a vote on a proposed yearlong moratorium on new data centers, as protesters chanted inside City Hall, police cleared the chamber and a fight broke out in the lobby.
paras.zh: “我们的城市”：周二晚上，孟菲斯市议会会议陷入混乱，议员们推迟了对拟议的为期一年的新数据中心暂停的投票，抗议者在市政厅内高喊口号，警察清理了会议厅，大厅里爆发了斗殴。

paras.en: FAMILY NIGHTMARE: A California mother and Navy veteran was having breakfast with her husband when a caller who cloned her daughter's voice claimed to have kidnapped her.
paras.zh: 家庭噩梦：一位加利福尼亚州的母亲和海军退伍军人正在与她的丈夫一起吃早餐，这时一个克隆了她女儿声音的打电话者声称绑架了她。

paras.en: MIND GAMES: A top official at the Department of War discussed how artificial intelligence is playing a role in war readiness strategy, and said foreign adversaries are carrying out "psyop" operations to fuel the anti-data center and anti-artificial intelligence movement across the U.S.
paras.zh: 思维游戏：战争部的一位高级官员讨论了人工智能如何在战备战略中发挥作用，并表示外国对手正在开展“心理战”行动，以推动美国各地的反数据中心和反人工智能运动。

paras.en: METAL MANIA: Investors have long prized gold as a hedge against inflation and economic uncertainty, but one of the world’s fastest-growing industries is now fueling a new source of demand for the precious metal. The buildout of artificial intelligence is driving investment in advanced semiconductors, servers and the sprawling data centers needed to power the technology. That expansion also requires a range of materials used in high-performance electronics, including gold.
paras.zh: 金属狂热：投资者长期以来一直将黄金视为对冲通胀和经济不确定性的工具，但世界上增长最快的行业之一现在正在推动对贵金属的新需求来源。人工智能的发展正在推动对先进半导体、服务器和支持该技术所需的庞大数据中心的投资。这种扩张还需要一系列用于高性能电子产品的材料，包括黄金。

paras.en: WIRED FOR WORK: Inside a sprawling Texas data center campus, blinking tower lights and rows of neatly organized cables power the technology Americans use every day. Keeping it all running, however, takes an army of electricians, mechanics, technicians and construction workers — and the industry says it needs more of them.
paras.zh: 工作连线：在德克萨斯州一个庞大的数据中心园区内，闪烁的塔灯和一排排整齐排列的电缆为美国人每天使用的技术提供动力。然而，要保持一切正常运转，需要一支由电工、机械师、技术人员和建筑工人组成的队伍——该行业表示需要更多的人员。

paras.en: TOMORROW'S TRADE-OFF: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said in an interview on Sunday that the benefits of artificial intelligence are enough to justify accepting some risks and suggesting that the public should continue to have broad access to the emerging technology.
paras.zh: 明天的权衡：OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 在周日接受采访时表示，人工智能的好处足以证明接受一些风险是合理的，并建议公众应继续广泛接触这项新兴技术。

paras.en: CAN'T SAY: During a Monday New York City Council hearing, representatives from OpenAI, Google, Meta and Anthropic were asked to assure under oath whether AI agents will always comply with safety guardrails to prevent catastrophic harm.
paras.zh: 不能说：在纽约市议会周一举行的听证会上，OpenAI、谷歌、Meta 和 Anthropic 的代表被要求宣誓保证人工智能代理是否将始终遵守安全护栏以防止灾难性伤害。

paras.en: FACE TIME: Chick-fil-A is bucking a growing fast-food industry trend, with CEO Andrew Cathy saying the chicken chain does not plan to use artificial intelligence to take customers' drive-thru orders.
paras.zh: 面对面：福来鸡正在逆着快餐行业不断增长的趋势，首席执行官安德鲁·凯西表示，这家鸡肉连锁店不打算使用人工智能来接受顾客的得来速订单。

paras.en: POWERING UP: President Donald Trump announced Sunday the creation of a new federal "Super Intelligence Force" tasked with coordinating the government’s efforts to keep the United States at the forefront of rapidly developing artificial intelligence technology.
paras.zh: 加强力量：唐纳德·特朗普总统周日宣布成立一支新的联邦“超级情报部队”，其任务是协调政府的努力，使美国保持在快速发展的人工智能技术的最前沿。

paras.en: FAST TRACK: Workers in the U.S. who use artificial intelligence regularly in their job are seeing benefits like working more quickly or creatively, though a new study finds that those gains aren't evenly distributed across the workforce.
paras.zh: 快速通道：在工作中经常使用人工智能的美国工人正在看到诸如工作速度更快或更具创造性等好处，尽管一项新的研究发现这些收益并没有均匀地分布在劳动力中。

paras.en: NEW TO CAMPUS: OpenAI on Wednesday announced that it's adding a college planner tool to its ChatGPT for Teens along with new study features on the platform.
paras.zh: 校园新功能：OpenAI 周三宣布，将在其针对青少年的 ChatGPT 中添加大学规划工具以及该平台上的新学习功能。

paras.en: Stay up to date on the latest AI technology advancements and learn about the challenges and opportunities AI presents now and for the future with Fox News here.
paras.zh: 通过福克斯新闻了解最新的人工智能技术进展，了解人工智能现在和未​​来带来的挑战和机遇。

articles.title: Schumer, Jeffries dodge Mamdani controversy as fellow New York Dem unloads

paras.en: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani has come under fire for his comments on the Oct. 7, 2023, attack on Israel, but two leading voices in New York politics have so far remained quiet.
paras.zh: 纽约市市长佐兰·马姆达尼 (Zohran Mamdani) 因其对 2023 年 10 月 7 日以色列袭击事件的评论而受到批评，但纽约政坛的两个主要声音迄今为止仍保持沉默。

paras.en: Mamdani’s post on Wednesday briefly acknowledged Hamas’ blitz on Israel that left more than 1,100 Israelis dead and more than 250 others captured and held hostage by the terrorist organization. But the bulk of his statement spent time on criticizing Israel for its actions in Gaza in the three years since.
paras.zh: 马姆达尼周三的帖子简要承认了哈马斯对以色列的闪电袭击，导致 1,100 多名以色列人死亡，另有 250 多人被该恐怖组织抓获并扣为人质。但他的声明大部分时间都在批评以色列三年来在加沙的行动。

paras.en: "The suffering did not begin nor end that day. It instead continued through the Israeli government’s devastating, ongoing genocide in Gaza, in which it has killed more than 74,000 Palestinians — including more than 21,000 children," Mamdani said on X. "Even since the so-called ceasefire, more than 1,400 Palestinians have been killed."
paras.zh: 马姆达尼在 X 台上表示：“苦难并没有从那天开始，也没有结束。相反，以色列政府在加沙实施毁灭性的、持续的种族灭绝，造成了74,000 多名巴勒斯坦人死亡，其中包括 21,000 多名儿童。即使自所谓的停火以来，仍有超过 1,400 名巴勒斯坦人被杀害。”

paras.en: "That suffering has intensified with every Israeli bomb dropped on ambulances waiting outside hospitals, every drone strike targeting a residential building or journalist, and every shipment of food aid turned away at a border crossing," he continued. "Many New Yorkers are reckoning with this unbearable grief, and we mourn alongside them — all while knowing that our tax dollars fund these war crimes."
paras.zh: 他继续说道：“以色列每向医院外等待的救护车投下一枚炸弹，每一次针对住宅楼或记者的无人机袭击，以及每批粮食援助都在过境点被拒之门外，这种痛苦都会加剧。” “许多纽约人正在承受这种难以忍受的悲痛，我们与他们一起哀悼——同时知道我们的税款资助了这些战争罪行。”

paras.en: Mamdani notably did not mention the Jewish community in New York City, which is home to nearly 1 million Jews, according to a 2023 study from the UJA-Federation of New York.
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，马姆达尼没有提及纽约市的犹太社区，根据纽约 UJA 联合会 2023 年的一项研究，纽约市有近 100 万犹太人。

paras.en: And while at least one New York Democrat, Rep. Dan Goldman, laid into Mamdani for his comments, neither Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer nor House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries, the two most powerful Democrats in Congress, has reacted.
paras.zh: 尽管至少一位纽约民主党众议员丹·戈德曼(Dan Goldman)对马姆达尼的言论进行了猛烈抨击，但国会中最有权势的两位民主党人参议院少数党领袖查克·舒默(Chuck Schumer)和众议院少数党领袖哈基姆·杰弗里斯(Hakeem Jeffries)都没有做出反应。

paras.en: "This is a reprehensible statement on the anniversary of the horrific terrorist attack by a Palestinian terrorist organization against innocent Israelis," Goldman said on X. "In the guise of ‘grieving’ with those mourning that day, Mayor Mamdani asserts as fact hotly disputed allegations that he knows full well will offend and further upset those same people he pretends to grieve with."
paras.zh: 高盛在 X 上表示：“在巴勒斯坦恐怖组织对无辜以色列人发动可怕恐怖袭击一周年之际，这是一份应受谴责的声明。”“马姆达尼市长以向那天哀悼的人们‘哀悼’为幌子，声称这是备受争议的事实，他完全知道这些指控会冒犯并进一步激怒那些他假装哀悼的人。”

paras.en: Neither Schumer nor Jeffries responded to requests for comment on Mamdani's remarks. They put out their own statements on the Oct. 7 attack on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 舒默和杰弗里斯都没有回应对马姆达尼言论发表评论的请求。他们周三就 10 月 7 日的袭击事件发表了自己的声明。

paras.en: Schumer, who is Jewish, noted that the attack was the "single deadliest day in Jewish history since the Holocaust." His support of Israel has become a wedge issue for some Senate Democrats, who have slowly pushed back against funding arms for Israel following three years of conflict in Gaza.
paras.zh: 犹太人舒默指出，这次袭击是“自大屠杀以来犹太历史上最致命的一天”。他对以色列的支持已成为一些参议院民主党人的一个棘手问题，在加沙冲突三年后，他们逐渐反对为以色列提供资金。

paras.en: "Today, we reaffirm our commitment to the security of the Israeli people, to the aid and wellbeing of the Palestinian people and the recovery of the devastation in Gaza that the ensuing conflict brought, and to doubling down on efforts for a lasting peace resulting in two states where Israelis and Palestinians can live side by side in equal measures of peace, security, dignity, and mutual recognition," Schumer said.
paras.zh: 舒默表示：“今天，我们重申致力于以色列人民的安全、巴勒斯坦人民的援助和福祉以及恢复加沙随后冲突带来的破坏，并加倍努力实现持久和平，从而建立以色列人和巴勒斯坦人能够在平等的和平、安全、尊严和相互承认的条件下毗邻共存的两个国家。”

paras.en: Jeffries was more aligned with Schumer’s left flank in his statement, while recognizing that "we are reminded of the painful reality that the Jewish people are in a constant struggle for survival, as has been the case for thousands of years."
paras.zh: 杰弗里斯在声明中更倾向于舒默的左翼，同时承认“我们想起了痛苦的现​​实，即犹太人民不断为生存而斗争，就像数千年来的情况一样。”

paras.en: "Throughout the past three years, considerable suffering has plagued the Middle East. The horrific death of Palestinian civilians, destruction of civil society and devastation in Gaza is reprehensible and can never be allowed to happen again," Jeffries said.
paras.zh: 杰弗里斯说：“过去三年来，中东地区遭受了巨大的苦难。巴勒斯坦平民的惨死、民间社会的破坏以及加沙的破坏应受到谴责，决不能允许再次发生。”

paras.en: "In order to end the vicious cycle of bloodshed, for the good of the Israeli and Palestinian people, American policy in the region must change dramatically," he continued. "We must commit to the creation of an independent Palestinian state to provide dignity, respect and self-determination for the Palestinian people."
paras.zh: 他继续说道：“为了结束流血的恶性循环，为了以色列和巴勒斯坦人民的利益，美国在该地区的政策必须发生巨大改变。” “我们必须致力于建立一个独立的巴勒斯坦国，为巴勒斯坦人民提供尊严、尊重和自决。”

articles.title: Israel promotes film that mimics NAZA documentary
articles.author: Louisa Loveluck

paras.en: The Israeli government is promoting an online film project that mimics the style of NAZA, the award-winning documentary that details Israel’s mass killings of civilians in Gaza, in an attempt to counter the real film’s findings.
paras.zh: 以色列政府正在推广一个模仿《NAZA》风格的在线电影项目，这部获奖纪录片详细描述了以色列在加沙大规模屠杀平民的行为，试图反驳真实电影的调查结果。

paras.en: The real documentary, directed by the Oscar-winning film-makers Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, and produced by the Guardian, is in cinemas and will be shown in more than 50 countries.
paras.zh: 这部真实的纪录片由奥斯卡获奖电影制作人尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕 (Yuval Abraham) 和雷切尔·索尔 (Rachel Szor) 执导，由《卫报》制作，现已在 50 多个国家的影院上映。

paras.en: The Israeli government has denounced the film and announced plans to strip Abraham and Szor of their citizenship, accusing them of treason.
paras.zh: 以色列政府谴责了这部电影，并宣布计划剥夺亚伯拉罕和索尔的公民身份，指控他们叛国。

paras.en: In recent days, Israeli embassies have been promoting a link to a hastily produced online film entitled NAZA: The Real Story. Mimicking some of the style of the real documentary, including the use of anonymised interviews shot on rooftops in Tel Aviv, it is hosted on a website called nazadocumentary.com.
paras.zh: 最近几天，以色列大使馆一直在宣传一部仓促制作的在线电影《NAZA：真实的故事》的链接。它模仿了真实纪录片的一些风格，包括使用在特拉维夫屋顶拍摄的匿名采访，并在一个名为 nazadocumentary.com 的网站上托管。

paras.en: Ariel Averbuch, an Israeli attorney and army reservist who made the new documentary, described it as an “offensive move” intended to shift the world’s focus from allegations about the Israeli military’s killing of civilians. The film claims that Israel has the “most moral army in the world”.
paras.zh: 制作这部新纪录片的以色列律师兼预备役军人阿里尔·阿弗布奇 (Ariel Averbuch) 将其描述为“进攻性举动”，旨在转移世界对以色列军队杀害平民指控的注意力。影片声称以色列拥有“世界上最有道德的军队”。

paras.en: Another film-maker listed on the website for NAZA: The Real Story is Roi Danino, a candidate for the rightwing Israel First party.
paras.zh: 《NAZA：真实故事》网站上列出的另一位电影制片人是罗伊·达尼诺 (Roi Danino)，他是右翼以色列第一党的候选人。

paras.en: The website domain was registered on 16 September, six days after NAZA’s premiere at the Venice international film festival, where it won the special jury prize after receiving the longest ovation in the festival’s history.
paras.zh: 该网站域名于 9 月 16 日注册，即《NAZA》在威尼斯国际电影节首映六天后，该片在威尼斯国际电影节上获得了电影节历史上最长的掌声，并获得了评审团特别奖。

paras.en: Initially, the website falsely presented itself as a promotional page for NAZA itself, naming Abraham and Szor as the directors, and listing film festivals where the documentary was due to be screened.
paras.zh: 最初，该网站错误地将自己定位为 NAZA 本身的宣传页面，将亚伯拉罕和索尔命名为导演，并列出了该纪录片将在哪些电影节上放映。

paras.en: “Shot at night on the rooftops of Tel Aviv, the film reveals in detail the systems behind Israel’s calculated mass killing of terrorists in Gaza,” it said, distorting the film’s official synopsis by removing the reference to the deaths of Palestinian civilians.
paras.zh: “这部电影于夜间在特拉维夫的屋顶上拍摄，详细揭示了以色列在加沙有计划地大规模屠杀恐怖分子背后的系统，”它说，通过删除对巴勒斯坦平民死亡的提及，歪曲了电影的官方概要。

paras.en: That wording was removed from recent updates of the website, once the video for NAZA: The Real Story had been added to the page.
paras.zh: 在《NAZA：真实故事》的视频添加到页面后，该措辞从该网站最近的更新中删除。

paras.en: It now appears as a platform for the rival film, with a counter that implausibly suggests the short film has been watched more than 42m times. (The film’s official YouTube page is listed as having just 30,000 views.)
paras.zh: 它现在似乎是竞争对手电影的平台，其计数器令人难以置信地表明该短片的观看次数已超过 4200 万次。 （这部电影的官方 YouTube 页面显示只有 30,000 次观看。）

paras.en: According to a technical analysis, the discrepancy suggested the viewer counter could have been driven by requests made to the website, by humans or bots, rather than the number of people who actually watched the video. When asked about the source of the 42m claim, Averbuch said he did not know and referred the questions to his tech team.
paras.zh: 根据技术分析，这种差异表明观看者计数器可能是由人类或机器人向网站发出的请求驱动的，而不是实际观看视频的人数。当被问及 4200 万美元索赔的来源时，Averbuch 表示他不知道，并将问题转交给他的技术团队。

paras.en: The Israeli military has killed more than 73,000 Palestinians in Gaza since the Hamas attacks of 7 October 2023, in a military campaign that a United Nations commission has described as genocide.
paras.zh: 自 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯袭击以来，以色列军队已在加沙杀害了超过 73,000 名巴勒斯坦人，联合国委员会将这场军事行动称为种族灭绝。

paras.en: The 24 interviews with Israeli military insiders in the original film NAZA detail how an AI-assisted apparatus of mass surveillance was activated during the Gaza war, revealing the systems that were used to target Hamas operatives in the knowledge large numbers of Palestinian civilians would also die.
paras.zh: 原版电影《NAZA》对以色列军方内部人士进行了 24 次采访，详细介绍了加沙战争期间人工智能辅助的大规模监视设备是如何启动的，揭示了用于瞄准哈马斯特工的系统，因为他们知道大量巴勒斯坦平民也会死亡。

paras.en: The Israeli embassy to the US, which shared the new documentary on its social media, said the ministry of foreign affairs was not involved in producing the film, and that it had intended only to “amplify the message of its creators and expose wider audiences to arguments challenging and dismantling the blood libels and false allegations”.
paras.zh: 以色列驻美国大使馆在其社交媒体上分享了这部新纪录片，并表示外交部没有参与这部电影的制作，其目的只是“扩大其创作者的信息，让更广泛的观众了解挑战和消除血腥诽谤和虚假指控的论点”。

paras.en: The Israeli government said on Thursday that it was awarding the film-makers with a certificate of appreciation “for their contribution to Israeli public diplomacy”, claiming the production had garnered tens of millions of views.
paras.zh: 以色列政府周四表示，将向电影制片人颁发感谢状，以表彰他们“对以色列公共外交的贡献”，并声称该作品已获得数千万次观看。

paras.en: A Guardian spokesperson said: “We are aware that the Israeli government has been promoting a film hosted on a website that initially – and falsely – claimed it was Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor’s documentary.
paras.zh: 卫报发言人表示：“我们知道，以色列政府一直在宣传在一个网站上托管的一部影片，该网站最初并错误地声称这是尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕和雷切尔·索尔的纪录片。

paras.en: “This was a brazen attempt to mislead audiences and distract from the urgent questions raised by NAZA.”
paras.zh: “这是一种厚颜无耻的企图，目的是误导观众并分散人们对 NAZA 提出的紧迫问题的注意力。”

paras.en: As well as its global cinema releases, NAZA will be available free on the Guardian’s website from late November.
paras.zh: 除了在全球上映的电影外，《NAZA》将于 11 月底在《卫报》网站上免费提供。

paras.en: Averbuch is the founder of an organisation that says it conducts “advocacy warfare”, including through the publication of scripts to help influencers criticise Abraham and Szor’s critically acclaimed previous film, No Other Land, which documents the destruction of the Palestinian village Masafer Yatta. The two Palestinian co-directors of No Other Land, Basel Adra and Hamdan Ballal, have been harassed or detained by the Israeli military since the film won an Oscar in 2025.
paras.zh: 阿弗布奇是一个组织的创始人，该组织自称正在进行“宣传战”，包括通过出版脚本来帮助有影响力的人批评亚伯拉罕和索尔之前广受好评的电影《没有其他土地》，该片记录了巴勒斯坦村庄马萨费尔·亚塔 (Masafer Yatta) 被毁的故事。自从该片于 2025 年获得奥斯卡奖以来，《无他之地》的两位巴勒斯坦联合导演巴塞尔·阿德拉和哈姆丹·巴拉尔一直受到以色列军方的骚扰或拘留。

paras.en: Israeli government officials have scrambled to discredit NAZA’s content, while far-right activists have threatened to hunt down the directors.
paras.zh: 以色列政府官员纷纷抹黑 NAZA 的内容，而极右翼活动人士则威胁要追捕这些导演。

paras.en: The Israel Defense Forces’ chief of staff, Eyal Zamir, has said they will use “every tool at our disposal” against the film, while the military has issued a 10-page response to the film, which was based on interviews with more than 100 sources with knowledge of the military systems used in the war.
paras.zh: 以色列国防军参谋长埃亚尔·扎米尔 (Eyal Zamir) 表示，他们将使用“我们可以使用的一切工具”来对付这部电影，而军方则针对这部电影发布了长达 10 页的回应，该回应基于对 100 多名了解战争中使用的军事系统的消息来源的采访。

paras.en: Within a week of NAZA’s premiere, Israel’s ministry of culture had announced a formal investigation into the documentary, calling for Abraham and Szor to be stripped of their citizenship.
paras.zh: 《NAZA》首映一周内，以色列文化部宣布对这部纪录片进行正式调查，呼吁剥夺亚伯拉罕和索尔的公民身份。

paras.en: Demonstrators gathered outside the home of Szor’s parents, demanding that the she face the death penalty, and a mural depicting the film-makers through the sights of a gun appeared in the Israeli city of Ashdod.
paras.zh: 示威者聚集在索尔父母的家外，要求判处她死刑，以色列城市阿什杜德出现了一幅通过枪瞄准器描绘电影制片人的壁画。

paras.en: On Monday, the far-right Israeli activist Mordechai David announced he was fundraising in order to establish a team that would “chase” Abraham. “We’ll find him,” David said in a video posted to Instagram.
paras.zh: 周一，以色列极右翼活动人士莫迪凯·大卫宣布，他正在筹款，以建立一支“追赶”亚伯拉罕的团队。 “我们会找到他的，”大卫在 Instagram 上发布的视频中说道。

paras.en: Szor and Abraham addressed the backlash to their documentary at a Q&A after its New York premiere. “Our country is doing so much to hide these systems,” Szor told the audience. “It’s not a world that is open even to the Israeli public.”
paras.zh: 索尔和亚伯拉罕在纽约首映后的问答中谈到了人们对他们的纪录片的强烈反对。 “我们的国家正在做很多事情来隐藏这些系统，”索尔告诉观众。 “这甚至不是一个对以色列公众开放的世界。”

paras.en: At the London film festival on Thursday, one of NAZA’s producers, James Wilson, said Israeli politicians’ “hysterical, vituperative, aggressive backlash” to the documentary had not been anticipated by the team behind it.
paras.zh: 在周四的伦敦电影节上，NAZA 的制片人之一詹姆斯·威尔逊 (James Wilson) 表示，以色列政客对这部纪录片的“歇斯底里、谩骂和攻击性的强烈反对”是其背后的团队没有预料到的。

paras.en: Wilson said although Abraham and Szor had “anticipated displeasure … there wasn’t an anticipation of the level of aggression leading to these threats and the rabble-rousing aspect”.
paras.zh: 威尔逊表示，尽管亚伯拉罕和索尔“预料到会感到不满……但并没有预料到会导致这些威胁和煽动暴民的侵略程度”。

paras.en: He added: “To have made a film, a documentary film and be threatened by the political elites of your home country, with charges of treason and defamation … it’s been very difficult and stressful and horrible and scary for them.
paras.zh: 他补充道：“制作一部电影，一部纪录片，并受到祖国政治精英的威胁，并被指控叛国和诽谤……这对他们来说非常困难、压力很大、可怕和可怕。

paras.en: “I try to look at the overwhelmingly positive reaction to the film in the majority of the world.”
paras.zh: “我试图了解世界上大多数国家对这部电影的压倒性积极反应。”

paras.en: Additional reporting by Philip McMahon and Rachel Hall
paras.zh: 菲利普·麦克马洪和雷切尔·霍尔的补充报道

articles.title: Astronomers detect mysterious burst of energy from a galaxy far, far away
articles.author: Donna Lu

paras.en: A long time ago in a galaxy far, far away, a mysterious flash of energy was released into the universe.
paras.zh: 很久以前，在一个遥远的星系中，一股神秘的能量闪光被释放到宇宙中。

paras.en: Astronomers have now detected that flash, a burst of radio waves which travelled for more than 10bn years before reaching Earth – what they believe to be the most distant fast radio burst (FRB) ever recorded.
paras.zh: 天文学家现在已经检测到了这种闪光，这是一种无线电波爆发，在到达地球之前已经传播了超过 100 亿年——他们认为这是有史以来有记录的最遥远的快速射电暴 (FRB)。

paras.en: FRBs are intense bursts of radio waves that can emit as much energy in milliseconds as the sun does in months or years. These mysterious pulses were first discovered in 2007 and have puzzled scientists ever since, with speculation from some that they could have an alien origin.
paras.zh: FRB 是强烈的无线电波爆发，可以在几毫秒内释放出与太阳在数月或数年中释放的能量一样多的能量。这些神秘的脉冲于 2007 年首次被发现，此后一直困扰着科学家，一些人猜测它们可能来自外星。

paras.en: In a new study published in Science, researchers have detected an FRB that originated when the universe was only about 3bn years old, meaning it has travelled through “approximately 80% of cosmic history”.
paras.zh: 在《科学》杂志上发表的一项新研究中，研究人员发现了一种快速射电暴，它起源于宇宙仅约 30 亿年的历史，这意味着它已经走过了“大约 80% 的宇宙历史”。

paras.en: The burst, dubbed FRB 20240304B, is believed to be the farthest yet detected, more than double the previous distance record.
paras.zh: 此次爆发被称为 FRB 20240304B，据信是迄今为止检测到的最远距离，是之前距离记录的两倍多。

paras.en: The scientists detected the burst using the MeerKAT radio telescope in South Africa, and subsequently identified its host galaxy using Nasa’s James Webb space telescope (JWST).
paras.zh: 科学家们使用南非的 MeerKAT 射电望远镜探测到了这次爆发，随后使用美国宇航局的詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜 (JWST) 识别出了它的宿主星系。

paras.en: Dr Themiya Nanayakkara of the University of Sydney, one of the lead researchers on the paper, said when the burst was produced, “there was no Earth, there was no sun”.
paras.zh: 该论文的主要研究人员之一、悉尼大学的 Themiya Nanayakkara 博士表示，当爆发产生时，“没有地球，也没有太阳”。

paras.en: Data from the JWST indicated that the burst originated from a “young, very small galaxy which is forming stars at a very high speed, with not many metals around it”.
paras.zh: 詹姆斯韦伯太空望远镜的数据表明，这次爆发起源于一个“年轻、非常小的星系，它正在以非常高的速度形成恒星，周围没有太多金属”。

paras.en: There are several theories as to what the source of FRBs is, including that they originate from magnetars, neutron stars with a very powerful magnetic field.
paras.zh: 关于快速射电暴的来源有多种理论，其中包括它们起源于磁星，即具有非常强大磁场的中子星。

paras.en: “Whatever the mechanism that causes this radio burst has to account for that fact that it can be produced in … very young galaxies with very low amount of metals”, Nanayakkara said.
paras.zh: 纳纳亚卡拉说：“无论导致这种射电爆发的机制是什么，都必须考虑到它可以在……金属含量非常低的非常年轻的星系中产生”这一事实。

paras.en: More than 10,000 FRBs have been detected since 2007. Some repeat continuously, Nanayakkara said, while “some of them repeat for a while and then stop … and then there are some FRBs that only go once and we never see again”.
paras.zh: 自 2007 年以来，已经检测到超过 10,000 个快速射电暴。Nanayakkara 说，有些快速射电暴不断重复，而“有些快速射电暴会重复一段时间，然后停止……还有一些快速射电暴只出现一次，我们就再也看不到了”。

paras.en: Whether the new distant burst is a one-off flash or will yield recurrent signals remains to be seen.
paras.zh: 新的远程爆发是一次性闪光还是会产生反复信号仍有待观察。

paras.en: But “the fun thing about FRBs is that we don’t need to know what is causing them to do some of the science we are doing now,” Nanayakkara said.
paras.zh: 但“快速射电暴的有趣之处在于，我们不需要知道是什么导致它们进行我们现在正在做的一些科学研究，”纳纳亚卡拉说。

paras.en: This particular burst “has been travelling for 80% of the age of the universe”, he said, adding that further detections of distant FRBs would enable scientists to map unseen matter in the distant universe.
paras.zh: 他说，这种特殊的爆发“已经传播了宇宙年龄的 80%”，并补充说，对遥远的快速射电暴的进一步探测将使科学家能够绘制遥远宇宙中看不见的物质的地图。

paras.en: Prof Matthew Bailes of Swinburne University, one of the astrophysicists who first discovered FRBs, described the new paper as “a validation of how powerful the FRBs are for probing the universe”.
paras.zh: 斯威本大学的马修·拜尔斯教授是最早发现快速射电暴的天体物理学家之一，他将这篇新论文描述为“验证了快速射电暴对于探测宇宙的强大作用”。

paras.en: Bailes described them as “a very fundamental way of counting how many atoms there are in the universe”. FRBs are affected by the particles they travel through, enabling scientists to quantify matter that cannot be seen through optical telescopes.
paras.zh: 拜尔斯将它们描述为“计算宇宙中有多少原子的一种非常基本的方法”。快速射电暴受到它们所穿过的粒子的影响，使科学家能够量化通过光学望远镜无法看到的物质。

paras.en: Dr Sara Webb, an astrophysicist also at Swinburne University who was not involved in the research, said: “You can use them essentially as a line-of-sight count for how much matter they had to go through [to get to Earth].”
paras.zh: 斯威本大学的天体物理学家萨拉·韦伯博士没有参与这项研究，她说：“你基本上可以用它们来计算它们必须经过多少物质才能到达地球。”

paras.en: The discovery suggests that “FRBs might have been very common in the early universe”, she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说，这一发现表明“快速射电暴在早期宇宙中可能非常普遍”。

articles.title: Nicolás Maduro and his wife indicted for alleged torture of US citizens
articles.author: Victoria Bekiempis
